/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ATS_Collection_daliy]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ATS_Collection_daliy] as
   Declare @date as datetime
    Declare @count as int
    Declare @loopcount as int 
set nocount on
BEGIN

truncate table ats_collection_daywise

set @count=datepart(dd,getdate()-1)
    set @loopcount=1
    set @date=convert(datetime,convert(varchar,DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(getdate()-1)-1),getdate()-1),106))
    
	WHILE ( @loopcount<=@count)
		Begin
	    insert into ats_collection_daywise 
		select case when day(a.date1)=1 then east_mkt_coll else isnull(east_mkt_coll,0)+isnull(east_act_mkt,0) end as east_act_mkt,
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then west_mkt_coll else isnull(west_mkt_coll,0)+isnull(west_act_mkt,0) end as west_act_mkt, 
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then north_mkt_coll else isnull(north_mkt_coll,0)+isnull(north_act_mkt,0) end as north_act_mkt ,
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then south_mkt_coll else isnull(south_mkt_coll,0)+isnull(south_act_mkt,0) end  as south_act_mkt,
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then east_aftsale_coll else isnull(east_aftsale_coll,0)+isnull(east_act_aftsale,0) end as east_act_aftsale, 
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then west_aftsale_coll else isnull(west_aftsale_coll,0)+isnull(west_act_aftsale,0) end as west_act_aftsale , 
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then north_aftsale_coll else isnull(north_aftsale_coll,0)+isnull(north_act_aftsale,0) end as north_act_aftsale ,
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then south_aftsale_coll else isnull(south_aftsale_coll,0)+isnull(south_act_aftsale,0) end as south_act_aftsale,
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then other_coll else isnull(other_coll,0)+isnull(other_sale,0) end as other_sale,
			 case when day(a.date1)=1 then export_coll else isnull(export_coll,0)+isnull(export_act,0) end as export_act,
			date1 from 
				(select * from vw_ats_collection_daywise_act where date1=@date )a
			left outer join
				(select * from ats_collection_daywise where date =convert(datetime,convert(varchar,@date-1,106)))b
			on a.date1=b.date+1
				order by date1

		set @date=@date+1
		set @loopcount=@loopcount+1
	   END

END



GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ATS_Collection_daywise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ATS_Collection_daywise] as

BEGIN

--New Method

truncate table ats_collection_daywise

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ATS_DailyInventory] as
Begin


Truncate table ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1
Truncate table ATS_DailyInventory
Truncate table ATS_DailyInventory2





--drop table ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1

Insert into ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 (COMPANY,CWAR,ITEMCODE,TRDT,QSKT,amnt)
--select * into ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM as ItemCode,b.T$TRDT TRDT,b.QSKT,(c.Amnt/b.QSTK)*b.QSKT from 
(select COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM
--,sum(QHND) QHND 
from TWHWMD215ALL
group by COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM
having sum(QHND)>0
)a

left  outer join

(select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP,sum(T$QSTK) QSTK,sum(T$QSKT) QSKT from TWHINA112ALL
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP
having sum(T$QSKT)>0)b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(a.CWAR))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$CWAR))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$ITEM))

left  outer join

(select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP,sum(T$AMNT$1) amnt from TWHINA113ALL
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP)c
on b.COMPANY=c.COMPANY
and b.T$CWAR=c.T$CWAR
and b.T$ITEM=c.T$ITEM
and b.T$TRDT=c.T$TRDT
and b.T$SEQN=c.T$SEQN
and b.T$INWP=c.T$INWP

where a.company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and a.CWAR  in (--'639', --Commented on request from ATS on 10-01-19
'651','652','653','654','655','667','674','675')
--)a

--alter table ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 add item_desc nvarchar(60) null
--alter table ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 add BuyerCode varchar(50) null

--alter table ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 add DeptName varchar(50) null



update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set item_desc=d.Description
from
(select t_dsca as Description,t_item as itemcode from ttcibd001600)d
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.itemcode)) = ltrim(rtrim(d.itemcode))

--BuyerCode and SuppCode for Lean Items
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BuyerCode=a.BUYR,SuppCode=a.SUNO1
from (
select * from TZZPUR049ALL a
where a.company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and BUYR is not null
--and ltrim(rtrim(ITEM))='110460710'
) a
where substring(ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.company,1,1)=substring(a.COMPANY,1,1) and 
ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.itemcode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))


--BuyerCode and SuppCode for Non Lean Items
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BuyerCode=a.BUYR,SuppCode=a.OTBP

and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.itemcode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))
and ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.BuyerCode is null


update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BuyerName=a.emp_name
from

where ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.BuyerCode= a.new_emp_code

update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set SuppName=a.custname1
from vw_Business_Partner a
where ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.SuppCode=a.custcode


update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set binQty=a.SQTY,SOPS=a.SOPS,DivCode=a.DIVI,DeptCode=a.DEPT
from (select * from TZZPUR049ALL 
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.itemcode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))

update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set DivName=a.DIVISION_NAME
from Materials_Division_MASTER a
where ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.divcode=a.DIVISION_CODE


update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set DeptName=a.Dept_Name
from MATERIALS_DEPT_MASTER a
where ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1.Deptcode=a.Dept_code

update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BinType='TWO BIN' where sops=1
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BinType='MULTIBIN' where sops=2
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BinType='MILKRUN' where sops=3
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BinType='MR-MOTORS' where sops=4
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BinType='FWD COVER' where sops=5
update ATS_DailyInventory_Stage1 set BinType='SINGLE BIN' where sops=6

--where DeptCode is not null

--)a


--Alter table ATS_DailyInventory2 alter column ExcessQty float
--Alter table ATS_DailyInventory2 alter column ExcessVal float
--Alter table ATS_DailyInventory2 alter column PriceSource varchar(25)
--Alter table ATS_DailyInventory2 alter column Currency varchar(25)
--Alter table ATS_DailyInventory2 alter column CurRate float


update ATS_DailyInventory2 set UnitPrice=null where company=600 and DeptCode is not null


--Unit price update from the Monthly file data provided by ATS Materials Team 
update ATS_DailyInventory2 set UnitPrice=a.Unitprice,PriceSource='FileData',Currency='IND',CurRate=1
from 
(
select * from
(select *,row_number() over (partition by Company,Wh,Item order by Company,Wh,Item,period desc) rnk from 
(select Company,Wh,Item,concat(Year,Month) as Period,avg(isnull(Unitprice,0)) Unitprice
--,count(Unitprice) Unitprice 
from ATS_Inv_UnitPrice
group by Company,Wh,Item,concat(Year,Month))a
)b
where rnk=1
) a
where ATS_DailyInventory2.company=a.Company
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory2.cwar))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Wh))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory2.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))
and ATS_DailyInventory2.DeptCode is not null


----Unit price update from the PBS Table for the missing items in the File shared by ATS
----Method 1
----update ATS_DailyInventory2 set UnitPrice=a.BAPR
----from (select OTBP,ITEM,BAPR,EXDT from TTDPCG031ALL where EXDT >getdate()--'9999-01-01 00:00:00.000'
----and PRBK='pur000001' )a
----where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory2.SuppCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.OTBP))
----and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory2.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))
----and ATS_DailyInventory2.UnitPrice is null



--Method 2 
update ATS_DailyInventory2 set PriceSource='PBS',Currency=b.CURN,CurRate=b.RATE,UnitPrice=b.BAPR
from (
select * from (
select *,ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by a.otbp,a.item,a.curn,a.bapr,a.efdt order by b.stdt desc) DateRnk from 
(select OTBP,ITEM,CURN,BAPR,EFDT,EXDT from TTDPCG031ALL where EXDT >getdate()-1
and PRBK='pur000001')a
left outer join
(select CCUR,RATE,STDT from TCMCS008ALL where ccur<>'IND' and bcur='IND')b
on a.CURN=b.CCUR
and a.EFDT>=b.STDT
where ltrim(rtrim(a.OTBP)) <>''
)a
where DateRnk=1
)b
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory2.SuppCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_DailyInventory2.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ATS_DailyInventory2.DeptCode is not null
and ATS_DailyInventory2.UnitPrice is null


update ATS_DailyInventory2 set CurRate=1 where PriceSource='PBS' and Currency='IND'
and ATS_DailyInventory2.DeptCode is not null

update ATS_DailyInventory2 set UnitPrice=UnitPrice*CurRate where PriceSource='PBS'
and ATS_DailyInventory2.DeptCode is not null


update ATS_DailyInventory2 set amnt=isnull(UnitPrice,0)* QSKT where DeptCode is not null


update ATS_DailyInventory2 set ExcessQty=QSKT-binQty where QSKT>binQty 
update ATS_DailyInventory2 set ExcessVal=(QSKT-binQty)*UnitPrice  where QSKT>binQty



update ATS_DailyInventory2 set deptcode=9999,deptname='ZZZ' where DeptCode is null

delete from ATS_DailyInventory2 where QSKT is null or QSKT=0


end

select * from ATS_DailyInventory

Begin


Truncate table ATS_Inv_Open_Close

Insert into ATS_Inv_Open_Close(COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,Date1,ORNO,KOOR_R,QSTK_R,QSKT_R)
--Drop table ATS_Inv_Open_Close
--select * into ATS_Inv_Open_Close from (
select COMPANY,T$CWAR CWAR,T$ITEM ITEM,convert(date,T$TRDT) Date1,T$ORNO ORNO,T$KOOR KOOR_R,
sum(isnull(T$QSTK,0)) QSTK_R,sum(isnull(T$QSKT,0)) QSKT_R from TWHINA112ALL
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,convert(date,T$TRDT),T$KOOR,T$ORNO
--)a

--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add KOOR_I int
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add QSTK_I float

--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add PUR_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add WHT_R float 
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add ADJ_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add PRD_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add SLS_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add FOC_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add BTA_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add SCR_R float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add OTH_R float


--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add PUR_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add WHT_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add ADJ_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add PRD_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add SLS_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add FOC_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add BTA_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add SCR_I float
--Alter  table ATS_Inv_Open_Close add OTH_I float


Insert into ATS_Inv_Open_Close(COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,Date1,ORNO,KOOR_I,QSTK_I)
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,convert(date,T$CTDT) T$CTDT,T$ORNO,T$KOOR KOOR_I,
sum(isnull(T$QSTK,0)) QSTK_I from TWHINA114ALL
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,convert(date,T$CTDT),T$KOOR,T$ORNO

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set PUR_R=QSTK_R where KOOR_R in (2)
update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set PUR_I=QSTK_I where KOOR_I in (2)

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set WHT_R=QSTK_R where KOOR_R in (22,36)
update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set WHT_I=QSTK_I where KOOR_I in (22,36)

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set ADJ_R=QSTK_R where KOOR_R in (52)
update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set ADJ_I=QSTK_I where KOOR_I in (52)

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set PRD_R=QSTK_R where KOOR_R in (1,32,46)
update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set PRD_I=QSTK_I where KOOR_I in (1,32,46)

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set SLS_R=QSTK_R where KOOR_R in (3)
update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set SLS_I=QSTK_I where KOOR_I in (3)

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set OTH_R=QSTK_R where KOOR_R in (35,42,51,100)
update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set OTH_I=QSTK_I where KOOR_I in (35,42,51,100)

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set BTA_I= A.DeliveryQty
FROM (select COMPANY,CONVERT(DATE,Invoice_Date) Invoice_Date,warehouse,ITEM,SUM(DeliveryQty) DeliveryQty  from LN_SALES_BDI 
where custcode in ('CU1A03537','CU1A03538')
GROUP BY COMPANY,Invoice_Date,warehouse,ITEM
)A
WHERE ATS_Inv_Open_Close.COMPANY=A.company
AND ATS_Inv_Open_Close.CWAR=A.warehouse
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ATS_Inv_Open_Close.ITEM))=LTRIM(RTRIM(A.Item))
AND ATS_Inv_Open_Close.Date1=A.Invoice_Date

update ATS_Inv_Open_Close set FOC_I= A.DeliveryQty
FROM (select COMPANY,CONVERT(DATE,Invoice_Date) Invoice_Date,warehouse,ITEM,SUM(DeliveryQty) DeliveryQty  from ATS_Sales_Details 
where CONCAT(COMPANY,SaleOrderType) IN (SELECT CONCAT(COMPANY,SALEORDERTYPE) FROM saletype_master_ATS WHERE Remarks='Not Considered')
GROUP BY COMPANY,Invoice_Date,warehouse,ITEM
)A
WHERE ATS_Inv_Open_Close.COMPANY=A.company
AND ATS_Inv_Open_Close.CWAR=A.warehouse
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ATS_Inv_Open_Close.ITEM))=LTRIM(RTRIM(A.Item))
AND ATS_Inv_Open_Close.Date1=A.Invoice_Date





end

select * from ATS_Inv_Open_Close WHERE BTA_I IS NOT NULL

--exec sp_ATS_Prd_Master_New
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ATS_Prd_Master_New] as

begin

--History Data load
--Truncate table ATS_Prd_Master_New

--insert into ATS_Prd_Master_New
----drop table ATS_Prd_Master_New
----select * into ATS_Prd_Master_New from (
--select *,row_number() over (partition by ltrim(rtrim(dpst)),ltrim(rtrim(item)) order by dpstname desc,item desc ) as Rnk from 
--(select distinct DPST,DpstName,Item,Item_desc,null as ProductGroups,getdate() as UpdatedDate from ATS_Sales_Details
--union
--select distinct convert(nvarchar,dpst) dpst,null,ItemCode,null as Item_desc,null,null from tmpslsdespdata_bckup where Company='101'
--)a
----)b


--insert into ATS_Prd_Master_New
--select * from (
--select distinct DPST,DpstName,Item,Item_desc,null as ProductGroups,getdate() as UpdatedDate,
--row_number() over (partition by ltrim(rtrim(dpst)),ltrim(rtrim(item)) order by dpstname desc,item desc ) as Rnk
--from ATS_Sales_Details
--where concat(DPST,ltrim(rtrim(item))) not in (select concat(DPST,ltrim(rtrim(item))) from ATS_Prd_Master_New)
--and dpst in (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS)
--and ltrim(rtrim(item))<>''
--)a

insert into ATS_Prd_Master_New
select * from (
select *,getdate() as Updt,
row_number() over (partition by ltrim(rtrim(dpst)),ltrim(rtrim(itemcode)) order by dpstname desc,itemcode desc ) as Rnk 
from (
select isnull(a.Dpst,b.dpst) Dpst,isnull(d.DPSTName,b.DpstName) DpstName,isnull(a.ItemCode,b.Item) ItemCode,
isnull(c.t_dsca,b.Item_desc) Item_desc,b.ProductGroups 
from 
(select distinct dpst,ItemCode from  Sales_Inflow where company like '6%')a
full outer  join (select * from ATS_Prd_Master_New) b
on a.Dpst=b.DPST
and ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.Item))
left outer  join TTCIBD001600 c
on ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.t_item))
left outer join DPST_Master_ATS d
on a.Dpst=d.DPSTcode
where b.ProductGroups is null 
and concat(a.DPST,ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))) not in (select concat(DPST,ltrim(rtrim(item))) from ATS_Prd_Master_New)
and a.Dpst in (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS)

union

select isnull(a.Dpst,b.dpst) Dpst,isnull(d.DPSTName,b.DpstName) DpstName,isnull(a.Item,b.Item) ItemCode,
isnull(c.t_dsca,b.Item_desc) Item_desc,b.ProductGroups 
from 
(select distinct dpst,Item from  ATS_Sales_Details where company like '6%')a
full outer  join (select * from ATS_Prd_Master_New) b
on a.Dpst=b.DPST
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(b.Item))
left outer  join TTCIBD001600 c
on ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(c.t_item))
left outer join DPST_Master_ATS d
on a.Dpst=d.DPSTcode
where b.ProductGroups is null 
and concat(a.DPST,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))) not in (select concat(DPST,ltrim(rtrim(item))) from ATS_Prd_Master_New)
and a.Dpst in (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS)


union

--Special Case
select a.Dpst,d.DPSTName,a.ItemCode,c.t_dsca,null as ProductGroups 
from 
(select distinct dpst,ItemCode from  Sales_Inflow where company like '6%')a
left outer  join TTCIBD001600 c
on ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.t_item))
left outer join DPST_Master_ATS d
on a.Dpst=d.DPSTcode
where concat(a.DPST,ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))) not in (select concat(DPST,ltrim(rtrim(item))) from ATS_Prd_Master_New)
and a.Dpst in (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS)



)a
)b
where rnk=1
--ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode))='20FSK01BR'
order by ItemCode,rnk



delete from ATS_Prd_Master_New where dpst is null
delete from ATS_Prd_Master_New where dpst like '%[a-z]%'
delete from ATS_Prd_Master_New where item is null
delete from ATS_Prd_Master_New where ltrim(rtrim(item)) =''
delete from ATS_Prd_Master_new where rnk>1
delete from ATS_Prd_Master_new where dpst in ('60041','90252')
--delete select * from ATS_Prd_Master_new where dpst not in (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS)

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set item=ltrim(rtrim(item))

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set dpstname=a.DPSTName
from DPST_Master_ATS a
where ATS_Prd_Master_New.dpst=a.DPSTcode


update ATS_Prd_Master_New set Item_desc=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001600 a
where ltrim(rtrim(Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))

--Alter table ATS_Prd_Master_New alter column ProductGroups varchar(100)

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='SPARES / ACCESSORIES'
where dpst in ('90041','90051')

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='Consumables'
where dpst in ('90041','90051')
and ltrim(rtrim(item)) in (select itemcode from vw_ATS_Consumables_Itemlist)

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='International Sales'
where dpst in (select distinct DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where Description='Exports')

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='SERVICE BILLING' where ltrim(rtrim(item))='SER001'
update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='SERVICE BILLING' where ltrim(rtrim(item)) like 'SC%'
update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='SERVICE BILLING' where DPST in ('90043','90045','90048','90054')


update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='SUPPLIER SALES' where DPST= '90049'
update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='SCRAP' where DPST= '90111'

update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='Training Income' where DPST= '90046'
update ATS_Prd_Master_New set ProductGroups='PAYU Income' where DPST= '90047'


end

select * from ATS_Prd_Master_new where ProductGroups is null 
--item='000900005'


--select * from DPST_Master_ATS where dpstname like '%scrap%'
--DPSTcode= '90111'

--select * from ATS_Sales_Details where ltrim(rtrim(item))='000900078'
--dpst='90029'

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ATS_Sales_Performance] as

begin

Truncate table ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp
Truncate table ATS_Sales_Performance

insert into ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp(SalesType,productgroup,last_year_ytd_bud,
this_year_ytd_bud,last_month_bud,this_month_bud,next_month_budget,nextof_next_month_budget)
select SalesType,productgroup,last_year_ytd_bud,this_year_ytd_bud,
last_month_bud,this_month_bud,next_month_budget,nextof_next_month_budget 
from vw_bud_ATS


insert into ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp(productgroup,Sales_Plan)
select product_group,[plan]
from  ATS_Plan_Master
where month(date) =month(getdate()-1) and year(date)=year(getdate()-1)


insert into ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp(SalesType,productgroup,DPSTCode,Zone,last_year_ytd_inflow,last_year_this_month_inflow,
this_year_ytd_inflow,last_month_inflow,this_month_inflow,last_day_inflow,last_year_day_inflow)
select SalesType,productgroup,Dpst,Zone,last_year_ytd_inflow,last_year_this_month_inflow,
this_year_ytd_inflow,last_month_inflow,this_month_inflow,last_day_inflow,last_year_day_inflow 
from vw_inflow_ATS_new


insert into ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp(SalesType,productgroup,DPSTCode,Zone,last_year_ytd,last_year_this_month_sale,
this_year_ytd,last_month_sale,this_month_sale,last_day_sale,last_year_day_sale)
select SalesType,productgroup,dpst,Zone,
last_year_ytd,last_year_this_month_sale,this_year_ytd,last_month_sale,
this_month_sale,last_day_sale,last_year_day_sale
from vw_sls_ATS_New


update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set DPSTName=a.DPSTName
from DPST_Master_ATS a
where ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp.DPSTCode=a.DPSTcode

update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set productgroup='SERVICE BILLING' 
where DPSTCode in ('90043','90045','90048','90054')
and productgroup is null 

--SalesType Updation

update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set SalesType=a.SalesType
from (select distinct productgroup,SalesType from  ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp 
where SalesType is not null 
and productgroup is not null)a
where ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp.productgroup=a.productgroup
and ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp.SalesType is null

update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set SalesType=null where productgroup is null

update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set SalesType='After Sales' where productgroup='CONSUMABLES' 
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set SalesType='After Sales' where productgroup='SERVICE BILLING'  
--and Sales_Plan<>0

update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set PrdgrpOrdering=18 where productgroup='INTERNATIONAL'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set PrdgrpOrdering=19 where productgroup='CONSUMABLES'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set PrdgrpOrdering=20 where productgroup='Service Billing'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set PrdgrpOrdering=21 where productgroup='SPARES / ACCESSORIES'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set PrdgrpOrdering=22 where productgroup='PAYU INCOME'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set PrdgrpOrdering=23 where productgroup='TRAINING INCOME'

--PrdgrpOrdering Updation

update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set ZoneOrdering=1 where Zone='South'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set ZoneOrdering=2 where Zone='North'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set ZoneOrdering=3 where Zone='West'
update ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp set ZoneOrdering=4 where Zone='East'

SalesType,productgroup,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,Zone,
sum(isnull(Sales_Plan,0)) Sales_Plan,
sum(isnull(last_year_ytd_bud,0)) last_year_ytd_bud,
sum(isnull(this_year_ytd_bud,0)) this_year_ytd_bud,
sum(isnull(last_month_bud,0)) last_month_bud,
sum(isnull(this_month_bud,0)) this_month_bud,
sum(isnull(next_month_budget,0)) next_month_budget,
sum(isnull(nextof_next_month_budget,0)) nextof_next_month_budget,
sum(isnull(last_year_ytd_inflow,0)) last_year_ytd_inflow,
sum(isnull(last_year_this_month_inflow,0)) last_year_this_month_inflow,
sum(isnull(this_year_ytd_inflow,0)) this_year_ytd_inflow,
sum(isnull(last_month_inflow,0)) last_month_inflow,
sum(isnull(this_month_inflow,0)) this_month_inflow,
sum(isnull(last_day_inflow,0)) last_day_inflow,
sum(isnull(last_year_day_inflow,0)) last_year_day_inflow,
sum(isnull(last_year_ytd,0)) last_year_ytd,
sum(isnull(last_year_this_month_sale,0)) last_year_this_month_sale,
sum(isnull(this_year_ytd,0)) this_year_ytd,
sum(isnull(last_month_sale,0)) last_month_sale,
sum(isnull(this_month_sale,0)) this_month_sale,
sum(isnull(last_day_sale,0)) last_day_sale,
sum(isnull(last_year_day_sale,0)) last_year_day_sale,

from ATS_Sales_Performance_Tmp
group by SalesType,productgroup,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,Zone,
ZoneOrdering,SalesTypeOrdering,PrdgrpOrdering,CalMonth,CalYear,FinMonth,FinYear


delete from ATS_Sales_Performance where
(Sales_Plan + last_year_ytd_bud + this_year_ytd_bud + last_month_bud + this_month_bud + next_month_budget +
nextof_next_month_budget + 
--last_year_ytd_inflow + last_year_this_month_inflow + this_year_ytd_inflow + last_month_inflow + 
this_month_inflow + last_day_inflow +
last_year_day_inflow + last_year_ytd + last_year_this_month_sale + this_year_ytd +
last_month_sale + this_month_sale + last_day_sale + last_year_day_sale)=0


end 

select * from ATS_Sales_Performance 
--where productgroup='CONSUMABLES'
order by SalesTypeOrdering,PrdgrpOrdering
--,ZoneOrdering





GO

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ATS_Share_of_Business] as

Begin

Truncate table ATS_Share_of_Business

Insert into ATS_Share_of_Business(ITEM,sup_cnt_person,semail,
SUNO1,SUNO2,SUNO3,SUNO4,SUNO5, 
SHA1,SHA2,SHA3,SHA4,SHA5, 
ORNO1,ORNO2,ORNO3,ORNO4,ORNO5,BUYR,QtyUpto)

select a.ITEM,SCPR,SEML,
SUNO1,SUNO2,SUNO3,SUNO4,SUNO5, 
SHA1,SHA2,SHA3,SHA4,SHA5, 
ORNO1,ORNO2,ORNO3,ORNO4,ORNO5,BUYR,b.miqt 
from TZZPUR049ALL a
left outer join vw_pbs_ats b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.SUNO1))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))

where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup ='ATS')



update ATS_Share_of_Business set empname=emp_name from
(select emp_code,new_emp_code,emp_name from employee_details) buyer 
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.BUYR)) =buyer.new_emp_code

update ATS_Share_of_Business set Description=t_dsca
from (select distinct t_item ,t_dsca from TTCIBD001600 ) ItemData 
where ATS_Share_of_Business.ITEM = ItemData.t_item 


--Price Updation
update ATS_Share_of_Business set price1=b.bapr
from vw_pbs_ats b
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.SUNO1))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))

update ATS_Share_of_Business set price2=b.bapr
from vw_pbs_ats b
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.SUNO2))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))

update ATS_Share_of_Business set price3=b.bapr
from vw_pbs_ats b
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.SUNO3))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))

update ATS_Share_of_Business set price4=b.bapr
from vw_pbs_ats b
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.SUNO4))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))

update ATS_Share_of_Business set price5=b.bapr
from vw_pbs_ats b
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(ATS_Share_of_Business.SUNO5))=ltrim(rtrim(b.OTBP))


End

CREATE procedure [dbo].[sp_ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD] as   

begin
  
truncate table ATS_Spares_Orders
truncate table ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD
truncate table ATS_Spares_Orders2    
truncate table ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC  
Truncate Table ATS_Spares_OTD_PurOrders

----ATS_Spares_Orders

insert into ATS_Spares_Orders 
SELECT distinct a.t_cofc as Dpst, a.Company, a.OrderNum, a.PositionNum, a.CustCode,a.t_odat OrderDate, 
dateadd(dd,10,a.t_odat) as plann_deliv_date, 
null as orderqty, null as warehouse,
a.t_item as itemcode  

FROM CI_Lines a
INNER JOIN  CI_Header b
ON a.Company = b.Company  
and a.invnum=b.invnum
and a.Trantype=b.Trantyp

WHERE a.t_cofc IN ('90041', '90051')
and dateadd(dd,10,a.t_odat) >= '04/01/2007' 
and dateadd(dd,10,a.t_odat) < getdate()  
and positionnum < 950 
--and orderqty > 0 
and a.CustCode not in ('CU1E00028','SU1E00028','CU1E00263','SU1E00263','CU1E00424','SU1E00424')  
and a.saletype in (select saleordertype from saletype_master_ATS where Sales_Category =0
union
select '6F1'
union
select '6P2'
)

--Commented on 9 May 2018
--delete from ATS_Spares_Orders where plann_deliv_date > convert(Datetime,convert(varchar,getdate()-1,101))  

update ATS_Spares_Orders set orderqty=a.t_qoor,warehouse=a.WareHouse
from Sales_Lines a
where ATS_Spares_Orders.Company=a.Company
and ATS_Spares_Orders.OrderNum=a.OrderNum
and ATS_Spares_Orders.PositionNum=a.PositionNum

update ATS_Spares_Orders set warehouse=a.t_cwar
from Sales_Header a
where ATS_Spares_Orders.Company=a.Company
and ATS_Spares_Orders.OrderNum=a.OrderNum
and ATS_Spares_Orders.warehouse is null



----ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD

insert into ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD (dpst,company,ordernum,positionnum,custcode,orderdate,plan_deliv_date,orderqty,  
deliverydt,deliveredqty,backordqty,slslines_aed_spares.warehouse,itemcode)  
SELECT a.Dpst, 
a.Company, 
a.OrderNum,   
a.PositionNum,
a.CustCode, 
a.OrderDate, 
a.plann_deliv_date,   
a.orderqty,  
max(case when isdate(b.INVD) = 1 then  b.INVD else '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' end) as DeliveryDt,
sum(B.QIDL) AS DeliveredQty,  
a.orderqty-sum(B.QIDL) as BackOrderQty,
a.warehouse,
a.itemcode  

FROM ATS_Spares_Orders a 
left outer JOIN sales_delivery b
ON a.Company = b.Company 
AND a.OrderNum = b.ORNO 
AND a.PositionNum = b.PONO  
group by a.Dpst,a.Company, a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.CustCode, a.OrderDate, 
a.plann_deliv_date,a.orderqty,a.warehouse,a.itemcode  



update ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD set DeliveredQty=DeliveredQty/a.T$CONV
from (
select a.Company,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.ItemCode,a.SlsUnit,b.CUNS,c.T$CONV from 
(select distinct COMPANY,OrderNum,PositionNum,ItemCode,SlsUnit from Sales_Lines where company=600)a
left outer join 
(select distinct company,ORNO,PONO,CUNS from sales_delivery  where company=600) b
ON a.Company = b.Company 
AND a.OrderNum = b.ORNO 
AND a.PositionNum = b.PONO  
left outer join 
(select distinct company,T$ITEM as Item,T$CONV from TTCIBD003ALL)c
on a.Company=c.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Item))
where a.SlsUnit<>b.CUNS
--a.OrderNum='634086052' and PositionNum=120
)a
where ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.Company=a.Company
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.OrderNum=a.OrderNum
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.PositionNum=a.PositionNum
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.itemcode=a.ItemCode



  
update ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD set deliverydt = a.deliverydt  
from  
(select Company ,orno as OrderNum ,pono as PositionNum ,max(INVD) as deliverydt  
from sales_delivery where INVD <> '9999-01-01'  
group by Company ,ORNO ,PONO )a  
where  
ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.deliverydt = '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' 
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.deliveredqty = orderqty  
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.Company = a.Company 
AND ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.OrderNum = a.OrderNum 
AND ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.PositionNum = a.PositionNum  
  
update  ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD set otd = 1  
update  ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD set otd = 0 where orderqty > deliveredqty  
update  ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD set otd = 0  where plan_deliv_date < deliverydt  
  
update ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD set itemdescription = a.t_dsca  
from TTCIBD001600 a   
where a.t_item = ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD.itemcode


----ATS_Spares_Orders2    

insert  into ATS_Spares_Orders2   

SELECT a.t_cofc as Dpst, a.Company, a.OrderNum, a.PositionNum, a.CustCode,   a.t_odat as OrderDate, 
dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) as plann_deliv_date,
null as orderqty,null as warehouse,
a.t_item as itemcode,a.saletype as ordertype,'BDI' as Type

FROM CI_Lines a
INNER JOIN CI_Header b
ON a.Company = b.Company  
and a.invnum=b.invnum
and a.Trantype=b.Trantyp

WHERE a.t_cofc IN ('90041', '90051')  
and dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) >= '04/01/2011' 
and dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) < getdate()  
and positionnum < 950 
--and orderqty > 0 
and a.saletype in ('640','641','642')  
and a.saletype in (select saleordertype from saletype_master_ATS where Sales_Category =0)

union all  

SELECT a.t_cofc as Dpst, a.Company, a.OrderNum, a.PositionNum, a.CustCode,   a.t_odat as OrderDate, 
dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) as plann_deliv_date,
null as orderqty,null as warehouse,
a.t_item as itemcode,a.saletype as ordertype,'FOC'  

FROM CI_Lines a
INNER JOIN CI_Header b
ON a.Company = b.Company  
and a.invnum=b.invnum
and a.Trantype=b.Trantyp

WHERE a.t_cofc IN ('90041', '90051')  
and dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) >= '04/01/2011' 
and dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) < getdate()  
and positionnum < 950 
--and orderqty > 0 
and a.saletype in ('623','624','625','626','6F1','6P2')   
  

--Commented on 9May2018
--delete from ATS_Spares_Orders2 where plann_deliv_date > convert(Datetime,convert(varchar,getdate()-1,101))  

  
update ATS_Spares_Orders2 set orderqty=a.t_qoor,warehouse=a.WareHouse
from Sales_Lines a
where ATS_Spares_Orders2.Company=a.Company
and ATS_Spares_Orders2.OrderNum=a.OrderNum
and ATS_Spares_Orders2.PositionNum=a.PositionNum



-----ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC

--select * into ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC from [ELGI-DW].dbo.sales_otd_aed_spares_bdi_foc


insert into ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC 
(dpst,company,ordernum,positionnum,custcode,orderdate,plan_deliv_date,orderqty,  
deliverydt,deliveredqty,backordqty,warehouse,itemcode,ordertype,type)  

SELECT a.Dpst, 
a.Company, 
a.OrderNum,   
a.PositionNum,
a.CustCode, 
a.OrderDate, 
a.plann_deliv_date,   
a.orderqty,  
max(case when isdate(b.INVD) = 1 then  b.INVD else '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' end) as DeliveryDt,
sum(B.QIDL) AS DeliveredQty,  
a.orderqty-sum(B.QIDL) as BackOrderQty,
a.warehouse,
a.itemcode,  
a.ordertype,a.type  

FROM ATS_Spares_Orders2 a 
left outer JOIN sales_delivery b
ON a.Company = b.Company 
AND a.OrderNum = b.ORNO 
AND a.PositionNum = b.PONO  

group by a.Dpst, a.Company, a.OrderNum, a.PositionNum, a.CustCode, a.OrderDate, 
a.plann_deliv_date,a.orderqty,a.warehouse,a.itemcode,a.ordertype,type  


update ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC set deliverydt = a.deliverydt  
from  
(select Company ,orno as OrderNum ,pono as PositionNum ,max(INVD) as deliverydt  
from sales_delivery where INVD <> '9999-01-01'  
group by Company ,ORNO ,PONO )a  
where  
ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC.deliverydt = '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' 
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC.deliveredqty = orderqty  
and ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC.Company = a.Company 
AND ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC.OrderNum = a.OrderNum 
AND ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC.PositionNum = a.PositionNum  


update  ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC set otd = 1  
update  ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC set otd = 0 where orderqty > deliveredqty  
update  ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC set otd = 0  where plan_deliv_date < deliverydt  
  
update ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC set itemdescription = a.t_dsca  
from TTCIBD001600 a   
where ATS_Spares_Orders_OTD_BDI_FOC.itemcode = a.t_item 


---------------------------

Insert into ATS_Spares_OTD_PurOrders
--select * into ATS_Spares_OTD_PurOrders from (
select a.COMPANY,a.ODAT,a.ORNO,b.PONO,b.ITEM,null as Itemdesc,b.CWAR,b.PlannedReceiptDt,b.ActualReceiptDt,
b.OrderQty,b.ReceiptQty,b.OrderAmt,b.SupplierCode,null as SupplierName,
case when PlannedReceiptDt>ActualReceiptDt then ReceiptQty else null end as DelvQty_before_Due,
case when PlannedReceiptDt<ActualReceiptDt then ReceiptQty else null end as DelvQty_over_Due,
CASE WHEN  PlannedReceiptDt>ActualReceiptDt and orderqty=ReceiptQty then 'Ontime Delivery'  
when PlannedReceiptDt<ActualReceiptDt and orderqty=ReceiptQty  then 'Delivered Not Ontime'  
when ReceiptQty<>0 and orderqty<>ReceiptQty then 'Partially Executed' 
when ReceiptQty=0 then 'Not Delivered' end as status

from
(select COMPANY,ODAT,ORNO from TTDPUR400ALL where company in (select company from elgi_companies_Master where companygroup='ATS')
and substring(ltrim(rtrim(orno)),1,3) in ('624','628')
)a
left outer join
(select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,ITEM,CWAR,DDTA as PlannedReceiptDt,
case when DDTE='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' then null else DDTE end as ActualReceiptDt,
QOOR as OrderQty,QIDL as ReceiptQty,OAMT as OrderAmt,OTBP as SupplierCode from TTDPUR401ALL where company in (select company from elgi_companies_Master where companygroup='ATS')
)b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY
and a.ORNO=b.ORNO
where b.PONO is not null
--order by a.ODAT,a.ORNO,b.PONO
--)a

--Alter table ATS_Spares_OTD_PurOrders alter column Itemdesc nvarchar(60)
update ATS_Spares_OTD_PurOrders set Itemdesc = a.t_dsca  
from TTCIBD001600 a   
where ATS_Spares_OTD_PurOrders.ITEM = a.t_item 




end

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ats_spares_otd_bdi_foc] as  

Begin

--truncate table slslines_aed_spares_bdi_foc    
--select * into ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders from [ELGI-DW].dbo.slslines_aed_spares_bdi_foc
--alter table ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders alter column ordertype nvarchar(6)
--truncate table sales_otd_aed_spares_bdi_foc  


truncate table ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders
truncate table ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD  

insert into ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders   
SELECT a.t_cofc as Dpst, 
a.Company, 
a.OrderNum, 
a.PositionNum, 
a.CustCode,   
a.t_odat as OrderDate, 
dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) as plann_deliv_date,
null as orderqty, null as warehouse,
a.t_item as itemcode,a.saletype as ordertype,'BDI' as Type

FROM CI_Lines a 
INNER JOIN CI_Header b
on a.Company=b.company
and a.invnum=b.invnum
and a.Trantype=b.Trantyp 

WHERE (a.t_cofc IN ('90041', '90051'))  
and dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) >= '04/01/2011' 
and dateadd(dd,1,a.t_odat) < getdate()  
and positionnum < 950 
--and orderqty > 0 
and a.saletype in ('640','641','642')  
 
union all  

SELECT b.Dpst, 
a.Company, 
a.OrderNum, 
a.PositionNum, 
a.CustCode,   
a.t_odat as OrderDate, 
dateadd(dd,2,a.t_odat) as plann_deliv_date,
null as orderqty,null as warehouse,
a.t_item as itemcode,a.saletype as ordertype,'FOC' as Type

FROM CI_Lines a 
INNER JOIN CI_Header b
on a.Company=b.company
and a.invnum=b.invnum
and a.Trantype=b.Trantyp 

WHERE (b.Dpst IN ('90041', '90051'))  
and dateadd(dd,2,a.t_odat) >= '04/01/2011' 
and dateadd(dd,2,a.t_odat) < getdate()  
and positionnum < 950 
--and orderqty > 0 
and a.saletype in ('623','624','625','626')   


delete from ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders where plann_deliv_date > convert(Datetime,convert(varchar,getdate()-1,101))  
  

update ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders set orderqty=a.t_qoor,warehouse=a.WareHouse
from Sales_Lines a
where ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders.Company=a.Company
and ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders.OrderNum=a.OrderNum
and ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders.PositionNum=a.PositionNum


--alter table ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD alter column ordertype nvarchar(6)


insert into ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD (dpst,company,ordernum,positionnum,custcode,orderdate,plan_deliv_date,orderqty,  
deliverydt,deliveredqty,backordqty,warehouse,itemcode,ordertype,type)  

SELECT a.Dpst, 
a.Company, 
a.OrderNum,   
a.PositionNum,
a.CustCode, 
a.OrderDate, 
a.plann_deliv_date,
a.orderqty,  
max(case when isdate(b.INVD) = 1 then  b.INVD else '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' end) as DeliveryDt,
sum(B.QIDL) AS DeliveredQty,  
a.orderqty-sum(B.QIDL) as BackOrderQty,
a.warehouse,
a.itemcode,ordertype,type  

FROM ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders a
left outer JOIN sales_delivery b
ON a.Company = b.Company 
AND a.OrderNum = b.ORNO 
AND a.PositionNum = b.PONO  

group by a.Dpst, a.Company, a.OrderNum, a.PositionNum, a.CustCode, a.OrderDate, 
a.plann_deliv_date,a.orderqty,a.warehouse,a.itemcode,a.ordertype,a.type  



update ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD set deliverydt = TmpSlsDelivery.deliverydt  
from  
(select Company ,orno as OrderNum ,pono as PositionNum ,max(INVD) as deliverydt  
from sales_delivery where INVD <> '9999-01-01'  
group by Company ,ORNO ,PONO )TmpSlsDelivery  
where ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD.deliverydt = '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' 
and ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD.deliveredqty = orderqty 
and ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD.Company = TmpSlsDelivery.Company 
AND ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD.OrderNum = TmpSlsDelivery.OrderNum 
AND ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD.PositionNum = TmpSlsDelivery.PositionNum  

update  ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD set otd = 1  
update  ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD set otd = 0 where orderqty > deliveredqty  
update  ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD set otd = 0  where plan_deliv_date < deliverydt  
  
update ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD set itemdescription = a.t_dsca  
from TTCIBD001600 a   
where a.t_item = ATS_Spares_BDI_FOC_Orders_OTD.itemcode

end


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ATS_TrialSales]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_ATS_TrialSales
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ATS_TrialSales] as
begin

Truncate Table ATS_TrialSales

Insert into ATS_TrialSales
--select * into ATS_TrialSales from (
select Company,Trantyp,Trantype_desc,SaleOrderType,OrderNo,
InvNo,CustNo,CustName,DPST,DpstName,
InvDate,
case when Rnk=1 then InvAmt else 0 end as InvAmt,
case when Rnk=1 then PaidAmt else 0 end as PaidAmt,
case when Rnk=1 then BalanceAmt else 0 end as BalanceAmt,
DueDate,
AreaCode,AreaName,Item,Item_desc,DeliveryQty,
datediff(dd,InvDate,getdate()-1) as DelayDays,
LN_Company
from (
select a.Company,isnull(a.LN_Company,b.LN_Company) as LN_Company, a.Trantyp,c.Trantype_desc,a.InvNo,b.SaleOrderType,b.OrderNo,a.CustNo,a.CustName,a.DPST,a.DpstName,
a.InvDate,InvAmt,PaidAmt,BalanceAmt,DueDate,AreaCode,AreaName,Item,Item_desc,DeliveryQty,
row_number() over (partition by a.Company,a.Trantyp,a.InvNo order by a.Company,a.Trantyp,a.InvNo) as Rnk from 
(select 101 as Company,Company as LN_Company,Trantyp,InvNo,CustNo,CustName,DPST,DpstName,AreaCode,AreaName,
InvDate,DueDate,InvAmt,PaidAmt,BalanceAmt
from ACR_Debtors_Details
where company in (select company from elgi_companies_master where companygroup='ATS')
and Trantyp in (select Trantype from vw_ATS_Trantypes)
)a
left outer join
(select 101 as Company,company as LN_Company,Trantype,Invoice,SaleOrderType,OrderNo,Item,Item_desc,DeliveryQty from ATS_Sales_Details 
where trantype in (select Trantype from vw_ATS_Trantypes)
union
select 101 as Company,company,TranType,InvoiceNum,null as OrderType,ordernum,ItemCode,null,DeliveredQty from [elgi-dw].dbo.TmpSlsDelivery
where company like '101%'
and trantype in (select Trantype from vw_ATS_Trantypes)
)b
on a.Company=b.company
and a.Trantyp=b.trantype
and a.InvNo=b.Invoice
inner join vw_ATS_Trantypes c
on a.Trantyp=c.Trantype

)a
--)b
where BalanceAmt<>0
--and InvDate between @FromDate and @ToDate
--and concat(Trantyp,InvNo) in ('6C375000026')
--and concat(Company,Trantyp,InvNo) in ('1016C375000026')
order by InvDate

update ATS_TrialSales set Item_desc=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001600 a
where ltrim(rtrim(ATS_TrialSales.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))
and ATS_TrialSales.Item_desc is null


end

select * from ATS_TrialSales



GO

--exec sp_bank_balance
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_bank_balance]  as
begin

truncate table bank_balance 
truncate table bank_balance_period

insert into bank_balance 
select COMPANY,OTYP,ODOC,OLIN,OCMP,LEAC,DCDT,REFR,AMTH$1,DBCR,FPRD,FYER,BPID,DATE,INTT,
FTYP,FDOC,CATG,CONT,CTYP,CINV,CORN,CSRN,TCSH,[TRAN],DELE,amnt,ccur,rate$1,
0 ,''
from gld_106_cashflow where leac in (select leac from bank_balance_gl)
and company not in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')


insert into bank_balance_period
select distinct fyer,fprd from bank_balance  

update bank_balance set type = dbcr

update bank_balance set type = 7
where dbcr = 1 and leac in (select leac from Bank_Balance_GL where  leac <> pleac)


update bank_balance set type = 8
where dbcr = 2 and leac in (select leac from Bank_Balance_GL where  leac <> pleac)

end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA
--select * from Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA] as 
begin

Truncate table Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA



Insert into Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA(Organ,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,
--DealerCode,DealerName,Category,ProductLine,company,warehouse,
ItemCode,Cal_month,Cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,Budget) 

select 
ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)) as Organ,
c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName,
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)) as areaname,
ltrim(rtrim(a.item_code)) as item_code,
month(a.date) as CalMonth,
year(a.date) as CalYear,
case when month(a.date) < 4 then month(a.date)+9 else month(a.date)-3 end Fin_month,
case when month(a.date) < 4 then year(a.date)-1 else year(a.date) end Fin_year,
sum(target) as Budget 

FROM	Itemwise_Budget a
	INNER JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.Area))
	INNER JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode))    
		and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))
where organ='COSEA'
GROUP BY ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)),ltrim(rtrim(c.region)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)),
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)),
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)),c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName,a.item_code,month(a.date),year(a.date)



Insert into Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA(Organ,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,
CustCode,CustName,company,warehouse,ItemCode,Cal_month,Cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,Sales_amount,Inflow_amount) 


select a.organ,a.Dpst,a.dpstname,a.Areacode,a.AreaName,
a.custcode,a.custname,a.company,a.warehouse,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) ,a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,
a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year,sum(Sales_amount) as Sales_amount,
sum(isnull(inf.sales,0)) as inflow_amount

FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
full outer join (select Company,OrderDate,OrderNum,PositionNum,Dpst,AreaCode,CustCode, sum(sales) sales from  Sales_Inflow
group by Company,OrderDate,OrderNum,PositionNum,Dpst,AreaCode,CustCode) inf
on  a.company=inf.Company
and a.OrderNo=inf.OrderNum
AND A.PositionNo=inf.PositionNum
and a.dpst=inf.Dpst
and a.areacode=inf.AreaCode
and month(a.Invoice_Date)=month(inf.OrderDate)
and year(a.Invoice_Date)=year(inf.OrderDate)
and ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(inf.CustCode))


WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 

--AND a.SaleOrderType in (
--select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
--union all
--select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
--)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 
and a.Organ='COSEA'
GROUP BY a.organ,a.Dpst,a.dpstname,a.Areacode,a.AreaName,
a.custcode,a.custname,a.company,a.warehouse,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) ,a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,
a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year


update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category=a.category,productline=a.productline
from ItemMaster_COSEA a
where ltrim(rtrim(Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.itemcode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))
--and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2.company=a.Company

--Old Method
--update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2 set dealerCode=dlr.DealerCode,Dealername=dlr.DealerName
--from Dealer_Master_COSEA dlr
--where ltrim(rtrim(substring(Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2.custcode,4,9)))=ltrim(rtrim(substring(dlr.DealerCode,4,9)))
--and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2.Areacode=dlr.CountryCode

--New Method
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set dealerCode=dlr.CustCode,Dealername=dlr.CustName
from (select * from DealerMaster_COSEA) dlr
where ltrim(rtrim(Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(dlr.CustCode))
and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.Areacode=dlr.areacode


update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set SalesRep=dlr.SalesRep
from (
select * from DealerMaster_COSEA
union
select * from customerMaster_COSEA
) dlr
where ltrim(rtrim(Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(dlr.CustCode))
and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.Areacode=dlr.areacode


update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA  set  DealerName='1Direct Sales'
where DealerCode is null and Sales_amount<>0



update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category_ordr=1 where  Category= 'EPSAC'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category_ordr=2 where  Category= 'OFSAC'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category_ordr=3 where  Category= 'DPSAC'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category_ordr=4 where  Category= 'RECIP'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category_ordr=5 where  Category= 'ACCESSSORIES'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set category_ordr=6 where  Category= 'SPARES'

update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set productline_ordr=1 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='S0'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set productline_ordr=2 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='S1'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set productline_ordr=3 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='S2'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set productline_ordr=4 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='L0'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set productline_ordr=5 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='L1&L2'


end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_Bud_sales_Inflow_ID]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/

GO
--exec sp_Bud_sales_Inflow_ID
--select * from Bud_sales_Inflow_ID

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Bud_sales_Inflow_ID] as 
begin

Truncate table Bud_sales_Inflow_ID

Insert into Bud_sales_Inflow_ID(Organ,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,
--DealerCode,DealerName,Category,ProductLine,company,warehouse,
ItemCode,Cal_month,Cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,Budget) 

select 
ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)) as Organ,
c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName,
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)) as areaname,
ltrim(rtrim(a.item_code)) as item_code,
month(a.date) as CalMonth,
year(a.date) as CalYear,
case when month(a.date) < 4 then month(a.date)+9 else month(a.date)-3 end Fin_month,
case when month(a.date) < 4 then year(a.date)-1 else year(a.date) end Fin_year,
sum(target) as Budget 

FROM	Itemwise_Budget a
	INNER JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.Area))
	INNER JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode))    
		and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))
where organ='ID'
GROUP BY ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)),ltrim(rtrim(c.region)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)),
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)),
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)),c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName,a.item_code,month(a.date),year(a.date)



Insert into Bud_sales_Inflow_ID(Organ,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,
CustCode,CustName,company,warehouse,ItemCode,Cal_month,Cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,Sales_amount,Inflow_amount) 


select a.organ,a.Dpst,a.dpstname,a.Areacode,a.AreaName,
a.custcode,a.custname,a.company,a.warehouse,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) ,a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,
a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year,sum(Sales_amount) as Sales_amount,
sum(isnull(inf.sales,0)) as inflow_amount

FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
full outer join (select Company,OrderDate,OrderNum,PositionNum,Dpst,AreaCode,CustCode, sum(sales) sales from  Sales_Inflow
group by Company,OrderDate,OrderNum,PositionNum,Dpst,AreaCode,CustCode) inf
on  a.company=inf.Company
and a.OrderNo=inf.OrderNum
AND A.PositionNo=inf.PositionNum
and a.dpst=inf.Dpst
and a.areacode=inf.AreaCode
and month(a.Invoice_Date)=month(inf.OrderDate)
and year(a.Invoice_Date)=year(inf.OrderDate)
and ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(inf.CustCode))


WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 

AND a.SaleOrderType in (
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 
and a.Organ='ID'
GROUP BY a.organ,a.Dpst,a.dpstname,a.Areacode,a.AreaName,
a.custcode,a.custname,a.company,a.warehouse,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) ,a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,
a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year


--Productline Updation

update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category=a.category,productline=a.productline
from ItemMaster_ID a
where ltrim(rtrim(Bud_sales_Inflow_ID.itemcode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))
--and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2.company=a.Company




--Dealer/Customer Updation
--update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA set dealerCode=dlr.CustCode,Dealername=dlr.CustName
--from (select * from DealerMaster_COSEA) dlr
--where ltrim(rtrim(Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(dlr.CustCode))
--and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA.Areacode=dlr.areacode

--Old Method
--update Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2 set dealerCode=dlr.DealerCode,Dealername=dlr.DealerName
--from Dealer_Master_COSEA dlr
--where ltrim(rtrim(substring(Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2.custcode,4,9)))=ltrim(rtrim(substring(dlr.DealerCode,4,9)))
--and Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA_ver2.Areacode=dlr.CountryCode


--SalesRep Updation

update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set SalesRep=Mapping.User_names
from (
select DPSTCode,Areacode,User_names from SalesMapping_Global
where organ='ID'
)Mapping
where ltrim(rtrim(Bud_sales_Inflow_ID.DPSTCode))=ltrim(rtrim(Mapping.DPSTCode))
and Bud_sales_Inflow_ID.Areacode=Mapping.areacode


--update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID  set  DealerName='1Direct Sales'
--where DealerCode is null and Sales_amount<>0



update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category_ordr=1 where  Category= 'EPSAC'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category_ordr=2 where  Category= 'OFSAC'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category_ordr=3 where  Category= 'DPSAC'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category_ordr=4 where  Category= 'RECIP'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category_ordr=5 where  Category= 'ACCESSSORIES'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set category_ordr=6 where  Category= 'SPARES'

update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set productline_ordr=1 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='S0'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set productline_ordr=2 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='S1'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set productline_ordr=3 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='S2'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set productline_ordr=4 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='L0'
update Bud_sales_Inflow_ID set productline_ordr=5 where  Category= 'EPSAC' and ProductLine='L1&L2'


delete from Bud_sales_Inflow_ID where  ItemCode like 'NEWTPL%' and Category is null
delete from Bud_sales_Inflow_ID where  ItemCode like 'Minvo%' and Category is null
delete from Bud_sales_Inflow_ID where Category ='ROTAIR'

end


--select * from Bud_sales_Inflow_ID


GO

CREATE Proc [dbo].[sp_Budget]
as
Begin


declare @FromYear varchar(10)=year(getdate())
declare @ToYear varchar(10)=year(getdate())+1

--select concat(@FromYear,'-04-01')
--select concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')  

--select * from Sales_Budget where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')  

--Backup and then Truncate
--select * from intra_sales_budget_details_bkp_08_Dec_17
--select * from intra_sales_budget_details_bkp_31_Mar_18
--select * into intra_sales_budget_details_bkp_31_Mar_18 from intra_sales_budget_details
--Truncate table intra_sales_budget_details
--select * from intra_sales_budget_details order by fin_year desc
--select dpst,fin_year from intra_sales_budget_details 
--where fin_year<>'2018-2019'
--order by fin_year desc



delete from Sales_Budget         where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')  
delete from TempBudget           where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01') 
delete from DPSTwise_Budget      where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01') 
and dpst not in (select dpstcode from DPST_Master_ATS)
delete from Itemwise_Budget      where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01') 
delete from SAAME_Budget_Details where dates between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01') 
delete from TPLwise_Budget       where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')


--delete from exp_pr_var_bud_0910   where date  between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')




insert into TempBudget
select dpst,date,convert(numeric(16,0),value1)/1000000,area,a,b from
(select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') as date,sum(apr_value) as value1 ,area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-05-01'),sum(may_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-06-01'),sum(jun_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-07-01'),sum(jul_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-08-01'),sum(aug_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-09-01'),sum(sep_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-10-01'),sum(oct_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-11-01'),sum(nov_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-12-01'),sum(dec_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-01-01'),sum(jan_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-02-01'),sum(feb_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-03-01'),sum(mar_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
)a



insert into DPSTwise_Budget
select dpst,date,sum(value1) as value1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10),getdate(),101)),0 from
(select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') as date,sum(apr_value) as value1,area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-05-01'),sum(may_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-06-01'),sum(jun_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-07-01'),sum(jul_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-08-01'),sum(aug_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-09-01'),sum(sep_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-10-01'),sum(oct_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-11-01'),sum(nov_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-12-01'),sum(dec_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-01-01'),sum(jan_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-02-01'),sum(feb_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-03-01'),sum(mar_value),area,0 as a,0 as b  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area
) a
group by date,dpst

--select * from Sales_Budget where dpst in (90092,90073,90091)order by date desc

INSERT INTO Sales_Budget (DPST,DATE,TARGET,AREA,SALETYPE,[hoTARGET],ORGAN) 
select *,'' from TempBudget where date between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01') 

update Sales_Budget set organ=a.organ from 
(SELECT DISTINCT DPST,AREA,ORGAN FROM Sales_Budget where organ !=' ') a 
where ltrim(rtrim(Sales_Budget.area))=ltrim(rtrim(a.area)) and ltrim(rtrim(Sales_Budget.dpst))=ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst))  
and date between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')



--select * from Sales_Budget where date between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01') and  organ =''
update Sales_Budget set organ='India' where date between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')
and organ ='' and area='001'

update Sales_Budget set organ = ltrim(rtrim(a.organ)) from vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER a where Sales_Budget.area=a.areacode and Sales_Budget.dpst=a.DPSTCode

update Sales_Budget set organ=a.organ from 
(select distinct areacode,organ  from vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER where areacode in (
select distinct area area  from Sales_Budget where date between concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') and concat(@ToYear,'-03-01')  and organ = '' ))a 
where Sales_Budget.organ='' and a.areacode=Sales_Budget.area


insert into Itemwise_Budget
select dpst,date,convert(numeric(16,4),value1) as target ,area,item_code,qty from
(select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') as date,sum(apr_value) as value1 ,area,item_code,sum(apr_qty) as qty  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-05-01'),sum(may_value),area,item_code,sum(may_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-06-01'),sum(jun_value),area,item_code,sum(jun_qty) from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-07-01'),sum(jul_value),area,item_code,sum(jul_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-08-01'),sum(aug_value),area,item_code,sum(aug_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-09-01'),sum(sep_value),area,item_code,sum(sep_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-10-01'),sum(oct_value),area,item_code,sum(oct_qty) from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-11-01'),sum(nov_value),area,item_code,sum(nov_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@FromYear,'-12-01'),sum(dec_value),area,item_code,sum(dec_qty) from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-01-01'),sum(jan_value),area,item_code,sum(jan_qty) from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-02-01'),sum(feb_value),area,item_code,sum(feb_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
union all
select dpst,concat(@ToYear,'-03-01'),sum(mar_value),area,item_code,sum(mar_qty)  from intra_sales_budget_details 
where fin_year=concat(@FromYear,'-',@ToYear) group by dpst,area,item_code
)a


--select top 1 *  from TPLwise_Budget
--select top 1 *  from SAAME_Budget_Details

insert into SAAME_Budget_Details
select dpst,item_code,tplnumber,item_desc,dates,bud_qty,bud_value/curr_val ,curr,region,areaname,user_names,curr_val,(bud_qty*base_price)/curr_val bud_values, base_price/curr_val
 from (
select a.dpst dpst,item_code,item_code tplnumber,item_desc,concat(@FromYear,'-04-01') as dates,apr_qty bud_qty,apr_value bud_value,curr,region,areaname,user_names,curr_val,base_price
from intra_sales_budget_details a inner join vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER b on a.area=b.areacode and a.dpst=b.DPSTCode

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Catg_MatBudget] as

begin

Truncate table Catg_MatBudget

Insert into Catg_MatBudget(YEAR,UPDT,LOGN,ITEM,PRIC,Q1PR,Q2PR,Q3PR,Q4PR,IMPO,CCUR,RATE,BVAL,COMP,
REMK1,BUYR,CATG,KITM,QTY1,QTY2,QTY3,QTY4,SUBC,REFCNTD,REFCNTU)
select *  from TZZINV612ALL

update Catg_MatBudget set emp_name=b.emp_name
from  Employee_Details b
where BUYR =  b.new_emp_code 

update Catg_MatBudget set Item_desc=c.Item_desc
from (select * from vw_Item_Master where company in (400,490,600)) c
where Catg_MatBudget.COMP=c.company
and ltrim(rtrim(Catg_MatBudget.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Item))

update Catg_MatBudget set Item_desc=c.Item_desc
from (select * from vw_Item_Master where company not in (600)) c
where ltrim(rtrim(Catg_MatBudget.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Item))
and Catg_MatBudget.Item_desc is null

update Catg_MatBudget set WGHT =d.WGHT
from tzzinv607all d
where ltrim(rtrim(Catg_MatBudget.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(d.ITEM))
and ltrim(rtrim(Catg_MatBudget.CATG))=ltrim(rtrim(d.CATG))
and ltrim(rtrim(Catg_MatBudget.SUBC))=ltrim(rtrim(d.SUBC))


end


GO

select * From (
SELECT ccs_pg,Invoice_date as date,sum(qty)qty
FROM (
SELECT ccs_pg,sptyp,DPST,convert(date,convert(varchar,year(a.Invoice_date))+'-'+convert(varchar,month(a.Invoice_date))+'-01') Invoice_date,
SUM(QTY) as qty FROM 
(
SELECT a.Item,a.DeliveryQty AS qty,
CASE WHEN b.sptyp in (3,4 ) and dpst not IN ('90021','90221')  THEN 4   
WHEN b.sptyp in (3,4 ) and dpst IN ('90021','90221') THEN 3   
ELSE b.sptyp END AS sptyp,C.ccs_pg,a.DPST,a.Invoice_date
FROM    

(
SELECT Invoice_date,Item ,sum(convert(int,invqty)) as DeliveryQty,dpst,ttyp as trantype,custcode   
FROM (select * from Dispatch_Details where invoice_date>='2017-04-01')Dispatch_Details
WHERE FABNO<>''--and MONTH(Invoice_Date)=@month AND YEAR(Invoice_Date)=@year 
group by Invoice_date,Item,dpst,ttyp,custcode 
)a  

left outer JOIN item_prodgrp_map b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.item))

left OUTER JOIN LN_prodgrp_map  c
ON sptyp=c.pgcode  

)a
GROUP BY ccs_pg,sptyp,a.DPST,a.Invoice_date
)B
group by ccs_pg,Invoice_date
)a

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_collection_report_daily_new_ats]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/

--exec sp_collection_report_daily_new_ats

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_collection_report_daily_new_ats] as

begin

--drop table collection_report_daily_new_ats
--create table collection_report_daily_new_ats
--(company	int,
--Trantyp	nvarchar(3),
--InvNo	int,
--CustNo	nvarchar(9),
--CustName1	nvarchar(70),
--DocDt	datetime,
--doctyp	int,
--collection	float,
--DpstCode	varchar(50),
--DpstName	varchar(100),
--Description	varchar(50),
--areacode	nvarchar(10),
--AreaName	varchar(50),
--Zone	varchar(50),
--region	varchar(50),
--Global	varchar(20),
--AnpTranTyp	nvarchar(3),
--anpdocno	int,
--ctrantyp	nvarchar(3),
--cdocno	int,
--refr	int
--)


Truncate Table  collection_report_daily_new_ats

Insert into collection_report_daily_new_ats(company,Trantyp,InvNo,CustNo,DocDt,doctyp,collection,AnpTranTyp,anpdocno,ctrantyp,cdocno)
SELECT company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, DocDt,2 AS doctyp, SUM(AmntHome) AS amnthome, AnpTranTyp, MAX(AnpDocNo) AS anpdocno,
MAX(CTranTyp) AS ctrantyp, MAX(CDocNo) AS cdocno--,[LineNo]
FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a  
WHERE   convert(datetime,docdt) >= dateadd(yy,-4,getdate()-1) AND      (DocTyp IN (2, 8))
GROUP BY company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, DocDt, AnpTranTyp--,[LineNo]

update collection_report_daily_new_ats set [collection]=[collection]*(-1) where [collection]<>0

update collection_report_daily_new_ats set areacode=b.area,DpstCode=b.dpst
from (
select * from (
select a.company, a.Trantyp, a.InvNo, a.[LineNo], a.CustNo, 
a.DocDt,a.CDocNo, CASE WHEN len(ltrim(rtrim(a.area))) = 2 THEN '0' + ltrim(rtrim(a.area)) 
ELSE a.area END AS area, a.PurNo, a.DueDt, a.CurRate, 
b.AreaCode AS area_head, CASE WHEN CONVERT(varchar, b.dpst) IS NULL THEN ltrim(rtrim(proj)) 
ELSE CONVERT(varchar, dpst) END AS dpst FROM 
(select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and purno not like '%[a-z]%' 
) a  
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(select company,OrderNum as OrderNo,CustCode,t_cofc as dpst,areacode from CI_Lines 
where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and t_cofc not like '%[a-z]%'
) b
on b.Company = a.company 
AND b.OrderNo = a.PurNo 
AND ltrim(rtrim(b.CustCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.CustNo))
WHERE a.CDocNo = 0
--order by DocDt
)a
)b
where collection_report_daily_new_ats.company = b.company 
AND collection_report_daily_new_ats.CustNo = b.CustNo 
AND collection_report_daily_new_ats.Trantyp = b.Trantyp 
AND collection_report_daily_new_ats.InvNo = b.InvNo 

update collection_report_daily_new_ats set DpstName=c.DPSTName,Description=c.Description
from vw_DPST_MASTER c 
where LTRIM(RTRIM(collection_report_daily_new_ats.dpstcode))  = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.DpstCode))

update collection_report_daily_new_ats set areaname=d.AreaName,zone=d.ATS_Zone,region=d.Region,global=d.Global
from vw_AREA_MASTER d 
where LTRIM(RTRIM(collection_report_daily_new_ats.areacode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(d.AreaCode))

update collection_report_daily_new_ats set custName1=e.t_nama
from TTCCOM100400 e
where e.t_bpid = collection_report_daily_new_ats.CustNo

delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where Trantyp LIKE '%ccj%'
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where Trantyp LIKE '%ccn%'
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where Trantyp LIKE '%cdj%'
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where Trantyp LIKE '%cbc%'

delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '251' AND '264') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '351' AND '364') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '451' AND '464') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '551' AND '564') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '651' AND '664') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '751' AND '764') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '2A1' AND '2C6') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '3A1' AND '3C6') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '4A1' AND '4C6') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '5A1' AND '5C6') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '7A1' AND '7C6') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '8A1' AND '8C6') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) BETWEEN '9A1' AND '9C6') 

delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) LIKE 'F%') 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) IN ('BCC')) 
delete from collection_report_daily_new_ats where (LTRIM(RTRIM(Trantyp)) IN 
('271', '272', '371', '372', '471', '472', '571', '572','671', '672', '674', '771', '772', '871', '872', '971', '972'))


end

select * from collection_report_daily_new_ats order by docdt


--Alter table collection_report_daily_new_ats alter column refr int null

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_Consumption]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/

GO
