--Declare @MMYYYY varchar(10)='092017'

create proc [dbo].[sp_Consumption] as

begin

truncate table Consumption

insert into Consumption (COMPANY,ItemCode,Production_Consumption,Sales_Consumption,CalMonth,CalYear,TRDT)
select a.COMPANY,ITEM,a.Production_Consumption,a.Sales_Consumption,CalMonth,CalYear,TRDT

from 
(
select company,item,sum(QSTK) Sales_Consumption,0 as Production_Consumption,month(TRDT) as CalMonth,year(TRDT) as CalYear,convert(date,TRDT) as TRDT
from TWHINR110ALL
where kost=5
and koor=3
and company like '4%'
--and concat(RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(TRDT) AS VARCHAR(2)),2),cast(year(TRDT) as varchar(4))) in (@MMYYYY)
group by convert(date,TRDT),company,item,month(TRDT),year(TRDT),convert(date,TRDT)

union
select company,item,0,sum(QSTK) Production_Consumption,month(TRDT) as CalMonth,year(TRDT) as CalYear,convert(date,TRDT) as TRDT
from TWHINR110ALL
where kost=5
and koor=1
and company like '4%'
group by convert(date,TRDT),company,item,month(TRDT),year(TRDT),convert(date,TRDT)

)a



update Consumption set ItemDescr=a.DSCA
from TTCIBD001465 a
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))
and Consumption.COMPANY=465

update Consumption set ItemDescr=a.DSCA
from ttcibd001470 a
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))
and Consumption.COMPANY=470

update Consumption set ItemDescr=a.DSCA
from TTCIBD001490 a
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))
and Consumption.COMPANY=490

update Consumption set ItemDescr=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001400 a
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))
and Consumption.ItemDescr is null



update Consumption set BuyrCode=b.BUYR,SuppCode=b.OTBP
from (
select distinct company ,item,BUYR,OTBP from ttdipu001all 
where company =465 and 
len(ltrim(rtrim(concat(BUYR,otbp))))>2
) b
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and Consumption.Company= b.company
and Consumption.Company=465



update Consumption set BuyrCode=b.BUYR,SuppCode=b.OTBP
from (
select distinct company ,item,BUYR,OTBP from ttdipu001all 
where company =470 and 
len(ltrim(rtrim(concat(BUYR,otbp))))>2
) b
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and Consumption.Company= b.company
and Consumption.Company=470



update Consumption set BuyrCode=b.BUYR,SuppCode=b.OTBP
from (
select distinct company ,item,BUYR,OTBP from ttdipu001all 
where company =490 and 
len(ltrim(rtrim(concat(BUYR,otbp))))>2
) b
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and Consumption.Company= b.company
and Consumption.Company=490



update Consumption set BuyrCode=b.BUYR,SuppCode=b.OTBP
from (
select distinct company ,item,BUYR,OTBP from ttdipu001all 
where company not in (465,470,490) 
and COMPANY like '4%'
and len(ltrim(rtrim(concat(BUYR,otbp))))>2
) b
where ltrim(rtrim(Consumption.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM))
and Consumption.BuyrCode is null

update Consumption set buyrname=c.emp_name
from
(select isnull(new_emp_code,emp_code) as new_emp_code, emp_name from employee_details) c
where consumption.buyrcode=c.new_emp_code 

update Consumption set SuppName=d.custname1
from vw_Business_Partner d
where Consumption.SuppCode=d.custcode



select * from Consumption

end

--select emp_code,new_emp_code,emp_name from employee_details where emp_code=1177
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_COSEA_Sales_CUBE]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--SELECT * fROM COSEA_Sales_CUBE where custcode is NOT null order by date desc
--exec sp_COSEA_Sales_CUBE
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_COSEA_Sales_CUBE]
as 
Begin

truncate table COSEA_Sales_CUBE
insert into COSEA_Sales_CUBE

select * From (
select date,year(date)as Year,month(date)as month,DATENAME(mm,date)as Monthname, 
concat(
case when month(date)<4 then convert(varchar,year(date)-1) else convert(varchar,year(date))end,' - ',
case when month(date)<4 then convert(varchar,year(date)) else convert(varchar,year(date)+1)end)as Fin_Year,
case when month(date)<4 then month(date)+9 else month(date)-3 end as Fin_month,
organ,division,Vertical1,Area as areacode,areaname,dpst as Dpstcode,DPSTName,concat(area,' - ',areaname)as Area,concat(dpst,' - ',DPSTName)as Dpst,
sum(isnull(year_bud_2011,0))budget_2011,sum(isnull(year_bud_2012,0))budget_2012,sum(isnull(year_bud_2013,0))budget_2013,sum(isnull(year_bud_2014,0))budget_2014,
sum(isnull(year_bud_2015,0))budget_2015,sum(isnull(year_bud_2016,0))budget_2016,sum(isnull(year_bud_2017,0))budget_2017,
sum(isnull(year_sale_2011,0))sales_2011,sum(isnull(year_sale_2012,0))sales_2012,sum(isnull(year_sale_2013,0))sales_2013,sum(isnull(year_sale_2014,0))sales_2014,
sum(isnull(year_sale_2015,0))sales_2015,sum(isnull(year_sale_2016,0))sales_2016,sum(isnull(year_sale_2017,0))sales_2017,
null as custcode,null as custName 
from (
select 
--ISNULL(budget.global,sales.Global) as Global,
ISNULL(budget.organ ,sales.organ) as organ,
--ISNULL(budget.region,sales.region) as region,
--ISNULL(budget.user_names,sales.user_names) as user_names,
ISNULL(budget.Division,sales.Division) as Division,
ISNULL(budget.Vertical1,sales.Vertical1) as Vertical1,
ISNULL(budget.Area,sales.Areacode) as Area,
ISNULL(budget.areaname,sales.areaname) as areaname,
ISNULL(budget.dpst,sales.DPSTcode) as dpst,
ISNULL(budget.DPSTName,sales.DPSTName) as DPSTName,
ISNULL(budget.date,sales.date) as date, 
budget.year_bud_2011,budget.year_bud_2012,budget.year_bud_2013,budget.year_bud_2014,budget.year_bud_2015,budget.year_bud_2016,budget.year_bud_2017,
sales.year_sale_2011,sales.year_sale_2012,sales.year_sale_2013,sales.year_sale_2014,sales.year_sale_2015,sales.year_sale_2016,sales.year_sale_2017



 FROM (

SELECT	ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)) Global,date,
case when ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ)))='ISAAME' then 'SAAME' else ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ))) end as organ,
ltrim(rtrim(c.region)) region,
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)) user_names,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)) as Division,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)) as Vertical1,
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)) areaname,c.DPSTCode as dpst,c.DPSTName,

round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2011'AND '03/31/2012'THEN (a.target)  ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2011,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2012'AND '03/31/2013'THEN (a.target) ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2012,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2013'AND '03/31/2014'THEN (a.target) ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2013,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2014'AND '03/31/2015'THEN (a.target) ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2014,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2015'AND '03/31/2016'THEN (a.target) ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2015,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016'AND '03/31/2017'THEN (a.target) ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2016,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2017'AND '03/31/2018'THEN (a.target) ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_bud_2017

FROM	(select * from Sales_Budget where organ ='cosea')a
	INNER JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.Area))
	INNER JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode))    
		and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

GROUP BY date,ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)),ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ))),
ltrim(rtrim(c.region)),ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)),
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)),c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName
) AS budget    

full join 
(
select * From (
SELECT a.date ,b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.user_names,c.Division as Division,c.Vertical1,
b.Areacode,b.AreaName, d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.description,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2011'AND '03/31/2012'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2011,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2012'AND '03/31/2013'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2012,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2013'AND '03/31/2014'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2013,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2014'AND '03/31/2015'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2014,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2015'AND '03/31/2016'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2015,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016'AND '03/31/2017'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2016,
round(SUM(CASE WHEN Date BETWEEN '04/01/2017'AND '03/31/2018'THEN (a.sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END),2) AS year_sale_2017
 FROM 
(select distinct COMPANY,'' as SaleOrderType,convert(date,date)date,year(date)as year,month(date)as Month,dpst,Area as areacode,sum(AssesValue)as sales  From [ELGi_LN].dbo.TmpSlsDespData_baan 
where Company not like '6%' and convert(date,date) between '2011-04-01' and '2017-03-31' and SaleType in (0,2) 
and dpst is not null
and area is not null
group by  COMPANY,date,year(date),month(date),dpst,Area
--order by year(date),month(date) 
union 
select distinct COMPANY,SaleOrderType,convert(date,invoice_date)as date,year(Invoice_Date)as year,month(Invoice_Date)as Month,dpst,areacode,sum(Sales_amount)as sales  From [ELGi_LN].dbo.ELGi_Sales_Details 
where Company not like '6%' and convert(date,Invoice_Date)>='2017-04-01' and sales_category not in (1) 
and dpst is not null
and dpst not like '%[a-z]%'
and areacode is not null
and Organ is not null
and Organ <>''
and Organ ='cosea'
AND concat(company,SaleOrderType) in (
select concat(company,SaleOrderType) from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category not in (1))
group by COMPANY,SaleOrderType,invoice_date,year(Invoice_Date),month(Invoice_Date),dpst,areacode) a 
	
	left outer JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.areacode))
	left outer JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
	ON 	ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode)) 
	AND ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))
	left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER d
	on ltrim(rtrim(d.DpstCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

GROUP BY a.date,b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.user_names,c.Division,c.Vertical1,b.Areacode,b.AreaName,d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.Description 
)a
where organ ='cosea'
)sales
on budget.dpst =sales.DPSTcode
and budget.Area =sales.areacode 
and budget.Date =sales.date 
  
)a
group by organ,division,Vertical1,Area,areaname,dpst,DPSTName,date--,custcode 
)A
--where vertical1 not in ('EZL TO CUST','MED & AIRENDS')
--where concat(Year,month) <=concat(convert(varchar,year(GETDATE())),convert(varchar,month(GETDATE())) ) 


update COSEA_Sales_CUBE set custcode =a.custcode from (select distinct dpst,area,custcode  From [ELGi_LN].dbo.TmpSlsDespData_baan 
where Company not like '6%' and convert(date,date) between '2011-04-01' and '2017-03-31' and SaleType in (0,2))a 
where COSEA_Sales_CUBE.areacode =a.Area 
and COSEA_Sales_CUBE.Dpstcode =a.Dpst 
and COSEA_Sales_CUBE.date <'2017-04-01'  


update COSEA_Sales_CUBE set custcode =concat('CU1',convert(varchar,custcode))
WHERE COSEA_Sales_CUBE.date <'2017-04-01'  
AND COSEA_Sales_CUBE.custcode IS NOT NULL

update COSEA_Sales_CUBE set custcode =a.custcode from (select distinct dpst,areacode,custcode  From ELGi_Sales_Details 
where Company not like '6%' and convert(date,Invoice_Date)>='2017-04-01' and sales_category not in (1) 
and dpst is not null
and dpst not like '%[a-z]%'
and areacode is not null
and Organ is not null
and Organ <>''
and Organ ='cosea')a
where COSEA_Sales_CUBE.areacode =a.areacode 
and COSEA_Sales_CUBE.Dpstcode =a.Dpst 
and COSEA_Sales_CUBE.date >='2017-04-01'  

update COSEA_Sales_CUBE set custname = 'Customer' where custcode is not null

update COSEA_Sales_CUBE set custname =CONCAT(a.CustCode,' - ',a.CustName)  from DealerMaster_COSEA a
where COSEA_Sales_CUBE .custcode =a.CustCode 


end




GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_CoseaitemTemp]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/

--exec sp_CoseaitemTemp
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_CoseaitemTemp] as

begin

truncate table CoseaitemTemp
truncate table CoseaitemTemp2


Insert into CoseaitemTemp

select distinct company,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) as Item ,a.Item_desc
FROM 	ELGi_Sales_Details a 
left outer JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.areacode))
	left outer JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
	ON 	ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode)) 
	AND ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))
	left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER d
	on ltrim(rtrim(d.DpstCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 

AND a.SaleOrderType in (
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 
and c.Organ='COSEA'
GROUP BY b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.Zone, c.user_names,c.Division,c.Vertical1,
b.Areacode,b.AreaName,d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.Description,
a.company,a.warehouse,a.Item,a.Item_desc,
a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year


update CoseaitemTemp set item_desc=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001400 a
where CoseaitemTemp.company like '4%'
and CoseaitemTemp.company not in (465,470,490)
and ltrim(rtrim(CoseaitemTemp.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))


update CoseaitemTemp set item_desc=a.DSCA
from TTCIBD001490 a
where CoseaitemTemp.company=490
--and len(CoseaitemTemp.Item_desc)<3
and ltrim(rtrim(CoseaitemTemp.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))

update CoseaitemTemp set item_desc=a.DSCA
from TTCIBD001551 a
where CoseaitemTemp.company=551
and ltrim(rtrim(CoseaitemTemp.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))

update CoseaitemTemp set item_desc=a.DSCA
from TTCIBD001552 a
where CoseaitemTemp.company=552
and ltrim(rtrim(CoseaitemTemp.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))


insert into CoseaitemTemp2
select distinct a.company,a.Item,a.Item_desc,null,null from CoseaitemTemp a
where 
concat(company,ltrim(rtrim(item))) not in 
(select concat(company,ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode))) from ItemMaster_COSEA)
--and concat(company,ltrim(rtrim(item)))='401B008603620001'


insert into CoseaitemTemp2
select distinct null,item_code,null,null,null from Itemwise_Budget
where concat(DPST,Area) in 
(select distinct concat(DPSTCode,Areacode) from SalesMapping_Global where organ='COSEA')
and ltrim(rtrim(item_code)) not in (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(itemcode)) from ItemMaster_COSEA)



Insert into ItemMaster_COSEA
select company,itemcode,item_desc,category,productline from 
(select company,itemcode,item_desc,category,productline,
row_number() over (partition by company,ltrim(rtrim(itemcode)) order by item_desc) as rnk from CoseaitemTemp2)a
where rnk=1 
order by itemcode,company


update ItemMaster_COSEA set category=null where category='null'
update ItemMaster_COSEA set productline=null where productline='null'

update ItemMaster_COSEA set item_desc=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001400 a
where ltrim(rtrim(ItemMaster_COSEA.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))
and Item_desc is null

update ItemMaster_COSEA set item_desc=a.dsca
from TTCIBD001551 a
where ltrim(rtrim(ItemMaster_COSEA.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and Item_desc is null

update ItemMaster_COSEA set item_desc=a.dsca
from TTCIBD001552 a
where ltrim(rtrim(ItemMaster_COSEA.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and Item_desc is null


delete from ItemMaster_COSEA where Item_desc is null

end

--in (select ItemCode from ItemMaster_COSEA where Item_desc is null)
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_cost_consolidated]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- exec sp_cost_consolidated
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_cost_consolidated]
as
begin

--create table cost_consolidated
--(
--description varchar(100),
--basic float,
--exchange float,
--qtydiff float,
--impdom_domimp float,
--costdiff float,
--remarks varchar(200)
--)

--insert into cost_consolidated(description) values ('Price decrease')
--insert into cost_consolidated(description) values ('BOM Addition')
--insert into cost_consolidated(description) values ('BOM Deletion')
--insert into cost_consolidated(description) values ('BOM Revision')
--insert into cost_consolidated(description) values ('Make to Buy - castings')
--insert into cost_consolidated(description) values ('Net Incr/Decr')


update cost_consolidated set basic=-1*(a.basic) ,exchange =-1*(a.Exchange_Diff) ,qtydiff =-1*(a.QTYDIFF) ,impdom_domimp =-1*(a.di_id) ,costdiff =-1*(a.NETDIFF)  
 from(
select sum(Pricediff)as basic,sum(Exchange_Diff)Exchange_Diff,sum(QTYDIFF)QTYDIFF,(sum(DOM_IMP)+sum(IMP_DOM))as di_id,sum(NETDIFF)NETDIFF From (
select a.*,B.CItem,B.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],b.Qty as CQty,b.Cur as CCur,b.CostPrice as CCostPrice,B.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,b.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,b.Basic_price as CBasic_price,'Match'as Status,'' as BOMADD,'' as BOMDEL,
round((a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]),2) AS NETDIFF ,

round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) AND (A.Cur<>'IND' AND B.Cur<>'IND')   then ((a.Basic_price -b.Basic_price)*b.Exch_Rate*a.Qty*1.15)
WHEN (A.Cur='IND' AND B.Cur='IND') AND (A.QTY=B.Qty) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%])  else 0 end,2) as Pricediff,  


round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) AND (A.Cur<>'IND' AND B.Cur<>'IND') then(((a.Qty-b.Qty)*b.Exch_Rate)*b.Basic_price*1.15)

WHEN (A.Cur='IND' AND B.Cur='IND') AND (A.QTY<>B.Qty) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) else 0 end,2) as QTYDIFF,

round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) then (((a.Exch_Rate-b.Exch_Rate)*a.Basic_price)*a.Qty*1.15) else 0 end,2) as  Exchange_Diff,

round(case when (a.cur<>b.cur) and (A.Exch_Rate<B.Exch_Rate) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END,2)AS  DOM_IMP,
round(CASE WHEN (a.cur<>b.cur) and (A.Exch_Rate>B.Exch_Rate) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END,2)AS  IMP_DOM

     From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price  From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
inner join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem)a
where NETDIFF <0
)a
where cost_consolidated.description ='Price increase'


update cost_consolidated set basic=-1*(a.basic) ,exchange =-1*(a.Exchange_Diff) ,qtydiff =-1*(a.QTYDIFF) ,impdom_domimp =-1*(a.di_id) ,costdiff =-1*(a.NETDIFF)  
 from(
select sum(Pricediff)as basic,sum(Exchange_Diff)Exchange_Diff,sum(QTYDIFF)QTYDIFF,(sum(DOM_IMP)+sum(IMP_DOM))as di_id,sum(NETDIFF)NETDIFF From (
select a.*,B.CItem,B.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],b.Qty as CQty,b.Cur as CCur,b.CostPrice as CCostPrice,B.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,b.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,b.Basic_price as CBasic_price,'Match'as Status,'' as BOMADD,'' as BOMDEL,
round((a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]),2) AS NETDIFF ,
round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) AND (A.Cur<>'IND' AND B.Cur<>'IND')   then ((a.Basic_price -b.Basic_price)*b.Exch_Rate*a.Qty*1.15)
WHEN (A.Cur='IND' AND B.Cur='IND') AND (A.QTY=B.Qty) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%])  else 0 end,2) as Pricediff,  
round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) AND (A.Cur<>'IND' AND B.Cur<>'IND') then(((a.Qty-b.Qty)*b.Exch_Rate)*b.Basic_price*1.15)
WHEN (A.Cur='IND' AND B.Cur='IND') AND (A.QTY<>B.Qty) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) else 0 end,2) as QTYDIFF,
round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) then (((a.Exch_Rate-b.Exch_Rate)*a.Basic_price)*a.Qty*1.15) else 0 end,2) as  Exchange_Diff,
round(case when (a.cur<>b.cur) and (A.Exch_Rate<B.Exch_Rate) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END,2)AS  DOM_IMP,
round(CASE WHEN (a.cur<>b.cur) and (A.Exch_Rate>B.Exch_Rate) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END,2)AS  IMP_DOM

     From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price  From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
inner join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem)a
where NETDIFF >0
)a
where cost_consolidated.description ='Price decrease'



update cost_consolidated set costdiff =-1*a.BOMDEL
from(
select sum(BOMDEL) as BOMDEL From (
select a.*,'BOMDEL'as Status,'' as BOMADD,[Import+15%] as BOMDEL,'' AS NETDIFF,'' as Pricediff,'' as QTYDIFF,''as Exchange_Diff,'' as DOM_IMP,'' AS IMP_DOM
   from (
			select A.*,B.CItem,B.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],b.Qty as CQty,b.Cur as CCur,b.CostPrice as CCostPrice,B.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,b.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,b.Basic_price as CBasic_price  From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price  From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
left join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price
From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem
)a
where a.CItem is null)a
)a
where cost_consolidated.description ='BOM Deletion'


update cost_consolidated set costdiff =a.BOMADD
from(
select sum(BOMADD) as BOMADD From (
select a.*,'BOMADD'as Status,[Import+15%]  as BOMADD,''as BOMDEL,'' AS NETDIFF,'' as Pricediff,'' as QTYDIFF,''as Exchange_Diff,'' as DOM_IMP,'' AS IMP_DOM
   from (
			select B.*,A.BItem,A.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],A.Qty as CQty,A.Cur as CCur,A.CostPrice as CCostPrice,A.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,A.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,A.Basic_price as CBasic_price  From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
RIGHT join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN Rate_Unit ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN Rate_Unit ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price 
From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem
)a
where a.BItem is null)a
)a
where cost_consolidated.description ='BOM Addition'

--update cost_consolidated set costdiff =a.revision
--from(
--select (sum(a.bomdel)-sum(b.BOMADD))as revision From (
--select a.*,'BOMDEL'as Status,'' as BOMADD,[Import+15%] as BOMDEL,'' AS NETDIFF,'' as Pricediff,'' as QTYDIFF,''as Exchange_Diff,'' as DOM_IMP,'' AS IMP_DOM

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[SP_COST_DATA]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--EXEC SP_COST_DATA
CREATE PROC [dbo].[SP_COST_DATA]
AS
BEGIN

TRUNCATE TABLE COST_DATA
INSERT INTO Cost_Data 
----------------START MATCH
select a.*,B.CItem,B.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],b.Qty as CQty,b.Cur as CCur,b.CostPrice as CCostPrice,B.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,b.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,b.Basic_price as CBasic_price,'Match'as Status,'' as BOMADD,'' as BOMDEL,

--(B.[Import+15%]-A.[Import+15%])AS NETDIFF,
--case when (a.cur='IND'and b.Cur='IND') THEN ((b.Rate_Unit-a.Rate_Unit)*B.Qty) 
--when (a.cur<>'IND'and b.Cur<>'IND') THEN ((b.Basic_price-a.Basic_price)*a.Exch_Rate*1.15*b.Qty ) ELSE 0 end as Pricediff,
--case when a.Qty=b.Qty then 0 else ((B.Rate_Unit*B.Qty)-(a.Rate_Unit*a.Qty)) end as QTYDIFF,
--case when a.Exch_Rate=b.Exch_Rate then 0 else ((b.Exch_Rate-a.Exch_Rate)*(b.Basic_price)*b.Qty) end as Exchange_Diff,
--CASE WHEN (A.Exch_Rate<B.Exch_Rate) THEN (B.[Import+15%]-A.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END  DOM_IMP,
--CASE WHEN (A.Exch_Rate>B.Exch_Rate) THEN (B.[Import+15%]-A.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END  IMP_DOM

round((a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]),2) AS NETDIFF ,
round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) AND (A.Cur<>'IND' AND B.Cur<>'IND')   then ((a.Basic_price -b.Basic_price)*b.Exch_Rate*a.Qty*1.15)
WHEN (A.Cur='IND' AND B.Cur='IND') AND (A.QTY=B.Qty) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%])  else 0 end,2) as Pricediff,  
round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) AND (A.Cur<>'IND' AND B.Cur<>'IND') then(((a.Qty-b.Qty)*b.Exch_Rate)*b.Basic_price*1.15)
WHEN (A.Cur='IND' AND B.Cur='IND') AND (A.QTY<>B.Qty) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) else 0 end,2) as QTYDIFF,
round(case when (a.cur=b.cur) then (((a.Exch_Rate-b.Exch_Rate)*a.Basic_price)*a.Qty*1.15) else 0 end,2) as  Exchange_Diff,
round(case when (a.cur<>b.cur) and (A.Exch_Rate<B.Exch_Rate) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END,2)AS  DOM_IMP,
round(CASE WHEN (a.cur<>b.cur) and (A.Exch_Rate>B.Exch_Rate) THEN (a.[Import+15%]-b.[Import+15%]) ELSE 0 END,2)AS  IMP_DOM

     From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN 0 ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN 0 ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price  From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
inner join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,
SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN 0 ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN 0 ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem
----------------------------END MATCH

union 

-------------------------- START BOMDEL
select a.*,'BOMDEL'as Status,'' as BOMADD,[Import+15%] as BOMDEL,'' AS NETDIFF,'' as Pricediff,'' as QTYDIFF,''as Exchange_Diff,'' as DOM_IMP,'' AS IMP_DOM
   from (
			select A.*,B.CItem,B.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],b.Qty as CQty,b.Cur as CCur,b.CostPrice as CCostPrice,B.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,b.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,b.Basic_price as CBasic_price  From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN 0 ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN 0 ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price  From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
left join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN 0 ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN 0 ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem
)a
where a.CItem is null
---------------------- END BOMDEL

UNION 

----------------------START BOMADD 
select a.*,'BOMADD'as Status,[Import+15%]  as BOMADD,''as BOMDEL,'' AS NETDIFF,'' as Pricediff,'' as QTYDIFF,''as Exchange_Diff,'' as DOM_IMP,'' AS IMP_DOM
   from (
			select B.*,A.BItem,A.[Import+15%] as [CImport+15%],A.Qty as CQty,A.Cur as CCur,A.CostPrice as CCostPrice,A.Rate_Unit AS CRate_Unit,A.Exch_Rate as CExch_Rate,A.Basic_price as CBasic_price  From (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as BItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN 0 ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN 0 ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price  From cost_base 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item))a
RIGHT join (
select itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)as CItem,
sum(Quantity)as Qty,sum([Import+15%])[Import+15%],sum(CostPrice)CostPrice,sum(Exch_Rate)Exch_Rate,sum(Rate_Unit)Rate_Unit,SUM(case when cur='IND'THEN 0 ELSE(CASE WHEN Exch_Rate=0 THEN 0 ELSE Rate_Unit/Exch_Rate END) END) AS Basic_price From cost_comparision 
group by itemselected,[desc],main_item,mainitmdesc,child_item,item_description,TYPE,Cur,concat(itemselected,main_item,child_item)
)b
on a.BItem =b.citem
)a
where a.BItem is null
----------------------------------- END BOMADD
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_cost_difference]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- exec sp_cost_difference
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_cost_difference]
as
begin

--create table cost_difference
--(Status varchar(100),BPrice float,Nprice float,NetPrice float)

--truncate table cost_difference
--insert into cost_difference(Status) values('Base')
--insert into cost_difference(Status) values('New')
--insert into cost_difference(Status) values('Net Incr/Decr')

update cost_difference set BPrice =a.base,Nprice =0,netprice=0 from(select sum([Import+15%]) as base From cost_BASE)a where cost_difference.Status ='Base'
update cost_difference set BPrice =0,Nprice=base,netprice=0 from(select sum([Import+15%]) as base From Cost_Comparision)a where cost_difference.Status ='New'

update cost_difference set BPrice=0,nprice=0  where cost_difference.Status ='Net Incr/Decr'


update cost_difference set  netprice=a.nf from (select (sum(nprice)-sum(bprice)) as Nf from cost_difference)a where cost_difference.Status ='Net Incr/Decr'

--select * From cost_difference

select sum(bprice) as Base,sum(nprice) as New,round(sum(netprice),2) as [Net Incr/Decr] from cost_difference
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_Debtors_DocdtWise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/

--exec sp_Debtors_DocdtWise
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Debtors_DocdtWise] as

begin

Truncate Table Debtors_DocdtWise

Insert into Debtors_DocdtWise 
select * from (
select company,cur,CurRate,area,AreaName,Zone,region,global,CustNo,CustName1,FinCustGrp,
Trantyp,InvNo,[LineNo],DocDt,DueDt,noofdays,ProductGrp,Division,description,ardivision,ardivisiondesc,filt_typ,
dpstname,Indent,Refrence,

avg(invval_fc) invval_fc,
avg(InvAmntInHomeCur) InvAmntInHomeCur,
avg(RecAmntHomeCur) RecAmntHomeCur,
avg(BalAmntHomeCur) BalAmntHomeCur,
avg(DueAmt) DueAmt,
avg(UnDueAmt) UnDueAmt,

avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 0 and 30 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC30,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 31 and 60 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC31_60,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 61 and 90 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC61_90,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 91 and 120 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC91_120,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 121 and 150 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC121_150,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 151 and 180 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC151_180,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 181 and 365 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC181_365,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 366 and 730 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC366_730,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) between 731 and 1095 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtHC731_1095,
avg(case when datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1) > 1095 then dueamt else 0 end) as DueAmtgt_1095,
datediff(dd,duedt,getdate()-1)  as datediff,

case when description = 'exports' then 'International' 
when description = 'Compressor-Channel' then 'Channel' 
when description = 'Compressor-C&M' then 'Compressor-C&M' 
when description = 'Compressor-WW' then 'Compressor-WW' 
when description = 'Compressor-Direct' then 'Direct' 
when description = 'Compressor-RLY' then 'Compressor-RLY'
when description = 'After Sales' then 'After Sales'
else 'Others' end as description1,

case when description = 'exports' then 7 
when description = 'Compressor-Channel' then 1
when description = 'Compressor-C&M' then 2
when description = 'Compressor-WW' then 3
 when description = 'Compressor-Direct' then 4
when description = 'Compressor-RLY' then 5
when description = 'After Sales' then 6
else 7 end as ordering1,

case when global = 'International' then region else zone end as zone1

from 
(select * from vw_ACR_Consolidated_AME
where company not in (423)
and InvAmntInHomeCur>0
and BalAmntHomeCur>5
--and area in ( select distinct Areacode from SalesMapping_Global 
--where ltrim(rtrim(region)) in ('AFRICA','MIDDLE EAST & WEST ASIA'))
)a

group by
company,cur,CurRate,area,AreaName,Zone,region,global,CustNo,CustName1,
FinCustGrp,Trantyp,InvNo,[LineNo],DocDt,DueDt,noofdays,ProductGrp,Division,
description,ardivision,ardivisiondesc,filt_typ,dpstname
,Indent,Refrence

)A
order by global,description,zone,areaname


end

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_DOL] as

Begin

Truncate table DOL

--Drop table DOL
Insert into  DOL
--select * into DOL from (
select a.year,a.month,a.monthname,week,
COMPANY,T$RCNO,Rec_Date,T$ORNO,T$PONO,T$SQNB,CWAR,ITEM,null as Item_desc,OTBP,null as SupplierName ,
count(*) as Rec_Count,null as DOL_SysCnt,null as DOL_ManCnt,sum(QIAP) QIAP 
from (
select year(a.T$DDTE) as year,month(a.T$DDTE) as month,datename(mm,a.T$DDTE) as monthname,
datepart(week, a.T$DDTE) as week,
convert(date,a.T$DDTE) Rec_Date,a.COMPANY,b.OTBP,T$RCNO,
a.T$ORNO,a.T$PONO,a.T$SQNB,b.CWAR,b.ITEM,b.QIAP
from TTDPUR406ALL a
left outer join TTDPUR401ALL b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY 
and a.T$ORNO=b.ORNO
and a.T$PONO=b.PONO
and a.T$SQNB=b.SQNB
--WHERE a.COMPANY=401
--and a.T$QUAL=1  --Inspectable Item
--and cwar IN ('209','211','212','246','252','253') 
)a
group by a.year,a.month,a.monthname,week,Rec_Date,
COMPANY,T$RCNO,T$ORNO,T$PONO,T$SQNB,OTBP,CWAR,ITEM
--)a


update DOL set SupplierName=a.custname1
from vw_Business_Partner a
where ltrim(rtrim(DOL.otbp))=ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))


update DOL set Item_desc=a.Item_desc
from
(select 400 as company,ltrim(rtrim(t_item))as Item,t_dsca as Item_desc From TTCIBD001400)a
where ltrim(rtrim(DOL.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))


update  DOL set DOL_SysCnt=b.DOL_SysCount
from (
select year,month,monthname,week,--ADAT,
COMPANY,RCNO,ORNO,a.PONO,SEQN,OTBP,AVG(cnt) as DOL_SysCount from
(select year(a.ADAT) as year,month(a.ADAT) as month,datename(mm,a.ADAT) as monthname, 
datepart(week, a.ADAT) as week,a.ADAT,a.COMPANY,b.OTBP,a.RCNO,
a.ORNO,a.PONO,a.SEQN,a.QAPR,a.QTBU,1 as cnt 
from TWHINH211ALL a
left outer join TTDPUR401ALL b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY 
and a.ORNO=b.ORNO
and a.PONO=b.PONO
and a.SEQN=b.SQNB
WHERE concat(a.COMPANY,a.ORNO) in (select concat(COMPANY,T$ORNO) from TZZIBD207ALL)
and a.COMPANY=401
--AND a.CWAR IN ('209','211','212','246','252','253') 
--AND CONVERT(DATE,a.ADAT) BETWEEN @Fromdate and @Todate 
--AND b.OTBP = @Suno
)a
group by year,month,monthname,week,COMPANY,RCNO,ORNO,PONO,SEQN,OTBP
)b
where DOL.COMPANY=b.COMPANY
and DOL.T$ORNO=b.ORNO
and DOL.T$PONO=b.PONO
and DOL.T$SQNB=b.SEQN
--and DOL.T$RCNO=b.RCNO

update  DOL set DOL_ManCnt=b.DOL_ManCount
from (
select year,month,monthname,week,
COMPANY,RCNO,ORNO,PONO,SEQN,OTBP,AVG(cnt) as DOL_ManCount from
(select year(a.ADAT) as year,month(a.ADAT) as month,datename(mm,a.ADAT) as monthname, 
datepart(week, a.ADAT) as week,convert(date,a.ADAT) ADAT,a.COMPANY,b.OTBP,a.RCNO,
a.ORNO,a.PONO,a.SEQN,a.QAPR,a.QTBU,1 as cnt 
from TWHINH211ALL a
left outer join TTDPUR401ALL b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY 
and a.ORNO=b.ORNO
and a.pono=b.pono
and a.SEQN=b.SQNB
WHERE concat(a.COMPANY,a.ORNO) not in (select concat(COMPANY,T$ORNO) from TZZIBD207ALL)
and a.COMPANY=401
--AND a.CWAR IN ('209','211','212','246','252','253') 
)a
group by year,month,monthname,week,
COMPANY,RCNO,ORNO,PONO,SEQN,OTBP
)b
where DOL.COMPANY=b.COMPANY
and DOL.T$ORNO=b.ORNO
and DOL.T$PONO=b.PONO
and DOL.T$SQNB=b.SEQN


--and DOL.T$RCNO=b.RCNO


End

company,Division_Code,Function_Code,Dept_Code

from (select *,
dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))  as Data_Load_Date 
--'2016-08-31 00:00:00.000' as Data_Load_Date 
from Hr_master_stage) Hr_master_stage
where Status='ACTIVE'
and company=100
and convert(date,[Start Date])<=
dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))

union all

CASE WHEN month(Data_Load_Date) > 3 THEN (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) + 1)) 
                      ELSE (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date))) END AS Fin_Year,
case when convert(date,[Start Date])='' or convert(date,[Start Date]) is null then ''
else convert(date,[Start Date]) end as Start_Date,
null,null,null,null,null,
company,Division_Code,Function_Code,Dept_Code

from (select *,
dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01')) as Data_Load_Date 
--'2016-08-31 00:00:00.000' as Data_Load_Date 
from Hr_master_stage) Hr_master_stage
where Status<>'ACTIVE'
and [Seperation Date] between 
--'2016-02-29 00:00:00.000'
(select max(Data_Load_Date) from HR_MASTER) and
dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))
and company=100


union all

select [Pers#No#] as Emp_Code,
Char80 as Emp_Name,

CASE WHEN [Seperation Date] IS NULL THEN ''

ELSE [Seperation Date] END as Seperation_Date,
case  when  [Trasf Date] is null then ''

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ELGI_HR_ATTRITION_ANALYSIS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

--exec sp_ELGI_HR_ATTRITION_ANALYSIS
--select * from hr_attrition_analysis

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ELGI_HR_ATTRITION_ANALYSIS] as

begin

Truncate table HR_Attrition_Analysis
Truncate table ELGi_HR_Final_Data


insert into ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
select GLOBAL,Emp_Name,OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE,EMP_CODE,ERANK,Designation,Org_Unit,Division_Name,Function_Name,Department,
Band,Location,Emp_Status,Reason,Seperation_Date,Transfer_Date,New_Division,New_Function,New_Department,EE_Subgroup,
Start_Date,Data_Load_Date,num,FinMonthNo,FinMonthName,FinYear,Fin_Year from vw_elgi_HR

declare @FinYear int
declare @FinMonthNo int
declare @FinYearCnt int
declare @FinMonthNoCnt int
declare @ResignedCnt int
declare @count1 int
declare @count2 int
declare @OpeningBalance int
declare @JoinedCnt int
declare @closingbalance int =0


set @FinYear=(select min(FinYear) from ELGi_HR_Final_Data)
set @FinMonthNo=1
set @FinYearCnt=(select count(distinct FinYear) from ELGi_HR_Final_Data)
set @count1=1
set @count2=1



while (@count1<=@FinYearCnt)

begin


set @FinMonthNo=1
set @count2=1


set @FinYear=(
select finyear from 
(select finyear ,row_number() over (order by finyear) finyearrank from
(select distinct finyear from ELGi_HR_Final_Data)a)b
where finyearrank=@count1)


set @FinMonthNoCnt=(select count(distinct FinMonthNo) from ELGi_HR_Final_Data where FinYear=@FinYear)


while(@count2<=@FinMonthNoCnt)

begin


--Part 2

if((@FinMonthNo<=12 and @FinYear='2015') or (@FinMonthNo=1 and @FinYear='2016'))   ---Attrition Logic for Manual Source data from HRD

begin


--calculating Joined Counts based on difference in two months data

set @JoinedCnt=
(
select case when count(*)>1000 then 0 else count(*) end as ResignedCnt from
(
select distinct Emp_Code from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where Band<>'0'
and FinMonthNo=case when @FinMonthNo+1 =13 then 1 else @FinMonthNo+1 end 
and FinYear=case when @FinMonthNo+1 =13 then @FinYear+1 else @FinYear end

except

select distinct Emp_Code from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where Band<>'0'
and FinMonthNo=@FinMonthNo 
and FinYear=@FinYear

)a
)

--calculating Resigned Counts based on difference in two months data

set @ResignedCnt =
(
select case when count(*)>1000 then 0 else count(*) end as ResignedCnt from
(
select distinct Emp_Code from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band <>'0'
and FinMonthNo=@FinMonthNo 
and FinYear=@FinYear

except

select distinct Emp_Code from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band <>'0'
and FinMonthNo=case when @FinMonthNo+1 =13 then 1 else @FinMonthNo+1 end 
and FinYear=case when @FinMonthNo+1 =13 then @FinYear+1 else @FinYear end
)a
)

set @OpeningBalance =@closingbalance

end

--End of Part 2



----Part 3

else  ---Attrition Logic for SAP Source data


begin


set @JoinedCnt=(select count(distinct emp_code) from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band<>'0'
and month(Start_Date)=
case when @FinMonthNo<10 then @FinMonthNo+3 else @FinMonthNo-9  end 
and year(Start_Date)=
case when @FinMonthNo<10 then @FinYear else @FinYear+1 end
)


set @ResignedCnt =(select count(distinct emp_code) from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band<>'0'
and month(Seperation_Date)=
case when @FinMonthNo<10 then @FinMonthNo+3 else @FinMonthNo-9  end 
and year(Seperation_Date)=
case when @FinMonthNo<10 then @FinYear else @FinYear+1 end
)


end

--End of Part 3


--Part 1

if(@FinMonthNo=1 and @FinYear='2015')  ---Attrition Logic for Manual Source data from HRD

begin

set @JoinedCnt=0

set @ResignedCnt =
(
select case when count(*)>1000 then 0 else count(*) end as ResignedCnt from
(
select distinct Emp_Code from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band <>'0'
and FinMonthNo=
@FinMonthNo 
and FinYear=
@FinYear

except

select distinct Emp_Code from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band <>'0'
and FinMonthNo=
case when @FinMonthNo+1 =13 then 1 else @FinMonthNo+1 end 
and FinYear=
case when @FinMonthNo+1 =13 then @FinYear+1 else @FinYear end
)a
)


set   @OpeningBalance= 
(select sum(num) from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band<>'0'
and FinMonthNo=@FinMonthNo
and FinYear=@FinYear
group by finyear,FinMonthNo,FinMonthName
)



end

--End of Part 1



set @closingbalance =@OpeningBalance+@JoinedCnt-@ResignedCnt



insert into HR_Attrition_Analysis
select FinYear,FinMonthNo,FinMonthName,
@OpeningBalance,
@JoinedCnt as Joined,
@ResignedCnt as Resigned,
@closingbalance as ClosingBalance
from ELGi_HR_Final_Data 
where band<>'0'
and FinMonthNo=@FinMonthNo
--case when @FinMonthNo<10 then @FinMonthNo-3 else @FinMonthNo-9  end 
and FinYear=@FinYear
--case when @FinMonthNo<10 then @FinYear else @FinYear+1 end
group by finyear,FinMonthNo,FinMonthName


set   @OpeningBalance= @closingbalance

set @FinMonthNo=@FinMonthNo+1
set @count2=@count2+1


end --End of Month loop


set @count1=@count1+1

end --End of Year loop

end




GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ELGi_Production]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Alter table ELGi_production_Stage2 add LineNum int null,Line varchar(25) null,
--SubLineNum int null,SubLine varchar(25) null,RegionNum int null, Region varchar(25) null


--exec sp_ELGi_Production

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ELGi_Production] as
begin

truncate table ELGi_production_Stage1
truncate table ELGi_production_Stage2


--Closed (current Month)

insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Actual_qty)
select COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,ORNO,TRDT,
sum(QSTK) as Actual_qty 
from TWHINR110ALL 
where KOST=3 and KOOR=1 
and ORNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and month(TRDT)=month(getdate()-1)
and year(TRDT)=year(getdate()-1)
group by COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,ORNO,TRDT


--WIP (Till Yesterday)

insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,Date1,WIP_qty)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,
b.date as WIP_Date,
sum(case when ADLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when a.OSTA IN(4,6) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as WIP_qty
from  TTISFC001ALL a 
left outer join
(
select * from (
select PDNO,OSTA,convert(date,date) as date,row_number() over (partition by pdno order by date) dateRank 
from TTICST151ALL
where OSTA in (4,6)
--and PDNO='230009816' --for testing Purpose
)b1
where dateRank=1
)b
on a.PDNO=b.PDNO

where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and b.date< getdate()-1
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,b.date
)a
where WIP_qty<>0


--Plan Pulling (greater than today)

insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,Date1,PlanPullQty)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD as Planned_Date,
sum(case when ADLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when a.OSTA in (4,6) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as WIP_qty
from  TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD) > getdate()-1
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where WIP_qty<>0

--Plan Pulling (Closed Qty greater than today is covered under Plan Pulling)
insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,Date1,PlanPullQty)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD as Planned_Date,
sum(case when ADLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when a.OSTA in (8,9) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as ClosedQty
from  TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD) > getdate()-1
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where ClosedQty<>0



--Backlog (Till yesterday)

insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Backlog_Qty)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then null else (case when osta in (1,2,3) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD) <getdate()-1
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where Planned_qty>0


update ELGi_production_Stage1 set Released_qty=isnull(Actual_qty,0)  +isnull(WIP_qty,0)
update ELGi_production_Stage1 set Planned_qty=isnull(Released_qty,0) +isnull(Backlog_Qty,0) -isnull(PlanPullQty,0)



insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Day1)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta in (1,2,3) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD)  = (select date1 from vw_next_5workingdays where daterank=1)
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where Planned_qty>0



insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Day2)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta in (1,2,3) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD)  = (select date1 from vw_next_5workingdays where daterank=2)
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where Planned_qty>0




insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Day3)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta in (1,2,3) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD)  = (select date1 from vw_next_5workingdays where daterank=3)
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where Planned_qty>0




insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Day4)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta in (1,2,3) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD)  = (select date1 from vw_next_5workingdays where daterank=4)
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where Planned_qty>0


insert into ELGi_production_Stage1(company,warehouse,item,Ordernum,date1,Day5)
select * from (
select a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta in (1,2,3) then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
and convert(date,RDLD)  = (select date1 from vw_next_5workingdays where daterank=5)
group by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.MITM,a.PDNO,RDLD
)a
where Planned_qty>0




--Production order category
update ELGi_production_Stage1 set Description=b.Description
from (
select distinct a.company,Description,prd_from,prd_to from ELGi_Production_Master a
left outer join ELGi_AssemblyLine_Master b
on b.code = a.assemblycode
)b
where ELGi_production_Stage1.Ordernum between b.prd_from and b.prd_to  
and ELGi_production_Stage1.company = b.company



--Item Description

update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_dsca))
from TTCIBD001400 a
where ELGi_production_Stage1.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where Company not in (465,490,551,552) and CompanyGroup ='ELGi')
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))


update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.DSCA))
from TTCIBD001465 a
where ELGi_production_Stage1.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where Company =465)
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))


update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))
from TTCIBD001490 a
where ELGi_production_Stage1.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where Company =490 )
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))


update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))
from TTCIBD001551 a
where ELGi_production_Stage1.company =551
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))

update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))
from TTCIBD001552 a
where ELGi_production_Stage1.company =552
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))

update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_dsca))
from TTCIBD001600 a
where ELGi_production_Stage1.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup ='ATS'  )
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))


update ELGi_production_Stage1 set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))

update ELGi_production_Stage1 set description='Others' where description is null

from TZZSFC270ALL a
where ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_Stage1.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.MITM))

update ELGi_production_Stage1 set line=a.Line

This_mnth_ReleasedQty,This_mnth_WIPQty,This_mnth_ActualQty,
Day1,Day2,Day3,Day4,Day5)

Description,company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Ordernum,
LineNum,Line,SubLineNum,SubLine,RegionNum,Region,
sum(isnull(Planned_qty,0)) Planned_qty,
sum(isnull(Released_qty,0)) Released_qty,
sum(isnull(WIP_qty,0)) WIP_qty,
sum(isnull(PlanPullQty,0)) PlanPullQty,
sum(isnull(Actual_qty,0)) Actual_qty,
sum(isnull(Backlog_Qty,0)) Backlog_Qty,
sum(isnull(BacklogPlanned_qty,0)) BacklogPlanned_qty,
sum(isnull(BacklogReleased_qty,0)) BacklogReleased_qty,
sum(isnull(BacklogWIP_qty,0)) BacklogWIP_qty,
sum(isnull(This_mnth_ReleasedQty,0)) This_mnth_ReleasedQty,
sum(isnull(This_mnth_WIPQty,0)) This_mnth_WIPQty,

sum(isnull(Day2,0)) Day2Qty,

from ELGi_production_Stage1
group by Description,company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Ordernum,
LineNum,Line,SubLineNum,SubLine,RegionNum,Region

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_ELGi_production_details]
as
begin

--alter table production_plan_vs_actual alter column Prodorderno float
--alter table TTISFC001ALL alter column qrdr float

TRUNCATE TABLE production_plan_vs_actual
TRUNCATE TABLE ELGi_production_details
TRUNCATE TABLE LEPSAC_Items_Tmp1
TRUNCATE TABLE ELGi_Production_Backlogs
TRUNCATE TABLE PDNO_CANCELLED
TRUNCATE TABLE Production_Summary
Truncate table WIP_Ageing 
Truncate table Production_ALC
Truncate table Production_ALCdate_Temp
Truncate table Production_Summary_Temp

--Planned
insert  into production_plan_vs_actual
--select * into production_plan_vs_actual from (
select distinct
convert(date,RDLD) as date1,
company,
PDNO as Prodorderno,
CWAR as Warehouse,
a.MITM as Item,
sum(case when RDLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta>=1 then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Planned_qty,
0 as Released_qty,
0 as Actual_qty,
0 as WIP_qty,
0 as avg_bud_price,
0 as sls_price,
0 as Dispatch_Qty
from TTISFC001ALL a 
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
--a.PDNO not like '%p%'
--and a.PDNO not like '%sc%'
--and a.PDNO='261004462' --for testing purpose
group by convert(date,RDLD),company,PDNO,CWAR,MITM,OSTA




--Released
insert  into production_plan_vs_actual
select distinct
convert(date,ReleaseDt) as date1,
company,
PDNO as Prodorderno,
CWAR as Warehouse,
a.MITM as Item,
0 as Planned_qty,
sum(case when ADLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta>=4 then qrdr else 0 end) end) as Released_qty,
0 as Actual_qty,
0 as WIP_qty,
0 as avg_bud_price,
0 as sls_price,
0 as Production_Qty
from (
select a.*,b.date as ReleaseDt from  TTISFC001ALL a 
left outer join
(
select * from (
select PDNO,OSTA,convert(date,date) as date,row_number() over (partition by pdno order by date) dateRank 
from TTICST151ALL
where OSTA in (4,6)
--and PDNO='230009816' --for testing Purpose
)b1
where dateRank=1
)b
on a.PDNO=b.PDNO
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
--a.PDNO not like '%p%'
--and a.PDNO not like '%sc%'
--and a.PDNO='230009816' --for testing Purpose
) a
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
--a.PDNO not like '%p%'
--and a.PDNO not like '%sc%'
--and a.PDNO='230009816' --for testing purpose
group by ReleaseDt,company,PDNO,CWAR,MITM,OSTA



--WIP
insert  into production_plan_vs_actual
select distinct
convert(date,WIP_Dt) as date1,
company,
PDNO as Prodorderno,
CWAR as Warehouse,
a.MITM as Item,
0 as Planned_qty,
0 as Released_qty,
0 as Actual_qty,
sum(case when ADLD='9999-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 0 else (case when osta=6 then qrdr else 0 end) end) as WIP_qty,
0 as avg_bud_price,
0 as sls_price,
0 as Production_Qty
from (
select a.*,b.date as WIP_Dt from  TTISFC001ALL a 
left outer join
(
select * from (
select PDNO,OSTA,convert(date,date) as date,row_number() over (partition by pdno order by date) dateRank 
from TTICST151ALL
where OSTA in (6)
--and PDNO='230009816' --for testing Purpose
)b1
where dateRank=1
)b
on a.PDNO=b.PDNO
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
--a.PDNO not like '%p%'
--and a.PDNO not like '%sc%'
--and a.PDNO='230009816' --for testing Purpose
) a
where a.PDNO not like '%[a-z]%'
--a.PDNO not like '%p%'
--and a.PDNO not like '%sc%'
--and a.PDNO='230009816' --for testing purpose
group by WIP_Dt,company,PDNO,CWAR,MITM,OSTA


--Actual

insert  into production_plan_vs_actual
select convert(date,TRDT) TRDT,a.COMPANY,
ORNO,a.CWAR,item,0,0,
sum(QSTK) as Actual_qty
,0,0,sum(isnull(sls_price,0)) as sls_price,
0
--,sum(convert(float,isnull(c.QDLV,0))) as QDLV
from (select * from TWHINR110ALL where KOST=3 and KOOR=1 and 
ORNO not like '%[a-z]%'
--ORNO not like '%p%'
--and ORNO not like '%sc%'
) a

left outer join
(
select a.Company,a.itemcode,max(Price) as sls_price  from Sales_Lines a
inner join
(select itemcode, max(deliverydate) as date   from Sales_Lines  group by itemcode) b
on a.itemcode=b.itemcode 
and a.deliverydate=b.date  
group by a.Company,a.itemcode
)b
on a.COMPANY=b.Company 
and		ltrim(rtrim(a.item))=ltrim(rtrim(b.itemcode))
group by convert(date,TRDT),a.COMPANY,ORNO,a.CWAR,item
order by convert(date,TRDT)


--Dispatch_qty


Insert into production_plan_vs_actual
SELECT convert(date,b.t_idat) t_idat,a.company,null as Prodorderno,c.WareHouse,t_item,
0 as Planned_qty,0 as Released_qty,0 as Actual_qty,0 as WIP_qty,
0 as avg_bud_price,0 as sls_price,sum(isnull(t_dqua,0)) t_dqua
--t_cofc,Trantype,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.invnum,a.CustCode,a.t_rate_1 ,a.t_rate_2 ,a.t_txai,
--sum(isnull(a.t_amth_1,0)) t_amth_1,sum(isnull(a.t_txah_1,0)) t_txah_1,sum(isnull(a.t_amti,0)) t_amti,sum(isnull(t_pric,0)),
--sum(isnull(a.t_amth_1,0)),saletype
FROM CI_Lines a
inner join CI_Header b
on a.Company=b.Company 
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Trantype)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Trantyp ))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.invnum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.invnum)) 
inner join (select distinct Company,OrderNum,--PositionNum,
WareHouse from Sales_Lines) c
on  a.company=c.Company
and a.OrderNum=c.OrderNum
--and a.PositionNum=c.PositionNum
--where ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))= 'X990614'
--and convert(date,b.t_idat) in ('2018-09-03','2018-09-05','2018-09-11','2018-09-12','2018-09-13','2018-09-14')
group by convert(date,b.t_idat),a.company,c.WareHouse,t_item
--t_cofc,Trantype,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.invnum,a.CustCode,t_item ,a.t_rate_1 ,a.t_rate_2 ,a.t_txai,saletype



insert into ELGi_production_details
select a.company,a.warehouse,a.item,null as itemdescr,null as Description,
a.Prodorderno,a.date1,sls_price,
sum(a.Planned_qty) Planned_qty,
sum(a.Released_qty) Released_qty,
sum(a.Actual_qty) Actual_qty,
sum(a.WIP_qty) WIP_qty,
sum(a.avg_bud_price) avg_bud_price,
sum(Dispatch_qty) Dispatch_qty
--,row_number() over(partition by a.company,a.warehouse,a.item,date1 order by a.company,a.warehouse,a.item,date1) as Rnk
from production_plan_vs_actual a
group by a.company,a.warehouse,a.item,a.Prodorderno,a.date1,sls_price



--Production order category
update ELGi_production_details set Description=b.Description
from (
select distinct a.company,Description,prd_from,prd_to from ELGi_Production_Master a
left outer join ELGi_AssemblyLine_Master b
on b.code = a.assemblycode
)b
where ELGi_production_details.Prodorderno between b.prd_from and b.prd_to  
and ELGi_production_details.company = b.company

--Since Dispatch details are not related to production orders, Productgroup is missing and needs to be updated
update ELGi_production_details set Description=a.Description
from (select distinct company,warehouse,item,Description from  ELGi_production_details 
where Description is not null)a
where ELGi_production_details.company=a.company
and ELGi_production_details.warehouse=a.warehouse
and ELGi_production_details.item=a.item
and ELGi_production_details.Description is null

update ELGi_production_details set Description='RLY-Spares' where warehouse='561' and Description='Railways'
--update ELGi_production_details set Description='Others' where Prodorderno like '901%' and Description='TOPBLOCK'
update ELGi_production_details set Description='Others' where Prodorderno like '991%' and Description='TOPBLOCK'



--Item Description
update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_dsca))
from TTCIBD001400 a
where ELGi_production_details.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where Company not in (465,470,490,551,552) and CompanyGroup ='ELGi')
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_details.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))


update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.DSCA))
from TTCIBD001465 a
where ELGi_production_details.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where Company =465)
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_details.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))


update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))
from TTCIBD001490 a
where ELGi_production_details.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where Company =490 )
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_details.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))


update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))
from TTCIBD001551 a
where ELGi_production_details.company =551
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_details.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))

update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))
from TTCIBD001552 a
where ELGi_production_details.company =552
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_details.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))

update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_dsca))
from TTCIBD001600 a
where ELGi_production_details.company in 
(select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup ='ATS'  )
and ltrim(rtrim(ELGi_production_details.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))


update ELGi_production_details set itemdescr=ltrim(rtrim(a.dsca))

update ELGi_production_details set description='Others' where description is null


--Removing Sub Assembly Parts in 470 Company

delete from ELGi_production_details where 
company =470 and 
ltrim(rtrim(item)) in 
('20228160','20228270','20364840','20228080','20364830','34030395A','20227680','20228200','340305550','20365950',
'340200820','340303440','340303640','20226950','34030395B','20226410','20230030','15301557','15306446','15304819',

--Removing 553 warehouse details

--warehouse in ('253' , '153', 'A53', 'C53' , 'D53','E53', 'L53' ,'W53')

Insert into WIP_Ageing 
--select * into WIP_Ageing from (
select *,ROW_NUMBER() over (partition by Escalationlevel order by date1) as rownum,
null as Escl_Comments,null as FabNo
from (
select *,Esclvl1+Esclvl2 as Escalationlevel from (
select *,WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays as Days_in_WIP,
case when Description='Lepsac' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =3 then 1 
when Description='OFSAC' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =3 then 1
when Description='Dpsac' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =2 then 1
when Description='Encap' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =2 then 1
when Description='Sepsac' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =2 then 1
when Description like '%RCD%' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =1 then 1
when Description like '%ENGC%' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays =1 then 1
else 0 end as Esclvl1,
case when Description='Lepsac' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >=4 then 2 
when Description='OFSAC' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >=4 then 2
when Description='Dpsac' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >=3 then 2
when Description='Encap' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >2 then 2
when Description='Sepsac' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >2 then 2
when Description like '%RCD%' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >1 then 2
when Description like '%ENGC%' and WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >1 then 2
else 0 end as Esclvl2

--case when WIPPendingDays-NationalHolidays >=6  then 1 else 0   end as Esclvl3
from (
select company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno,date1,
(DATEDIFF(dd, date1, getdate()-1) + 1)
-(DATEDIFF(wk, date1, getdate()-1) * 2)
-(CASE WHEN DATENAME(dw, date1) = 'Sunday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
-(CASE WHEN DATENAME(dw, getdate()-1) = 'Saturday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as WIPPendingDays,

(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between date1 and getdate()-1) as NationalHolidays

from ELGi_production_details 
where WIP_qty<>0
)a
)b
)c
--)d


--Alter table WIP_Ageing add FabNo nvarchar(60)

update WIP_Ageing set FabNo=b.MSER
from (select company,pdno,mitm,mser from ttimfc010all)b
where WIP_Ageing.company=b.company
and WIP_Ageing.prodorderno=b.pdno
and ltrim(rtrim(WIP_Ageing.item))=ltrim(rtrim(b.mitm))

delete from WIP_Ageing where Prodorderno not between 300000000 and 309999999
and Description = 'RCD Unit Assy'


update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='To be Closed Today' where Escalationlevel=1
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 4 Days' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description='Lepsac'
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 4 Days' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description='OFSAC'
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 3 Days' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description='Dpsac'
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 2 Days' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description='Encap'
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 2 Days' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description='Sepsac'
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 1 Day' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description like '%RCD%'
update WIP_Ageing set Escl_Comments='Exceeding 1 Day' where Escalationlevel=2 and Description like '%ENGC%'

insert into Production_ALC(company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno)
select distinct company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno
from elgi_production_details

update Production_ALC set PlannedDt=a.date1
from (select distinct company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno,date1
from elgi_production_details where Planned_qty>0)a
where Production_ALC.company=a.company
and Production_ALC.warehouse=a.warehouse
and Production_ALC.item=a.item
and Production_ALC.prodorderno=a.Prodorderno


update Production_ALC set ReleaseDt=a.date1
from (select distinct company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno,date1
from elgi_production_details where Released_qty>0)a
where Production_ALC.company=a.company
and Production_ALC.warehouse=a.warehouse
and Production_ALC.item=a.item
and Production_ALC.prodorderno=a.Prodorderno

delete from Production_ALC where ReleaseDt not in (select * from Production_ALCdate_Temp)
delete from Production_ALC where ReleaseDt is null


update Production_ALC set WIPDt=a.date1
from (select distinct company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno,date1
from elgi_production_details where WIP_qty>0)a
where Production_ALC.company=a.company
and Production_ALC.warehouse=a.warehouse
and Production_ALC.item=a.item
and Production_ALC.prodorderno=a.Prodorderno


update Production_ALC set ActualDt=a.date1
from (select distinct company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno,date1
from elgi_production_details where Actual_qty>0)a
where Production_ALC.company=a.company
and Production_ALC.warehouse=a.warehouse
and Production_ALC.item=a.item
and Production_ALC.prodorderno=a.Prodorderno


update Production_ALC set DaysDiff=a.DaysDiff,
NationalHolidays=a.NationalHolidays
from (select company,warehouse,item,itemdescr,Description,Prodorderno,
(DATEDIFF(dd, ReleaseDt, ActualDt) + 1)
-(DATEDIFF(wk, ReleaseDt, ActualDt) * 2)
-(CASE WHEN DATENAME(dw, ReleaseDt) = 'Sunday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
-(CASE WHEN DATENAME(dw, ActualDt) = 'Saturday' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as DaysDiff,
(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between ReleaseDt and ActualDt) as NationalHolidays
from Production_ALC
)a
where Production_ALC.company=a.company
and Production_ALC.warehouse=a.warehouse
and Production_ALC.item=a.item
and Production_ALC.prodorderno=a.Prodorderno


delete from Production_ALC where Prodorderno not between 300000000 and 309999999
and Description = 'RCD Unit Assy'



update Production_ALC set ALCDays=DaysDiff-NationalHolidays
update Production_ALC set ALCPercentage=100 where ALCDays<=2 and Description  like '%RCD%'
update Production_ALC set ALCPercentage=100 where ALCDays<=2 and Description  like '%ENGC%'
update Production_ALC set ALCPercentage=0 where ALCDays>2 and Description  like '%RCD%'
update Production_ALC set ALCPercentage=0 where ALCDays>2 and Description  like '%ENGC%'
update Production_ALC set ALCPercentage=0 where ALCPercentage is null

--Truncate table Production_Summary
--Truncate table Production_Summary_Temp


Insert into Production_Summary_Temp
select Prodorderno from ELGi_production_details group by Prodorderno having sum(Actual_qty) <>0


Insert into Production_Summary(Description,company,warehouse,item,itemdescr)
--select * into Production_Summary from (
select distinct Description,company,warehouse,item,itemdescr from ELGi_production_details
where Description='DPSAC'
--)a

--Planned Qty(till this Month end)

update Production_Summary set plan_qty=a.Planned_qty
from (
select Description,company,warehouse,item,sum(Planned_qty) Planned_qty from (
select Description,company,warehouse,item,date1,Prodorderno,
sum(Planned_qty) Planned_qty,
sum(Actual_qty) Actual_qty
from ELGi_production_details 
where --Prodorderno between'230000000'	and '239999999' and 
date1 between dateadd(MM,datediff(MM,0,getdate()-1),0)  and EOMONTH(getdate()-1)
and Prodorderno not in (select distinct Prodorderno from Production_Summary_Temp)
and Planned_qty<>0
group by Description,company,warehouse,item,date1,Prodorderno
)a
group by Description,company,warehouse,item
)a
where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.warehouse
and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and Production_Summary.Description=a.Description


--Backlog Qty (Less than Current Date)

update Production_Summary set Backlog_qty=a.Planned_qty
from (
select Description,company,warehouse,item,sum(Planned_qty) Planned_qty from (
select Description,company,warehouse,item,date1,Prodorderno,
sum(Planned_qty) Planned_qty,
sum(Actual_qty) Actual_qty
from ELGi_production_details 
where --Prodorderno between'230000000'	and '239999999' and 
date1 <getdate()-1
and Prodorderno not in (select distinct Prodorderno from Production_Summary_Temp)
group by Description,company,warehouse,item,date1,Prodorderno

)a
group by Description,company,warehouse,item
)a
where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.warehouse
and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and Production_Summary.Description=a.Description

--WIP Qty (Current date)

update Production_Summary set WIP_qty=a.WIP_qty
from (
select Description,company,warehouse,item,sum(WIP_qty) WIP_qty from (
select Description,company,warehouse,item,date1,Prodorderno,
sum(WIP_qty) WIP_qty
from ELGi_production_details 
where --Prodorderno between'230000000'	and '239999999' and 
date1 <getdate()-1
group by Description,company,warehouse,item,date1,Prodorderno
having sum(WIP_qty) <>0
)a
group by Description,company,warehouse,item
)a
where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.warehouse
and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and Production_Summary.Description=a.Description

--MTD_sls_qty (From 1st to Current Date of the Current Month)

update Production_Summary set MTD_sls_qty=a.DeliveryQty
from (
select company,warehouse,Item,sum(DeliveryQty) DeliveryQty from ELGi_Sales_Details 
where Invoice_Date>=dateadd(dd,-day(EOMONTH(getdate()-1))+1,EOMONTH(getdate()-1))
group by company,warehouse,Item
)a
where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.warehouse
and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))



update Production_Summary set Avg_Sales_amount=a.Avg_Sales_amount
from (
select company,Item,sum(Sales_amount)/(sum(DeliveryQty)+0.01) Avg_Sales_amount 
from ELGi_Sales_Details 
group by company,Item
)a
where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))



--FG Qty (Current Date)

update Production_Summary set FG_qty=a.QHND
from (
select COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,sum(QHND) QHND from TWHLTC500ALL
where convert(date,IDAT)=convert(date,GETDATE()-1)
group by COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM
)a
where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.CWAR
and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))



--update Production_Summary set plan_qty=a.Planned_qty
--from 
--(select company,warehouse,item,sum(Planned_qty) Planned_qty 
--from (select * from ELGi_production_details where Planned_qty<>0 and date1<=getdate()-1)a
--group by company,warehouse,item)a
--where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
--and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.warehouse
--and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))


--update Production_Summary set WIP_qty=a.WIP_qty
--from 
--(select company,warehouse,item,sum(WIP_qty) WIP_qty
--from (select * from ELGi_production_details where WIP_qty<>0 and date1=getdate()-1)a
--group by company,warehouse,item)a
--where Production_Summary.company=a.COMPANY
--and Production_Summary.warehouse=a.warehouse
--and ltrim(rtrim(Production_Summary.item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))

update Production_Summary set Backlog_value=(Avg_Sales_amount * Backlog_qty)/1000000
update Production_Summary set MTD_sls_value=(Avg_Sales_amount * MTD_sls_qty)/1000000
update Production_Summary set FG_value=(Avg_Sales_amount * FG_qty)/1000000
update Production_Summary set plan_value=(Avg_Sales_amount * plan_qty)/1000000
update Production_Summary set WIP_value=(Avg_Sales_amount * WIP_qty)/1000000




end

bud.this_month_budget,sls.this_month_sale,sls.last_month_sale,
bud.ytd_budget,sls.this_year_sale,

sls.last_year_this_month_sale,@Finyear as FinYear,@Finmonthnum as FinMonth,'001' as AreaCode
from ufn_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise(@Calmonthnum,@Calyear) bud
full join ufn_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise(@Calmonthnum,@Calyear) sls
on bud.dpst=sls.dpstcode

union

SELECT isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ) organ,isnull(bud.user_names,sls.user_names) user_names,
isnull(bud.Division,sls.Division) Division,
isnull(bud.Dpst,sls.Dpstcode) Dpstcode,isnull(bud.dpstname,sls.dpstname) dpstname,
bud.this_month_budget,sls.this_month_sale,sls.last_month_sale,
bud.ytd_budget,sls.this_year_sale,case when sls.last_year_ytd = 0 then  0.01 else sls.last_year_ytd end as last_year_ytd,
sls.last_year_this_month_sale,@Finyear as FinYear,@Finmonthnum as FinMonth,isnull(bud.Area,sls.Areacode) as Areacode
FROM (
select organ,user_names,Division,dpst,dpstname,Area,
sum(this_month_budget) this_month_budget,sum(ytd_budget) ytd_budget
from ufn_bud_global(@Calmonthnum,@Calyear) 
group by organ,user_names,Division,dpst,dpstname,Area
) bud

full JOIN
(select organ,user_names,Division,Dpstcode,dpstname,Areacode,sum(this_month_sale) this_month_sale,
sum(last_month_sale) last_month_sale, sum(this_year_sale) this_year_sale,
sum(last_year_ytd) last_year_ytd,sum(last_year_this_month_sale) last_year_this_month_sale from 
ufn_sls_global(@Calmonthnum,@Calyear)
group by organ,user_names,Division,Dpstcode,dpstname,Areacode
) sls 
ON isnull(bud.Dpst,'0')=isnull(sls.Dpstcode,'0')
and isnull(bud.Area,'0')=isnull(sls.Areacode,'0')
where isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ)<>'India'


)a

------END OF PART 2: LOADING CURRENT FINMONTH DATA ON DALY BASIS-------------------------------------------------




end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ELGi_Sales_Flash_Data_Consolidated]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
