------------ end sales plan updation



insert into inflow_mothwise
select *  from (
select distinct Vertical1 as vertical,sum(sales/1000000)as inflow,year(OrderDate)as cal_year,month(OrderDate)as cal_Month,null as vertical1    From Sales_Inflow 
where organ in ('India')
and  company in (select Company  from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup ='ELGI' )
and concat(company,ordertype) in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from saletype_master where Sales_Category not in (1)) 
group by Vertical1,year(OrderDate),month(OrderDate)  

union all

select distinct user_names ,sum(sales/1000000)as inflow,year(OrderDate)as cal_year,month(OrderDate)as cal_Month,null as vertical1    From Sales_Inflow 
where organ in ('SAAME')
and  company in (select Company  from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup ='ELGI' )
and concat(company,ordertype) in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from saletype_master where Sales_Category not in (1)) 
group by user_names,year(OrderDate),month(OrderDate)  
)a

update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Compressor-C&M' where vertical='C&M'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Compressor-WW' where vertical='WW'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='After Sales' where vertical='AFTERSALES'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Compressor-RLY' where vertical='RAILWAY'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Compressor-Direct' where vertical='DIRECT'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Compressor-Channel' where vertical='CHANNEL'

update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Africa-Spares' where vertical='Africa-Spares'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='Africa-Units' where vertical='Africa-Units'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='ME-Spares' where vertical='ME-Spares'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='ME-Units' where vertical='ME-Units'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='SA-Spares' where vertical='SA-Spares'
update inflow_mothwise set vertical1='SA-Units' where vertical='SA-Units'


----------------- inflow updation
update india_inflow_sales_plan set sales_Inflow=a.inflow 
from 
(select vertical1,sum(inflow)as inflow from inflow_mothwise where cal_year=year(getdate()-1) and cal_month=month(getdate()-1)
group by vertical1)a
where india_inflow_sales_plan.description=a.vertical1


update saame_inflow_sales_plan set sales_Inflow=a.inflow
from 
(select vertical1,sum(inflow)as inflow from inflow_mothwise where cal_year=year(getdate()-1) and cal_month=month(getdate()-1)
group by vertical1)a
where saame_inflow_sales_plan.user_names=a.vertical1

-------- end inflow updation

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Ledger_details] as

begin

Truncate table Ledger_details

--sp_rename 'Ledger_details.HomeCurrencyAmt','CreditAmt'
--Alter table Ledger_details alter column Debit_Credit varchar(20)

Insert into Ledger_details
--select * into Ledger_details from (
select 
T$OCMP as OriginalCompany,
T$OTYP as TransactionType,
null as TranTypeDescription,
T$ODOC as Document,
T$DCDT as DocumentDate,
T$LEAC as LedgerAccount,
null as LedgerDescription,
T$REFR as TransReference,
T$CCUR as Currency,
T$RATE$1 as CurRate,
case when T$DBCR=1 then 'Debit' 
 when T$DBCR=2 then 'Credit' 
else '' end as Debit_Credit,
case when T$DBCR=1 then T$AMTH$1 
when T$DBCR=2 then (-1)*T$AMTH$1 end as Amount,
T$BPID as BusinessPartner,
null as BusinessPartnerName,
case when T$CATG =1 then 'JournalVoucher' 
when T$CATG =3 then 'SalesInvoice' 
when T$CATG =4 then 'SalesCreditNote' 
when T$CATG =6 then 'PurchaseInvoice' 
when T$CATG =7 then 'PurchaseCreditNote' 
when T$CATG =10 then 'Cash' end as TransCategory,
null as TRANCode,
null as TRANDesc,
T$FYER,
T$FPRD
from TTFGLD106ALL
where T$LEAC in 
('AB0701002','AB0701007','AB0701008','AB0701010',
'AB0701024',
'AB0701025','AB0701026','LC0201000','LC0203000')
--('AB0701002','AB0701007','AB0701008','AB0701009',
--'AB0701010','AB0701024','AB0701025','AB0701025','AB0701026',
--'LC0201000','LC0203000','AB0701000','AB0701009','AB0701039')
and T$FYER =2018
and T$FPRD in (6,7,8,9)
--)a

--Alter table Ledger_details add FPRD varchar(10)
--Alter table Ledger_details alter column Debit varchar(20)
--sp_rename 'Ledger_details.DebitAmt', 'Amount'

update Ledger_details set LedgerDescription=a.T$DESC
from (select distinct T$LEAC,T$DESC from TTFGLD008ALL) a
where Ledger_details.LedgerAccount=a.T$LEAC

update Ledger_details set TranTypeDescription=a.[DESC]
from (select distinct TTYP,[DESC] from TTFGLD011ALL) a
where Ledger_details.TransactionType=a.TTYP


update Ledger_details set businessPartnerName=a.custname1
from (select distinct custcode,custname1 from vw_Business_Partner) a
where ltrim(rtrim(Ledger_details.BusinessPartner))=ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))


update Ledger_details set TRANCode=a.[TRAN]
from (select distinct COMPANY,TTYP,[TRAN] from TTFCMG204ALL) a
where Ledger_details.OriginalCompany=a.COMPANY
and Ledger_details.TransactionType=a.TTYP

update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='ReceiptTransaction' where TRANCode=1
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='PaymentTransaction' where TRANCode=2
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='UnallocatedPayment' where TRANCode=3
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='UnallocatedReceipt' where TRANCode=4
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='AdvancePayment' where TRANCode=5
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='AdvanceReceipt' where TRANCode=6
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='Journal' where TRANCode=7
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='ReceiptReconciliaton' where TRANCode=8
update Ledger_details set TRANDesc='PaymentReconciliaton' where TRANCode=9



end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_LN_Sales_Details]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--EXEC sp_LN_Sales_Details


CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_LN_Sales_Details]
as 
begin


--History sales data 
Truncate table LN_Sales_Details
insert into LN_Sales_Details
select * From sales_2016_2017





delete from LN_Sales_Details where Invoice_Date>='2017-04-01'
Truncate table SaleType_Master
Truncate table Saletype_master_ATS
Truncate table Inflowtype_master
Truncate table ELGi_Sales_Details
Truncate table ATS_Sales_Details


insert into LN_Sales_Details (company,trantype,warehouse,OrderNo,PositionNo,Invoice,Invoice_Date,Taxcode,Currency,
Item,Item_desc,custcode,custname,dpst,dpstname,Organ,Vertical1,user_names,Division,productgrp,Region,Zone,areacode,
areaname,t_rate_1,t_rate_2,t_rate_3,t_amth_1,t_amth_2,t_amth_3,UnitPrice,DeliveryQty,cal_Month,cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,
Monthname,Sales_amount,SaleOrderType,sales_category
--,FinCustGrp,ShipmentNO,ShipmentLine,ShiptoAddress
)

select * from (
select company,trantyp,warehouse,OrderNum,PositionNum,invnum ,Invoice_Date,
Taxcode ,Currency ,Item,Item_desc, custcode,custname,dpst,dpstname,
Organ,Vertical1,user_names,Division,productgrp,Region,Zone,areacode,areaname,t_rate_1,t_rate_2,t_rate_3, 
t_amth_1,t_amth_2,t_amth_3,UnitPrice,DeliveryQty,
cal_Month,cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,Monthname,Sales_amount,SaleOrderType,0 as sales_category
from (

select 
A.Company,A.Trantyp ,A.OrderNum ,A.Sales_header_orderNo ,A.PositionNum ,A.Sales_lines_positionNo ,
A.invnum ,A.Invoice_Date,A.Taxcode ,A.Currency,
A.Warehouse,a.CustCode ,A.CustName ,a.DPST,a.DPSTName,a.Areacode,a.AreaName,A.Item ,A.Item_desc ,
A.t_amth_1 ,A.t_amth_2 ,A.t_amth_3 ,A.UnitPrice ,A.DeliveryQty ,A.t_rate_1 ,A.t_rate_2,A.t_rate_3 ,
b.Organ,Vertical1,User_names ,b.Division,b.ProductGrp ,b.Region ,b.Zone,
month(Invoice_Date)as cal_month,year(Invoice_Date) as cal_year,
case when month(Invoice_Date)<4 then month(Invoice_Date)+9 else month(Invoice_Date)-3 end as Fin_month,
case when month(Invoice_Date)<4 then year(Invoice_Date)-1 else year(Invoice_Date) end as Fin_year,
datename(MM,Invoice_Date) as Monthname,Sales_amount,a.SaleOrderType,Fin_cust_group
 From (

select 
a.Company ,a.Trantyp,a.OrderNum ,a.PositionNum ,a.invnum ,a.Invoice_Date,a.Taxcode ,a.Currency ,a.Item,a.t_rate_1,a.t_rate_2 ,a.t_rate_3,a.DeliveryQty ,a.UnitPrice,  
a.t_amth_1 ,a.t_amth_2 ,a.t_amth_3
,isnull(b.dpst,a.dpst)as dpst ,b.OrderNum  as Sales_header_orderNo ,b.PositionNum  as Sales_lines_positionNo ,b.Warehouse ,b.CustCode 
,c.DPSTName 
,d.t_nama as custname
,f.Areacode ,f.AreaName 
,case when a.company like '6%' then null else g.t_dsca end as Item_desc,
t_amth_1 as Sales_amount,
a.saletype as SaleOrderType,
ee.t_cfcg as Fin_cust_group

From (
select 
a.Company,a.Trantyp,a.invnum,a.Invoice_Date,a.Taxcode,a.Currency,b.Item,
b.t_amth_1,b.t_amth_2,b.t_amth_3,b.t_rate_1 ,b.t_rate_2 ,b.t_rate_3,
b.DeliveryQty,b.UnitPrice ,b.OrderNum ,b.PositionNum ,b.saletype,b.dpst 
From 
(SELECT distinct Company,
Trantyp,invnum,convert(date,t_idat) as Invoice_Date,t_cvat as Taxcode,t_ccur as Currency fROM CI_Header 
) a
left join 
(SELECT company,t_item as Item,t_rate_1 ,t_rate_2 ,t_rate_3,OrderNum,PositionNum,invnum,Trantype,saletype,t_cofc as dpst,
sum(t_amth_1) as t_amth_1,sum(t_amth_2) as t_amth_2,sum(t_amth_3) as t_amth_3,sum(t_dqua) as DeliveryQty,sum(t_pric) as UnitPrice
FROM CI_Lines 
group by t_item,t_rate_1 ,t_rate_2 ,t_rate_3,OrderNum ,PositionNum,invnum,Trantype,saletype,t_cofc,Company  
) b
on a.Company=b.Company and 
	ltrim(rtrim(a.Trantyp)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Trantype ))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.invnum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.invnum)) 
)a

left join 
(
select a.dpst,a.OrderNum ,a.Warehouse ,a.custcode,a.ordertype,
b.positionnum,b.Invoiceno ,b.Trantype,a.Company  From 
(select company,ordernum,custcode,ordertype,orderdate,dpst,area,t_cwar as warehouse,TaxCode  from sales_header 
--WHERE company NOT IN (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
) a
left join
 ( select Company,OrderNum,Trantype ,positionnum,custcode,itemcode,warehouse,taxcode,invnum as Invoiceno from Sales_Lines 
	--WHERE company NOT IN	(select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
	)b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.OrderNum )) =ltrim(rtrim(b.OrderNum  ))
and a.Company=b.Company
)b

on a.Company=b.Company
and ltrim(rtrim(a.OrderNum )) =ltrim(rtrim(b.OrderNum   )) 
and ltrim(rtrim(a.PositionNum )) =ltrim(rtrim(b.PositionNum  )) 
and ltrim(rtrim(a.invnum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Invoiceno )) 
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Trantyp )) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Trantype )) 


left join vw_DPST_MASTER  c
on ltrim(rtrim(b.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTcode))
left join TTCCOM100400 d
on ltrim(rtrim(d.t_bpid)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.CustCode  ))
left join TTCCOM110400  e
on ltrim(rtrim(d.t_bpid ))=ltrim(rtrim(e.t_ofbp ))
left join (select distinct t_itbp,t_cfcg  from  TTCCOM112400) ee
on ltrim(rtrim(d.t_bpid ))=ltrim(rtrim(ee.t_itbp ))
left join vw_AREA_MASTER  f
on ltrim(rtrim(f.Areacode)) =ltrim(rtrim(e.t_creg ))
left join TTCIBD001400 g
on ltrim(rtrim(g.t_item)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.Item )) 

)a

left outer join (select * from vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER  where organ is not null)b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTCode ))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Areacode)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode ))
)a
where Fin_cust_group <>'004'
)b



--Removing FinCustGrp =004
delete from LN_Sales_Details where FinCustGrp='004'

--Removing ELGI Sauer Sales details 
delete from LN_Sales_Details where company=581

--Removing Transportation charges
delete from LN_Sales_Details where  ltrim(rtrim(Item))='FRT'

--------- update DPST for Australia,Indonasia
update Ln_sales_details  set  dpst  = TTCIBD001551.dpst from 
(select '551'as company,b.dpst,item from TTCIBD001551 a inner join  producttype_aust_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001551
where TTCIBD001551.company = Ln_sales_details.company and 
ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001551.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(Ln_sales_details.Item)) 


update Ln_sales_details  set  dpst  = TTCIBD001551.dpst from 
(select '552'as company,b.dpst,item from TTCIBD001551 a inner join  producttype_indo_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001551
where TTCIBD001551.company = Ln_sales_details.company and 
ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001551.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(Ln_sales_details.Item)) 


---Update Sales_Amount for Australia and Indonesia


update LN_Sales_Details  set Sales_amount=a.Sales_Amount
from
(select company,OrderNum,PositionNum,invnum,Trantype,(t_amti+t_txai)*48.0708 as Sales_Amount from ci_lines where company =551)a
where LN_Sales_Details.company=551
--and LN_Sales_Details.Invoice_Date>='2017-04-01'
and LN_Sales_Details.company=a.Company
and LN_Sales_Details.OrderNo=a.OrderNum
and LN_Sales_Details.PositionNo=a.PositionNum
and LN_Sales_Details.Invoice=a.invnum
and LN_Sales_Details.trantype=a.Trantype


update LN_Sales_Details  set Sales_amount=a.Sales_Amount
from
(select company,OrderNum,PositionNum,invnum,Trantype,(t_amti+t_txai)*0.0048 as Sales_Amount from ci_lines where company =552)a
where LN_Sales_Details.company=552

--EXEC sp_LN_Sales_Details_ver2
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_LN_Sales_Details_ver2]
as 
begin


Truncate table LN_Sales_Details_ver2
Truncate table ELGi_Sales_Details
Truncate table ATS_Sales_Details
Truncate table IAS_Sales_details
Truncate table LN_SALES_BDI
Truncate table Auction_sales
Truncate table FRT_Sales

Truncate table SaleType_Master
Truncate table Saletype_master_ATS


---------------------Part 1  DATA LOAD From LN --------------------------------------------------------------------


insert into LN_Sales_Details_ver2
(company,dpst,trantype,OrderNo,PositionNo,Invoice,custcode,Item,t_rate_1,t_rate_2,ED_AMOUNT,t_amth_1,t_txah_1,Foreign_currency_amount,UnitPrice,DeliveryQty,
Sales_amount,SaleOrderType)

SELECT company,t_cofc,Trantype,OrderNum,PositionNum,invnum,CustCode,t_item ,t_rate_1 ,t_rate_2 ,t_txai,
sum(isnull(t_amth_1,0)),sum(isnull(t_txah_1,0)),sum(isnull(t_amti,0)),sum(isnull(t_pric,0)),
sum(isnull(t_dqua,0))
,sum(isnull(t_amth_1,0)),saletype
FROM CI_Lines 
group by company,t_cofc,Trantype,OrderNum,PositionNum,invnum,CustCode,t_item ,t_rate_1 ,t_rate_2 ,t_txai,saletype


--Incorrect Delivery Qty
--update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set DeliveryQty=c.DelQty from
--(select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,sum(QIDL) as DelQty from sales_delivery where QIDL>0  group by COMPANY,ORNO,PONO)c
--where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Company=c.COMPANY
--and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo=c.ORNO
--and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.PositionNo=c.PONO


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set OrderDate=a.OrderDate--,Del_Address=a.DelAddress
from (
select * From (select company,OrderDate,OrderNum,CustCode,t_itad From Sales_Header)a
left join (select distinct CADR, concat(BLDG,BLFL,BLUN) as DelAddress  --NAMA,NAMB,NAMC  
from ttccom130400 )b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.t_itad))=ltrim(rtrim(b.CADR)) 
)a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company =a.Company 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo =a.OrderNum 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.CustCode

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set Del_Address=a.DelAddress
from (
select * From (select distinct company,OrderNum,CustCode,t_stoa From CI_Lines)a
left join (select distinct CADR, concat(BLDG,BLFL,BLUN) as DelAddress  --NAMA,NAMB,NAMC  
from ttccom130400 )b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.t_stoa))=ltrim(rtrim(b.CADR)) 
)a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company =a.Company 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo =a.OrderNum 
--and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.CustCode


--reconciliation 
update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set dpst='70026' where company=401 and SaleOrderType='217' and OrderNo=	290001079 and dpst='70226'
update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set dpst='70028' where company=490 and SaleOrderType='219' and OrderNo=	292003196 and dpst='70228'



--SalesRep Updation

--SalesRepcode for Special Indents 
update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set salesrepcode=a.SalesRep
from
(select distinct T$ORNO,T$REM2 as SalesRep from tzzsls320600 )a
where LTRIM(RTRIM(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo))=LTRIM(RTRIM(a.T$ORNO)) 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company='600'

--SalesRepCode for Other Cases
update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set salesrepcode=a.SalesRep
from
(select distinct Company,OrderNum,t_oref as Segment, LineOfBusiness,SalesRep from sales_header)a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company=a.Company
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo=a.OrderNum
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.SalesRepCode is null


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set salesRep=a.NAMA
from TTCCOM001ALL a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.salesrepcode=a.EMNO 

--LOB Updation

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set LOBCode=a.LineOfBusiness
from
(select distinct Company,OrderNum,t_oref as Segment, LineOfBusiness,SalesRep from sales_header)a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company=a.Company
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo=a.OrderNum

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set LineOfBusiness=replace(a.T$DSCA,'|','')
from TTCMCS031400 a 
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.lobcode=a.T$CBRN


--Segment Updation

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set Segment=b.chnl
from TZZSLS326ALL b
where ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.LOBCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.cbrn))
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS' --and company not in (600)
)

--Segment for Special Indents 
update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set Segment=b.T$REM1
from tzzsls320600 b
where ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$ORNO))
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (600)




-----------------Inserting and Updating China Sales Data from BAAN ----------------------
insert into LN_Sales_Details_ver2
select Company,TranType,Warehouse,OrderNum,PositionNum,InvoiceNum,Date,null as taxcode,null as currency,ItemCode,
null as item_desc,CustCode,null as custname,Dpst,null as dpstname,null as organ,null as vertical,null as user_names,
Division,null as productgrp,null as region,
null as zone,Area,null as areaname,0 as rate1,0 as rate2,0 as rate3,0 amt1,0 amt2,0 amt3,
BasicPrice,DeliveredQty,null as cmonth,null as calyear,null as fmonth,null as fyear,null as monthname,
AssesValue,OrderType, SaleType,FinCustGrp,null as shipmentno,null as shipmentline,null as shipmentaddress,
null as SegmentCode,null as Segment,null as SalesRepCode,null as SalesRep,null as LOBCode,null as LineOfBusiness,
null as OrderDate, null as Del_Address
from Tmpslsdespdata_chn


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set custname=ltrim(rtrim(a.NAMB))
from [ELGI-DW].dbo.Tmpcustomer_chn a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.CUNO
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (711,712)

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set Item_desc=a.DSCA
from [ELGI-DW].dbo.comitemdata_chn a
where ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (711,712)


-------------------End of Inserting and Updating China Sales Data from BAAN ----------------------


--Invoice date Updation

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set invoice_date=convert(date,b.t_idat),
currency=b.t_ccur
from CI_Header b
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Company=b.Company 
and ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Trantype)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Trantyp ))
and ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Invoice)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.invnum)) 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.invoice_date is null

--TaxCode Updation

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set taxcode=b.t_cvat
from CI_Lines b
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Company=b.Company 
and ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Trantype)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Trantype ))
and ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Invoice)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.invnum)) 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo=b.OrderNum
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.PositionNo=b.PositionNum



---DPST, Customer Updations

--------------------- update DPST for Australia,Indonasia-----------------------------

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2  set  dpst  = TTCIBD001551.dpst 
from 
(select company,b.dpst,item from TTCIBD001551 a 
inner join  producttype_aust_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001551
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Company=551
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Invoice_Date >='2017-04-01'
and TTCIBD001551.company = LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company 
and ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001551.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Item)) 


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2  set  dpst  = TTCIBD001552.dpst from 
(select company,b.dpst,item from  TTCIBD001552 a
inner join  producttype_indo_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001552
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Company=552
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Invoice_Date >='2017-04-01'
and TTCIBD001552.company = LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company 
and ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001552.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Item)) 

-----------------End: update DPST for Australia,Indonasia-----------------------------


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set custname=a.custname1,FinCustGrp=a.FinCustGrp
from vw_Business_Partner a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.custcode
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master 
where Company not in (551,552,951) and CompanyGroup in ('ELGi','ATS'))

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set custname=a.custname1,FinCustGrp=a.FinCustGrp
from vw_Business_Partner_IAS a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.custcode
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master 
where CompanyGroup ='IAS')

from vw_Business_Partner_551 a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.custcode
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master 
where CompanyGroup ='ELGi' and company=551)


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set custname=a.custname1,FinCustGrp=a.FinCustGrp
from vw_Business_Partner_552 a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.custcode=a.custcode
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (select  company from ELGI_Companies_Master 
where CompanyGroup ='ELGi' and company=552)


update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set dpstname=a.DPSTName
from vw_DPST_MASTER a

from vw_Business_Partner a
where ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.CustCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode)) 
and ltrim(rtrim(LN_Sales_Details_ver2.areacode))=''
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company not in (551,552,951)


--Area Updation from IndentNo 

update ln_sales_details_ver2 set areacode =b.IndentArea
from (select distinct concat('0',substring(ltrim(rtrim(RefA)),2,2)) IndentArea,* From Sales_Header 
where len(ltrim(rtrim(RefA)))=9 and RefA is not null
--and concat('0',substring(RefA,2,2)) like '%[0-9]%'
and substring(Area,1,1)='0'
and concat('0',substring(ltrim(rtrim(RefA)),2,2)) in (select Areacode from vw_AREA_MASTER)
)b
where ln_sales_details_ver2.company =b.Company 
and ln_sales_details_ver2.OrderNo =b.OrderNum
and ln_sales_details_ver2.areacode like '0%' 
AND ln_sales_details_ver2.company not in (551,552,951)

--Overwrite the Areacode for Areas updated from Customer Master due to unavailability of Indent Area
update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set areacode=a.H$CREG 
from (
select a.Company,OrderNum,b.H$CREG from 
(select distinct Company,OrderNum,refa,concat('0',substring(ltrim(rtrim(RefA)),2,2)) IndentArea From Sales_Header 
where len(ltrim(rtrim(RefA)))<>9)a
inner join
(select distinct NCMP,LORN,H$CREG From tzzsls885all where H$CREG<>'')b
on a.Company=b.NCMP
and a.OrderNum=b.LORN
)a
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company =a.Company 
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.OrderNo =a.OrderNum 


--Special Case: Updating Areacode for Australia and Indonesia companies (551,552)

update LN_Sales_Details_ver2 set dpst=b.COFC
from
(
select a.SFCP,ITYP,IDOC,line,a.MSID,b.COFC  from TCISLI225ALL a
left outer join
(select SFCP,MSID,COFC from TCISLI220ALL) b
on a.SFCP=b.SFCP
and a.MSID=b.MSID
)b
where LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company=b.SFCP
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.trantype=b.ITYP
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.Invoice=b.IDOC
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and LN_Sales_Details_ver2.dpst like '%[a-z]%'

--exec sp_MaterialBudget

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_MaterialBudget] as
begin 
Truncate table MaterialBudget

Insert into MaterialBudget
SELECT YEAR, Company1, SOFC, SalesOfc, MITM, Item_desc, 
SUM(QANA) AS QANA, SUM(PRIC) AS PRIC, 
SUM(PreBud_MatCost) AS PreBud_MatCost, SUM(Q1PR) AS Q1PR, 
SUM(Q1_Qty) AS Q1_Qty, SUM(Q1_Val) AS Q1_Val, SUM(Q1Increase) AS Q1Increase, SUM(Q1_MatCost) AS Q1_MatCost, 
SUM(APRQ) AS APRQ, SUM(APRV) AS APRV,SUM(Apr_MatCost) AS Apr_MatCost, 
SUM(MAYQ) AS MAYQ, SUM(MAYV) AS MAYV, SUM(May_MatCost) AS May_MatCost, 
SUM(JUNQ) AS JUNQ, SUM(JUNV) AS JUNV, SUM(Jun_MatCost) AS Jun_MatCost, 
SUM(Q2_Qty) AS Q2_Qty, SUM(Q2_Val) AS Q2_Val, SUM(Q2PR) AS Q2PR, SUM(Q2Increase) AS Q2Increase, SUM(Q2_MatCost) AS Q2_MatCost, 
SUM(JULQ) AS JULQ, SUM(JULV) AS JULV, SUM(Jul_MatCost) AS Jul_MatCost, 
SUM(AUGQ) AS AUGQ, SUM(AUGV) AS AUGV, SUM(Aug_MatCost) AS Aug_MatCost, 
SUM(SEPQ) AS SEPQ, SUM(SEPV) AS SEPV, SUM(Sep_MatCost) AS Sep_MatCost, 
SUM(Q3_Qty) AS Q3_Qty, SUM(Q3_Val) AS Q3_Val, SUM(Q3PR) AS Q3PR, SUM(Q3Increase) AS Q3Increase, SUM(Q3_MatCost) AS Q3_MatCost, 
SUM(OCTQ) AS OCTQ, SUM(OCTV) AS OCTV, SUM(Oct_MatCost) AS Oct_MatCost, 
SUM(NOVQ) AS NOVQ, SUM(NOVV) AS NOVV, SUM(Nov_MatCost) AS Nov_MatCost, 
SUM(DECQ) AS DECQ, SUM(DECV) AS DECV, SUM(Dec_MatCost) AS Dec_MatCost, 
SUM(Q4_Qty) AS Q4_Qty, SUM(Q4_Val) AS Q4_Val, SUM(Q4PR) AS Q4PR, SUM(Q4Increase) AS Q4Increase, SUM(Q4_MatCost) AS Q4_MatCost, 
SUM(JANQ) AS JANQ, SUM(JANV) AS JANV, SUM(Jan_MatCost) AS Jan_MatCost, 
SUM(FEBQ) AS FEBQ, SUM(FEBV) AS FEBV, SUM(Feb_MatCost) AS Feb_MatCost, 
SUM(MARQ) AS MARQ, SUM(MARV) AS MARV, SUM(Mar_MatCost) AS Mar_MatCost, 
SUM(Total_Qty) AS Total_Qty, SUM(Total_Value) AS Total_Value
FROM (SELECT a.SOFC, null AS SalesOfc, a.MITM, b_1.Item_desc, a.QANA, a.PRIC, a.PreBud_MatCost, 
a.Q1_Qty, a.Q1_Val, a.Q1PR, a.Q1Increase, a.Q1_MatCost, 
a.APRQ, a.APRV, a.APRQ * a.Q1_MatCost AS Apr_MatCost, 
a.MAYQ, a.MAYV, a.MAYQ * a.Q1_MatCost AS May_MatCost, 
a.JUNQ, a.JUNV, a.JUNQ * a.Q1_MatCost AS Jun_MatCost, 
a.Q2_Qty, a.Q2_Val, a.Q2PR, a.Q2Increase, a.Q2_MatCost, 
a.JULQ, a.JULV, a.JULQ * a.Q2_MatCost AS Jul_MatCost, 
a.AUGQ, a.AUGV, a.AUGQ * a.Q2_MatCost AS Aug_MatCost, 
a.SEPQ, a.SEPV, a.SEPQ * a.Q2_MatCost AS Sep_MatCost, 
a.Q3_Qty, a.Q3_Val, a.Q3PR, a.Q3Increase, a.Q3_MatCost, 
a.OCTQ, a.OCTV, a.OCTQ * a.Q3_MatCost AS Oct_MatCost, 
a.NOVQ, a.NOVV, a.NOVQ * a.Q3_MatCost AS Nov_MatCost, 
a.DECQ, a.DECV, a.DECQ * a.Q3_MatCost AS Dec_MatCost, 
a.Q4_Qty, a.Q4_Val, a.Q4PR, a.Q4Increase, a.Q4_MatCost, 
a.JANQ, a.JANV, a.JANQ * a.Q4_MatCost AS Jan_MatCost, 
a.FEBQ, a.FEBV, a.FEBQ * a.Q4_MatCost AS Feb_MatCost, 
a.MARQ, a.MARV, a.MARQ * a.Q4_MatCost AS Mar_MatCost, 
a.APRQ + a.MAYQ + a.JUNQ + a.JULQ + a.AUGQ + a.SEPQ + a.OCTQ + a.NOVQ + a.DECQ + a.JANQ + a.FEBQ + a.MARQ AS Total_Qty, 
a.APRV + a.MAYV + a.JUNV + a.JULV + a.AUGV + a.SEPV + a.OCTV + a.NOVV + a.DECV + a.JANV + a.FEBV + a.MARV AS Total_Value,
a.YEAR, 
a.Company1
FROM (SELECT a_1.YEAR, a_1.Company1, a_1.SOFC, a_1.MITM, 
SUM(a_1.QANA) AS QANA, SUM(a_1.PRIC) AS PRIC, SUM(a_1.PreBud_MatCost) AS PreBud_MatCost, 
SUM(a_1.Q1PR) AS Q1PR, SUM(ISNULL(b.APRQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.MAYQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.JUNQ, 0)) AS Q1_Qty, 
SUM(ISNULL(b.APRV, 0) + ISNULL(b.MAYV, 0) + ISNULL(b.JUNV, 0)) AS Q1_Val, 
SUM(a_1.Q1Increase) AS Q1Increase, SUM(a_1.Q1_MatCost) AS Q1_MatCost, 
SUM(b.APRQ) AS APRQ, SUM(b.APRV) AS APRV, 
SUM(b.MAYQ) AS MAYQ, SUM(b.MAYV) AS MAYV, 
SUM(b.JUNQ) AS JUNQ, SUM(b.JUNV) AS JUNV, 
SUM(a_1.Q2PR) AS Q2PR, SUM(ISNULL(b.JULQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.AUGQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.SEPQ, 0)) AS Q2_Qty, 
SUM(ISNULL(b.JULV, 0) + ISNULL(b.AUGV, 0) + ISNULL(b.SEPV, 0)) AS Q2_Val, 
SUM(a_1.Q2Increase) AS Q2Increase, SUM(a_1.Q2_MatCost) AS Q2_MatCost, 
SUM(b.JULQ) AS JULQ, SUM(b.JULV) AS JULV, 
SUM(b.AUGQ) AS AUGQ, SUM(b.AUGV) AS AUGV, 
SUM(b.SEPQ) AS SEPQ, SUM(b.SEPV) AS SEPV, 
SUM(a_1.Q3PR) AS Q3PR, SUM(ISNULL(b.OCTQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.NOVQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.DECQ, 0)) AS Q3_Qty, 
SUM(ISNULL(b.OCTV, 0) + ISNULL(b.NOVV, 0) + ISNULL(b.DECV, 0)) AS Q3_Val, 
SUM(a_1.Q3Increase) AS Q3Increase, SUM(a_1.Q3_MatCost) AS Q3_MatCost, 
SUM(b.OCTQ) AS OCTQ, SUM(b.OCTV) AS OCTV, 
SUM(b.NOVQ) AS NOVQ, SUM(b.NOVV) AS NOVV, 
SUM(b.DECQ) AS DECQ, SUM(b.DECV) AS DECV, 
SUM(a_1.Q4PR) AS Q4PR, SUM(ISNULL(b.JANQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.FEBQ, 0) + ISNULL(b.MARQ, 0)) AS Q4_Qty, 
SUM(ISNULL(b.JANV, 0) + ISNULL(b.FEBV, 0) + ISNULL(b.MARV, 0)) AS Q4_Val, 
SUM(a_1.Q4Increase) AS Q4Increase, SUM(a_1.Q4_MatCost) AS Q4_MatCost, 
SUM(b.JANQ) AS JANQ, SUM(b.JANV) AS JANV, 
SUM(b.FEBQ) AS FEBQ, SUM(b.FEBV) AS FEBV, 
SUM(b.MARQ) AS MARQ, SUM(b.MARV) AS MARV

FROM (SELECT YEAR, Company, SOFC, MITM, 
SUM(QANA) AS QANA, SUM(PRIC) AS PRIC, SUM(QANA * PRIC) AS PreBud_MatCost, 
SUM(Q1PR) AS Q1PR, SUM(QANA * Q1PR) AS Q1Increase, 
SUM(Q2PR) AS Q2PR, SUM(QANA * Q2PR) AS Q2Increase, 
SUM(Q3PR) AS Q3PR, SUM(QANA * Q3PR) AS Q3Increase, 
SUM(Q4PR) AS Q4PR, SUM(QANA * Q4PR) AS Q4Increase, 
SUM(QANA * PRIC + QANA * Q1PR) AS Q1_MatCost, 
SUM(QANA * PRIC + QANA * Q1PR + QANA * Q2PR) AS Q2_MatCost, 
SUM(QANA * PRIC + QANA * Q1PR + QANA * Q2PR +QANA * Q3PR) AS Q3_MatCost, 
SUM(QANA * PRIC + QANA * Q1PR + QANA * Q2PR +QANA * Q3PR + QANA * Q4PR) AS Q4_MatCost, 
CASE WHEN company = 400 AND sofc IN ('90257', '90231', '90213', '90013', '90028', '90031', 
'90075', '90076', '90077', '90092', '90039', '70085', '70056', '70057', '70028', '70029', 
'70030', '70096', '70065', '70066', '70016') THEN 490 ELSE company END AS Company1
FROM tzzinv609all
GROUP BY YEAR, Company, SOFC, MITM) AS a_1 


LEFT OUTER JOIN

(SELECT COMPANY, YEAR, SOFC,TPL, 
sum(APRQ) APRQ, sum(APRV) APRV, sum(MAYQ) MAYQ, sum(MAYV) MAYV, sum(JUNQ) JUNQ, sum(JUNV) JUNV, 
sum(JULQ) JULQ, sum(JULV) JULV, sum(AUGQ) AUGQ, sum(AUGV) AUGV, sum(SEPQ) SEPQ, sum(SEPV) SEPV,
sum(OCTQ) OCTQ, sum(OCTV) OCTV, sum(NOVQ) NOVQ, sum(NOVV) NOVV, sum(DECQ) DECQ, sum(DECV) DECV, 
sum(JANQ) JANQ, sum(JANV) JANV, sum(FEBQ) FEBQ, sum(FEBV) FEBV, sum(MARQ) MARQ, sum(MARV) MARV,
CASE WHEN company = 400 AND sofc IN ('90257', '90231', '90213', '90013', '90028', '90031', '90075', 
'90076', '90077', '90092', '90039', '70085', '70056', '70057', '70028', '70029', '70030', '70096', 
'70065', '70066', '70016') THEN 490 ELSE company END AS Company1
--,UPDT,LOGN,RMRK, REFCNTD, REFCNTU
FROM TZZINV608ALL
group by COMPANY, YEAR, SOFC,TPL 

) AS b 

ON a_1.SOFC = b.SOFC 
AND a_1.MITM = b.TPL 
AND a_1.YEAR = b.YEAR
and a_1.Company1=b.Company1
GROUP BY a_1.YEAR, a_1.Company1, a_1.SOFC, a_1.MITM
) AS a 



LEFT OUTER JOIN

(SELECT DISTINCT company, Item, Item_desc FROM vw_Item_Master
WHERE (company IN (400, 490, 600))) AS b_1 
ON a.Company1 = b_1.company 
AND REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(a.MITM)), '''', '') = LTRIM(RTRIM(b_1.Item)) 

) AS complete

--WHERE  Company1 IN (@Company)
--and year in (@Year)
--and sofc in ('90031','90032')
--and ltrim(rtrim(mitm)) in --('s013865','s013866','s013867','s013868','s013869','s013870')
--('s013396','s013397')
--('z011537','z011538')  --for testing purpose

GROUP BY YEAR, Company1, SOFC, SalesOfc, MITM, Item_desc





--Special Case :ATS Value calculated base on Percentage of the Value

Insert into MaterialBudget
select a.YEAR,a.Company,a.SOFC,null as SalesOfc,
a.tpl as MITM,b.itemdesc as Item_desc,
null as QANA,null as PRIC,null as PreBud_MatCost,
null as Q1PR,null as Q1_Qty,null as Q1_Val,null as Q1Increase,null as Q1_MatCost,
APRQ,APRV,null as Apr_MatCost,
MAYQ,MAYV,null as May_MatCost,
JUNQ,JUNV,null as Jun_MatCost,
null as Q2_Qty,null as Q2_Val,null as Q2PR,null as Q2Increase,null as Q2_MatCost,
JULQ,JULV,null as Jul_MatCost,
AUGQ,AUGV,null as Aug_MatCost,
SEPQ,SEPV,null as Sep_MatCost,
null as Q3_Qty,null as Q3_Val,null as Q3PR,null as Q3Increase,null as Q3_MatCost,
OCTQ,OCTV,null as Oct_MatCost,
NOVQ,NOVV,null as Nov_MatCost,
DECQ,DECV,null as Dec_MatCost,
null as Q4_Qty,null as Q4_Val,null as Q4PR,null as Q4Increase,null as Q4_MatCost,
JANQ,JANV,null as Jan_MatCost,
FEBQ,FEBV,null as Feb_MatCost,
MARQ,MARV,null as Mar_MatCost,
null as Total_Qty,null as Total_Value
--select * 
from TZZINV608ALL a
inner join MatBudget_Percentage b
on a.COMPANY=b.company
and a.SOFC=b.dpst
and ltrim(rtrim(a.TPL))=ltrim(rtrim(b.Itemcode))



update MaterialBudget set SalesOfc=c.DPSTName
from vw_DPST_MASTER AS c 
where LTRIM(RTRIM(SOFC)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.DPSTcode))


update MaterialBudget set Q1_Qty=APRQ+MAYQ+JUNQ
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)



update MaterialBudget set Q2_Qty=JULQ+AUGQ+SEPQ
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)


update MaterialBudget set Q3_Qty=OCTQ+NOVQ+DECQ
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)



update MaterialBudget set Q4_Qty=JANQ+FEBQ+MARQ
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)


update MaterialBudget set Total_Qty=isnull(Q1_Qty,0)+isnull(Q2_Qty,0)+isnull(Q3_Qty,0)+isnull(Q4_Qty,0)
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)


update MaterialBudget set Q1_Val=APRV+MAYV+JUNV
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)


update MaterialBudget set Q2_Val=JULV+AUGV+SEPV
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)


update MaterialBudget set Q3_Val=OCTV+NOVV+DECV
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)


update MaterialBudget set Q4_Val=JANV+FEBV+MARV
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)



update MaterialBudget set Total_Value=isnull(Q1_Val,0)+isnull(Q2_Val,0)+isnull(Q3_Val,0)+isnull(Q4_Val,0)
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) in 
(select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) from MatBudget_Percentage)



update MaterialBudget set Q1_MatCost=((APRV+MAYV+JUNV)/ q1_qty)  *a.Percentage
from (select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) cola,Percentage from MatBudget_Percentage) a
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) =a.cola  and q1_qty > 0


update MaterialBudget set Q2_MatCost=((JULV+AUGV+SEPV)/ q2_qty)*a.Percentage
from (select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) cola,Percentage from MatBudget_Percentage) a
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) =a.cola  and q2_qty > 0


update MaterialBudget set Q3_MatCost=((OCTV+NOVV+DECV) / q3_qty)*a.Percentage
from (select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) cola,Percentage from MatBudget_Percentage) a
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) =a.cola  and q3_qty > 0



update MaterialBudget set Q4_MatCost=((JANV+FEBV+MARV)/ q4_qty)*a.Percentage
from (select concat(company,DPST,ltrim(rtrim(Itemcode))) cola,Percentage from MatBudget_Percentage) a
where concat(company1,SOFC,ltrim(rtrim(MITM))) =a.cola and q4_qty > 0

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_NonMovingInventory]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_NonMovingInventory
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_NonMovingInventory] as 

begin


Truncate table NonMovingInventory

--Alter table NonMovingInventory alter column RecpAge varchar(20), IssueAge varchar(20)

Insert into NonMovingInventory (Company,WareHouse,ItemCode,QHND,Amnt)
select a.company,a.cwar,a.ITEM,
avg(isnull(a.QHND,0)) QHND,
--sum(b.QSKT) QSKT,
--sum(c.amnt) amnt
(sum(c.amnt)/sum(b.QSTK))*sum(b.QSKT) as amnt
--,convert(date,b.T$TRDT),b.T$SEQN,b.T$INWP,convert(date,c.T$TRDT),c.T$SEQN,c.T$INWP--,c.CPCP_rnk
from 
(select COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,sum(QHND) QHND 
from TWHWMD215ALL
group by COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM
having sum(QHND)>0
)a

left  outer join

(select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP,sum(T$QSTK) as QSTK,sum(T$QSKT) QSKT from TWHINA112ALL
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP
having sum(T$QSKT)>0)b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(a.CWAR))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$CWAR))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$ITEM))

left  outer join

(select * from
(select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP,T$cpcp,
dense_rank() over (partition by company,T$cwar,T$item order by T$cpcp) as CPCP_rnk,
sum(T$AMNT$1) amnt 
from TWHINA113ALL
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,T$SEQN,T$INWP,T$cpcp)c
--where CPCP_rnk=1
)c
on b.COMPANY=c.COMPANY
and b.T$CWAR=c.T$CWAR
and b.T$ITEM=c.T$ITEM
and b.T$TRDT=c.T$TRDT
and b.T$SEQN=c.T$SEQN
and b.T$INWP=c.T$INWP

--where a.COMPANY=@Company and a.CWAR =@War and ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))=@ItemCode
group by a.company,a.cwar,a.ITEM
--,convert(date,b.T$TRDT),b.T$SEQN,b.T$INWP,convert(date,c.T$TRDT),c.T$SEQN,c.T$INWP--,c.CPCP_rnk




--------------------------------Special Case: ISSUE DATE UPDATIONS------------------------------------


----special Case for ATS: on First day of LN Implementation,Adjustments order to be considered.
--Step 1: Data from Manual File Load
update NonMovingInventory set IssueDate_C=a.issuedate
from ATS_Initial_Inv_Adjustments a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.company
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))

update NonMovingInventory set IssueDate_CW=a.issuedate
from ATS_Initial_Inv_Adjustments a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.company
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.WareHouse))=ltrim(rtrim(a.war))
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))

---------------------------------End of Special Case------------------------------------------------


update NonMovingInventory set IssueDate_CW=a.CTDT
from
(
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,max(T$CTDT) as CTDT FROM (
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$CTDT,SUM(T$QSTK) AS T$QSTK from TWHINA114ALL
where T$KOOR in (1,3)
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$CTDT
HAVING SUM(T$QSTK)>0
)a
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM
)a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.COMPANY
and NonMovingInventory.WareHouse=a.T$CWAR
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))


update NonMovingInventory set IssueDate_C=a.CTDT
from
(
select COMPANY,ltrim(rtrim(T$ITEM)) T$ITEM,max(CTDT) CTDT from (
select isnull(a.COMPANY,b.company) as COMPANY,isnull(a.T$ITEM,b.ItemCode) as T$ITEM ,
--max(T$CTDT) T$CTDT,b.IssueDate,
isnull(max(T$CTDT),b.IssueDate) as CTDT 
FROM (
select COMPANY,T$ITEM,T$CTDT,SUM(T$QSTK) AS T$QSTK from TWHINA114ALL
where T$KOOR in (1,3)
--and ltrim(rtrim(T$ITEM))='48IMM70551FT' --For Testing Purpose
group by COMPANY,T$ITEM,T$CTDT
--HAVING SUM(T$QSTK)>0
)a
full outer join 
(
select * from ATS_Initial_Inv_Adjustments 
--where ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode))='48IMM70551FT'  --For Testing Purpose
) b
on a.Company=b.company
and ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ItemCode))
--where ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))='48IMM70551FT'  --For Testing Purpose
group by isnull(a.COMPANY,b.company),isnull(a.T$ITEM,b.ItemCode),b.IssueDate

union
select COMPANY,ItemCode,IssueDate from ATS_Initial_Inv_Adjustments 
--where ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode))='48IMM70551FT'  --For Testing Purpose
)a1

group by COMPANY,ltrim(rtrim(T$ITEM))

)a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))

-----------------------------------


----------------------------------RECEIPT DATE UPDATIONS----------------------------------------------

----special Case for ATS: on First day of LN Implementation,Adjustments order to be considered.
--Step 1: Data from Manual File Load
update NonMovingInventory set ReceiptDate_C=a.ReceiptDate
from ATS_Initial_Inv_Adjustments a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.company
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))

--Step 2: Consider Adjustment Orders
update NonMovingInventory set ReceiptDate_CW=a.TRDT
from
(select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,case when convert(date,T$TRDT) in ('2017-04-05','2017-04-06' ,'2017-04-07' ,'2017-04-08')
then convert(date,T$TRDT) else null end as TRDT from TWHINA112ALL
where T$KOOR in (52)
and company like '6%'
)a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.COMPANY
and NonMovingInventory.WareHouse=a.T$CWAR
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))
and ReceiptDate_CW is null

update NonMovingInventory set ReceiptDate_C=a.TRDT
from
(select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,case when convert(date,T$TRDT) in ('2017-04-05','2017-04-06' ,'2017-04-07' ,'2017-04-08')
then convert(date,T$TRDT) else null end as TRDT
from TWHINA112ALL
where T$KOOR in (52)
and company like '6%'
)a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))
and ReceiptDate_C is null

---------------------------------End of Special Case------------------------------------------------




update NonMovingInventory set ReceiptDate_CW=a.TRDT
from
(
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,max(T$TRDT) as TRDT,SUM(T$QSKT) AS T$QSKT FROM (
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,SUM(T$QSKT) AS T$QSKT from TWHINA112ALL
where T$KOOR in (1,2)
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT
HAVING SUM(T$QSKT)>0
)A
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM

)a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.COMPANY
and NonMovingInventory.WareHouse=a.T$CWAR
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))


update NonMovingInventory set ReceiptDate_C=a.TRDT
from
(
select COMPANY,T$ITEM,max(T$TRDT) as TRDT,SUM(T$QSKT) AS T$QSKT FROM (
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT,SUM(T$QSKT) AS T$QSKT from TWHINA112ALL
where T$KOOR in (1,2)
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,T$TRDT
HAVING SUM(T$QSKT)>0
)A
group by COMPANY,T$ITEM

)a
where NonMovingInventory.Company=a.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))



---ATS: Issue Date and Receipt Date of 600 Company to be updated for other Companies for matching items

update NonMovingInventory set IssueDate_C=a.IssueDate_C
from (select * from NonMovingInventory where Company=600) a
where ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))
and NonMovingInventory.Company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS' and Company<>600)


update NonMovingInventory set ReceiptDate_C=a.ReceiptDate_C
from (select * from NonMovingInventory where Company=600) a
where ltrim(rtrim(NonMovingInventory.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))
and NonMovingInventory.Company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS' and Company<>600)

----------------------------------------

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_OrgChart]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_OrgChart

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_OrgChart]

AS

Begin

DECLARE @emp_code numeric(10),
@Name char(50),
@lvl integer,
@level integer,
@target numeric(10),
@strq varchar(500),
@rnum int

SET NOCOUNT ON

CREATE TABLE #GROUP (emp_code numeric(10), empname Char(50), glevel int)
CREATE TABLE #FTABLE (emp_code numeric(10), empname Char(50), glevel int,ordid int)
Create table #Stack (emp_code numeric(10), empname char(50), glevel int)

INSERT #GROUP 
   SELECT emp_code,empname, 1  FROM emp_appr WHERE isemp_code=0 and emp_code =10084 ORDER BY emp_code DESC
WHILE EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #GROUP)
BEGIN
   SELECT @lvl = 0
   SELECT @emp_Code= emp_code, @Name=empname FROM #Group 
   DELETE FROM #Group WHERE emp_code=@emp_Code	

   INSERT INTO #STACK VALUES(@emp_Code,@Name,1)
   SELECT @LEVEL = 1
			select @rnum=1
   WHILE @LEVEL > 0
   BEGIN
     IF EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM #STACK WHERE GLEVEL=@LEVEL )
     BEGIN
       SELECT @emp_Code=emp_code, @Name=empname FROM #STACK WHERE Glevel = @Level

						select @rnum=@rnum+1
       INSERT INTO #FTABLE VALUES ( @emp_Code,@Name,@Level,@rnum)
       DELETE FROM #STACK WHERE Glevel = @Level AND emp_code = @emp_Code

       INSERT #STACK
        SELECT emp_code, empname, @Level + 1
        FROM emp_appr WHERE employee_status = 'Live' and  isemp_code = @emp_Code ORDER BY emp_code DESC
       IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 SELECT @Level = @Level + 1
     END

    ELSE SELECT @Level = @Level - 1
   END

   --


truncate table travel_emp

insert into travel_emp(emp_code,emp_name,glevel,ordid) SELECT  *FROM #FTABLE 


update travel_emp set spaceid=6 where glevel=2
update travel_emp set spaceid=10 where glevel=3
update travel_emp set spaceid=14 where glevel=4
update travel_emp set spaceid=18 where glevel=5
update travel_emp set spaceid=22 where glevel=6
update travel_emp set spaceid=26 where glevel=7
update travel_emp set spaceid=30 where glevel=8

update Travel_emp set reportid = isemp_code   from  emp_appr   where Travel_emp.emp_code = emp_appr.emp_code 



end


end

--    EXEC SP_OTD 
--  select * From OTD_GRAPH
CREATE PROC [dbo].[SP_OTD]
AS 
BEGIN

TRUNCATE TABLE OTD
TRUNCATE TABLE OTD_GRAPH

insert into OTD

select areacode,'' Custordr,SaleOrderType,OrderNo,OrderDate,PositionNo,CustCode,Custname,Item,Item_desc,currency,WareHouse,trantype,invoice,
areaname,Invoice_Date,DeliveryQty,round(Sales_amount,2)Value,0 as Taxamt,round(Sales_amount,2)totValue ,dpst,'' as lrno,' ' as lr_date,0 as tot_wgt,
'       ' as abc,0 as leadtime,0 as timetaken,'               ' stat ,'                       ' as Month 
from ELGi_Sales_Details  where Company =490 and convert(date,Invoice_Date)>='2018-04-01'and custcode='CU1E00847'
--and CustCode ='CU1E00847'and OrderNo ='292000554' and PositionNo =30


UPDATE OTD SET ABC=A.Category  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM))AS ITEM,Category  FROM ITEM_ABC_CLASIFICATION_MASTER)A
WHERE A.ITEM =LTRIM(RTRIM(OTD.Item))

UPDATE OTD SET ABC='C' where ABC NOT IN ('A','B','C')
UPDATE OTD SET ABC='C' where ABC is null

UPDATE OTD SET LEADTIME= 7 WHERE ABC='A'
UPDATE OTD SET LEADTIME= 15 WHERE ABC='B'
UPDATE OTD SET LEADTIME= 30 WHERE ABC='C'

UPDATE OTD SET TIMETAKEN= DATEDIFF(DD,CONVERT(DATE,OrdER_Date),CONVERT(DATE,Inv_Date))   
UPDATE OTD SET stat= case when leadtime>=timetaken then 'On Time' else 'Delay' end
UPDATE OTD SET month= concat(left(datename(m,Inv_Date),3),'-',convert(varchar,year(Inv_Date)))

INSERT INTO OTD_GRAPH
SELECT 'Y15-16','Y15-16 OTD%',60 UNION ALL
SELECT 'Y16-17','Y16-17 OTD%',74 UNION ALL
SELECT 'Y17-18','Y17-18 OTD%',57 UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Total line items',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'On time supplied',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Delayed supply',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class A total',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class b total',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class c total',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Target%',90  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class A%',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class B%',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class C%',0  from otd UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'2018-19 OTD%',0  from otd

WHERE OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='TOTAL LINE ITEMS'

UPDATE OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM OTD WHERE STAT='On Time' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='On time supplied'

UPDATE OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM OTD WHERE STAT='DELAY' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Delayed supply'

UPDATE OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM OTD WHERE ABC='A'GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class A total'

UPDATE OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM OTD WHERE ABC='B' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class B total'

UPDATE OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM OTD WHERE ABC='C' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class C total'

select a.*,'' as Item_desc,'' as Custname,'' as Dpstname,'' as areacode,'' as areaname,h.Dpst,H.ordertype,h.t_corn ,h.origin,case when h.Origin=3 then 'EDI' else 'Manual' End as orjn,h.RefA AS Indent,
0 AS STOCK_440_act,0 AS STOCK_440_onhand,0 AS STOCK_401_act,0 AS STOCK_401_onhand,0 AS STOCK_416_act,0 AS STOCK_416_onhand,
0 AS STOCK_450_act,0 AS STOCK_450_onhand,0 AS STOCK_490_act,0 AS STOCK_490_onhand,0 as STOCK_DEL_act,0 as STOCK_DEL_onhand,0 AS STOCK_CAL_act,0 AS STOCK_CAL_onhand
 From (

select a.Company,a.CustCode,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,
avg(a.ord_qty) as ord_qty,
--TranType,--b.ShipNo,--c.INVNUM,
sum(ShipQty) ShipQty,
sum(DelQty) DelQty,
avg(a.ord_qty)-sum(isnull(DelQty,0)) as PendQty,
TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,t_rats_1,t_oamt,case when t_rats_1<1 then 1*t_oamt else t_rats_1*t_oamt end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays 
 from 
(
--Detailed Data
select a.Company,CustCode,ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.ord_qty,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,case when t_rats_1<1 then 1*t_oamt else t_rats_1*t_oamt end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays,t_rats_1,t_oamt, 
--c.TranType,b.ShipNo,--c.INVNUM,
ISNULL(b.ShipQty,0)ShipQty,
ISNULL(c.DelQty,0)DelQty From 
(

select Company,OrderDate,CustCode,ItemCode,OrderNum ,PositionNum,t_qoor as ord_qty,invnum,
TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,case when t_rats_1<1 then 1*t_oamt else t_rats_1*t_oamt end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays,t_rats_1,t_oamt 
 From Sales_Lines
where company in (490) and t_sqnb=0 
--and ltrim(rtrim(custcode))not in ('CU1K02388','CU1E00893','CU1L00543','CU1E00015','CU1E00791',
--'CU1E00008','CU1E00814','CU1E00914','CU1E00477','CU1E00679','CU1E00263','CU1E00926','CU1E00396','CU1E00887')
 and t_clyn<>1 
	AND t_qoor > 0
	--and t_dldt='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
	)a

left outer join
(select COMPANY,WORN as OrderNum , WPON as PosNum,sum(convert(float,QSHP))as ShipQty from TWHINH431ALL where convert(float,QSHP)>0 group by COMPANY,WORN,WPON)b
on a.Company=b.COMPANY
and a.OrderNum=b.OrderNum
and a.PositionNum=b.PosNum
left outer join 
(select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,sum(QIDL) as DelQty from TTDSLS406ALL where QIDL>0 --and INVN <>0 
group by COMPANY,ORNO,PONO)c
on a.Company=c.COMPANY
and a.OrderNum=c.ORNO
and a.PositionNum=c.PONO
--WHERE 
--a.company=490
--and a.OrderNum= '292000008'
--and a.PositionNum=30
)a
--where ord_qty >0 
group by a.Company,a.CustCode,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,t_rats_1,t_oamt
having avg(a.ord_qty)-sum(isnull(DelQty,0))<>0


)a
inner join (select * From Sales_Header where Company in (490) AND dpst not in ('SAL01','SLS01')) h
on a.OrderNum =h.OrderNum 
and a.Company =h.Company 
and h.OrderType  IN ('274','374','284','384','242','342','226','246','346','326','526','546','AMC')
)a
left join (select * From tsacom999all where type=2)b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.OrderNum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.NORN ))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.PositionNum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.NPOS))


update pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC set Cancel_Qty=a.qty from (select company,OrderNum,PositionNum,t_clyn,sum(t_qoor)as qty From Sales_Lines where company in (401,490) and t_clyn=1 and t_qoor>0 group by OrderNum,PositionNum,t_clyn,Company )a
where a.Company =pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC.Company 
and a.OrderNum =pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC.OrderNum 
and a.PositionNum =pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC.PositionNum 
and a.t_clyn=1


update pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC set custname=a.custname1
from vw_Business_Partner a
where pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC.custcode=a.custcode


update pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC set dpstname=a.DPSTName
from vw_DPST_MASTER a
where pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC.dpst=a.dpstcode

update pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC set areacode=a.t_creg

where ltrim(rtrim(pending_order_GSC_BDI_FOC.CustCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_ofbp))

--exec sp_Pending_orders
--select * from pending_orders where invoice is null
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Pending_orders] as
Begin

--Truncate table [wms].dbo.Pending_orders
Truncate table  Pending_orders
insert into Pending_orders

select * from (
select Company,CustCode,ItemCode,OrderDate,OrderNum,PositionNum,ord_qty,ShipQty,DelQty,PendQty,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,t_rats_1,t_oamt,Value,diffdays,                   
null as Item_desc,null as Custname,null as Dpstname,null as areacode,null as areaname,
null as Dpst,null as ordertype,null as Buyer ,null as origin,
--case when h.Origin=3 then 'EDI' else 'Manual' End as orjn,
null as orjn ,null as Indent,
0 AS STOCK_440_act,0 AS STOCK_440_onhand,0 AS STOCK_401_act,0 AS STOCK_401_onhand,0 AS STOCK_416_act,0 AS STOCK_416_onhand,
0 AS STOCK_450_act,0 AS STOCK_450_onhand,0 AS STOCK_490_act,0 AS STOCK_490_onhand,0 as STOCK_DEL_act,0 as STOCK_DEL_onhand,
0 AS STOCK_CAL_act,0 AS STOCK_CAL_onhand,
null as Baan_orderno,null as Baan_positionno,0 as Cancel_Qty,null as Zone,null as OrderMonthNo,null as OrderMonth,null as OrderMonthYear,
NULL AS Origin_desc,NULL AS Region,NULL AS Sale_Type, NULL AS Tax_Desc ,NULL AS HSN_CODE ,NULL AS GSTN_NO ,NULL AS PRICE_ORIGIN ,NULL AS SP_SEQ_NO,
NULL AS Ref,NULL AS Old_orderno,NULL AS Old_positionno,null as State,
NULL as Sales_Inv_Address,NULL as Cust_Inv_Address,
NULL as Sales_GSTN_NO,NULL as Cust_GSTN_NO,
NULL as SALES_SEQ,NULL as Cust_SEQ,
NULL as SALES_state,NULL as Cust_state,
NULL as plan_del_Date,
DiscPerc2,'' as disc_origin,'' as Blocked ,null as currecny,null as plan_recp_date,
0 as MaxQty,0 as Monthwise_Ordqty,
'' as ExportOrder,null as invoice,null as inv_date, null as dest_type, null as issue_item,
'      ' as itemtype,'     ' as itemclass,0 AS ISSS , '  ' as estimated_date,0 as lead_days,0 AS NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS,
'TYP'as typ,'     ' as shpment_date,0 as Delay_days,'' as trantype, '   ' as Mitachi,'   ' as Hanva



From   
	
(
select a.Company,a.CustCode,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,
avg(a.ord_qty) as ord_qty,
--TranType,--b.ShipNo,--c.INVNUM,
sum(ShipQty) ShipQty,
sum(DelQty) DelQty,
avg(a.ord_qty)-sum(isnull(DelQty,0)) as PendQty,
TaxCode,case when DeliveryDate='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' then null else DeliveryDate end as DeliveryDate ,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,t_rats_1,t_oamt,case when t_rats_1<1 then 1*t_oamt else t_rats_1*t_oamt end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays 
 from 
(
--Detailed Data
select a.Company,CustCode,ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.ord_qty,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,
case when t_rats_1<1 then 1*t_oamt else t_rats_1*t_oamt end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays,t_rats_1,t_oamt, 
--c.TranType,b.ShipNo,--c.INVNUM,
ISNULL(b.ShipQty,0)ShipQty,
ISNULL(c.DelQty,0)DelQty From 
(
--Fetching OrderQty
select Company,OrderDate,CustCode,ItemCode,OrderNum ,PositionNum,t_qoor as ord_qty,invnum,
TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,case when t_rats_1<1 then 1*t_oamt else t_rats_1*t_oamt end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays,t_rats_1,t_oamt 
From Sales_Lines
where t_sqnb=0 
and t_clyn<>1 
and t_qoor > 0

--and company in (490) 
--and ltrim(rtrim(custcode))not in ('CU1K02388','CU1E00893','CU1L00543','CU1E00015','CU1E00791',
--'CU1E00008','CU1E00814','CU1E00914','CU1E00477','CU1E00679','CU1E00263','CU1E00926','CU1E00396','CU1E00887')
	--and t_dldt='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
)a

left outer join
(
--Fetching Packing Qty below comment data old table
select COMPANY,WORN as OrderNum , WPON as PosNum,sum(convert(float,QSHP))as ShipQty 
from TWHINH431ALL 
where convert(float,QSHP)>0 and company in (401) and WORG =1
 group by COMPANY,WORN,WPON 
union all
select COMPANY,t$orno as OrderNum , t$pono as PosNum,sum(t$qpli)as ShipQty  from  TWHINH480ALL
where t$qpli>0 and COMPANY in (490) group by COMPANY,t$orno ,t$pono

)b
on a.Company=b.COMPANY
and a.OrderNum=b.OrderNum
and a.PositionNum=b.PosNum

left outer join 
(
--Fetching Deliverd Qty
select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,sum(QIDL) as DelQty from 
sales_delivery
--TTDSLS406ALL 
where QIDL>0 
--and INVN <>0 
group by COMPANY,ORNO,PONO
)c
on a.Company=c.COMPANY
and a.OrderNum=c.ORNO
and a.PositionNum=c.PONO

--WHERE 
--a.company=490
--and a.OrderNum= '292000008'
--and a.PositionNum=30
)a
--where ord_qty >0 
group by a.Company,a.CustCode,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,t_rats_1,t_oamt
--having avg(a.ord_qty)-sum(isnull(DelQty,0))<>0
)Details
)a

------- delete foc orders due to karun kannan request

delete from Pending_Orders  where CONCAT(company,ordertype) in
(select distinct CONCAT(company,saleordertype)as type  From saletype_master where Sales_Category =1)

---------------------
update pending_orders set ShipQty =(ShipQty-DelQty)

update pending_orders set plan_del_date=a.t_ddta,ISSS=A.InvIssStat  
from Sales_Lines a
where pending_orders.Company =a.Company
and pending_orders.OrderNum =a.OrderNum
and pending_orders.PositionNum =a.PositionNum 

update pending_orders set plan_recp_date=a.planrecdate  from Sales_Lines a
where pending_orders.Company =a.Company
and pending_orders.OrderNum =a.OrderNum
and pending_orders.PositionNum =a.PositionNum


update pending_orders set 
Dpst=h.Dpst,
ordertype=H.ordertype,
origin=h.origin,
orjn=case when h.Origin=3 then 'EDI' else 'Manual' End ,
Indent=case when h.t_corn=' ' then h.RefA else h.t_corn end
from 
(select * From Sales_Header where dpst not like '%[a-z]%') h
where pending_orders.OrderNum =h.OrderNum 
and pending_orders.Company =h.Company 

-----------------update dpst for 551,552
update Pending_Orders   set  dpst  = TTCIBD001551.dpst 
from 
(select company,b.dpst,item from TTCIBD001551 a 
inner join  producttype_aust_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001551
where Pending_Orders.Company=551
and TTCIBD001551.company = Pending_Orders.company 
and ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001551.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode )) 


update Pending_Orders  set  dpst  = TTCIBD001552.dpst from 
(select company,b.dpst,item from  TTCIBD001552 a
inner join  producttype_indo_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001552
where Pending_Orders.Company=552
and TTCIBD001552.company = Pending_Orders.company 
and ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001552.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) 

-------------end dpst updation for 551,552


-------Buyer Updation

update PENDING_ORDERS set Buyer= a.BuyerName  from 
(select b.NAMA as BuyerName,a.ITEM,A.COMPANY   From
(select distinct BUYR,ITEM,COMPANY  From TTDIPU001ALL 
where ltrim(rtrim(item)) in (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode ))as item from PENDING_ORDERS)
 AND COMPANY =401)a
left join TTCCOM001ALL b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.BUYR)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.EMNO)))a
 where ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM)) =ltrim(rtrim(PENDING_ORDERS.ItemCode)) 
		AND PENDING_ORDERS.Company =490

 AND COMPANY <>490)a

(select company,cwar,item,sum(qhnd)qhnd from twhwmd215all where Company=416  and cwar in ('049') group by company,cwar,item) b
where ltrim(rtrim(pending_orders.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.item)) 
and pending_orders.company=490 and b.CWAR in ('049')
--416 end


--------450 stock
update pending_orders set STOCK_450_act=b.qhnd from 
(select company,cwar,item,((sum(qhnd))-(sum(QlAL)+sum(QBLK)))as qhnd from twhwmd215all where Company=450   and cwar in ('251','174')group by company,cwar,item) b
where ltrim(rtrim(pending_orders.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.item)) 
and pending_orders.company=490 and b.cwar in ('251','174')

update pending_orders set STOCK_450_onhand=b.qhnd from 
(select company,cwar,item,sum(qhnd)qhnd from twhwmd215all where Company=450 and cwar in ('251','174') group by company,cwar,item ) b
where ltrim(rtrim(pending_orders.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.item)) 
and pending_orders.company=490 and b.cwar in ('251','174')
-------- end 450 stock


update Pending_Orders set currency=a.Currency  from (select distinct company,OrderNum,Currency From Sales_Header)a 
where Pending_Orders .Company =a.Company 
and Pending_Orders .OrderNum =a.OrderNum  

update Pending_Orders set MaxQty =a.Max_Qty  from Itemwise_Qty  a
where ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) 

update Pending_Orders set Monthwise_Ordqty  =a.qty   
from (select sum(qty)qty,ItemCode  from Sales_Inflow 
where  month(OrderDate)=month(getdate()-1) and year(OrderDate)=year(getdate()-1)
and concat(company,ordertype) in (select CONCAT(company,saleordertype) from saletype_master where Sales_Category not in (1)) 
group by ItemCode) a
where ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))
and ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) in (select distinct Item from Itemwise_qty)

update Pending_Orders set invoice =a.invnum,trantype=a.Trantype from (select distinct company,OrderNum,PositionNum,Trantype,invnum from  CI_Lines)a
where Pending_Orders.Company =a.company
and Pending_Orders.OrderNum =a.OrderNum 
and Pending_Orders.PositionNum =a.PositionNum 
 
update Pending_Orders set inv_date  =a.invdate from (select distinct company,invnum,Trantyp,max(t_idat) as invdate from  CI_Header group by invnum,company,Trantyp)a
where Pending_Orders.invoice=a.invnum 
and Pending_Orders.company=a.company
and Pending_Orders.trantype=a.Trantyp
 
update Pending_Orders set dest_type ='OPEN AT HOME OFFICE' WHERE invoice is null 

update Pending_Orders set dest_type ='IN TRANSIT TO SUBSIDIARIES' WHERE CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()) BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE,inv_date) AND CONVERT(DATE,inv_date+51)

update Pending_Orders set dest_type ='REACHED TO SUBSIDIARY' WHERE GETDATE() >=CONVERT(DATE,inv_date+52)  

update Pending_Orders set issue_item=a.InvIssStat from (select distinct company,OrderNum,PositionNum,InvIssStat from Sales_Lines )a
where Pending_Orders.Company =a.Company 
and Pending_Orders.OrderNum =a.OrderNum 
and Pending_Orders.PositionNum =a.PositionNum 

update Pending_Orders set issue_item ='Main Item' where Pending_Orders.issue_item='1'
update Pending_Orders set issue_item ='Component' where Pending_Orders.issue_item='2'

update Pending_Orders set itemclass=a.Category from (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(item)) as Item,Category From ITEM_ABC_CLASIFICATION_MASTER)a
where ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) =a.Item

update Pending_Orders set lead_days=(case when itemclass='A'THEN 7 WHEN itemclass='B'THEN 15 WHEN itemclass='C'THEN 30 WHEN itemclass='D'THEN 90 else 30 END)
where Pending_Orders.company in (490)

update Pending_Orders set lead_days=10
where Pending_Orders.company in (401)
and ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) in (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(item))as Item from  Itemwise_Qty)

update Pending_Orders set lead_days=65
where Pending_Orders.company in (401)
and ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) NOT in (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(item))as Item from  Itemwise_Qty)


update Pending_Orders set itemtype=b.KITM from (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM))AS ITEM,
	CASE WHEN KITM=1 THEN 'P'when KITM=2 then 'M' when KITM=4 then 'C'when KITM=5 then 'S' end as KITM
	  fROM ELGi_LN.DBO.TTCIBD001490)b
			WHERE ltrim(rtrim(Pending_Orders.ItemCode)) =b.ITEM 

			update Pending_Orders set estimated_date=dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(orderdate,lead_days)

			update Pending_Orders set NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
    and date between Pending_Orders.OrderDate and Pending_Orders.estimated_date)

			update Pending_Orders set estimated_date=dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(estimated_date,NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS)

			--- old method changed as on jan25 2019
-- update Pending_Orders set estimated_date=

-- update Pending_Orders set estimated_date=
--	(select 
--DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,estimated_date) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,estimated_date) +

--(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,estimated_date) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,estimated_date))-2))

update Pending_Orders set typ=A.BDI from (select distinct t$sotp,t$cofc,CASE WHEN T$BDIO=1 THEN 'BDI' END BDI From  [WMS].DBO.TZZSLS608490 WHERE T$BDIO=1)a
where Pending_Orders.ordertype=a.t$sotp
and Pending_Orders.dpst=a.t$cofc

update Pending_Orders set typ='TYP'  where company in(490)and ordertype  in ('516','AMC')

update Pending_Orders set typ='DOM' WHERE (Pending_Orders.Dpst  BETWEEN '90000' AND '90091') AND TYP<>'BDI'

update Pending_Orders set typ='RLY' WHERE (DPST='90092') AND TYP<>'BDI' AND TYP<>'DOM' AND TYP<>'EXP' AND TYP<>'SUB'


update Pending_Orders set shpment_date=A.SHPM_DATE FROM(
SELECT DISTINCT A.SHPM,SHPM_DATE,WORN,WPON,a.COMPANY  fROM (select DISTINCT company,SHPM,MAX(CDAT)AS SHPM_DATE   From TWHINH430ALL GROUP BY SHPM,company)A

--exec sp_Pending_orders_wms
--select * from pending_orders_wms where invoice is null
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Pending_orders_wms] 
as
Begin

Truncate table [wms].dbo.Pending_orders
Truncate table  Pending_orders_wms
insert into Pending_orders_wms

select * from (
select Company,CustCode,ItemCode,OrderDate,OrderNum,PositionNum,ord_qty,ShipQty,DelQty,PendQty,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,T$RATS$1,T$OAMT,Value,diffdays,                   
null as Item_desc,null as Custname,null as Dpstname,null as areacode,null as areaname,
null as Dpst,null as ordertype,null as Buyer ,null as origin,
--case when h.Origin=3 then 'EDI' else 'Manual' End as orjn,
null as orjn ,null as Indent,
0 AS STOCK_440_act,0 AS STOCK_440_onhand,0 AS STOCK_401_act,0 AS STOCK_401_onhand,0 AS STOCK_416_act,0 AS STOCK_416_onhand,
0 AS STOCK_450_act,0 AS STOCK_450_onhand,0 AS STOCK_490_act,0 AS STOCK_490_onhand,0 as STOCK_DEL_act,0 as STOCK_DEL_onhand,
0 AS STOCK_CAL_act,0 AS STOCK_CAL_onhand,
null as Baan_orderno,null as Baan_positionno,0 as Cancel_Qty,null as Zone,null as OrderMonthNo,null as OrderMonth,null as OrderMonthYear,
NULL AS Origin_desc,NULL AS Region,NULL AS Sale_Type, NULL AS Tax_Desc ,NULL AS HSN_CODE ,NULL AS GSTN_NO ,NULL AS PRICE_ORIGIN ,NULL AS SP_SEQ_NO,
NULL AS Ref,NULL AS Old_orderno,NULL AS Old_positionno,null as State,
NULL as Sales_Inv_Address,NULL as Cust_Inv_Address,
NULL as Sales_GSTN_NO,NULL as Cust_GSTN_NO,
NULL as SALES_SEQ,NULL as Cust_SEQ,
NULL as SALES_state,NULL as Cust_state,
NULL as plan_del_Date,
DiscPerc2,'' as disc_origin,'' as Blocked ,null as currecny,null as plan_recp_date,
0 as MaxQty,0 as Monthwise_Ordqty,
'' as ExportOrder,null as invoice,null as inv_date, null as dest_type, null as issue_item,
'      ' as itemtype,'     ' as itemclass,0 AS ISSS , '  ' as estimated_date,0 as lead_days,0 AS NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS,
'TYP'as typ,'     ' as shpment_date,0 as Delay_days,'' as trantype,'   'as Mitachi,'   ' as Hanva


From   
	
(
select a.Company,a.CustCode,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,
avg(a.ord_qty) as ord_qty,
--TranType,--b.ShipNo,--c.INVNUM,
sum(ShipQty) ShipQty,
sum(DelQty) DelQty,
avg(a.ord_qty)-sum(isnull(DelQty,0)) as PendQty,
TaxCode,case when DeliveryDate='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' then null else DeliveryDate end as DeliveryDate ,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,T$RATS$1,T$OAMT,case when T$RATS$1<1 then 1*T$OAMT else T$RATS$1*T$OAMT end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays 
 from 
(
--Detailed Data
select a.Company,CustCode,ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,a.ord_qty,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,
Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,OrderDate,getdate())as diffdays,T$RATS$1,T$OAMT, 
--c.TranType,b.ShipNo,--c.INVNUM,
ISNULL(b.ShipQty,0)ShipQty,
ISNULL(c.DelQty,0)DelQty From 
(
--Fetching OrderQty
select Company,t$odat as OrderDate,t$ofbp as CustCode,ltrim(rtrim(t$item)) as ItemCode,t$orno as OrderNum ,t$pono as PositionNum,t$qoor as ord_qty, t$invn as invnum,
T$CVAT as TaxCode,T$DLDT as DeliveryDate, T$CWAR as WareHouse,t$pric as Price,T$DISC$1 as DiscPerc1,T$DISC$2 as DiscPerc2,case when T$RATS$1 <1 then 1*T$OAMT else T$RATS$1*T$OAMT end  as Value,
DATEDIFF(dd,t$odat,getdate())as diffdays,T$RATS$1,T$OAMT 
From [wms].dbo.TTDSLS401490 
where t$sqnb=0 
and t$clyn<>1 
and T$QOOR >0

--and company in (490) 
--and ltrim(rtrim(custcode))not in ('CU1K02388','CU1E00893','CU1L00543','CU1E00015','CU1E00791',
--'CU1E00008','CU1E00814','CU1E00914','CU1E00477','CU1E00679','CU1E00263','CU1E00926','CU1E00396','CU1E00887')
	--and t_dldt='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
)a

left outer join
(
--Fetching Packing Qty below comment data old table
select COMPANY,t$orno as OrderNum , t$pono as PosNum,sum(t$qpli)as ShipQty  from  [wms].dbo.TWHINH480490
where t$qpli>0 and COMPANY in (490) group by COMPANY,t$orno ,t$pono

)b
on a.Company=b.COMPANY
and a.OrderNum=b.OrderNum
and a.PositionNum=b.PosNum

left outer join 
(
--Fetching Deliverd Qty
select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,sum(QIDL) as DelQty from [wms].dbo.sales_delivery
--TTDSLS406ALL 
where QIDL>0 
--and INVN <>0 
group by COMPANY,ORNO,PONO
)c
on a.Company=c.COMPANY
and a.OrderNum=c.ORNO
and a.PositionNum=c.PONO

--WHERE 
--a.company=490
--and a.OrderNum= '292000008'
--and a.PositionNum=30
)a
--where ord_qty >0 
group by a.Company,a.CustCode,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate,a.OrderNum,a.PositionNum,TaxCode,DeliveryDate,WareHouse,Price,DiscPerc1,DiscPerc2,T$RATS$1,T$OAMT
--having avg(a.ord_qty)-sum(isnull(DelQty,0))<>0
)Details
)a


------------ foc orders removed as req to karun kannan
delete from Pending_orders_wms  where CONCAT(company,ordertype) in
(select distinct CONCAT(company,saleordertype)as type  From saletype_master where Sales_Category =1)
---------------------

update Pending_orders_wms set ShipQty =(ShipQty-DelQty)

update Pending_orders_wms set plan_del_date=a.t_ddta,ISSS=A.InvIssStat  
from Sales_Lines a
where Pending_orders_wms.Company =a.Company
and Pending_orders_wms.OrderNum =a.OrderNum
and Pending_orders_wms.PositionNum =a.PositionNum 

update Pending_orders_wms set plan_recp_date=a.planrecdate  from Sales_Lines a
where Pending_orders_wms.Company =a.Company
and Pending_orders_wms.OrderNum =a.OrderNum
and Pending_orders_wms.PositionNum =a.PositionNum


update Pending_orders_wms set 
Dpst=h.Dpst,
ordertype=H.ordertype,
origin=h.origin,
orjn=case when h.Origin=3 then 'EDI' else 'Manual' End ,
Indent=case when h.t_corn=' ' then h.RefA else h.t_corn end
from 
(select * From Sales_Header where dpst not like '%[a-z]%') h
where Pending_orders_wms.OrderNum =h.OrderNum

-----------------update dpst for 551,552

and ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001551.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode )) 


update Pending_orders_wms  set  dpst  = TTCIBD001552.dpst from 
(select company,b.dpst,item from  TTCIBD001552 a
inner join  producttype_indo_master b on a.CTYP = b.t$ctyp) TTCIBD001552
where Pending_orders_wms.Company=552
and TTCIBD001552.company = Pending_orders_wms.company 
and ltrim(rtrim(TTCIBD001552.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) 

-------------end dpst updation for 551,552


-------Buyer Updation

update Pending_orders_wms set Buyer= a.BuyerName  from 
(select b.NAMA as BuyerName,a.ITEM,A.COMPANY   From
(select distinct BUYR,ITEM,COMPANY  From TTDIPU001ALL 
where ltrim(rtrim(item)) in (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode ))as item from Pending_orders_wms)
 AND COMPANY =401)a
left join TTCCOM001ALL b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.BUYR)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.EMNO)))a
 where ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM)) =ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) 
		AND Pending_orders_wms.Company =490


		update Pending_orders_wms set Buyer= a.BuyerName  from 
(select b.NAMA as BuyerName,a.ITEM,A.COMPANY   From
(select distinct BUYR,ITEM,COMPANY  From TTDIPU001ALL 
where ltrim(rtrim(item)) in (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode ))as item from Pending_orders_wms)
 AND COMPANY <>490)a
left join TTCCOM001ALL b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.BUYR)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.EMNO)))a
 where ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM)) =ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) 
	and a.COMPANY =Pending_orders_wms.Company 
		AND Pending_orders_wms.Company <>490

------------------ buyer updation end


update Pending_orders_wms set Baan_orderno=b.OORN,Baan_positionno=b.OPOS
from (select * From tsacom999all where type=2)b
where ltrim(rtrim(OrderNum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.NORN ))

update Pending_orders_wms set currency=a.Currency  from (select distinct company,OrderNum,Currency From Sales_Header)a 
where Pending_orders_wms .Company =a.Company 
and Pending_orders_wms .OrderNum =a.OrderNum  

update Pending_orders_wms set MaxQty =a.Max_Qty  from Itemwise_Qty  a
where ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) 

update Pending_orders_wms set Monthwise_Ordqty  =a.qty   
from (select sum(qty)qty,ItemCode  from Sales_Inflow 
where  month(OrderDate)=month(getdate()-1) and year(OrderDate)=year(getdate()-1)
and concat(company,ordertype) in (select CONCAT(company,saleordertype) from saletype_master where Sales_Category not in (1)) 
group by ItemCode) a
where ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))
and ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) in (select distinct Item from Itemwise_qty)

update Pending_orders_wms set invoice =a.invnum,trantype=a.Trantype from (select distinct company,OrderNum,PositionNum,Trantype,invnum from  CI_Lines)a
where Pending_orders_wms.Company =a.company
and Pending_orders_wms.OrderNum =a.OrderNum 
and Pending_orders_wms.PositionNum =a.PositionNum 
 
update Pending_orders_wms set inv_date  =a.invdate from (select distinct COMPANY,invnum,t_ttyp,max(t_idat) as invdate from  CI_Header group by invnum,t_ttyp,COMPANY)a
where Pending_orders_wms.invoice=a.invnum 
and Pending_orders_wms.trantype =a.t_ttyp
AND Pending_orders_wms.COMPANY=A.COMPANY
 
update Pending_orders_wms set dest_type ='OPEN AT HOME OFFICE' WHERE invoice is null 

update Pending_orders_wms set dest_type ='IN TRANSIT TO SUBSIDIARIES' WHERE CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE()) BETWEEN CONVERT(DATE,inv_date) AND CONVERT(DATE,inv_date+51)

update Pending_orders_wms set dest_type ='REACHED TO SUBSIDIARY' WHERE GETDATE() >=CONVERT(DATE,inv_date+52)  

update Pending_orders_wms set issue_item=a.InvIssStat from (select distinct company,OrderNum,PositionNum,InvIssStat from Sales_Lines )a
where Pending_orders_wms.Company =a.Company 
and Pending_orders_wms.OrderNum =a.OrderNum 
and Pending_orders_wms.PositionNum =a.PositionNum 

update Pending_orders_wms set issue_item ='Main Item' where Pending_orders_wms.issue_item='1'
update Pending_orders_wms set issue_item ='Component' where Pending_orders_wms.issue_item='2'

update Pending_orders_wms set itemclass=a.Category from (select distinct ltrim(rtrim(item)) as Item,Category From ITEM_ABC_CLASIFICATION_MASTER)a
where ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) =a.Item

update Pending_orders_wms set lead_days=(case when itemclass='A'THEN 7 WHEN itemclass='B'THEN 15 WHEN itemclass='C'THEN 30 WHEN itemclass='D'THEN 90 END )

update Pending_orders_wms set itemtype=b.KITM from (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM))AS ITEM,
	CASE WHEN KITM=1 THEN 'P'when KITM=2 then 'M' when KITM=4 then 'C'when KITM=5 then 'S' end as KITM
	  fROM ELGi_LN.DBO.TTCIBD001490)b
			WHERE ltrim(rtrim(Pending_orders_wms.ItemCode)) =b.ITEM 

update Pending_Orders set estimated_date=dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(orderdate,lead_days)

			update Pending_Orders set NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
    and date between Pending_Orders.OrderDate and Pending_Orders.estimated_date)

			update Pending_Orders set estimated_date=dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(estimated_date,NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS)

-- update Pending_orders_wms set estimated_date=
--(select 
--DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,OrderDate) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,OrderDate) +
--(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,OrderDate) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,OrderDate)) - 2 +convert(int,lead_days)) %5 +
--((DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,OrderDate) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,OrderDate))-2+convert(int,lead_days))/5)*7-
--(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,OrderDate) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,OrderDate))-2))

--update Pending_orders_wms set NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
--and date between Pending_orders_wms.OrderDate and Pending_orders_wms.estimated_date)

-- update Pending_orders_wms set estimated_date=
--	(select 
--DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,estimated_date) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,estimated_date) +
--(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,estimated_date) WHEN 7THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,estimated_date))-2 +convert(int,NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS)) %5 +
--((DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,estimated_date) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,estimated_date))-2+convert(int,NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS))/5)*7-
--(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,estimated_date) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,estimated_date))-2))

update Pending_orders_wms set typ=A.BDI from (select distinct t$sotp,t$cofc,CASE WHEN T$BDIO=1 THEN 'BDI' END BDI From  [WMS].DBO.TZZSLS608490 WHERE T$BDIO=1)a
where Pending_orders_wms.ordertype=a.t$sotp
and Pending_orders_wms.dpst=a.t$cofc

update Pending_orders_wms set typ='TYP'  where company in(490)and ordertype  in ('516','AMC')

update Pending_orders_wms set typ='DOM' WHERE (Pending_orders_wms.Dpst  BETWEEN '90000' AND '90091') AND TYP<>'BDI'  

update Pending_orders_wms set typ='EXP' WHERE DPST in ('90231','90213','90257','90293') AND TYP<>'BDI' AND TYP<>'DOM'

update Pending_orders_wms set typ='SUB' WHERE (DPST BETWEEN '70000' AND '70099') AND TYP<>'BDI' AND TYP<>'DOM' AND TYP<>'EXP'

update Pending_orders_wms set typ='RLY' WHERE (DPST='90092') AND TYP<>'BDI' AND TYP<>'DOM' AND TYP<>'EXP' AND TYP<>'SUB'


update Pending_orders_wms set shpment_date=A.SHPM_DATE FROM(
SELECT DISTINCT A.SHPM,SHPM_DATE,WORN,WPON,a.COMPANY  fROM (select DISTINCT company,SHPM,MAX(CDAT)AS SHPM_DATE   From TWHINH430ALL GROUP BY SHPM,company)A
INNER JOIN (select DISTINCT company,SHPM,WORN,WPON From TWHINH431ALL)B 
ON A.SHPM =B.SHPM and a.COMPANY=b.company)A
WHERE Pending_orders_wms.OrderNum=A.WORN

and Pending_orders_wms.company=a.company

--update Pending_orders_wms set ord_qty= (ord_qty-Cancel_Qty)

update Pending_orders_wms  set Delay_days=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where CCAL ='COMPANY' and DFCA <>4
and date between Pending_orders_wms.estimated_date  and Pending_orders_wms.inv_date)

update Pending_Orders_wms set Mitachi='No'
update Pending_Orders_wms set Mitachi='Yes' where ltrim(rtrim(itemcode)) in (select distinct item From [wms].dbo.Mitachi_master) 

update Pending_Orders_wms set hanva='No'
update Pending_Orders_wms set hanva='Yes' where ltrim(rtrim(itemcode)) in (select distinct item From [wms].dbo.hanva_master) 

-- due to karun kannan req elgi equipment customers need to remove

'CU1E00396','CU1E00424','CU1E00477','CU1E00508','CU1E00578','CU1E00580','CU1E00629','CU1E00675','CU1E00676','CU1E00728','CU1E00780',
'CU1E00791','CU1E00798','CU1E00814','CU1E00885','CU1E00887','CU1E00893','CU1E00914','CU1E00926','CU1E00961','CU1E00992',
