/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_price_amenment]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_price_amenment
--Tables are loaded in Purchase data load
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_price_amenment]
as
begin
truncate table price_Amenment 
insert into price_Amenment 
select a.*,c.item_desc From (
select convert(date,a.T$DATE) as Date,a.COMPANY,T$BPID,b.custname1 as Custname,T$ITEM,T$ORNO as Old_orno,T$PONO as Old_pono,T$SEQN as Old_seq,T$BQTY as old_qty,T$OPRIC as old_pric,T$NORNO,T$NPONO,T$NQTY as New_qty,T$NPRIC as New_pric,
T$HSNC,T$GSTIN,T$REM1,T$REMK ,
case when COMPANY in (400,401,416,440,450)then 400 else COMPANY end as comp_new
From TZZPUR611All a
left join vw_Business_Partner b
on a.T$BPID =b.custcode 
)a
left join vw_item_master c
on concat(a.comp_new,ltrim(rtrim(a.t$item)))=concat(c.company,ltrim(rtrim(c.item)))
end

group by year(odat),month(odat),day(odat)
)a
-------------p Lines
 
union all
select * from (
select 'P Line'as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(odat)as Year,month(odat)as Month,day(odat)as Day,count(*)as count From ttdpur401ALL
where CONVERT(DATE,odat) between '2017-04-01'and '2017-04-30' AND Company IN (400,401,490,450)

---------------S Header

group by year(OrderDate),month(OrderDate),day(OrderDate)

-----------------Invoice
union all

select *  from (
select 'Sales Invoice' as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(t_idat)as Year,month(t_idat)as Month,day(t_idat)as Day,count(*)as count 
From CI_Header
where CONVERT(DATE,t_idat) between '2017-04-01'and '2017-04-30' AND Company IN (400,401,490,450) 
group by year(t_idat),month(t_idat),day(t_idat)
union all
select 'Sales Invoice' as Categ,'BAAN'AS TYPE,YEAR(InvoiceDt)AS Year,month(InvoiceDt)as Month,Day(InvoiceDt)as Day,count(*)as Count 
From(select Company ,InvoiceDt,InvoiceNum,TranType

where DeliveryDt between '2017-03-01'and '2017-03-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
group by Company ,InvoiceDt,InvoiceNum,TranType )a
group by year(InvoiceDt),month(InvoiceDt),day(InvoiceDt)
)e

--------------- sales value
union all
select * From (
select 'Sales Value'as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(t_idat )as Year,month(t_idat )as Month,day(t_idat )as Day,round(sum(t_amth_1/1000000),2)as count 
From (select a.t_idat,b.t_amth_1,
 case when b.company = 490 and saletype  in('226','242','246','270','274','284','326','342','346','374','384','526','546')then '1'
when b.company = 401 and saletype  in('223','240','244','246','225','252','344','523','RGS')then '1'
when b.company = 450 and saletype  in('A14','244')then '1'else  0 end as sales_category
  From CI_Header a
inner join CI_Lines b
on a.company =b.Company 
and ltrim(rtrim(a.invnum)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.invnum )) 
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Trantyp)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.Trantype)) 
and b.Company IN (400,401,490,450))a
where CONVERT(DATE,t_idat ) between '2017-04-01'and '2017-04-30'
and sales_category =0
group by year(t_idat ),month(t_idat ),day(t_idat )

From [ELGI-DW].dbo.tmpslsdespdata
where Date between '2017-03-01'and '2017-03-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
group by year(Date ),month(Date ),day(Date )
)gg

-------------------- 
UNION ALL
select * From (
select 'Packing Slip'as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(sdtf)as Year,month(sdtf)as Month,day(sdtf)as Day,count(*)as count 
From twhinh430all
where CONVERT(DATE,sdtf) between '2017-04-01'and '2017-04-30' AND Company IN (400,401,490,450) 
group by year(sdtf),month(sdtf),day(sdtf)
union all
select 'Packing Slip' as Categ,'BAAN'AS TYPE,YEAR(DeliveryDt)AS Year,month(DeliveryDt)as Month,Day(DeliveryDt)as Day,count(*)as Count 
From(select Company ,DeliveryDt,InvoiceNum,TranType   
From [ELGI-DW].dbo.TmpSlsDelivery   
where DeliveryDt between '2017-03-01'and '2017-03-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
group by Company ,DeliveryDt,InvoiceNum,TranType )a
group by year(DeliveryDt),month(DeliveryDt),day(DeliveryDt)
)f

union all


select * from (
select 'Production'as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(date1)as Year,month(date1)as Month,day(date1)as Day,count(*)as count From ELGi_production_details 
where CONVERT(DATE,date1) between '2017-04-01'and '2017-04-30' AND Company IN (400,401,490,450)
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
union all
select 'Production'as Categ,'BAAN'AS TYPE,YEAR(date1)AS Year,month(date1)as Month,Day(date1)as Day,count(*)as Count From [ELGI-DW].dbo.production_plan_vs_actual_ver2  
where convert(date,date1) between '2017-03-01'and '2017-03-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
)g


update Baan_Ln_Data set count=b.count
from Purchase_data_Baan_LN b
where b.Categ =Baan_Ln_Data.categ
and b.TYPE =Baan_Ln_Data.type
and b.Year =Baan_Ln_Data.year
and b.Month =Baan_Ln_Data.month
and b.Day =Baan_Ln_Data.day

end

group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
union all
select 'Production plan'as Categ,'BAAN'AS TYPE,YEAR(date1)AS Year,month(date1)as Month,Day(date1)as Day,sum(Planned_qty)as Count
 From  [ELGI-DW] .dbo.production_plan_vs_actual_ver2 
where convert(date,date1) between '2016-05-01'and '2016-05-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
and Planned_qty >0
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
)p1

union all
select * from (
select 'Production Rel'as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(date1)as Year,month(date1)as Month,day(date1)as Day,sum(Released_qty)as Count From ELGi_production_details 
where CONVERT(DATE,date1) between '2017-05-01'and '2017-05-31' AND Company IN (400,401,490,450)
and Released_qty >0
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
union all
select 'Production Rel'as Categ,'BAAN'AS TYPE,YEAR(date1)AS Year,month(date1)as Month,Day(date1)as Day,sum(Released_qty)as Count
 From  [ELGI-DW] .dbo.production_plan_vs_actual_ver2 
where convert(date,date1) between '2016-05-01'and '2016-05-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
and Released_qty >0
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
)p2
union all

select * from (
select 'Production close'as Categ,'LN'AS TYPE,year(date1)as Year,month(date1)as Month,day(date1)as Day,sum(Actual_qty)as Count From ELGi_production_details 
where CONVERT(DATE,date1) between '2017-05-01'and '2017-05-31' AND Company IN (400,401,490,450)
and  Actual_qty>0
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
union all
select 'Production Close'as Categ,'BAAN'AS TYPE,YEAR(date1)AS Year,month(date1)as Month,Day(date1)as Day,sum(Actual_qty)as Count
 From  [ELGI-DW] .dbo.production_plan_vs_actual_ver2 
where convert(date,date1) between '2016-05-01'and '2016-05-31' and COMPANY in (100,150,102,108) 
and Actual_qty >0
group by year(date1),month(date1),day(date1)
)p3


update Baan_Ln_Data_may set count=b.count
from Purchase_data_Baan_LN_may b
where b.Categ =Baan_Ln_Data_may.categ
and b.TYPE =Baan_Ln_Data_may.type
and b.Year =Baan_Ln_Data_may.year
and b.Month =Baan_Ln_Data_may.month
and b.Day =Baan_Ln_Data_may.day
end


GO

--exec sp_Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp] as

Begin

--LN Data
Truncate table Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp

Insert into Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp
--select * into Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp from (
select CalYear,calMonth,company,dpst,custcode,custname,ItemCode,Item_desc,sum(Sales_amount) Sales_amount from 
(select year(Invoice_Date) as CalYear,month(Invoice_Date) as calMonth,company,dpst,custcode,custname,Item as ItemCode,Item_desc,Sales_amount 
from ELGi_Sales_Details where dpst in ('90073','90091','90092')
and Invoice_Date>='2017-04-01'
)a
group by CalYear,calMonth,company,dpst,custcode,custname,ItemCode,Item_desc
--order by CalYear,calMonth
--)a

--BAAN Data
Insert into Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp
select CalYear,calMonth,company,dpst,custcode,custname,ItemCode,Item_desc,sum(AssesValue) Sales_amount from (
select year(Date) as CalYear, month(Date) as calMonth,company,dpst,CustCode,null as custname,ItemCode,null as Item_desc,AssesValue 
from TmpSlsDespData_baan
where dpst in ('90073','90091','90092')
and date between '2014-04-01' and '2017-03-31'
)a
where company not like '1%'
and company not like '6%'
group by CalYear,calMonth,company,dpst,custcode,custname,ItemCode,Item_desc
order by CalYear,calMonth

update Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp set custname=custname1
from (select distinct CustCode,CustName1 from [ELGI-DW].dbo.tmpcustomer)a
where Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.custcode=a.custcode
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.custname is null


update Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp set Item_desc=a.t_dsca
from (select distinct t_item,t_dsca from TTCIBD001400)a
where ltrim(rtrim(Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.company like '4%'
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.company<>490
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.Item_desc is null



update Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp set Item_desc=a.dsca
from (select distinct item,dsca from TTCIBD001490)a
where ltrim(rtrim(Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.company like '4%'
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.company=490
and Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp.Item_desc is null

update Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp set ItemCode=ltrim(rtrim(ItemCode))

end


select CalYear,calMonth,dpst,custcode,custname,ItemCode,Item_desc,sum(Sales_amount) Sales_amount 
from Rly_sales_2014_18_Tmp 
group by CalYear,calMonth,dpst,custcode,custname,ItemCode,Item_desc
order by CalYear,calMonth




GO

CREATE PROC [dbo].[SP_ROTAIR_OTD]
AS 
BEGIN

TRUNCATE TABLE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET ABC=A.Category  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM))AS ITEM,Category  FROM ITEM_ABC_CLASIFICATION_MASTER)A
WHERE A.ITEM =LTRIM(RTRIM(ROTAIR_OTD.Item))

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET ABC='C' where ABC NOT IN ('A','B','C')
UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET ABC='C' where ABC is null

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET LEADTIME= 7 WHERE ABC='A'
UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET LEADTIME= 15 WHERE ABC='B'
UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET LEADTIME= 30 WHERE ABC='C'

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET TIMETAKEN= DATEDIFF(DD,CONVERT(DATE,OrdER_Date),CONVERT(DATE,Inv_Date))   
UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET stat= case when leadtime>=timetaken then 'On Time' else 'Delay' end
UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD SET month= concat(left(datename(m,Inv_Date),3),'-',convert(varchar,year(Inv_Date)))

INSERT INTO ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH
SELECT 'Y15-16','Y15-16 OTD%',66 UNION ALL
SELECT 'Y16-17','Y16-17 OTD%',90 UNION ALL
SELECT 'Y17-18','Y17-18 OTD%',85 UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Total line items',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'On time supplied',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Delayed supply',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class A total',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class b total',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class c total',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Target%',90  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class A%',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class B%',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'Class C%',0  from ROTAIR_OTD UNION ALL
select DISTINCT MONTH,'2018-19 OTD%',0  from ROTAIR_otd 


UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT   FROM ROTAIR_OTD GROUP BY MONTH)A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='TOTAL LINE ITEMS'

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM ROTAIR_OTD WHERE STAT='On Time' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='On time supplied'

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM ROTAIR_OTD WHERE STAT='DELAY' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Delayed supply'

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM ROTAIR_OTD WHERE ABC='A'GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class A total'

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM ROTAIR_OTD WHERE ABC='B' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class B total'

UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM ROTAIR_OTD WHERE ABC='C' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class C total'


UPDATE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH SET CNT=A.CONT FROM (SELECT MONTH,COUNT(*)AS CONT FROM ROTAIR_OTD WHERE ABC='A' and STAT='On Time' GROUP BY MONTH )A 
WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class A%'

WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class B%'

WHERE ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.MONTH=A.MONTH AND ROTAIR_OTD_GRAPH.TARGET='Class C%'

--exec sp_sales_cube
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_sales_cube]
as 
begin

truncate table sales_cube

insert into sales_cube
select a.company,trantype,OrderNo,PositionNo,Invoice,item,Item_desc,custcode,custname,dpst,dpstname,organ,isnull(Region,'Others')Region,
isnull(Vertical1,'Others')Vertical1,isnull(Division,'Others')Division, 
areacode,isnull(areaname,'Others')areaname,isnull(Zone,'Others')Zone,cal_year,Fin_year,cal_Month,Fin_month,Monthname,day(Invoice_Date)as Day, 
SaleOrderType,isnull(shipmentno,'')shipmentno,isnull(shipmentline,'')shipmentline,isnull(shiptoaddress,'')shiptoaddress,Sales_amount/1000000,
case
when Organ='India' then Description
when Organ='COSEA' then Division 
when Organ='SAAME' then user_names 
when Organ='ID' then Division
when Organ='Subsidiary' then Division
	end as Vertical_new,
case when Organ='India' then 'Domestic'
when Organ in ('COSEA','SAAME','ID','Subsidiary') then 'International'
end as Global

  from (
select a.*,b.Description  From LN_Sales_Details_ver2 a
left join DPST_Master_Domestic b
on a.dpst =b.DPSTcode 
where Organ in ('India','COSEA','SAAME','ID','Subsidiary')
and concat(convert(varchar,a.company),a.SaleOrderType) in (select concat(convert(varchar,company),saleordertype) from saletype_master where sales_category<>1)
and a.company in (select distinct company  From ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup ='ELGI')
and Sales_amount >0
)a
end


GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_sales_report_LN]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_sales_report_ln
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_sales_report_LN]
as 
begin

truncate table sales_report_LN 
insert into sales_report_LN 

select date,OrderNum,ItemCode,areacode,areaname,model,Item_desc,dpst,dpstname,custname,DeliveredQty,CustCode,sales_category,SaleOrderType,
AssesValue,Zone,Invoice,trantype,company,
SalesDescription,taxcode,month(date)as Month,datename(mm,date)as Monthaname,null as Item_Category,null as Type,null as Product_Group,Tax_Amount  From (
select 
convert(varchar,convert(datetime,a.Invoice_Date),101) as Date,
ltrim(rtrim(a.OrderNo)) as OrderNum, 
ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) as ItemCode, 
areacode,areaname , 
null as Model, 
a.Item_desc, 
--producttpl.Model, 
--producttpl.Item, 
a.dpst , 
a.dpstname, 
ltrim(rtrim(a.custname))custname, 
a.DeliveryQty as DeliveredQty, 
ltrim(rtrim(a.CustCode))CustCode,
--salesdescription,     
a.sales_category,    
ltrim(rtrim(a.SaleOrderType))SaleOrderType ,             
sum(a.Sales_amount) as AssesValue,
a.zone,
ltrim(rtrim(a.Invoice))Invoice, 
ltrim(rtrim(a.trantype))trantype  ,
a.company,
b.SalesDescription,
ltrim(rtrim(a.taxcode)) taxcode,
a.t_txah_1 as Tax_Amount
--f.RefA as indentno
from (
select * From ELGi_Sales_Details where Invoice_Date >='2017-04-01' and sales_category not in (1)
and Organ is not null
and Organ <>''
AND concat(company,SaleOrderType) in (select distinct concat(company,SaleOrderType) from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category not in (1))
)a
left outer join SalesCategory_Master b
on b.salescode = a.sales_category
group by convert(varchar,convert(datetime,a.Invoice_Date),101),
a.OrderNo,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)),a.Item_desc,a.dpst , a.dpstname, a.custname, a.DeliveryQty,a.CustCode ,areacode,areaname ,
a.sales_category,a.zone,a.Invoice,a.trantype ,b.SalesDescription,a.SaleOrderType,a.company,a.taxcode,a.t_txah_1  
)a

update sales_report_LN set type=b.TYPE  from (select distinct dpst,[ITEM CODE],TYPE   from Item_category_model)b
where  --ltrim(rtrim(sales_report_LN.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.dpst)) and 
ltrim(rtrim(sales_report_LN.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.[item code]))


update sales_report_LN set item_category=b.category  from (select distinct dpst,[ITEM CODE],category   from Item_category_model)b
where  
--ltrim(rtrim(sales_report_LN.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.dpst)) and 
ltrim(rtrim(sales_report_LN.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.[item code]))


update sales_report_LN set Product_Group=b.pg  from (select distinct dpst,[ITEM CODE],PG   from Item_category_model)b
where

ltrim(rtrim(sales_report_LN.ItemCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.[item code]))

end

CREATE PROC [dbo].[SP_SalesHistory_Thailand] 
as

begin

Truncate table SalesHistory_Thailand

Insert into SalesHistory_Thailand
--select * into SalesHistory_Thailand  from (
select company,trantype,Invoice,Invoice_Date,
sum(DeliveryQty) DeliveryQty,sum(Sales_amount) Sales_amount,
dpst,dpstname,areacode,areaname,custcode,custname,Item,Item_desc,productgrp,Fin_year,Fin_month,null as Month_Name

and a.Organ='COSEA'
group by company,trantype,Invoice,Invoice_Date,
dpst,dpstname,areacode,areaname,custcode,custname,Item,Item_desc,productgrp,Fin_year,Fin_month

order by invoice_date


Insert into SalesHistory_Thailand
select Company,TranType,InvoiceNum,Date as Invoice_Date,

Dpst,null as dpstname,Area,null as AreaName,CustCode,null as CustName,ItemCode,

from TmpSlsDespData_baan where Area='623'
and date>='2013-04-01'
and SaleType in (0)

and SalesHistory_Thailand.dpstname is null

update SalesHistory_Thailand set areaname=a.AreaName
from vw_AREA_MASTER a
where SalesHistory_Thailand.areacode=a.areacode
and SalesHistory_Thailand.areaname is null


update SalesHistory_Thailand set custname=a.custname1
from vw_Business_Partner a
where SalesHistory_Thailand.custcode=substring(ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode)),4,20)
and SalesHistory_Thailand.custname is null


update SalesHistory_Thailand set Item_desc=a.DSCA
from TTCIBD001490 a
where SalesHistory_Thailand.company=490
and ltrim(rtrim(SalesHistory_Thailand.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))
and SalesHistory_Thailand.Item_desc is null


update SalesHistory_Thailand set Item_desc=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001400 a
where SalesHistory_Thailand.company in (400,401,440)
and ltrim(rtrim(SalesHistory_Thailand.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))
and SalesHistory_Thailand.Item_desc is null


--update SalesHistory_Thailand set productgrp=a.ProductGrp
--from (select * from vw_salesmapping_master where organ not in ('India','Subsidiary')) a
--where SalesHistory_Thailand.dpst=a.DPSTCode
--and SalesHistory_Thailand.areacode=a.Areacode
--and SalesHistory_Thailand.productgrp is null

from (select distinct ItemCode,Category,ProductLine from Bud_sales_Inflow_COSEA)a
where ltrim(rtrim(SalesHistory_Thailand.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))

and productgrp is null




--Alter table SalesHistory_Thailand alter column Month_Name varchar(20)

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_SalesTrend]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_SalesTrend
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_SalesTrend] as

begin

Truncate table SalesTrend

Insert into SalesTrend(Organ,Vertical,Invoice_Date,VerticalOrdr,
--Budget
this_month_sales,last_year_this_month_sales)
select 'India' as Organ, c.Description as Vertical,Invoice_Date,
null as VerticalOrdr,

SUM(CASE WHEN month(a.invoice_date) =month(getdate()-1) 
and year(a.invoice_date) =year(getdate()-1)
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS this_month_sales,  

sum(case when a.invoice_date between
convert(date,dateadd(yy,-1,DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()-1), 0)))
and
CONVERT(date,dateadd(yy,-1,DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(DATEADD(mm,1,getdate()-1))),DATEADD(mm,1,getdate()-1))))
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_sales

FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
left JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
ON b.AreaCode = a.areacode
left JOIN vw_DPST_MASTER c 
ON c.DpstCode = a.Dpst  

WHERE	ltrim(rtrim(c.Description))
IN ('Compressor-RLY','After Sales', 'Compressor-WW','Compressor-C&M', 'Compressor-Channel', 'Compressor-Direct')
AND (a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2017' AND GETDATE()) 
AND a.SaleOrderType in 
(
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)

GROUP BY c.Description,Invoice_Date


Insert into SalesTrend(Vertical,Invoice_Date,budget)
select b.Description,
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,date))) as Date1,  
--dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,date)) as Date2,
sum(Target)/1000000 as Budget
FROM DPSTwise_Budget a
--(select dpst,date,sum(target)*1000000 target from sales_budget
--group by dpst,date) a
INNER JOIN vw_DPST_MASTER b 
ON b.DpstCode = a.Dpst
WHERE ltrim(rtrim(b.Description)) 
IN ('Compressor-RLY','After Sales', 'Compressor-WW','Compressor-C&M', 'Compressor-Channel', 'Compressor-Direct')
and dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,date)))=
--'2017-06-30'
CONVERT(date,dateadd(yy,-1,DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(DATEADD(mm,1,getdate()-1))),DATEADD(mm,1,getdate()-1))))
group by date,Description



update SalesTrend set organ=a.Organ
from 
(select distinct organ,Vertical from SalesTrend where organ is not null)a
where SalesTrend.Vertical=a.Vertical
and SalesTrend.organ is null


update SalesTrend set VerticalOrdr=1 where Vertical='Compressor-Channel'
update SalesTrend set VerticalOrdr=2 where Vertical='Compressor-Direct'
update SalesTrend set VerticalOrdr=3 where Vertical='Compressor-RLY'
update SalesTrend set VerticalOrdr=4 where Vertical='Compressor-WW'
update SalesTrend set VerticalOrdr=5 where Vertical='Compressor-C&M'
update SalesTrend set VerticalOrdr=6 where Vertical='After Sales'


end

select * from SalesTrend where budget is not null

--Alter table SalesTrend alter column Organ varchar(50) null

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_sms4md]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_sms4md]
as
begin

truncate table sms4md
insert into sms4md

select organ,sum(isnull(Mbud,0))as Mbud,sum(isnull(Msal,0))as Msal,sum(isnull(Ybud,0))as Ybud,sum(isnull(Ysal,0))as Ysal,sum(isnull(LMSal,0))as LMSal,sum(isnull(LYSal,0))as LYSal
   from (
select ltrim(rtrim(isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ))) as organ,
this_month_budget as Mbud,this_month_sale as Msal,ytd_budget as Ybud ,this_year_sale as Ysal,last_month_sale as LMSal,last_year_sale as LYSal From (select * from vw_bud_Global WHERE GLOBAL='International')bud
full JOIN 
(SELECT * fROM vw_sls_Global WHERE GLOBAL='International')sls
ON  ltrim(rtrim(isnull(bud.Dpst,'0')))=ltrim(rtrim(isnull(sls.Dpstcode,'0')))
and ltrim(rtrim(isnull(bud.Area,'0')))=ltrim(rtrim(isnull(sls.Areacode,'0')))

union

select 'India'as organ,
this_month_budget as Mbud,this_month_sale as Msal,ytd_budget as Ybud ,this_year_sale as Ysal,last_month_sale as LMSal,last_year_sale as LYSal from vw_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise bud
full join vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise sls
on ltrim(rtrim(isnull(bud.Dpst,'0')))=ltrim(rtrim(isnull(sls.Dpstcode,'0')))
)a
where organ in ('SAAME','ID','India','COSEA')
group by organ 
order by organ 
end



GO

GO
-- exec sp_sms4md_china_osea
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_sms4md_china_osea]
as 
begin

truncate table sms4md_china_osea
insert into sms4md_china_osea
select 
CASE WHEN Division ='CHINA' THEN 'CHINA'
ELSE 'OSEA' END AS Division,
sum(mbud)mbud,sum(msal)msal,sum(ybud)ybud,sum(ysal)ysal,sum(lmsal)lmsal,sum(lysal)lysal from 
 (
	select ltrim(rtrim(isnull(b.division,a.Division))) as Division ,Mbud,Msal,Ybud,Ysal,LMSal,LYSal  from (
	(select Dpstcode ,Areacode ,organ,division,this_month_sale as Msal,this_year_sale as Ysal,last_month_sale as LMSal,last_year_sale as LYSal  from vw_sls_Global
	 where global ='International' and organ='COSEA'
	)a
	full join (select dpst,area,organ,Division,this_month_budget as Mbud,ytd_budget as Ybud from  vw_bud_Global where global ='International'  and organ='COSEA')b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpstcode ))=ltrim(rtrim(b.dpst))
and ltrim(rtrim(A.areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.area))
)
)
a
group by CASE WHEN Division ='CHINA' THEN 'CHINA'
ELSE 'OSEA' END 
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_Stock_ForeFigures]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_Stock_ForeFigures
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Stock_ForeFigures] as

begin

Truncate Table Stock_ForeFigures

Insert into Stock_ForeFigures
--select * into Stock_ForeFigures from (
select coalesce(a.COMPANY,b.company,c.company) as Company,
coalesce(a.CWAR,b.T$cwar,c.T$cwar) as CWAR,
coalesce(a.ITEM,b.T$item,c.T$item) as ITEM,
row_number() over (partition by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM order by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM) as rnk1,
a.QHND,
b.Pur_month,b.Pur_year,
row_number() over (partition by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM,b.Pur_year,b.Pur_month 
--b.COMPANY,b.T$CWAR,b.T$ITEM,b.Pur_month,b.Pur_year 
order by  a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM,b.Pur_year,b.Pur_month 
--b.COMPANY,b.T$CWAR,b.T$ITEM,b.Pur_month,b.Pur_year
) as rnk2,
b.QSKT ToBe_ConsQty,b.QSTK as RecvdQty,
c.Issue_month,c.Issue_year,
row_number() over (partition by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM,c.Issue_year,c.Issue_month
--c.COMPANY,c.T$CWAR,c.T$ITEM,c.Issue_month,c.Issue_year 
order by a.COMPANY,a.CWAR,a.ITEM,c.Issue_year,c.Issue_month
--c.COMPANY,c.T$CWAR,c.T$ITEM,c.Issue_month,c.Issue_year
) as rnk3,
c.QSTK as IssueQty
from 
(select COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM,sum(QHND) QHND 
from TWHWMD215ALL
group by COMPANY,CWAR,ITEM
having sum(QHND)>0
)a
full outer join
(--Purchase Items
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,month(T$TRDT) as Pur_month,year(T$TRDT) as Pur_year,
sum(T$QSTK) QSTK,
sum(T$QSKT) QSKT 
from TWHINA112ALL
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,month(T$TRDT),year(T$TRDT)
having sum(T$QSKT)>0
)b
on a.COMPANY=b.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(a.CWAR))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$CWAR))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(b.T$ITEM))

full outer join 
(--Production and Sales Issue Items
select COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,month(T$TRDT) as Issue_month,year(T$TRDT) as Issue_year,
sum(T$QSTK) QSTK
from TWHINA114ALL
group by COMPANY,T$CWAR,T$ITEM,month(T$TRDT),year(T$TRDT)
having sum(T$QSTK)>0
)c
on a.COMPANY=c.COMPANY
and ltrim(rtrim(a.CWAR))=ltrim(rtrim(c.T$CWAR))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(c.T$ITEM))
--and b.Pur_month=c.Issue_month
--and b.Pur_year=c.Issue_year

--where a.company=400	
--and ltrim(rtrim(a.CWAR))='005'
--and ltrim(rtrim(a.ITEM))='000900009'
--order by a.COMPANY,CWAR,item,Pur_year,Pur_month,Issue_year,Issue_month

--)a

update Stock_ForeFigures set QHND=null where rnk1>1
update Stock_ForeFigures set ToBe_ConsQty=null,RecvdQty=null where rnk2>1
update Stock_ForeFigures set IssueQty=null where rnk3>1

end


select * from Stock_ForeFigures
order by company,CWAR,ITEM,Pur_year,Pur_month,Issue_year,Issue_month

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_stock_min_max]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--select * From stock_min_max
--exec sp_stock_min_max
---------Tables are loaded in purchase data load
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_stock_min_max]
as
begin

truncate table stock_min_max
insert into stock_min_max 

SELECT ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM)) AS Item,b.DSCA as Item_desc,t$cwar as Warehouse,t$mioq as Minqty,t$maoq as Maxqty,
'' as stock_onhand,''as stock_act,''as pending_order_stock from 
  (select * fROM TWHWMD210951 where t$cwar in (102,202))a
LEFT JOIN TTCIBD001951 B
ON ltrim(rtrim(A.T$ITEM)) =ltrim(rtrim(B.ITEM)) 


update stock_min_max set stock_act =b.qhnd from
(select company,CWAR ,ITEM ,((sum(QHND))-(sum(QLAL)+sum(QBLK)))as qhnd
from TWHWMD215ALL 
where Company=951
and CWAR  in ('102','202')
group by company,CWAR,item
) b
where ltrim(rtrim(stock_min_max.item))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM)) 
and stock_min_max.Warehouse=b.CWAR


update stock_min_max set stock_onhand=b.qhnd from 
(select company,CWAR,ITEM,sum(QHND)qhnd
from TWHWMD215all
where Company=951
and CWAR in ('102','202')
group by company,CWAR,ITEM
) b
where ltrim(rtrim(stock_min_max.item))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEM)) 
and stock_min_max.Warehouse=b.CWAR

update stock_min_max set pending_order_stock=b.pnd_qty  from 
(
select ITEMCODE,sum((ord_qty-Cancel_Qty)-DelQty)AS pnd_qty From Pending_Orders 
where CustCode='CU1I00910'
AND Company IN (490)
and ((ord_qty-Cancel_Qty)-DelQty)>0
--and  ltrim(rtrim(itemcode))='00041503A'
group by ItemCode 

)b
where ltrim(rtrim(stock_min_max.item))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ITEMCODE)) 
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_stock_out]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_stock_out

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_stock_out] as

begin

--drop table TwoBin_Stock_Out
Truncate table TwoBin_Stock_Out


Insert  into TwoBin_Stock_Out

--select * into TwoBin_Stock_Out from(

select company,ITEM,Trig_Dt,
case datepart(dw,Exp_DT1)
when 7 then convert(date,2+Exp_DT1)
when 1 then convert(date,1+Exp_DT1)
else convert(date,Exp_DT1)
end as Exp_DT2,
DUDT,RPLT,SUPP,DIVI,BUYR,QTY,ID,SUPERMARKET,DEPARTMENT,DEPT,
group_leader,NAMA,Description,empname,Stock_DT,LOT_NO

from (  

select *,dateadd(dd,3,Exp_DT) as Exp_DT1 
from (

select *,
(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where 
date between Trig_Dt and Exp_DT and
datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7)
and DFCA='4') as No_of_nat_holidays
from(


SELECT b.company,f.ITEM, 
CONVERT(date, f.DATE) AS Trig_Dt, 
--CONVERT(char, CONVERT(datetime, DATEADD(day,convert(int,b.RPLT), f.DATE)), 103) AS Exp_DT, 
convert(datetime,
DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE) +
(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE)) - 2 +convert(int,b.RPLT)) %5 +
((DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE))-2+convert(int,b.RPLT))/5)*7-
(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE))-2)
) AS Exp_DT,
f.DUDT,
b.RPLT, 
f.SUNO as SUPP, 
b.DIVI, 
b.BUYR, 
f.RQTY as QTY, 
a.Dept_code as ID, 
a.Dept_Name as SUPERMARKET, 
d.DIVISION_NAME as DEPARTMENT, 
b.DEPT,
' ' as group_leader, 
h.custname1 as NAMA, 
null as Description,  
c.emp_name as empname, 
CONVERT(char, GETDATE() - 1, 103) AS Stock_DT, 
f.LOTN as LOT_NO,b.SOPS


FROM Materials_Dept_MASTER a 
RIGHT OUTER JOIN (select * from TZZPUR049ALL where 
company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ELGI')
and BITM<>1
) b  
ON a.Dept_code = b.DEPT
LEFT OUTER JOIN  Employee_Details c 
ON b.BUYR =  convert(varchar,c.new_emp_code)
LEFT OUTER JOIN  Materials_Division_MASTER d 
ON b.DIVI = d.DIVISION_CODE  
RIGHT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT ITEM, DIVI,DEPT FROM TZZPUR014ALL
WHERE STAT = 'M'
and company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ELGI')
GROUP BY ITEM, DIVI, DEPT
--HAVING (COUNT(ITEM) > 1)
) e
INNER JOIN 
(select * from TZZPUR014ALL where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ELGI')) f
ON e.DIVI = f.DIVI 
AND e.DEPT = f.DEPT 
AND e.ITEM = f.ITEM 

ON LTRIM(RTRIM(b.ITEM)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(f.ITEM)) 
AND b.DIVI = f.DIVI 
AND b.DEPT = f.DEPT 

LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_Business_Partner h 
ON f.SUNO = h.custcode

WHERE 
f.STAT = 'm'
and b.SOPS=1
--and (ComItemData.company = 101) 

GROUP BY b.company,f.ITEM, f.DATE,f.DUDT, f.SUNO, b.DIVI, b.BUYR, f.RQTY,a.Dept_code, 
a.Dept_Name, d.DIVISION_NAME, b.DEPT,h.custname1, c.new_emp_code,  
c.emp_name, b.RPLT,f.LOTN,b.SOPS

)a)b)c




--)a


--alter table TwoBin_Stock_Out alter column Description varchar(100)


update TwoBin_Stock_Out set Description=a.t_dsca
from TTCIBD001400 a
where ltrim(rtrim(TwoBin_Stock_Out.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(a.t_item))
and TwoBin_Stock_Out.company not in (465,470,490)

update TwoBin_Stock_Out set Description=a.dsca
from ttcibd001470 a
where ltrim(rtrim(TwoBin_Stock_Out.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and TwoBin_Stock_Out.company  in (470)


update TwoBin_Stock_Out set Description=a.dsca
from TTCIBD001490 a
where ltrim(rtrim(TwoBin_Stock_Out.ITEM))=ltrim(rtrim(a.item))
and TwoBin_Stock_Out.company  in (490)

delete from TwoBin_Stock_Out where
concat(DIVI,DEPT,ltrim(rtrim(Item))) not in 
(select concat(DIVI,DEPT,Item) from 
(select DIVI,DEPT,ltrim(rtrim(ITEM)) Item ,count(LOT_NO) lot_cnt from TwoBin_Stock_Out
group by DIVI,DEPT,ITEM
having count(LOT_NO)=2
)a)



end

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--exec sp_Stock_Out_ATS

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Stock_Out_ATS]
as
begin

Truncate table TwoBin_Stock_Out_ATS
Truncate table RPLDATA_ATS_Milkrun 
Truncate table Milkrun_Stock_Out_ATS

--Alter table TwoBin_Stock_Out_ATS alter column Stock_DT date


---TWOBIN STOCK OUT
insert into TwoBin_Stock_Out_ATS 

select ITEM,Trig_Dt,
case datepart(dw,Exp_DT1)
when 7 then convert(date,dateadd(dd,2,Exp_DT1))
when 1 then convert(date,dateadd(dd,1,Exp_DT1))
else convert(date,Exp_DT1)
end as Exp_DT2,
RPLT,SUPP,DIVI,BUYR,QTY,ID,SUPERMARKET,DEPARTMENT,DEPT,
group_leader,NAMA,Description,empname,Stock_DT,LOT_NO,COMPANY

from (  

select *,dateadd(dd,No_of_nat_holidays,Exp_DT) as Exp_DT1 
from (

select *,
(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where 
date between Trig_Dt and Exp_DT and
datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7)
and DFCA='4') as No_of_nat_holidays
from(

SELECT f.ITEM, 
CONVERT(date, f.DATE) AS Trig_Dt, 
--CONVERT(char, CONVERT(datetime, DATEADD(day,convert(int,b.RPLT), f.DATE)), 103) AS Exp_DT, 
convert(date,
DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE) +
(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE)) - 2 +convert(int,b.RPLT)) %5 +
((DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE))-2+convert(int,b.RPLT))/5)*7-
(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE))-2)
) AS Exp_DT,
b.RPLT, 
f.SUNO as SUPP, 
b.DIVI, 
b.BUYR, 
f.RQTY as QTY, 
a.Dept_code as ID, 
a.Dept_Name as SUPERMARKET, 
d.DIVISION_NAME as DEPARTMENT, 
b.DEPT,
' ' as group_leader, 
h.custname1 as NAMA, 
g.t_dsca as Description,  
c.emp_name as empname, 
GETDATE() - 1 AS Stock_DT, 
f.LOTN as LOT_NO,
b.company

FROM Materials_Dept_MASTER a 
RIGHT OUTER JOIN (select * from TZZPUR049ALL where 
company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and BITM<>1
) b  
ON a.Dept_code = b.DEPT
LEFT OUTER JOIN  Employee_Details c 
ON b.BUYR =  c.new_emp_code 
LEFT OUTER JOIN  Materials_Division_MASTER d 
ON b.DIVI = d.DIVISION_CODE  
RIGHT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT ITEM, DIVI,DEPT FROM TZZPUR014ALL
WHERE STAT = 'M'
and company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
GROUP BY ITEM, DIVI, DEPT
HAVING (COUNT(ITEM) > 1)
) e
INNER JOIN (select * from TZZPUR014ALL where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) f
ON e.DIVI = f.DIVI 
AND e.DEPT = f.DEPT 
AND e.ITEM = f.ITEM 

LEFT OUTER JOIN TTCIBD001600 g 
ON f.ITEM = g.t_item 
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(b.ITEM)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(f.ITEM)) 
AND b.DIVI = f.DIVI 
AND b.DEPT = f.DEPT 

LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_Business_Partner h 
ON f.SUNO = h.custcode

WHERE 
(f.STAT = 'm')
and b.SOPS=1
--and (ComItemData.company = 101) 

GROUP BY f.ITEM, f.DATE, f.SUNO, b.DIVI, b.BUYR, f.RQTY,a.Dept_code, 
a.Dept_Name, d.DIVISION_NAME, b.DEPT,h.custname1, g.t_dsca, c.new_emp_code,  
c.emp_name, b.RPLT,f.LOTN,b.company
)a)b)c

------------------------
--MILKRUN STOCK OUT

insert into RPLDATA_ATS_Milkrun 
select a.* from 
(select * from TZZPUR014ALL where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a 
inner join (select * from TZZPUR049ALL 
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and BITM<>1
) b
on a.DIVI = b.DIVI and a.DEPT = b.DEPT and a.ITEM = b.ITEM and b.SOPS = 3 



insert into Milkrun_Stock_Out_ATS

SELECT f.ITEM, 
CONVERT(char, CONVERT(datetime, f.DATE), 103) AS Trig_Dt, 
--CONVERT(char, CONVERT(datetime, DATEADD(day, convert(int,b.RPLT), f.DATE)), 103) AS Exp_DT, 
convert(char,convert(datetime,
DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE) +
(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE)) - 2 +convert(int,b.RPLT)) %5 +
((DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE))-2+convert(int,b.RPLT))/5)*7-
(DATEPART(dw,DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,f.DATE) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,f.DATE))-2)
,103),103) AS Exp_DT,
b.RPLT, 
f.SUNO as SUPP,
b.DIVI, 
b.BUYR, 
f.RQTY as QTY, 
a.Dept_code as ID, 
a.Dept_Name as SUPERMARKET, 
d.DIVISION_NAME as DEPARTMENT, 
b.DEPT,
' ' as group_leader, 
h.custname1 as  NAMA, 
g.t_dsca as  Description,  
c.emp_name as  empname, 
CONVERT(char, GETDATE() - 1, 103) AS Stock_DT, 
f.LOTN as LOT_NO,
b.company,
e.status,
e.itemcount,
b.SLOQ

FROM MATERIALS_DEPT_MASTER a 
RIGHT OUTER JOIN (select * from TZZPUR049ALL where 
company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and BITM<>1
) b  
ON a.Dept_code = b.DEPT
LEFT OUTER JOIN  Employee_Details c 
ON b.BUYR =  c.new_emp_code 
LEFT OUTER JOIN  Materials_Division_MASTER d 
ON b.DIVI = d.DIVISION_CODE  
RIGHT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT COUNT(ITEM) as itemcount,
case when COUNT(ITEM) > 1 then 'M' else 'S' end  as status,  
ITEM, DIVI, DEPT 
FROM RPLDATA_ATS_Milkrun
WHERE (STAT = 'M') 
GROUP BY ITEM, DIVI, DEPT
HAVING (COUNT(ITEM) >= 1)
) AS e 
INNER JOIN RPLDATA_ATS_Milkrun f 
ON e.DIVI = f.DIVI
AND e.DEPT = f.DEPT 
AND e.ITEM = f.ITEM 

LEFT OUTER JOIN TTCIBD001600 g 
ON f.ITEM = g.t_item 
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(b.ITEM)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(f.ITEM)) 
AND b.DIVI = f.DIVI
AND b.DEPT = f.DEPT 

LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_Business_Partner h 
ON f.suno = h.custcode

WHERE (f.STAT = 'm') 
--and (ComItemData.company = 101)  
--and derivedtbl_1.itemcount >= lean_master_ats.SLOQ

GROUP BY f.ITEM, f.DATE, f.suno, b.DEPT, b.BUYR, 
f.RQTY,a.Dept_code, a.Dept_Name, d.DIVISION_NAME, b.DIVI,h.custname1, g.t_dsca, c.new_emp_code, 
c.emp_name, b.RPLT,f.LOTN,b.company,e.status,e.itemcount,b.SLOQ




end

CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_UTN]
as 
begin
truncate table UTN_NEW
truncate table UTN
truncate table utn_bckup


alter table UTN alter column Release_Date datetime
alter table UTN alter column delivery_date datetime
alter table UTN alter column Completed_Date datetime
alter table UTN alter column Order_Date datetime
alter table UTN alter column Target_Date datetime
alter table UTN alter column Ordqty float
alter table UTN alter column delqty float
alter table UTN alter column poqty float


alter table UTN alter column Item_Desc varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column Custcode varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column Custname varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column area varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column areaname varchar(100)

alter table UTN alter column region varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column OtaCountry varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column  Planning_model varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column  Division varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column  TPL_CLASS varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column  TPL_SUBCLASS varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column  s varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column  Allocation varchar(100)

alter table UTN alter column score varchar(100)
alter table UTN alter column final_score varchar(100)



insert into UTN_NEW 

SELECT * fROM (
-- drop table UTN
--select * into UTN  from(
select 
A.T$ORNO AS SaleOrderno,A.T$PONO AS PONO,A.T$PUTN as UTN,A.T$ITEM AS Item,T$CWAR as Warehouse,a.T$OQUA as Ordqty_old,1 as Ordqty,a.T$DDAT as Cust_Date,a.T$CLDT as Clearence_Date, 
CASE WHEN a.T$MAKE=1 THEN 'ELGI' ELSE 'SIEMENS'END as M,
case when a.T$CLER=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Cler,
case when a.T$ALLO=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Allocation,
case when a.T$INVO=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Invoiced,
case when a.T$PACK=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Packed,
case when a.T$DELI=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Delivered,
case when a.t$schd=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Schedule,


b.T$PDNO as Production_ord_no,b.T$PDAT as Prod_Gen_Date,
0 as POQty,'' as S,'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' as delivery_date,'' as Release_Date,'' as Completed_Date,
null as Planning_model,
null as Order_Date,'' as item_Desc,''custcode,'' as CustName,0 as Delqty,'' as Area,'' as Areaname,null as Region,null as OtaCountry,
null as Division,null as TPL_CLASS,null AS TPL_SUBCLASS,'' AS Score,'' as Final_Score,'' AS OTA_Finalscore,
0 as TargetLeadTime,0 as OTP , '        ' as Target_date_old
 
	 From (select * From  TZZSFC254401 where T$ALLO =1) A
LEFT JOIN (select * from  TZZSFC289401)B
	on a.T$PUTN=b.T$PUTN 
and a.T$PONO =b.T$PONO
and a.T$ORNO =b.T$ORNO 
--and ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.T$ITEM))  
--)a
)a
where Clearence_Date >='2017-08-01'
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM)) NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(T$ITEM)) ITEM fROM TZZSFC227401)
--and concat(saleorderno,pono) in (select distinct concat(OrderNum,PositionNum )  From sales_lines where company=401)


update UTN_NEW set poqty=a.Poqty,s=a.OSTA,delivery_date=RDLD,Completed_Date=CMDT   from(select PDNO,sum(isnull(QRDR,0))as Poqty,
case when OSTA=1 then 'Planned' when OSTA=2 then 'Scheduled' when OSTA=3 then 'Documents Printed'when OSTA=4 then 'Released'when OSTA=6 then 'Active'
when OSTA=7 then 'TO be Completed'when OSTA=8 then 'Completed'when OSTA=9 then 'Closed'when 
OSTA=OSTA then 'Archived' end as OSTA
,RDLD,CMDT From TTISFC001ALL where COMPANY =401 group by pdno,OSTA,RDLD,CMDT)a
where ltrim(rtrim(UTN_NEW.Production_ord_no))=ltrim(rtrim(a.PDNO))  


update UTN_NEW set Release_Date=a.t$date from (select distinct t$pdno,min(t$date)t$date,t$osta From TICST151401 where t$osta=4 group by T$PDNO,T$OSTA)a where UTN_NEW.Production_ord_no=a.t$pdno

UPDATE UTN_NEW SET Planning_model=a.T$FGTM  
from(select distinct T$ITEM,
case when T$FGTM=1 then 'Stock' 
when T$FGTM=2 then  'AO'
when T$FGTM=3 then 'Forecast' 
when T$FGTM=4 then 'Subsidiaries' 
when T$FGTM=5 then 'Manual' 
when T$FGTM=6 then 'AO1' ELSE '' end as T$FGTM
  from TZZSFC211401)a
where ltrim(rtrim(UTN_NEW.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))


update UTN_NEW SET Order_Date =B.OrderDate,CustCode =B.CustCode--,OrdQty =B.OrdQty   
FROM(
select distinct OrderNum,PositionNum ,ItemCode,CustCode,OrderDate,sum(t_qoor)as OrdQty      From Sales_Lines where company=401 
group by OrderNum,PositionNum ,ItemCode,CustCode,OrderDate)b
WHERE ltrim(rtrim(UTN_NEW.SaleOrderno)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.OrderNum))
and ltrim(rtrim(UTN_NEW.Pono))=ltrim(rtrim(b.PositionNum ))

UPDATE UTN_NEW SET item_Desc=a.Item_desc
from (select distinct  Item,Item_desc   From vw_Item_Master where company =400)a
where ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(UTN_NEW.item))

UPDATE UTN_NEW  SET custname=a.custname1 
from (select distinct custcode,custname1 From vw_Business_Partner)a
where ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(UTN_NEW .custcode))

--UPDATE UTN  SET Area =a.area 
--from(select distinct OrderNum,Area  from Sales_Header where COMPANY =401)a
--where UTN.SaleOrderno =a.OrderNum 

UPDATE UTN_NEW  SET Area =a.area
from(select distinct ordernum,area  from sales_header  where COMPANY =401)a
where UTN_NEW.SaleOrderno =a.ordernum  

UPDATE UTN_NEW SET AreaName  =a.areaname 
from(select distinct Areacode,AreaName from vw_AREA_MASTER)a
where UTN_NEW.Area =a.Areacode

UPDATE UTN_NEW set Delqty=isnull(a.DelQty,0) 
from(select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,sum(QIDL) as DelQty from  sales_delivery where QIDL>0 and company=401 group by COMPANY,ORNO,PONO)a
where UTN_NEW.saleorderno=a.ORNO 
and UTN_NEW.PONO =a.PONO 
  
update UTN_NEW set region=a.region,otacountry=a.otacountry
from (select right(concat(0,areacode),3)as area,region,otacountry  From utn_region_master where areacode is not null)a
where UTN_NEW.area=a.area  

update UTN_NEW set Division=a.Divn,TPL_CLASS=PM_TPLs_classR18,TPL_SUBCLASS=PM_TPLs_subclassR18
from (select DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM))AS ITEM,Divn,PM_TPLs_classR18,PM_TPLs_subclassR18  From UTN_TPL_MASTER)a
where LTRIM(RTRIM(UTN_NEW.Item)) =A.ITEM 


update UTN_NEW set TargetLeadTime=a.[LT-OTA],OTP=A.[LT-OTP]  from (select model,[LT-OTA],[LT-OTP] From UTN_OTA_MASTER)a
where UTN_NEW.tpl_subclass=a.Model 

update UTN_NEW set Target_date_old=DATEADD(dd,TargetLeadTime,Clearence_Date) 

--update UTN_NEW set s=stat from(select case when s=1 then 'Planned' when s=2 then 'Scheduled' when s=3 then 'Documents Printed'when s=4 then 'Released'when s=6 then 'Active'when s=7 then 'TO be Completed'when s=8 then 'Completed'when s=9 then 'Closed'
--when s=10 then 'Archived' end as stat from UTN_NEW)a 


------------------------------

INSERT INTO UTN
select * , 
(select count(distinct DATE) from CompanyCalendar where 
(convert(date,date) between convert(date,Targetdate_otp) and (dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,case when ( delivery_date='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' or delivery_date='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000')then getdate()
 else delivery_date end)))and CCAL ='company' and DFCA<>4))AS OTP_GAPDAYS
	
	,0 as score_0,0 as score_100,0 as score_blank,
 0 as Finalscore_0,0 as Finalscore_100,0 as Finalscore_blank,
	0 as final_score_max_blank,0 as final_score_max_0,0 as final_score_max_100
 
	from(

select *,dateadd(dd,case when TargetLeadTime=0 then 0 else (TargetLeadTime-workdays) end,Target_date_old)as Target_date From (
select *,(select count(distinct DATE) from CompanyCalendar where 
(convert(date,date) between convert(date,Clearence_Date) and convert(date,dateadd(dd,TargetLeadTime,Clearence_Date))
 and CCAL ='company' and DFCA<>4))as workdays,
	(select count(distinct DATE) from CompanyCalendar where 
(convert(date,date) between convert(date,Clearence_Date) and (dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,case when (Completed_Date='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' or Completed_Date='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000')then getdate()
 else completed_date end)))and CCAL ='company' and DFCA<>4)) as LeadtimeOTA,'                     ' as Remarks,
	(select count(distinct DATE) from CompanyCalendar where 
(convert(date,date) between convert(date,Clearence_Date) and (dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,case when (Prod_Gen_Date ='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' or Prod_Gen_Date='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000')then getdate()
 else Prod_Gen_Date end)))and CCAL ='company' and DFCA<>4))AS OTG_GAPDAYS,
	dateadd(dd,otp,Clearence_Date)as Targetdate_otp From UTN_NEW)a
	)a

	---------------------------------
	update utn set Remarks='Po Deleted' where utn.Production_ord_no in(
		select distinct Production_ord_no  From utn where UTN<>'' and Production_ord_no is not null and Production_ord_no <>''
		and Production_ord_no not in (select distinct PDNO  From TTISFC001ALL ))
	
	-- select Clearence_Date,Prod_Gen_Date,otg_gapdays fROM utn
		

update UTN set leadtimeota=0 where ltrim(rtrim(utn.Production_ord_no))=''
update UTN set leadtimeota=0 where utn.Production_ord_no is null

--------------- calulating score

update UTN set score='Blank' where Ordqty <1  
update UTN set score='Blank' where Ordqty is null 
update UTN set score='Blank' where custcode is null 
update UTN set score='Blank' where custcode='' 
update UTN set score='Blank' where (convert(Date,Target_Date)>=convert(date,getdate())) and (Completed_Date='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' or Completed_Date='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000')


update UTN set score=100 where remarks='po deleted' and score<>'Blank'
update UTN set score=100 where (Production_ord_no ='' or Production_ord_no is null) and Delqty>0 and score<>'Blank'
update UTN set score=100 where LeadtimeOTA<=TargetLeadTime and score<>'Blank'

update UTN set score=0 where score<>100 and score<>'Blank' 
------------------- score completed

update UTN set score_Blank=1 where Ordqty <1  
update UTN set score_Blank=1 where Ordqty is null 
update UTN set score_Blank=1 where custcode is null 
update UTN set score_Blank=1 where custcode='' 
update UTN set score_Blank=1 where (convert(Date,Target_Date)>convert(date,getdate())) and (Completed_Date='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' or Completed_Date='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000')


update UTN set score_100=1 where remarks='po deleted' and score_blank <>1
update UTN set score_100=1 where (Production_ord_no ='' or Production_ord_no is null) and Delqty>0 and score_blank <>1
update UTN set score_100=1 where LeadtimeOTA<=TargetLeadTime and score_blank <>1

-- update UTN set score_0=1 where (score_100<>1 and score_blank<>1) and(LeadtimeOTA>TargetLeadTime)   
update UTN set score_0=1 where score_100<>1 and score_blank<>1


update UTN set final_score=score where score<>'0'
update UTN set final_score=0 where Score='0'
update UTN set final_score=100 where OTP_GAPDAYS>2 and OTG_GAPDAYS <2 and score='0'

update UTN set finalscore_blank=1 where score_blank=1
update UTN set finalscore_100=1 where score_100=1

update UTN set finalscore_100=1 where score='0' and (OTP_GAPDAYS>2 and OTG_GAPDAYS <2)

update UTN set finalscore_0=1 where score_0=1 and finalscore_100<>1 and finalscore_blank<>1

update UTN set final_score_max_blank=1 where finalscore_blank=1
update UTN set final_score_max_100=1 where Finalscore_100 =1
update UTN set final_score_max_100=1 where OTP_GAPDAYS>2 and OTG_GAPDAYS <2 and score='0'


update UTN set final_score_max_0=1 where Finalscore_100 =1

b.T$PDNO as Production_ord_no,b.T$PDAT as Prod_Gen_Date,
null as POQty,null as S,
'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' as delivery_date,'1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' as Release_Date,

	0 as final_score_max_blank,0 as final_score_max_0,0 as final_score_max_100,

	0 as Clearence_Date_NH,null as H_allocation,null as Fabno,null as H_alloc_Qty,
	null as TARGET_OTA_NH,null as TARGET_OTG_NH,null as TARGET_OTP_NH,null as TARGET_OTR_NH,null as TARGET_OTC_NH,
		0 as OTA_NH2,0 as OTG_NH2,0 as OTP_NH2,0 as OTR_NH2,0 as OTC_NH2,

		null as TARGET_OTA_NH1,null as TARGET_OTG_NH1,null as TARGET_OTP_NH1,null as TARGET_OTR_NH1,null as TARGET_OTC_NH1,
		0 as OTA_NH3,0 as OTG_NH3,0 as OTP_NH3,0 as OTR_NH3,0 as OTC_NH3,

		null as Clearence_Date_chk, 0 as Clearence_Date_NH1
				
		From (select * From  TZZSFC254401 where T$CLER=1) A ----- earlier t$allo=1 but Sep182018 on wards T$CLER=1 (kavitha confirmation)
LEFT JOIN (select * from  TZZSFC289401)B
	on a.T$PUTN=b.T$PUTN 
and a.T$PONO =b.T$PONO
and a.T$ORNO =b.T$ORNO 
--and ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.T$ITEM))  
--)a where 1=2
)a 
where Clearence_Date >='2017-08-01'
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM)) NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(T$ITEM)) ITEM fROM TZZSFC227401) ---- eliminating borewell items
and LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEM))NOT IN ('S06041','S06042','S06012') ---- eliminating borewell items
--and concat(saleorderno,pono) in (select distinct concat(OrderNum,PositionNum )  From sales_lines where company=401)

----------- CALCULATING CLEARENCE DATE 

update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date = case when Schedule='Yes' then dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Cust_Date,-10) else Clearence_Date end

update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date_chk=Clearence_Date

update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date_NH=case when Schedule='Yes' then (select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4' and date between utn_ver1.Clearence_Date and utn_ver1.Cust_Date ) else 0 end

update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date = case when Schedule='Yes' then dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Clearence_Date,-Clearence_Date_NH) else Clearence_Date end

update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date=case when datepart(dw,Clearence_Date) in (1,7) then dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Clearence_Date,1) else Clearence_Date end


----------- END


update UTN_VER1 set h_allocation=a.Halloc,H_alloc_Qty=a.h_Qty  from(select distinct t$putn,t$orno,t$pono,sum(T$HQUA) as h_Qty,case when T$HALL=1 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Halloc  From TZZSFC261401 group by t$putn,t$orno,t$pono,T$HALL)a
where UTN_VER1.UTN =a.T$PUTN 
and utn_ver1.SaleOrderno =a.T$ORNO
and utn_ver1.PONO =a.T$PONO 


update UTN_VER1 set poqty=a.Poqty,s=a.OSTA,delivery_date=RDLD,Completed_Date=CMDT  
 from(select PDNO,sum(isnull(QRDR,0))as Poqty,	
case when OSTA=1 then 'Planned' when OSTA=2 then 'Scheduled' when OSTA=3 then 'Documents Printed'when OSTA=4 then 'Released'when OSTA=6 then 'Active'
when OSTA=7 then 'TO be Completed'when OSTA=8 then 'Completed'when OSTA=9 then 'Closed'when 
OSTA=10 then 'Archived' end as OSTA
,RDLD,CMDT From TTISFC001401 where COMPANY =401 group by pdno,OSTA,RDLD,CMDT)a
where ltrim(rtrim(UTN_VER1.Production_ord_no))=ltrim(rtrim(a.PDNO))  


update UTN_VER1 set Release_Date=a.t$date from (select distinct t$pdno,min(t$date)t$date,t$osta From TICST151401 where t$osta=4 group by 
T$PDNO,T$OSTA)a where UTN_VER1.Production_ord_no=a.t$pdno

--UPDATE UTN_VER1 SET Planning_model=a.T$FGTM  
--from(select distinct T$ITEM,
--case when T$FGTM=1 then 'Stock' 
--when T$FGTM=2 then  'AO'
--when T$FGTM=3 then 'Forecast' 
--when T$FGTM=4 then 'Subsidiaries' 
--when T$FGTM=5 then 'Manual' 
--when T$FGTM=6 then 'AO1' ELSE '' end as T$FGTM
--  from TZZSFC211401)a
--where ltrim(rtrim(UTN_VER1.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(a.T$ITEM))


update UTN_VER1 SET Order_Date =B.OrderDate,CustCode =B.CustCode--,OrdQty =B.OrdQty   
FROM(
select distinct OrderNum,PositionNum ,ItemCode,CustCode,OrderDate,sum(t_qoor)as OrdQty      From Sales_Lines where company=401 
group by OrderNum,PositionNum ,ItemCode,CustCode,OrderDate)b
WHERE ltrim(rtrim(UTN_VER1.SaleOrderno)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.OrderNum))
and ltrim(rtrim(UTN_VER1.Pono))=ltrim(rtrim(b.PositionNum ))

UPDATE UTN_VER1 SET item_Desc=a.Item_desc
from (select distinct  Item,Item_desc   From vw_Item_Master where company =400)a
where ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))=ltrim(rtrim(UTN_VER1.item))

UPDATE UTN_VER1  SET custname=a.custname1 
from (select distinct custcode,custname1 From vw_Business_Partner)a
where ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(UTN_VER1 .custcode))


UPDATE UTN_VER1  SET Area =a.area
from(select distinct ordernum,area  from sales_header  where COMPANY =401)a
where UTN_VER1.SaleOrderno =a.ordernum  

UPDATE UTN_VER1 SET AreaName  =a.areaname 
from(select distinct Areacode,AreaName from vw_AREA_MASTER)a
where UTN_VER1.Area =a.Areacode

UPDATE UTN_VER1 set Delqty=isnull(a.DelQty,0) 
from(select COMPANY,ORNO,PONO,sum(QIDL) as DelQty from  sales_delivery where QIDL>0 and company=401 group by COMPANY,ORNO,PONO)a
where UTN_VER1.saleorderno=a.ORNO 
and UTN_VER1.PONO =a.PONO 

UPDATE utn_region_master SET Areacode =right(concat(0,ISNULL(areacode,0)),3)

update UTN_VER1 set region=a.region,otacountry=a.otacountry
from (select RIGHT(CONCAT('0',Areacode),3)AS Areacode  ,region,otacountry  From utn_region_master where areacode is not null)a
where UTN_VER1.area=a.Areacode

update UTN_VER1 set Division=a.Division,TPL_CLASS=DEMCLASS ,TPL_SUBCLASS=DEMSUBCLASS ,product_line=a.PRODUCTLINE ,SUB_DIV=SUBDIVISION 
from (select DISTINCT LTRIM(RTRIM(ITEMCODE))AS ITEM,DIVISION,DEMCLASS,DEMSUBCLASS ,PRODUCTLINE ,SUBDIVISION,YEAR,MONTH  From OTA_TPL_MASTER)a
where LTRIM(RTRIM(UTN_VER1.Item)) =A.ITEM 
AND YEAR(UTN_VER1.Clearence_Date)=A.Year 
AND  MONTH(UTN_VER1.Clearence_Date)=A.Month  

update UTN_VER1 set Target_OTA_LT=a.Target_OTA_LT,LT_OTG=a.LT_OTG,LT_OTP=a.LT_OTP,LT_OTR=a.LT_OTR,LT_OTC=a.LT_OTC
from (select * From UTN_MODEL_MASTER)a
where LTRIM(RTRIM(UTN_VER1.TPL_CLASS))=LTRIM(RTRIM(a.Model))
AND  LTRIM(RTRIM(UTN_VER1.Division))=LTRIM(RTRIM(a.TYPE))

update UTN_VER1 set Target_OTA_LT=Target_OTA_LT+2 where Region <>'India' and TPL_CLASS<>'AO1'

update UTN_VER1 set Target_OTA_LT=a.Target_OTA_LT,LT_OTG=a.LT_OTG,LT_OTP=a.LT_OTP,LT_OTR=a.LT_OTR,LT_OTC=4--a.LT_OTC
from (select * From UTN_MODEL_MASTER WHERE MODEL ='Forecast')a
where LTRIM(RTRIM(UTN_VER1.TPL_CLASS)) IS NULL


update utn_ver1 set Cust_Date=case when year(cust_date)<2000 or cust_date is null then '1900-01-01'  else Cust_Date end 
update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date=case when year(Clearence_Date)<2000 or Clearence_Date is null then '1900-01-01' else Clearence_Date end
update utn_ver1 set Prod_Gen_Date=case when year(Prod_Gen_Date)<2000 or Prod_Gen_Date is null  then '1900-01-01' else Prod_Gen_Date end 
update utn_ver1 set delivery_date=case when year(delivery_date)<2000 or delivery_date is null then '1900-01-01' else delivery_date end
update utn_ver1 set Release_Date=case when year(Release_Date)<2000 or Release_Date is null then '1900-01-01' else Release_Date end
update utn_ver1 set Completed_Date=case when year(Completed_Date)<2000 or Completed_Date is null then '1900-01-01' else Completed_Date end
update utn_ver1 set Order_Date=case when year(Order_Date)<2000 or Order_Date is null then '1900-01-01' else Order_Date end
update utn_ver1 set Clearence_Date_orijinal=case when year(Clearence_Date_orijinal)<2000 or Clearence_Date_orijinal is null then '1900-01-01' else Clearence_Date_orijinal end


update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTA_ISS =DATEADD(dd,Target_OTA_LT,Clearence_Date) 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTG_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTG,Clearence_Date) 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTP_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTP,Clearence_Date) 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTR_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTR,delivery_date) 

update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTC,Release_Date) WHERE UTN_VER1.Division='SEPSAC' 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTC,Release_Date) WHERE UTN_VER1.Division='LEPSAC' 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTC,Release_Date) WHERE UTN_VER1.Division='DPSAC' 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC_ISS =DATEADD(dd,LT_OTC,Release_Date) WHERE UTN_VER1.Division='RCD' 

--------- maximum case utn is available clearence date shoudn't blank

update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTA =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Clearence_Date,Target_OTA_LT)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTG =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Clearence_Date,LT_OTG)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTP =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Clearence_Date,LT_OTP)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTR =
case when convert(date,delivery_date)='1900-01-01'then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(delivery_date,LT_OTR) end
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC =
case when convert(date,Release_Date)='1900-01-01'then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(Release_Date,LT_OTC) end

--else (select 
--DATEADD(d,CASE DATEPART(dw,Clearence_Date) WHEN 7 THEN 2 WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,Clearence_Date) +

-- Note: if when we ariving target date base data shoud be blank then target date also blank
-- target dates before find national holidays 
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTA_NH=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTA)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTG_NH=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTG)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTP_NH=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTP)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTR_NH=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTR)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC_NH=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTC)

------- finding national holidays
update utn_ver1 set OTA_NH=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between utn_ver1.Clearence_Date and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTA)

update utn_ver1 set OTG_NH=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between utn_ver1.Clearence_Date and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTG)

update utn_ver1 set OTP_NH=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between utn_ver1.Clearence_Date and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTP)

update utn_ver1 set OTR_NH=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between utn_ver1.delivery_date and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTR)

update utn_ver1 set OTC_NH=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between utn_ver1.Release_Date and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTC)
    
---------- FOR NATIONAL HOLIDAYS

update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTA =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTA,OTA_NH)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTG =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTG,OTG_NH)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTP =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTP,OTP_NH)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTR =
case when convert(date,TARGET_OTR)='1900-01-01' then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTR,OTR_NH) end
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC =
case when convert(date,TARGET_OTC)='1900-01-01'then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTC,OTC_NH) end

--------- 2ND TIME NATIONAL HOLIDAYS FINDING

update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTA_NH1=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTA)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTG_NH1=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTG)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTP_NH1=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTP)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTR_NH1=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTR)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC_NH1=CONVERT(DATE,TARGET_OTC)

update utn_ver1 set OTA_NH2=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTA_NH) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTA)

update utn_ver1 set OTG_NH2=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTG_NH) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTG)

update utn_ver1 set OTP_NH2=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTP_NH) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTP)

update utn_ver1 set OTR_NH2=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTR_NH) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTR)

update utn_ver1 set OTC_NH2=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTC_NH) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTC)


update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTA =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTA,OTA_NH2)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTG =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTG,OTG_NH2)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTP =dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTP,OTP_NH2)
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTR =
case when convert(date,TARGET_OTR)='1900-01-01' then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTR,OTR_NH2) end
update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC =
case when convert(date,TARGET_OTC)='1900-01-01'then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTC,OTC_NH2) end 

------------ end 2nd time

----------------- 3rd time 

update utn_ver1 set OTA_NH3=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTA_NH1) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTA)

update utn_ver1 set OTG_NH3=(select count(*) from CompanyCalendar where datepart(dw,date) not in(1,7) and DFCA='4'
and date between DATEADD(DAY,1,utn_ver1.TARGET_OTG_NH1) and utn_ver1.TARGET_OTG)

update UTN_VER1 set TARGET_OTC =
case when convert(date,TARGET_OTC)='1900-01-01'then '1900-01-01' else dbo.UFN_working_wkdays(TARGET_OTC,OTC_NH3) end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_variablecost_mainreport_Ln]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * From variablecost_mainreport_Ln
-- exec sp_variablecost_mainreport_Ln '2017'

CREATE  proc [dbo].[sp_variablecost_mainreport_Ln] @year varchar(12)
as 
begin

truncate table Variablecost_mainreport_Ln
--delete from variablecost_mainreport_Ln where years=(select year(getdate()-1))
insert into Variablecost_mainreport_Ln

select sum(budget )as budget,years ,functions ,Subcategory ,PARTICULARS,exp_ordering ,ytd_act,mon_act1
,mon_act2,mon_act3 ,mon_act4 ,mon_act5,mon_act6,mon_act7 ,mon_act8,mon_act9 ,mon_act10,mon_act11,mon_act12  
from (
select a.*,isnull(b.budget,0)as budget  From (
select 	years,functions,subcategory,particulars,exp_ordering,
sum(ytd_act)as ytd_act,
sum(mon_act1)as mon_act1,
sum(mon_act2 )as mon_act2,
sum(mon_act3 )as mon_act3,
sum(mon_act4)as mon_act4,
sum(mon_act5 )as mon_act5,
sum(mon_act6 )as mon_act6,
sum(mon_act7 )as mon_act7,
sum(mon_act8 )as mon_act8,
sum(mon_act9 )as mon_act9,
sum(mon_act10 )as mon_act10,
		sum(mon_act11 )as mon_act11,
		sum(mon_act12)as mon_act12,
		sum(lytd_act) as lytd_act
		 from (
			select 	t$cono,years,periods as month,functions,subcategory,particulars,exp_ordering,
				sum(case when years = @year then val else 0 end ) as ytd_act,
				sum(case when periods = 1 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act1,
				sum(case when periods = 2 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act2,
				sum(case when periods = 3 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act3,
				sum(case when periods = 4 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act4,
				sum(case when periods = 5 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act5,
				sum(case when periods = 6 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act6,
				sum(case when periods = 7 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act7,
				sum(case when periods = 8 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act8,
				sum(case when periods = 9 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act9,
				sum(case when periods = 10 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act10,
				sum(case when periods = 11 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act11,
				sum(case when periods = 12 and years = @year then val else 0 end) as mon_act12,
				sum(case when years = @year-1 then val else 0 end ) as lytd_act,
				--sum(case when periods = @prno and years = @year-1 then val else 0 end) as lytd_mon_act,
				0 as lytd_mon_act
			from (
				--Layer 4
				select 	a.*, case when periods < 10 then periods + 3 else periods - 9 end as periods1,
					case when periods < 10 then years else years + 1 end as year1
				from (
					--Layer 5   
					select 	t$cono,T$LEAC as leac,SUM(T$FDAH$1)-SUM(T$FCAH$1) as val,
					case when t$cono in (401)then 'Compressor Center'
						when t$cono in (450)then 'Air Centre'
						--when t$cono in (104)then 'MED'
						when t$cono in (470)then 'PVD'
						when t$cono in (490)then 'GSC'
						when t$cono in (411,412,413,414,415,416,417,418,419,420,421,422)then 'Branch'
						when t$cono in (440)then 'R&D '
						when t$cono in (400)then 'ME'
						end as functions,subcategory,particulars,ordering as exp_ordering
						,t$year as years,T$prno as periods
					
					from 	TTFGLD205ALL ttfgld205 (nolock)
						inner join (select * from elgi_exp_master where ordering < 4)elgi_exp_master 
						on ttfgld205.t$leac between elgi_exp_master.from_leac and elgi_exp_master.to_leac
						and t$year in ( @year) 
						and T$PRNO in(1,2,3,4,5,6) and T$PTYP=1
							GROUP BY t$cono,T$LEAC,
					--case when t$cono in (401)then 'Compressor Center'
					--	when t$cono in (450)then 'Air Centre'
					--	--when t$cono in (104)then 'MED'
					--	when t$cono in (470)then 'PVD'
					--	when t$cono in (490)then 'GSC'
					--	when t$cono in (411,412,413,414,415,416,417,418,419,420,421,422)then 'Branch'
					--	when t$cono in (440)then 'R&D '
					--	when t$cono in (400)then 'ME'
					--	end ,
					t$year,T$prno,subcategory,particulars,ordering
					HAVING SUM(T$FDAH$1)-SUM(T$FCAH$1) <> 0
					)a

				--where periods <=@prno
		where years=@year and t$cono not in (465) --and periods <= case when month(getdate()-1)>3 then month(getdate())-3 else month(getdate())+9 end
			           )a 
  				group by t$cono,years,periods,functions,subcategory,particulars,exp_ordering)a
						group by 	years,functions,subcategory,particulars,exp_ordering)a
						left outer join variable_budget b
						on a.PARTICULARS =b.particulars 
						and a.years =b.year 
						and a.functions =b.functions 
						)a
						group by years ,functions ,Subcategory ,PARTICULARS,exp_ordering ,ytd_act,mon_act1
,mon_act2,mon_act3 ,mon_act4 ,mon_act5,mon_act6,mon_act7 ,mon_act8,mon_act9 ,mon_act10,mon_act11,mon_act12  
--having a.Subcategory ='VARIABLE COSTS' and a.PARTICULARS  in (@particulars)
						--and a.functions  in (@function)and years in (@year)
					
											end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_variablecost_subreport_Ln]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_variablecost_subreport_Ln
--select * From variablecost_subreport_Ln
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_variablecost_subreport_Ln]
as
begin
truncate table variablecost_subreport_Ln

insert into variablecost_subreport_Ln 

select distinct company,t$Leac ,
case when t$dim2=' ' then '-' else t$Dim2 end as dim2_new,
case when t$Dim3=' 'then '-'else t$Dim3 end as dim3_new,year ,prno ,
case when t$Refr=' 'then '-'else t$Refr end as refr_new ,
''as item_new,
--case when t$item=' ' or t$item is null then '-' else t$item end as item_new,
case when T$BPID=' 'then '-'else T$BPID end as suno_new,new_amth,Particulars ,functions   from 
(select distinct *,T$FYER as year,T$FPRD as prno,
case when COMPANY in (401)then 'Compressor Center'
						when COMPANY in (450)then 'Air Centre'
						--when t$COMPANY in (104)then 'MED'
						when COMPANY in (470)then 'PVD'
						when COMPANY in (490)then 'GSC'
						when COMPANY in (411,412,413,414,415,416,417,418,419,420,421,422)then 'Branch'
						when COMPANY in (440)then 'R&D '
						when COMPANY in (400)then 'ME'
						end as functions
						From (
select  *,row_number()over(partition by ltrim(rtrim(company)),ltrim(rtrim(t$leac)),ltrim(rtrim(t$dim2)),ltrim(rtrim(t$dim3)),
ltrim(rtrim(t$Fyer)),ltrim(rtrim(t$dbcr)),ltrim(rtrim(t$fprd)),
--ltrim(rtrim(Refr)) ,ltrim(rtrim(item)),
ltrim(rtrim(T$AMTH$1)),ltrim(rtrim(T$BPID)) 
order by ltrim(rtrim(company)),ltrim(rtrim(t$leac)),ltrim(rtrim(t$dim2)),ltrim(rtrim(t$dim3)),ltrim(rtrim(t$Fyer)),ltrim(rtrim(t$dbcr)),
ltrim(rtrim(t$fprd)),
--ltrim(rtrim(Refr)) ,ltrim(rtrim(item)),
ltrim(rtrim(T$AMTH$1)),ltrim(rtrim(T$BPID)))as rownum
 ,case when T$DBCR =1
 then T$AMTH$1*1 else T$AMTH$1*-1 end new_amth,
 case when t$leac between 'EA0107001   'and 'EA0107999   ' then 'Machining Charges'
	 when t$leac between 'EC0301001   'and 'EC0399999   ' then 'Packing Charges' 
	 when t$leac between 'EC0101001   'and 'EC0199999   ' then 'Consumption of Stores'
	 end  as Particulars
		  From TTFGLD106ALL 
				where T$FYER =2017)a
		where particulars is not null
		and rownum =1)a
	end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_verticalwisesales_sms]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- exec sp_verticalwisesales_sms
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_verticalwisesales_sms]
as
begin
truncate table verticalwisesales_sms
insert into verticalwisesales_sms

select sdate,vertical_name,shortname,dval,mval,yval,ordr from (
select *,
case 
when Vertical_Name ='Compressor-Channel                 ' then 1
when Vertical_Name ='Compressor-Direct                  ' then 2
when Vertical_Name ='Compressor-RLY' then 3
when Vertical_Name ='Compressor-C&M' then 4
when Vertical_Name ='Compressor-WW' then 5
when Vertical_Name ='After Sales                        ' then 6
--when Vertical_Name ='Collections' then 7
end as ordr
 From (
select convert(date,getdate()-1) as sdate,description as Vertical_Name,
case 
when description='After Sales                        ' then 'AS'
when description='Compressor-Channel                 ' then 'Channel'
when description='Compressor-Direct                  ' then 'Direct'
when description='Compressor-RLY' then 'Rly'
when description='Compressor-C&M' then 'CnM'
when description='Compressor-WW' then 'WW'
else description
end as Shortname,
sum(ondate)Dval,
sum(mtd)Mval,
sum(ytd)Yval 
from (
select 
case 
when dpstname ='CONSTRUCTION (C)' or dpstname ='MINING (M)'then'Compressor-C&M'
WHEN dpstname ='WW'  or dpstname ='WW – OE'then 'Compressor-WW'
ELSE Description END AS Description
, dpstname,sum(ondate_sale) as ONDATE,SUM(this_month_sale)as MTD ,SUM(this_year_sale)AS YTD
from (
--select Dpstcode ,dpstname ,description,ondate_sale,this_month_sale,this_year_sale    From  vw_sls_Global
--where global ='International'
--union all
select Dpstcode ,dpstname ,description,ondate_sale,this_month_sale,this_year_sale    From  vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise 
)a
group by dpstname,description 
)a
group by Description 
)a
)a

insert into verticalwisesales_sms
select convert(date,getdate()-1),'Total','TOT', sum(dval),sum(mval),sum(yval),10 from verticalwisesales_sms
end

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[SP_WARRANTY_PPM_ln]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec SP_WARRANTY_PPM_ln
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SP_WARRANTY_PPM_ln]
AS 
BEGIN 
declare @dt datetime=getdate()
declare @month int = month(@dt-1)
declare @year int =year(@dt-1)
declare @x int=day(@dt)

if(@x =1)
begin

INSERT INTO WARRANTY_PPM_LN

select *,ccs_pg as product,DATEADD(mm,-1,DATEADD(mm,DATEDIFF(mm,0,GETDATE()),0))  as new_date  from (

SELECT SUM(DeliveryQty ) AS qty,CASE WHEN sptyp in (3,4 ) and dpst not IN ('90021','90221')  THEN 4   
        WHEN sptyp in (3,4 ) and dpst IN ('90021','90221') THEN 3   
        ELSE sptyp END AS sptyp,
								company,ltrim(rtrim(OrderNo))OrderNo,ltrim(rtrim(PositionNo))PositionNo,SequenceNum ,ltrim(rtrim(SaleOrderType))SaleOrderType ,Invoice_Date ,dpst, ltrim(rtrim(CustCode))CustCode ,ltrim(rtrim(a.item))item,DeliveryQty,ltrim(rtrim(TranType))TranType ,Invoice 
 FROM   
  ( SELECT  company,OrderNo,PositionNo ,0 as SequenceNum ,SaleOrderType  ,Invoice_Date,dpst, CustCode ,Item,DeliveryQty ,TranType ,Invoice 
    FROM (select * from elgi_sales_details where invoice_date>='2017-04-01'  )elgi_sales_detaills
    WHERE  MONTH(Invoice_Date)=@month AND YEAR(Invoice_Date)=@year 
				and 				SaleOrderType in (select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6))
								AND company IN (400,401)   
  )a  

INNER JOIN  
  (SELECT * FROM item_prodgrp_map WHERE sptyp IN (1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,12,13))b  
ON ltrim(rtrim(a.Item ))=ltrim(rtrim(b.item))  
GROUP BY sptyp,company,OrderNo ,PositionNo ,SequenceNum ,SaleOrderType ,Invoice_Date ,dpst, CustCode ,a.item,DeliveryQty ,TranType ,Invoice  
)a  
left OUTER JOIN  
LN_prodgrp_map  b  
ON sptyp=pgcode  
end
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_Warrenty_tracker]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--exec sp_Warrenty_tracker 
--  select * From Warrenty_tracker 
CREATE proc [dbo].[sp_Warrenty_tracker]
as
begin

truncate table Warrenty_tracker 
insert into Warrenty_tracker 
select * from (
select *,total_item_price+new_Mileage_Cost+new_Labour_cost+new_Misc_cost+new_Freight_cost as total,'' as Approve_id,'Pending' as Status
From (
select *,
case when rno >1 then 0 else Mileage_Cost  end as new_Mileage_Cost,
case when rno >1 then 0 else Labour_cost  end as new_Labour_cost,
case when rno >1 then 0 else Misc_cost  end as new_Misc_cost,
case when rno >1 then 0 else Qty  end as new_Qty,
case when rno >1 then 0 else Trips  end as new_Trips,
case when rno >1 then 0 else Freight_cost  end as new_Freight_cost
 From (
select distinct *,ROW_NUMBER()over(order by focno) rno  From (
select  convert(date,a.date_time) as Log_Date,a.ccstrackno,a.focno,a.fabno,a.pr_model as Model,a.cu_name as Custname,
Item_code as partcode,item_desc as Part_desc,item_req as Itemqty,Item_price,a.mileage_charge as Mileage_Cost,
a.service_charge as Labour_cost,a.miscell_charges as Misc_cost,a.qty_req as Qty,
a.no_trips as Trips,a.other_charges as Freight_cost,
item_req*Item_price as total_item_price
--,apprv_id,,case when a.focno in (select distinct focno  From active_foc_approvels WHERE apprv_id='11120')then 'Approved' else 'Pending'end as Status
From (select * From active_foc where dlr_name ='cu1e00847' and convert(date,date_time) between'2017-08-01'and '2017-08-31'-- and focno ='26519h059'
) a
--left join active_foc_approvels b
--on a.focno=b.focno
--and a.firno=b.firno
--and a.ccstrackno=b.trackno
inner join active_foc_parts c
on a.ccstrackno=c.ccstrackno
and a.firno=c.focno
)a
)a
)a
)a

update Warrenty_tracker set Approve_id=a.apprv_id 
from (
select focno,apprv_id,max(rnk_new)as cnt   From (select focno,apprv_id,case when apprv_id='11120'then 10 when apprv_id between 800000 and 899999 then 9 else rnk end as rnk_new From (
select distinct LTRIM(RTRIM(focno))focno,apprv_id ,ROW_NUMBER ()over(partition by focno order by focno,apprv_id)as rnk  From active_foc_approvels
where focno <>''
and focno is not null
and apprv_id <>''
and apprv_id is not null
)a
)a
group by focno,apprv_id 
)a
where ltrim(rtrim(Warrenty_tracker.focno))=ltrim(rtrim(a.focno))

update Warrenty_tracker set status='Approved' where Warrenty_tracker.Approve_id in ('11120')
update Warrenty_tracker set status='Approved' where Warrenty_tracker.Approve_id between 800000 and 899999

end

 From (

From (select * From active_foc where dlr_name ='cu1e00847' --and convert(date,date_time) between'2017-08-01'and '2017-08-31' --and focno ='26519h059'

on a.ccstrackno=c.ccstrackno
and a.firno=c.focno
)a
)a
)a
)a

update Warrenty_tracker_active set Approve_id=a.apprv_id

  From active_foc_approvels
where focno <>''
and focno is not null
and apprv_id not like '%[a-z]%'

--where focno ='26519H132'
group by focno,rnk_new,apprv_id  
)a
where ltrim(rtrim(Warrenty_tracker_active.focno))=ltrim(rtrim(a.focno))
and rowno=1


update Warrenty_tracker_active set status='Approved' where Warrenty_tracker_active.Approve_id in ('11120')
