/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--declare @CalMonth int=11
--declare @CalYear int=2017
--select * from ufn_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise(@CalMonth,@CalYear)
--go


CREATE function [dbo].[ufn_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise] (@CalMonth int,@CalYear int)

RETURNS @ufn_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise TABLE 
(
Description	varchar(50),
Dpst	varchar(10),
dpstname	varchar(100),
budget_year	float,
last_month_budget	float,
ytd_budget	float,
this_month_budget	float,
next_month_budget	float,
nextof_next_month_budget	float
)

AS

BEGIN


WITH CTE_bud_domestic_dpstwise
(
Description,Dpst,dpstname,budget_year,last_month_budget,ytd_budget,this_month_budget,next_month_budget,
nextof_next_month_budget
) -- CTE name and columns

AS (


select *  from (  
SELECT Description,Dpst,dpstname, 
SUM(budget_year)/1000000 AS budget_year, 
SUM(last_month_budget)/1000000 AS last_month_budget, 
SUM(ytd_budget)/1000000 AS ytd_budget,   
SUM(this_month_budget)/1000000 AS this_month_budget, 
SUM(next_month_budget)/1000000 AS next_month_budget, 
SUM(nextof_next_month_budget)/1000000 AS nextof_next_month_budget  
FROM (

SELECT     

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end ))) 
AND 
('03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear else @CalYear+1 end )))
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS budget_year,  

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 4 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end ))) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, RIGHT('00'+CAST(@CalMonth AS VARCHAR(2)),2) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)),101) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_budget,  

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end )) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1,RIGHT('00'+CAST(@CalMonth AS VARCHAR(2)),2) +'/'+convert(varchar,datepart(dd,getdate()))+'/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear) ),101) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS ytd_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date)= @CalMonth 
AND year(date) =@CalYear
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date)= case when @CalMonth=12 then 1 else @CalMonth+1 end AND 
year(date) = case when @CalMonth=12 then @CalYear+1 else @CalYear end
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS next_month_budget,     

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date) = case 
when @CalMonth=11 then 1  
when @CalMonth=12 then 2 else @CalMonth+2 end AND
year(date) = case 
when @CalMonth=11 then @CalYear+1
when @CalMonth=12 then @CalYear+1 else @CalYear end
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS nextof_next_month_budget,

b.Description,dpstname,a.Dpst

FROM DPSTwise_Budget a
 
INNER JOIN vw_DPST_MASTER b 
ON b.DpstCode = a.Dpst


WHERE (b.Description IN ('Compressor-RLY','After Sales', 
'Compressor-WW','Compressor-C&M', 'Compressor-Channel', 'Compressor-Direct')) 
GROUP BY b.Description,dpstname,Dpst

) AS budget  
GROUP BY Description,dpstname,Dpst
)a  
where budget_year <> 0 or ( (last_month_budget) > 0)


)



INSERT @ufn_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise

SELECT Description,Dpst,dpstname, budget_year,
last_month_budget,ytd_budget,this_month_budget,next_month_budget,
nextof_next_month_budget
FROM CTE_bud_domestic_dpstwise

RETURN

END;



GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_bud_global]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from ufn_bud_global(11,2017)
--declare @CalMonth int=11
--declare @CalYear int=2017
--select case 
--when @CalMonth=11 then 1  
--when @CalMonth=12 then 2 else @CalMonth+2 end
--select case when @CalMonth=12 then @CalYear+1 else @CalYear end

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_bud_global] (@CalMonth int,@CalYear int)

RETURNS @ufn_bud_global TABLE 

(
Global	varchar(20),
organ	varchar(20),
region	varchar(150),
Zone	varchar(100),
user_names	varchar(100),
Division	varchar(50),
Vertical1	varchar(100),
Area	nvarchar(255),
AreaName	varchar(50),
Dpst	varchar(50),
DPSTName	varchar(100),
--item_code varchar(50),
budget_year	float,
last_month_budget	float,
ytd_budget	float,
this_month_budget	float,
next_month_budget	float,
nextof_next_month_budget	float,
AprBud float,
MayBud float,
JunBud float,
JulBud float,
AugBud float,
SepBud float,
OctBud float,
NovBud float,
DecBud float,
JanBud float,
FebBud float,
MarBud float,	
AprBudLYr float,
MayBudLYr float,
JunBudLYr float,
JulBudLYr float,
AugBudLYr float,
SepBudLYr float,
OctBudLYr float,
NovBudLYr float,
DecBudLYr float,
JanBudLYr float,
FebBudLYr float,
MarBudLYr float	
)

AS

BEGIN

WITH CTE_bud_global
(
Global,organ,region,Zone,user_names,Division,Vertical1,Area,AreaName,Dpst,DPSTName,--item_code,
budget_year,
last_month_budget,ytd_budget,this_month_budget,next_month_budget,nextof_next_month_budget,
AprBud,MayBud,JunBud,JulBud,AugBud,SepBud,OctBud,NovBud,DecBud,JanBud,FebBud,MarBud,
AprBudLYr,MayBudLYr,JunBudLYr,JulBudLYr,AugBudLYr,SepBudLYr,OctBudLYr,NovBudLYr,DecBudLYr,JanBudLYr,FebBudLYr,MarBudLYr
) -- CTE name and columns

AS (


SELECT	Global,organ,region,Zone,user_names,Division,Vertical1,Area,AreaName,Dpst,DPSTName,
--ltrim(rtrim(item_code)) as item_code,
	SUM(budget_year) AS budget_year, 
	SUM(last_month_budget) AS last_month_budget, 
	SUM(ytd_budget) AS ytd_budget,     
	SUM(this_month_budget) AS this_month_budget, 
	SUM(next_month_budget) AS next_month_budget, 
	SUM(nextof_next_month_budget) AS nextof_next_month_budget,
	SUM(AprBud) as AprBud,
	SUM(MayBud) as MayBud,
 SUM(JunBud) as JunBud,
	SUM(JulBud) as JulBud,   
	SUM(AugBud) as AugBud,
	SUM(SepBud) as SepBud,
 SUM(OctBud) as OctBud,
	SUM(NovBud) as NovBud,
	SUM(DecBud) as DecBud,
	SUM(JanBud) as JanBud,
 SUM(FebBud) as FebBud,
	SUM(MarBud) as MarBud,

	SUM(AprBudLYr) as AprBudLYr,
	SUM(MayBudLYr) as MayBudLYr,
 SUM(JunBudLYr) as JunBudLYr,
	SUM(JulBudLYr) as JulBudLYr,   
	SUM(AugBudLYr) as AugBudLYr,
	SUM(SepBudLYr) as SepBudLYr,
 SUM(OctBudLYr) as OctBudLYr,
	SUM(NovBudLYr) as NovBudLYr,
	SUM(DecBudLYr) as DecBudLYr,
	SUM(JanBudLYr) as JanBudLYr,
 SUM(FebBudLYr) as FebBudLYr,
	SUM(MarBudLYr) as MarBudLYr



FROM (

SELECT	ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)) Global,
--case when ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ)))='ISAAME' then 'SAAME' else ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ))) end as organ,
case when ltrim(rtrim(c.organ))='ISAAME' then 'SAAME' else ltrim(rtrim(c.organ)) end as organ,
ltrim(rtrim(c.region)) region,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)) Zone,
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)) user_names,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)) as Division,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)) as Vertical1,
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)) areaname,c.DPSTCode as dpst,c.DPSTName,
--a.item_code,

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end ))) 
AND 
('03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear else @CalYear+1 end )))
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS budget_year,  

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 4 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end ))) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, RIGHT('00'+CAST(@CalMonth AS VARCHAR(2)),2) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)),101) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_budget,  

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end )) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1,RIGHT('00'+CAST(@CalMonth AS VARCHAR(2)),2) +'/'+convert(varchar,datepart(dd,getdate()))+'/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear) ),101) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS ytd_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date)= @CalMonth 
AND year(date) =@CalYear
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date)= case when @CalMonth=12 then 1 else @CalMonth+1 end AND 
year(date) = case when @CalMonth=12 then @CalYear+1 else @CalYear end
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS next_month_budget,     

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date) = case 
when @CalMonth=11 then 1  
when @CalMonth=12 then 2 else @CalMonth+2 end AND
year(date) = case 
when @CalMonth=11 then @CalYear+1
when @CalMonth=12 then @CalYear+1 else @CalYear end
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS nextof_next_month_budget,



sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =4 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as AprBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =5 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as MayBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =6 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as JunBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =7 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as JulBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =8 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as AugBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =9 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as SepBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =10 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as OctBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =11 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as NovBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =12 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as DecBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)+1 and month(date) =1 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as JanBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)+1 and month(date) =2 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as FebBud,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)+1 and month(date) =3 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as MarBud,

sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =4 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as AprBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =5 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as MayBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =6 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as JunBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =7 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as JulBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =8 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as AugBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =9 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as SepBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =10 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as OctBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =11 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as NovBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(date) =12 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as DecBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =1 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as JanBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =2 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as FebBudLYr,
sum(case when year(date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(date) =3 THEN [target] ELSE 0 END) as MarBudLYr

FROM	Sales_Budget a
--Itemwise_Budget a
	INNER JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.Area))
	INNER JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode))    
		and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

GROUP BY ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)),--ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ))),
ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)),ltrim(rtrim(c.region)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)),
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)),
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)),c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName
--,a.item_code
) AS budget    

GROUP BY Global,organ,region,Zone,user_names,Division,Vertical1,Area,AreaName,Dpst,DPSTName
--,item_code
--HAVING      (SUM(budget_year) > 0) or (SUM(last_month_budget) > 0)


)

INSERT @ufn_bud_global

SELECT 
Global,organ,region,Zone,user_names,Division,Vertical1,Area,AreaName,Dpst,DPSTName,--item_code,
budget_year,
last_month_budget,ytd_budget,this_month_budget,next_month_budget,nextof_next_month_budget,
AprBud,MayBud,JunBud,JulBud,AugBud,SepBud,OctBud,NovBud,DecBud,JanBud,FebBud,MarBud,
AprBudLYr,MayBudLYr,JunBudLYr,JulBudLYr,AugBudLYr,SepBudLYr,OctBudLYr,NovBudLYr,DecBudLYr,JanBudLYr,FebBudLYr,MarBudLYr
FROM CTE_bud_global

RETURN

END;

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_sls_domestic_dpstwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--declare @CalMonth int=4
--Declare @CalYear int=2018
--select convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1)),
--dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/'+  CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))))
--CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()-1))+'/'+  CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1)


CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sls_domestic_dpstwise] (@CalMonth int,@CalYear int)

RETURNS @ufn_sls_domestic_dpstwise TABLE 

(
Description	varchar(50),
DPSTcode	varchar(20),
dpstname	varchar(100),
ondate_sale	float,
last_year_sale	float,
last_year_ytd	float,
this_year_sale	float,
last_month_sale	float,
this_month_sale	float,
thr_month_sale	float,
n1_month_sale	float,
n2_month_sale	float,
n3_month_sale	float,
last_year_this_month_sale	float
)

AS

BEGIN

WITH CTE_sls_domestic_dpstwise
(Description	,DPSTcode	,dpstname	,ondate_sale	,last_year_sale	,last_year_ytd	,this_year_sale	,last_month_sale	,
this_month_sale	,thr_month_sale	,n1_month_sale	,n2_month_sale	,n3_month_sale	,last_year_this_month_sale) -- CTE name and columns

AS (
SELECT	c.Description, c.DPSTcode,c.dpstname,

sum(CASE WHEN day(a.invoice_date)=day(getdate()-1)and month(a.invoice_date)=@CalMonth
and year(a.invoice_date)=@CalYear THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS ondate_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 2 else @CalYear-1 end )) 
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale, 


SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
convert(date,'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 2 else @CalYear-1 end )) )
AND 
convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()-1))+'/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_ytd, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
convert(date,'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end )))
AND 
convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()-1))+'/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_year_sale,   

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN month(a.Invoice_Date) =@CalMonth
and year(a.Invoice_Date) =@CalYear
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,

--SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
--CONVERT(varchar,@CalMonth)  + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear)
--AND 
--dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)))
--THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS thr_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) +'/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) +'/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_sale,

--SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
--CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1)
--AND 
--CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()-1))+'/'+  CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1)
--THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_this_month_sale

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/'+  CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_this_month_sale

FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
left JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
ON b.AreaCode = a.areacode
left JOIN vw_DPST_MASTER c 
ON c.DpstCode = a.Dpst  

WHERE	(c.Description IN ('Compressor-RLY','After Sales', 'Compressor-WW','Compressor-C&M', 'Compressor-Channel', 'Compressor-Direct')) 
AND (a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2015' AND GETDATE()) 
AND a.SaleOrderType in 
(
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)

GROUP BY c.Description,c.DPSTName,c.DPSTcode

)



INSERT @ufn_sls_domestic_dpstwise

SELECT Description	,DPSTcode	,dpstname	,ondate_sale	,last_year_sale	,last_year_ytd	,this_year_sale	,last_month_sale	,this_month_sale	,
thr_month_sale	,n1_month_sale	,n2_month_sale	,n3_month_sale	,last_year_this_month_sale
FROM CTE_sls_domestic_dpstwise

RETURN

END;




GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_sls_global]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select distinct FinYear,FinMonthnum from ELGi_Sales_Flash_data order by FinYear desc ,FinMonthnum desc


--select * from ELGi_Sales_Flash_data a
--where a.FinMonthnum=10--@FinMonthnum
--and a.FinYear=2017--@FinYear
--and organ='India'
--and user_names='After Sales                        '



--declare @CalMonth int =8
--declare @CalYear int=2017
--select * from ufn_sls_global(@CalMonth,@CalYear)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_sls_global] (@CalMonth int,@CalYear int)



RETURNS @ufn_sls_global TABLE 



(
global	varchar(20),
organ	varchar(50),
region	varchar(150),
Zone	varchar(100),
user_names	varchar(100),
Division	varchar(50),
Vertical1	varchar(100),
Areacode	varchar(5),
AreaName	varchar(50),
Dpstcode	varchar(20),
dpstname	varchar(100),
Item nvarchar(50),
Item_desc nvarchar(30),
description	varchar(50),
ondate_sale	float,
last_year_sale	float,
last_year_ytd	float,
this_year_sale	float,
last_month_sale	float,
last_year_this_month_sale	float,
this_month_sale	float,
thr_month_sale	float,
n1_month_sale	float,
n2_month_sale	float,
n3_month_sale	float,
AprSales float,
MaySales float,
JunSales float,
JulSales float,
AugSales float,
SepSales float,
OctSales float,
NovSales float,
DecSales float,
JanSales float,
FebSales float,
MarSales float,
AprSalesLYr float,
MaySalesLYr float,
JunSalesLYr float,
JulSalesLYr float,
AugSalesLYr float,
SepSalesLYr float,
OctSalesLYr float,
NovSalesLYr float,
DecSalesLYr float,
JanSalesLYr float,
FebSalesLYr float,
MarSalesLYr float
)

AS

BEGIN

WITH CTE_sls_global
(global,organ	,region	,Zone,user_names	,Division	,Vertical1	,Areacode	,AreaName	,Dpstcode	,dpstname	,
description	,Item,Item_desc,ondate_sale	,last_year_sale	,last_year_ytd	,this_year_sale	,last_month_sale	,last_year_this_month_sale	,
this_month_sale	,thr_month_sale	,n1_month_sale	,n2_month_sale	,n3_month_sale,
AprSales,MaySales,JunSales,JulSales,AugSales,SepSales,OctSales,NovSales,DecSales,JanSales,FebSales,MarSales,
AprSalesLYr,MaySalesLYr,JunSalesLYr,JulSalesLYr,AugSalesLYr,SepSalesLYr,OctSalesLYr,NovSalesLYr,DecSalesLYr,JanSalesLYr,FebSalesLYr,MarSalesLYr

) -- CTE name and columns

AS (
SELECT b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.Zone,c.user_names,c.Division as Division,c.Vertical1,
b.Areacode,b.AreaName, d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.description,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) as Item,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item_desc)) as Item_desc,

sum(CASE WHEN day(a.invoice_date)=day(getdate()-1)and month(a.invoice_date)=@CalMonth
and year(a.invoice_date)=@CalYear THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS ondate_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 2 else @CalYear-1 end )) 
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
convert(date,'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 2 else @CalYear-1 end )))
AND 
convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()-1))+'/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_ytd, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when @CalMonth between 1 and 3 then @CalYear - 1 else @CalYear end )) 
AND 
CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()))+'/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_year_sale,   

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_sale,

--SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
--CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1)
--AND 
--CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/'+convert(varchar,day(getdate()-1))+'/'+  CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1)
--THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_this_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,convert(date,CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/'+  CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear-1))))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_this_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN month(a.Invoice_Date) =@CalMonth
and year(a.Invoice_Date) =@CalYear
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,

--SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
--CONVERT(varchar,@CalMonth)  + '/1/' + CONVERT(varchar,@CalYear)
--AND 
--dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)))
--THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear)) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS thr_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) +'/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) + '/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, @CalMonth) +'/1/' + convert(varchar,@CalYear))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_sale,


sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =4 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as AprSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =5 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as MaySales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =6 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as JunSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =7 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as JulSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =8 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as AugSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =9 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as SepSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =10 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as OctSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =11 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as NovSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =12 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as DecSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)+1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =1 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as JanSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)+1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =2 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as FebSales,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)+1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =3 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as MarSales,

sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =4 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as AprSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =5 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as MaySalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then 
@CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =6 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as JunSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =7 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as JulSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =8 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as AugSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =9 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as SepSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =10 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as OctSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =11 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as NovSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end)-1 and month(a.Invoice_Date) =12 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as DecSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =1 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as JanSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =2 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as FebSalesLYr,
sum(case when year(a.Invoice_Date) =(case when @CalMonth<4 then @CalYear-1 else @CalYear end) and month(a.Invoice_Date) =3 THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) as MarSalesLYr

FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
	left outer JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.areacode))
	left outer JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
	ON 	ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode)) 
	AND ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))
	left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER d
	on ltrim(rtrim(d.DpstCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))


WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 

AND a.SaleOrderType in (
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 
GROUP BY b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.Zone, c.user_names,c.Division,c.Vertical1,
b.Areacode,b.AreaName,d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.Description,a.Item,a.Item_desc


)



INSERT @ufn_sls_global

SELECT 
global,organ	,region	,Zone,user_names	,Division	,Vertical1	,Areacode	,AreaName	,Dpstcode	,dpstname	,
description	,Item,Item_desc,
ondate_sale	,last_year_sale	,last_year_ytd	,this_year_sale	,last_month_sale	,last_year_this_month_sale	,
this_month_sale	,thr_month_sale	,n1_month_sale	,n2_month_sale	,n3_month_sale,
AprSales,MaySales,JunSales,JulSales,AugSales,SepSales,OctSales,NovSales,DecSales,JanSales,FebSales,MarSales,
AprSalesLYr,MaySalesLYr,JunSalesLYr,JulSalesLYr,AugSalesLYr,SepSalesLYr,OctSalesLYr,NovSalesLYr,DecSalesLYr,JanSalesLYr,FebSalesLYr,MarSalesLYr
FROM CTE_sls_global

RETURN

END;

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_Split]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_Split] (@String varchar(8000), @Delimiter char(1))       
   returns @temptable TABLE (items varchar(8000))       
   as       
   begin       
       declare @idx int       
       declare @slice varchar(8000)       
         
       select @idx = 1       
           if len(@String)<1 or @String is null  return       
         
       while @idx!= 0       
       begin       
           set @idx = charindex(@Delimiter,@String)       
           if @idx!=0       
               set @slice = left(@String,@idx - 1)       
           else       
               set @slice = @String       
             
           if(len(@slice)>0)  
               insert into @temptable(Items) values(@slice)       
     
          set @String = right(@String,len(@String) - @idx)       
         if len(@String) = 0 break       
       end   
   return       
   end


GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_SplitFieldByDelimiter]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_SplitFieldByDelimiter] 
(
    @fieldname varchar(max)
    ,@delimiter varchar(max)
    ,@delimiter_count int
)
RETURNS varchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
 
    declare @first_index varchar(max)
    ,@next_index varchar(max)
    ,@sql_statement varchar(max)
    ,@term_statement varchar(max)
    ,@length varchar(max)
    ,@iterator int

 
    set @next_index=-1
    set @iterator=1
    set @sql_statement=' '

 
    while(@iterator<=@delimiter_count)
    begin
        set @first_index=@next_index+'+1'
        set @next_index='CHARINDEX('+@delimiter+','+@fieldname+','+@first_index+')'
        if (@iterator=@delimiter_count)
        begin
        set @next_index='LEN('+@fieldname+')+1'
        end
        set @length=@next_index+'-('+@first_index+')'
        set @term_statement='SubString('+@fieldname+','+@first_index+','+@length+')'
        set @term_statement='case when '+@next_index+'>0 then '+@term_statement+' else "nothing" end as Column'+CONVERT(varchar(max),@iterator) 
        if (@iterator=1) 
        begin
            set @sql_statement=@term_statement
        end
        else
        begin
            set @sql_statement=@sql_statement+', '+@term_statement
        end

        set @iterator=@iterator+1
    end


    
    RETURN @sql_statement

END


GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ufn_SplitString]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ufn_SplitString]
( 
    @string NVARCHAR(MAX), 
    @delimiter CHAR(1) 
) 
RETURNS @output TABLE(id int,splitdata NVARCHAR(MAX) ) 
BEGIN 
    DECLARE @start INT, @end INT 
    SELECT @start = 1, @end = CHARINDEX(@delimiter, @string) 
    WHILE @start < LEN(@string) + 1 BEGIN 
        IF @end = 0  
            SET @end = LEN(@string) + 1
       
        INSERT INTO @output (id,splitdata)  
        VALUES(1, SUBSTRING(@string, @start, @end - @start)) 
        SET @start = @end + 1 
        SET @end = CHARINDEX(@delimiter, @string, @start)
        
    END 
    RETURN 
END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[UFN_WEEKEND_DAYS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
create function [dbo].[UFN_WEEKEND_DAYS](@fromdate as DATE,@todate as DATE)
returns INT
as
begin
declare @cnt int
set @cnt =0

while(@fromdate<=@todate)
begin
if(datepart(DW,@fromdate)=1 or datepart(DW,@fromdate)=7)
begin
set @cnt=@cnt+1
end
set @fromdate=dateadd(dd,1,@fromdate)
end
return @cnt 
END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[UFN_working_wkdays]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:46 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE function [dbo].[UFN_working_wkdays](@addDate as datetime,@numdays as int)
returns datetime
as
begin

if @numdays>0
while @numdays>0
begin

set @addDate =dateadd(d,1,@adddate)
if datename(dw,@addDate)='saturday' and convert(date,@addDate)<>'2019-01-19'  set @addDate =dateadd(d,1,@adddate)
if datename(dw,@addDate)='sunday' set @addDate =dateadd(d,1,@adddate)
set @numdays=@numdays-1 

end 
else if @numdays <0
while @numdays <0
begin

set @addDate =dateadd(d,-1,@adddate)
if datename(dw,@addDate)='saturday' set @addDate =dateadd(d,-1,@adddate)
if datename(dw,@addDate)='sunday' set @addDate =dateadd(d,-2,@adddate)
set @numdays=@numdays+1 

end
return cast (@adddate as datetime)
end

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ACR_Report]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ACR_Report] as     
select *,case when delays between 0 and 30 then balance else 0 end del_00_30,        
case when delays between 31 and 40 then balance else 0 end del_31_40,        
case when delays between 41 and 45 then balance else 0 end del_41_45,        
case when delays between 46 and 50 then balance else 0 end del_46_50,        
case when delays between 51 and 90 then balance else 0 end del_51_90,        
case when delays between 91 and 999 then balance else 0 end del_91_999,        
case when delays > 999 then balance else 0 end del_gt_999,        
case when delays between 31 and 60 then balance else 0 end del_31_60,        
case when delays between 61 and 90 then balance else 0 end del_61_90,        
case when delays between 91 and 120 then balance else 0 end del_91_120,        
case when delays between 121 and 180 then balance else 0 end del_121_180,        
case when delays > 180 then balance else 0 end del_gt_180 from      
(select a.*,cust.t_nama custname1,a.Area as custarea,vw_Area_Master.areaname,vw_Area_Master.region,
b.areaname as custareaname,b.Region as custregion,
case 
when organ is null and a.company in (150,401) then 'ISAAME' 
when organ is null and a.company in (180,403) then 'AMEROPA' 
when organ is null and a.company in (170,402) then 'COSEA' else organ end as organ,
invamntininvcur as inv_value ,
(recamntinvcur+curdiffamnt) as coll_value,
balamntinvcur as balance,
datediff(dd,docdt,getdate()) as delays,
balamnthomecur as balancehmcur 
from ACR a      
inner join (select Company,t_idoc as invnum,t_tran ttyp from tcisli310all)Ttesls598baan 
on ttyp=trantyp and invno=invnum      
inner join TTCCOM100400 cust      
on t_bpid=custno      
inner join vw_Area_Master      
on a.area=areacode       
left outer join      
(select distinct areacode,organ from vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER where organ is not null ) map      
on a.area=map.areacode     
inner join VW_AREA_MASTER b  
on a.area=b.areacode   
)a





GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_DPST_MASTER]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_DPST_MASTER]
AS 
SELECT * FROM DPST_Master_Domestic 
UNION  
SELECT * FROM DPST_Master_Global where DPSTcode not like 's%' and DPSTcode<>'999999' 
UNION  
SELECT * FROM DPST_Master_ATS





GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise] as   

select * from (  
SELECT Description,Dpst,dpstname, 
SUM(budget_year) AS budget_year, 
SUM(last_month_budget) AS last_month_budget, 
SUM(ytd_budget) AS ytd_budget,   
SUM(this_month_budget) AS this_month_budget, 
SUM(next_month_budget) AS next_month_budget, 
SUM(nextof_next_month_budget) AS nextof_next_month_budget  
FROM (

SELECT     

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))) 
AND 
('03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) else year(getdate()-1)+1 end )))
THEN (target) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS budget_year,   

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 4 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))),101) 
THEN (target) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_budget,   

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()) 
THEN (target) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS ytd_budget,   

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1,getdate())) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()),101) 
THEN (target) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date)= datepart(mm, dateadd(mm, 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) AND 
year(date) = datepart(yy, dateadd(mm, 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (target) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS next_month_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date) = datepart(mm, dateadd(mm, 2, dateadd(dd, - 1,getdate()))) AND 
year(date) = datepart(yy, dateadd(mm, 2, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (target) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS nextof_next_month_budget, 

b.Description,dpstname,a.Dpst

FROM DPSTwise_Budget a
 
INNER JOIN vw_DPST_MASTER b 
ON b.DpstCode = a.Dpst


WHERE ltrim(rtrim(b.Description)) 
IN ('Compressor-RLY','After Sales', 'Compressor-WW','Compressor-C&M', 'Compressor-Channel', 'Compressor-Direct')
GROUP BY b.Description,dpstname,Dpst

) AS budget  
GROUP BY Description,dpstname,Dpst
)a  
where budget_year <> 0 or ( (last_month_budget) > 0)

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bud_Global]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_bud_Global] as     

SELECT	Global,organ,region,Zone,user_names,Division,Vertical1,Area,AreaName,Dpst,DPSTName,
	SUM(budget_year) AS budget_year, 
	SUM(last_month_budget) AS last_month_budget, 
	SUM(ytd_budget) AS ytd_budget,     
	SUM(this_month_budget) AS this_month_budget, 
	SUM(next_month_budget) AS next_month_budget, 
	SUM(nextof_next_month_budget) AS nextof_next_month_budget    

FROM (

SELECT	ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)) Global,
case when ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ)))='ISAAME' then 'SAAME' else ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ))) end as organ,
ltrim(rtrim(c.region)) region,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)) Zone,
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)) user_names,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)) as Division,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)) as Vertical1,
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)) areaname,c.DPSTCode as dpst,c.DPSTName,

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))) 
AND 
('03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) else year(getdate()-1)+1 end )))
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS budget_year,  

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
('04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 4 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))),101) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_budget,  

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS ytd_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1,getdate())) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()),101) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date)= datepart(mm, dateadd(mm, 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) AND 
year(date) = datepart(yy, dateadd(mm, 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS next_month_budget,     

SUM(CASE WHEN month(date) = datepart(mm, dateadd(mm, 2, dateadd(dd, - 1,getdate()))) AND 
year(date) = datepart(yy, dateadd(mm, 2, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (target) ELSE 0 END) AS nextof_next_month_budget

FROM	Sales_Budget a
	INNER JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.Area))
	INNER JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode))    
		and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

GROUP BY ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)),ltrim(rtrim(isnull(a.organ,c.organ))),
ltrim(rtrim(c.region)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)),ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)),
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)),c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName
) AS budget    

GROUP BY Global,organ,region,Zone,user_names,Division,Vertical1,Area,AreaName,Dpst,DPSTName
HAVING      (SUM(budget_year) > 0) or (SUM(last_month_budget) > 0)

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

--select * from vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise] as   


select a.* ,
b.Inflow,b.Ondate_Inflow,YTD_INFLOW,n1_month_inflow,n2_month_inflow,n3_month_inflow,INFLOW_Opening,
case when row_number() over(partition by a.description order by a.description) =1 then c.Sales_Plan else 0 end as Sales_Plan
from (
SELECT	c.Description, c.DPSTcode,c.dpstname,

sum(CASE WHEN day(a.invoice_date)=day(getdate()-1)and month(a.invoice_date)=month(getdate()-1)
and year(a.invoice_date)=year(getdate()-1)THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS ondate_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
AND
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1)-1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale, 


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
AND
convert(varchar ,dateadd(yy, - 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())),101) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_ytd, 


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
getdate() --enable it only on Monthend date
--dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())  --disable it only on Monthend date
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_year_sale, 


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 4 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))),101) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount)/ 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN 
CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
AND 
getdate() --enable it only on Monthend date
--dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())  --disable it only on Monthend date
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS thr_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))    
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.invoice_date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_sale,

sum(case when a.invoice_date between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_sale  



FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
left JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
ON b.AreaCode = a.areacode
left JOIN vw_DPST_MASTER c 
ON c.DpstCode = a.Dpst  


WHERE	(c.Description IN ('Compressor-RLY','After Sales', 'Compressor-WW','Compressor-C&M', 'Compressor-Channel', 'Compressor-Direct')) 
AND (a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2015' AND GETDATE()) 
AND a.SaleOrderType in 
(
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)


GROUP BY c.Description,c.DPSTName,c.DPSTcode


)a
--	--Newly added on 18 Dec 2017

left outer join 
(
select Dpst,
--sum(sales) as Inflow
 SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
AND getdate()-1 THEN (sales) ELSE 0 END) AS Inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN convert(date,OrderDate) =convert(date,getdate()-1) THEN (sales/1000000) ELSE 0 END) AS Ondate_Inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN '04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND getdate()-1  THEN (sales)/1000000  ELSE 0 END) AS YTD_INFLOW,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN '04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND (dateadd(dd,- day(getdate()),convert(date,getdate())))  THEN (sales)/1000000  ELSE 0 END) AS INFLOW_Opening,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))    
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_inflow 

	from Sales_Inflow where organ='India'
and concat(company,ordertype) in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from saletype_master where Sales_Category not in (1) ) 
--and month(OrderDate)=month(getdate()-1) and year(OrderDate)=year(getdate()-1)
group by Dpst
)b
on a.DPSTcode=b.Dpst


left outer join (select Vertical1,Cal_Month,cal_year,sum([plan]) as Sales_Plan from ISAAME_SALES_PLAN 
where Cal_Month=month(getdate()-1) and cal_year=year(getdate()-1)
and organ1='India'
group by Vertical1,Cal_Month,cal_year
)c
on a.Description=c.Vertical1
--where a.DPSTcode in ('90082','90083')

AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))

THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_sale




FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 
and organ<>'India'
AND a.SaleOrderType in (
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 

group by dpst,areacode
)sls
on sls.dpst=c.DPSTCode
and sls.areacode=c.Areacode



left outer join (select Vertical1,Cal_Month,cal_year,sum([plan]) as Sales_Plan from ISAAME_SALES_PLAN 
where Cal_Month=month(getdate()-1) and cal_year=year(getdate()-1)
and organ1='SAAME'
group by Vertical1,Cal_Month,cal_year
)Sls_plan
on ltrim(rtrim(c.User_names))=ltrim(rtrim(Sls_plan.Vertical1))

--where c.User_names ='Africa-Spares'
)a
where concat(a.Dpstcode,Areacode) in 
(select distinct concat(Dpst,Areacode) from Sales_Inflow
union
select distinct concat(dpst,areacode) from ELGi_Sales_Details
)




GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sales_flash]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view  [dbo].[vw_sales_flash] as
select Global,upper(organ)organ,region,user_names,Division,description,Dpstcode,dpstname,AreaCode,AreaName,
case 
when organ ='India' then 1
when organ ='SAAME' then 2
when organ ='COSEA' then 3
when organ ='ID' then 4
else 5
end as ordr,
sum(budget_year) as budget_year,
sum(last_month_budget) as last_month_budget,
isnull(sum(ytd_budget),0) as ytd_budget,
sum(this_month_budget) as this_month_budget, 
sum(next_month_budget) as next_month_budget,
sum(nextof_next_month_budget) as 
nextof_next_month_budget,
sum(last_year_sale) as last_year_sale,
sum(last_year_ytd) as last_year_ytd,
sum(thr_month_sale) as
thr_month_sale,sum(this_month_sale) as this_month_sale,
sum(this_year_sale) as this_year_sale,
sum(last_month_sale) as last_month_sale,
sum(n1_month_sale) as n1_month_sale,
sum(n2_month_sale) as n2_month_sale,
sum(n3_month_sale) as n3_month_sale,
sum(inflow/1000000)as inflow,
sum(YTD_INFLOW)as YTD_INFLOW,
sum(n1_month_inflow)as n1_month_inflow,
sum(n2_month_inflow)as n2_month_inflow,
sum(n3_month_inflow)as n3_month_inflow,
sum(INFLOW_Opening)as INFLOW_Opening

from(

SELECT
isnull(bud.global,sls.global) Global,isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ) organ,isnull(bud.region,sls.region) region,
isnull(bud.user_names,sls.user_names) user_names,isnull(bud.Division,sls.Division) Division,isnull(bud.Area,sls.areacode) AreaCode,
isnull(bud.Areaname,sls.AreaName) AreaName,isnull(bud.Dpst,sls.Dpstcode) Dpstcode,isnull(bud.dpstname,sls.dpstname) dpstname,
sls.description,bud.budget_year,bud.last_month_budget, bud.ytd_budget,bud.this_month_budget, bud.next_month_budget,bud.nextof_next_month_budget,
sls.last_year_sale,case when sls.last_year_ytd = 0 then  0.01 else sls.last_year_ytd end as last_year_ytd,
sls.this_year_sale,sls.last_month_sale, sls.this_month_sale,sls.thr_month_sale,n1_month_sale,n2_month_sale,n3_month_sale,
sls.inflow,sls.YTD_INFLOW,sls.n1_month_inflow,sls.n2_month_inflow,sls.n3_month_inflow,INFLOW_Opening   

FROM 
(select * from vw_bud_Global) bud 
full JOIN
(select * from vw_sls_Global) sls 
ON  
--isnull(bud.Global,'0')=isnull(sls.global,'0')
--and isnull(bud.organ,'0')=isnull(sls.organ,'0')
--and isnull(bud.region,'0')=isnull(sls.region,'0')
--and isnull(bud.user_names,'0') =isnull(sls.user_names,'0')
--and isnull(bud.division,'0') = isnull(sls.division,'0') 
isnull(bud.Dpst,'0')=isnull(sls.Dpstcode,'0')
and isnull(bud.Area,'0')=isnull(sls.Areacode,'0')
where isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ)<>'India'


union

SELECT
'Domestic' as Global,'India' as organ,'India' as region,
null as  user_names,null as  Division,null as AreaCode,
null as AreaName,isnull(bud.Dpst,sls.Dpstcode) Dpstcode,isnull(bud.dpstname,sls.dpstname) dpstname,
sls.description,bud.budget_year,bud.last_month_budget, bud.ytd_budget,bud.this_month_budget, bud.next_month_budget,bud.nextof_next_month_budget,
sls.last_year_sale,case when sls.last_year_ytd = 0 then  0.01 else sls.last_year_ytd end as last_year_ytd,
sls.this_year_sale,sls.last_month_sale, sls.this_month_sale,sls.thr_month_sale,n1_month_sale,n2_month_sale,n3_month_sale,
sls.inflow,sls.YTD_INFLOW,sls.n1_month_inflow,sls.n2_month_inflow,sls.n3_month_inflow,INFLOW_Opening    

from vw_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise bud
full join vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise sls
on bud.dpst=sls.dpstcode

) BDM

group by Global,organ,region,user_names,Division,AreaCode,AreaName,Dpstcode,dpstname,description





GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ACR_ME]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ACR_ME] as 
select * from (
select *,case when delays between 0 and 30 then balance else 0 end del_00_30,
case when delays between 31 and 60 then balance else 0 end del_31_60,
case when delays between 61 and 90 then balance else 0 end del_61_90,
case when delays between 91 and 120 then balance else 0 end del_91_120,
case when delays between 121 and 180 then balance else 0 end del_121_180,
case when delays > 180 then balance else 0 end del_gt_180,case when custno = 'E00625' and trantyp = 'CDJ' then 1 else 0 end as filt_typ
from (
select company,trantyp,invno,custno,invamntinhomecur as inv_value ,
(recamnthomecur+curdiffamnt) as coll_value,
balamnthomecur as balance,
docdt,duedt,
datediff(dd,docdt,getdate()) as delays,productgrp,area 
from (
select * from ACR 
where company  not in (101,712)  
and area in (select areacode from vw_AREA_MASTER where region = 'Middle East & West Asia       ') 
and productgrp not in (select dpstcode from vw_DPST_MASTER where division  in ('ats'))
)a
)ar_me
)ar_me 
where filt_typ <> 1
--order by custno



GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_collection_report_daily_ats]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
Create VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_report_daily_ats] as

SELECT dates.company, dates.Trantyp, dates.InvNo, dates.CustNo, e.t_nama as CustName1, dates.DocDt, ABS(dates.AmntHome) AS collection, 
c.DpstCode, c.DpstName, c.Description, LTRIM(RTRIM(acc_rec_ats.area)) AS areacode, 
d.AreaName, d.Zone, d.region, d.Global, dates.AnpTranTyp, dates.AnpDocNo, dates.CDocNo, 
dates.CTranTyp, dates.DocTyp, 0 AS refr

FROM         

(
SELECT     a.company, a.Trantyp, a.InvNo, a.[LineNo],a.CustNo, 
a.DocDt, CASE WHEN len(ltrim(rtrim(a.area))) = 2 THEN '0' + ltrim(rtrim(a.area)) 
ELSE a.area END AS area, a.PurNo, a.DueDt, a.CurRate, 
b.AreaCode AS area_head, CASE WHEN CONVERT(varchar, b.dpst) IS NULL THEN ltrim(rtrim(proj)) 
ELSE CONVERT(varchar, dpst) END AS dpst
FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a 
LEFT OUTER JOIN (select * from CI_Header where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) b
ON b.Company = a.company 
AND b.OrderNum = a.PurNo 
AND b.CustCode = a.CustNo
WHERE      (a.CDocNo = 0)
GROUP BY a.company, a.Trantyp, a.InvNo, a.[LineNo], a.CustNo, 
a.DocDt, a.Area, a.PurNo, a.DueDt, a.CurRate, 
b.AreaCode, b.Dpst, a.Proj
) AS acc_rec_ats 

INNER JOIN

(
SELECT     company, Trantyp, InvNo, [LineNo], CTranTyp, CDocNo, CLineNo, CustNo, DocDt, DocTyp, Cur, CurRate, Amnt, AmntInv, AmntHome, 
FDisDt, FDisAmnt, FDisAmntInv, FDisAmntHome, SDisDt, SDisAmnt, SDisAmntInv, SDisAmntHome, TDisDt, TDisAmnt, TDisAmntInv, 
TDisAmntHome, PayDiff, PayDiffInv, PayDiffHome, BankCost, BankCostHome, CurDiffBas, CurDiffAmnt, RealCurDiff, DueDt, Refrence, 
PayTerm, OrgTranTyp, OrgInvNo, PayRecMeth, Proj, PurNo, ProbCode, PropDate, ProbRef, CustBank, LettNo, FinRunNo, FinDt, BalAmnt, 
BalHome, BalAnti, BalAntiHome, StatUpd, Fyear, Fprod, BtNo, Tyear, Tprod, SalRep, ExpCashDt, LinkAmt, RecStep, StLinkUnall, Doub, 
CalInt, LevTaxCal, AnpTranTyp, AnpDocNo, 
--CustDirDeb, 
Area
FROM  (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a 
WHERE (DocDt >= DATEADD(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, DATEPART(mm, GETDATE())) + '/01/' + DATENAME(yy, GETDATE()))) AND (Amnt < 0) AND 
(CTranTyp NOT LIKE '%B28%') AND (CTranTyp NOT LIKE '%B23%') AND (CTranTyp NOT LIKE '%B45%') AND (DocTyp IN (2, 8))

UNION

SELECT     company, Trantyp, InvNo, [LineNo], CTranTyp, CDocNo, CLineNo, CustNo, DocDt, DocTyp, Cur, CurRate, Amnt, AmntInv, AmntHome, 
FDisDt, FDisAmnt, FDisAmntInv, FDisAmntHome, SDisDt, SDisAmnt, SDisAmntInv, SDisAmntHome, TDisDt, TDisAmnt, TDisAmntInv, 
TDisAmntHome, PayDiff, PayDiffInv, PayDiffHome, BankCost, BankCostHome, CurDiffBas, CurDiffAmnt, RealCurDiff, DueDt, Refrence, 
PayTerm, OrgTranTyp, OrgInvNo, PayRecMeth, Proj, PurNo, ProbCode, PropDate, ProbRef, CustBank, LettNo, FinRunNo, FinDt, BalAmnt, 
BalHome, BalAnti, BalAntiHome, StatUpd, Fyear, Fprod, BtNo, Tyear, Tprod, SalRep, ExpCashDt, LinkAmt, RecStep, StLinkUnall, Doub, 
CalInt, LevTaxCal, AnpTranTyp, AnpDocNo, 
--CustDirDeb, 
Area
FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a 
WHERE
(DocDt >= DATEADD(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, DATEPART(mm, GETDATE())) + '/01/' + DATENAME(yy, GETDATE()))) AND (Amnt < 0) AND 
(Trantyp LIKE '%R28%') AND (CTranTyp LIKE '%B28%') AND (DocTyp IN (2, 8))
) AS dates 
ON dates.company = acc_rec_ats.company 
AND dates.InvNo = acc_rec_ats.InvNo 
AND dates.CustNo = acc_rec_ats.CustNo 
AND dates.Trantyp = acc_rec_ats.Trantyp 
AND dates.[LineNo] = acc_rec_ats.[LineNo] 

LEFT OUTER JOIN
vw_DPST_MASTER c
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(c.DpstCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(acc_rec_ats.dpst)) 
LEFT OUTER JOIN
vw_AREA_MASTER d
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(d.AreaCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(acc_rec_ats.area)) 
INNER JOIN TTCCOM100400 e
ON e.t_bpid = acc_rec_ats.CustNo


WHERE (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%ccj%') 
AND (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%ccn%') 
AND (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%cdj%') 
AND (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%cbc%') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '251' AND '264') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '351' AND '364') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '451' AND '464') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '551' AND '564') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '651' AND '664') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '751' AND '764') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '2A1' AND '2C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '3A1' AND '3C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '4A1' AND '4C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '5A1' AND '5C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '7A1' AND '7C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '8A1' AND '8C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) 
NOT BETWEEN '9A1' AND '9C6') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT LIKE 'F%') AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT IN ('BCC')) 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT IN ('271', '272', '371', '372', '471', '472', '571', '572', '671', '672', '674', '771', '772', '871', '872', '971', '972'))



GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_collection_report_daily_new_ats]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_report_daily_new_ats] as

SELECT company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, CustName1, DocDt, collection, DpstCode, DpstName, Description, areacode, AreaName, Zone, region, Global,AnpTranTyp, anpdocno, cdocno, ctrantyp, doctyp, refr
FROM 
(
SELECT dates.company, dates.Trantyp, dates.InvNo, dates.CustNo, e.t_nama as CustName1,
dates.DocDt, - (1 * dates.amnthome) AS collection, c.DpstCode, c.DpstName, c.Description, 
LTRIM(RTRIM(acc_rec_ats.area)) AS areacode, d.AreaName, d.ATS_Zone as zone, d.region, d.Global,
dates.AnpTranTyp, dates.anpdocno, dates.cdocno, dates.ctrantyp, dates.doctyp, 0 AS refr
FROM    
(
SELECT a.company, a.Trantyp, a.InvNo, a.[LineNo], a.CustNo, 
a.DocDt, CASE WHEN len(ltrim(rtrim(a.area))) = 2 THEN '0' + ltrim(rtrim(a.area)) 
ELSE a.area END AS area, a.PurNo, a.DueDt, a.CurRate, 
b.AreaCode AS area_head, CASE WHEN CONVERT(varchar, b.dpst) IS NULL THEN ltrim(rtrim(proj)) 
ELSE CONVERT(varchar, dpst) END AS dpst
FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and purno not like '%[a-z]%' 
) a  
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(

--select company,OrderNo,CustCode,dpst,areacode from LN_Sales_Details_ver2 
--where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
--and dpst not like '%[a-z]%'
select company,OrderNum as OrderNo,CustCode,t_cofc as dpst,areacode from CI_Lines 
where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and t_cofc not like '%[a-z]%'
--union
--select company,OrderNum,concat('CU1',CustCode),Dpst,Area from TmpSlsDespData_baan 
--where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
) b
ON b.Company = a.company 
AND b.OrderNo = a.PurNo 
AND ltrim(rtrim(b.CustCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(a.CustNo))
--AND ltrim(rtrim(b.CustCode)) =ltrim(rtrim(substring(a.CustNo,4,20)))
WHERE (a.CDocNo = 0)
GROUP BY a.company, a.Trantyp, a.InvNo, a.[LineNo],a.CustNo, a.DocDt, a.Area, a.PurNo,a.DueDt,a.CurRate,b.AreaCode,b.dpst,a.Proj
) AS acc_rec_ats 

INNER JOIN
   
(
SELECT     company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, DocDt, SUM(AmntHome) AS amnthome, AnpTranTyp, MAX(AnpDocNo) AS anpdocno,
MAX(CDocNo) AS cdocno, MAX(CTranTyp) AS ctrantyp, 2 AS doctyp, [LineNo]
FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a  
WHERE   convert(datetime,docdt) >= dateadd(yy,-4,getdate()-1) AND      (DocTyp IN (2, 8))


GROUP BY company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, DocDt, AnpTranTyp, [LineNo]

--UNION

--SELECT     company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, DocDt, SUM(AmntHome) AS amnthome, AnpTranTyp, MAX(AnpDocNo) AS anpdocno,     
--MAX(CDocNo) AS cdocno, MAX(CTranTyp) AS ctrantyp, 2 AS doctyp, [LineNo]
--FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a  
--WHERE   convert(datetime,docdt) >= '04/01/2011' AND 
--(Trantyp LIKE '%R28%') AND (CTranTyp LIKE '%B28%') AND (DocTyp IN (2, 8))
--GROUP BY company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, DocDt, AnpTranTyp, [LineNo]
) AS dates 
ON dates.company = acc_rec_ats.company 
AND dates.InvNo = acc_rec_ats.InvNo 
AND dates.CustNo = acc_rec_ats.CustNo 
AND dates.Trantyp = acc_rec_ats.Trantyp 
AND dates.[LineNo] = acc_rec_ats.[LineNo] 

LEFT OUTER JOIN
vw_DPST_MASTER c ON LTRIM(RTRIM(c.DpstCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(acc_rec_ats.dpst)) 
LEFT OUTER JOIN
vw_AREA_MASTER d ON LTRIM(RTRIM(d.AreaCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(acc_rec_ats.area)) 
INNER JOIN TTCCOM100400 e
ON e.t_bpid = acc_rec_ats.CustNo
     
WHERE
(dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%ccj%') 
AND (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%ccn%') 
AND (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%cdj%') 
AND (dates.Trantyp NOT LIKE '%cbc%') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '251' AND '264') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '351' AND '364') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '451' AND '464') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '551' AND '564') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '651' AND '664') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '751' AND '764') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '2A1' AND '2C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '3A1' AND '3C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '4A1' AND '4C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '5A1' AND '5C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '7A1' AND '7C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '8A1' AND '8C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT BETWEEN '9A1' AND '9C6') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT LIKE 'F%') 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT IN ('BCC')) 
AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(dates.Trantyp)) NOT IN ('271', '272', '371', '372', '471', '472', '571', '572', 
     '671', '672', '674', '771', '772', '871', '872', '971', '972'))
) AS test
