/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_Collection_Daily]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[vw_Collection_Daily] as 

select b.company,b.trantyp,b.invno,b.custno,e.t_nama as custname1,b.docdt,abs(b.amnthome) as collection,dpstcode,
dpstname,c.description,ltrim(rtrim(a.area)) as areacode, d.areaname,d.zone,d.region,global,
b.anptrantyp,anpdocno,b.cdocno,b.ctrantyp,b.doctyp,0 as refr
from
(select a.company,a.trantyp,a.invno,a.[lineno],a.custno,a.docdt,
case when len(ltrim(rtrim(a.area)))=  2 then '0' + ltrim(rtrim(a.area)) else a.area end as area,
a.purno,a.duedt,a.currate,CI_Header.AreaCode as area_head,
case when convert(varchar,CI_Header.DPST) is null then ltrim(rtrim(proj)) else convert(varchar,dpst) end as dpst
from Collection_Stage2 a (nolock) 
left outer join CI_Header on
CI_Header.company = a.company and
CI_Header.ordernum = a.purno and
CI_Header.custcode = a.custno
where cdocno = 0 and a.company <> 101
group by  a.company,a.trantyp,a.invno,a.[lineno],a.custno,
a.docdt,a.area,a.purno,a.duedt,a.currate,CI_Header.AreaCode,CI_Header.DPST,proj
)a

inner join

(
select  * from Collection_Stage2 (nolock)  
where docdt >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))
and company  <> 101 
and amnt < 0 
and ctrantyp not like '%B28%' 
and ctrantyp not like '%B23%' 
and ctrantyp not like '%B45%' 
and doctyp in (2,8)

union

select  * from Collection_Stage2 (nolock)  
where docdt >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))  
and company  <> 101 
and amnt < 0 
and trantyp like '%R28%' 
and ctrantyp like '%B28%' 
and doctyp in (2,8)

) b

on b.company = a.company and
b.invno = a.invno and
b.custno = a.custno and
b.trantyp = a.trantyp and
b.[lineno] = a.[lineno] 

left outer join vw_DPST_Master  c (nolock)  on ltrim(rtrim(c.dpstcode)) = ltrim(rtrim(dpst))
left outer join vw_Area_Master d  (nolock)  on ltrim(rtrim(d.areacode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.area))
inner join Customer_Master e (nolock)  on e.custcode  = a.custno
where 
len(ltrim(rtrim(dpst))) >= 5 
and b.trantyp not like '%ccj%' 
and b.trantyp not like '%ccn%' 
and b.trantyp not like '%cdj%' 
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '251' and  '264'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '351' and '364'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '451' and '464'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '551' and '564'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '651' and '664'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '751' and '764'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '2A1' and '2C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '3A1' and '3C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '4A1' and '4C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '5A1' and '5C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '7A1' and '7C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '8A1' and '8C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not between '9A1' and '9C6'
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not like 'F%' 
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not in ('BCC','CBD')
and ltrim(rtrim(b.trantyp)) not in ('271','272','371','372','471','472','571','572','671','672','771','772','871','872','971','972')

GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ats_collection_daywise_act]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ats_collection_daywise_act] as

select sum(case when zone='East' and type='mfg' then collection else 0 end) as east_mkt_coll,
sum(case when zone='West' and type='mfg' then collection else 0 end) as west_mkt_coll,
sum(case when zone='North' and type='mfg' then collection else 0 end) as north_mkt_coll ,
sum(case when zone='South' and type='mfg' then collection else 0 end) as south_mkt_coll ,
sum(case when zone='East' and type='aftersale' then collection else 0 end) as east_aftsale_coll ,
sum(case when zone='North' and type='aftersale' then collection else 0 end) as north_aftsale_coll ,
sum(case when zone='West' and type='aftersale' then collection else 0 end) as west_aftsale_coll ,
sum(case when zone='South' and type='aftersale' then collection else 0 end) as south_aftsale_coll ,
sum(case when zone='Export' and type='Export' then collection else 0 end) as export_coll,
sum(case when zone='Others'  then collection else 0 end) as other_coll,date as date1

from (


select isnull(collection,0) as collection, isnull(a.zone,b.zone) as zone , isnull(a.type,b.type) as type , date from 
(
select sum(collection) as collection,zone,type,docdt from 
(
select docdt,isnull(a.collection,0) as collection,a.dpstname as dpstname,
UPPER(case when a.zone is null then 'Others' else a.zone end)  as zone,type 
from 
(
SELECT SUM(a.collection) / 1000000 AS collection, 
UPPER(CASE WHEN dpstname IS NULL OR dpstname = ' ' or dpstname='OTHERS' THEN 'OTHERS' ELSE LTRIM(dpstname) END) AS dpstname, 
CASE WHEN dpstcode in ('90041','90048','90045') THEN 'aftersale' ELSE 'mfg' end as type,
b.ord,ltrim(rtrim(a.zone)) as zone,a.docdt

FROM Acc_Collection_ATS a
LEFT OUTER JOIN ats_area_ord  b
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(a.areaname)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(b.areaname))

WHERE (a.global LIKE '%domestic%') 
AND (a.collection > 0) 
AND (a.docdt between CONVERT(VARCHAR(25),DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(getdate()-1)-1),getdate()-1),101) and getdate()-1)
                      
GROUP BY a.dpstname, b.ord,a.zone,docdt,dpstcode,dpstname
)a
)a
group by zone,type,docdt
)a

right outer  JOIN

(
select * from
(select distinct date from companycalendar 
where date between CONVERT(VARCHAR(25),DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(getdate()-1)-1),getdate()-1),101) and convert(datetime,convert(varchar,getdate()-1,106))
)a

cross join
(select 'Others' as zone,'mfg' as type 
union all 
select 'Others' as zone,'aftersale' as type 
union all select 'EAST' as zone , 'mfg' as type 
union all 
select 'NORTH', 'mfg' as type 
union all 
select 'SOUTH', 'mfg' as type 
union all 
select 'WEST', 'mfg' as type 
union all 
select 'EAST'  as zone, 'aftersale' as type 
union all 
select 'NORTH', 'aftersale' as type 
union all 
select 'SOUTH', 'aftersale' as type 
union all 
select 'WEST','Aftersale' as type 
)b

)b
on convert(datetime,a.docdt)=b.date 
and a.zone=b.zone and a.type=b.type


union all

select isnull(out_collection,0) / 1000000 as collection,
isnull(zone,'Export') as zone, 
isnull(type,'Export') as type,
isnull(docdt,date) as date 
from 
(
SELECT 
sum(case when doctyp = 2 then (c.Amnthome - c.BankCosthome )*-1 else 0 end) as out_collection,
'Export' as zone,'Export' as type,DocDt
FROM vw_AREA_MASTER a
INNER JOIN (select distinct t_ofbp as CustCode,t_creg as Area from TTCCOM110400) b 
ON a.areacode = b.Area 
RIGHT OUTER JOIN (select * from Collection_Stage1 where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) c
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(b.CustCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CustNo))

WHERE (c.Trantyp IN ('B29', 'B45', '633', '634', 'B28', 'B31', 'B46','B48','B49','B50','B51','B52','B53')) 
AND (c.DocDt between CONVERT(VARCHAR(25),DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(getdate()-1)-1),getdate()-1),101) and getdate()-1) 
AND (c.DocTyp IN (2, 9)) AND (a.Global <> 'Domestic')
GROUP BY docdt
)a

right outer join
(select * from
(select distinct date from companycalendar where date between CONVERT(VARCHAR(25),DATEADD(dd,-(DAY(getdate()-1)-1),getdate()-1),101) and convert(datetime,convert(varchar,getdate()-1,106)))a
)b
on convert(datetime,a.docdt)=b.date 

)a
group by date








GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_Global_temp]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_sls_Global_temp] as   


SELECT b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.Zone,c.user_names,c.Division as Division,c.Vertical1,
coalesce(b.Areacode,sls.areacode,inf.areacode) as Areacode,b.AreaName, 
coalesce(d.Dpstcode,sls.dpst,inf.dpst) as Dpstcode ,d.dpstname,d.description,
ondate_sale,last_year_sale,last_year_ytd,this_year_sale,last_month_sale,last_year_this_month_sale,this_month_sale,
thr_month_sale,n1_month_sale,n2_month_sale,n3_month_sale,
inflow,Ondate_Inflow,YTD_INFLOW,n1_month_inflow,n2_month_inflow,n3_month_inflow,INFLOW_Opening,
case when row_number() over(partition by c.user_names order by c.user_names ) =1 then Sls_plan.Sales_Plan else 0 end as Sales_Plan
from vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
left outer JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b 
ON 	ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode)) 
left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER d
on ltrim(rtrim(d.DpstCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

full outer join

(select dpst,areacode,
sum(CASE WHEN day(a.invoice_date)=day(getdate()-1)and month(a.invoice_date)=month(getdate()-1)
and year(a.invoice_date)=year(getdate()-1)THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS ondate_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1)-1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
AND 
dateadd(yy, - 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_ytd, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
getdate() 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_year_sale,   

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 4 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
 CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
AND 
 dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_this_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
AND 
getdate() 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS thr_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))    
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_sale




FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 
and organ<>'India'
AND a.SaleOrderType in (
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 

group by dpst,areacode
)sls
on sls.dpst=c.DPSTCode
and sls.areacode=c.Areacode



--	--Newly added on 18 Dec 2017

full outer join 
(
select Dpst,AreaCode,
--sum(sales) as Inflow
SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
AND getdate()-1 THEN (sales) ELSE 0 END) AS Inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN convert(date,OrderDate) =convert(date,getdate()-1) THEN (sales/1000000) ELSE 0 END) AS Ondate_Inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN '04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND getdate()-1  THEN (sales)/1000000  ELSE 0 END) AS YTD_INFLOW ,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN '04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND (dateadd(dd,- day(getdate()),convert(date,getdate())))  THEN (sales)/1000000  ELSE 0 END) AS INFLOW_Opening,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate  BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))    
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_inflow,

SUM(CASE WHEN OrderDate BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (sales) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_inflow

 from Sales_Inflow 
	where ltrim(rtrim(organ))<>'India' and 
	concat(company,ordertype) in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from saletype_master where Sales_Category not in (1) ) 
--and month(OrderDate)=month(getdate()-1) and year(OrderDate)=year(getdate()-1)
and OrderNum in ('290001737','290001798','290001757','290001910','290001909')
group by Dpst,AreaCode
)inf
on c.DPSTcode=inf.Dpst
and c.areacode=inf.AreaCode



left outer join (select Vertical1,Cal_Month,cal_year,sum([plan]) as Sales_Plan from ISAAME_SALES_PLAN 
where Cal_Month=month(getdate()-1) and cal_year=year(getdate()-1)
and organ1='SAAME'
group by Vertical1,Cal_Month,cal_year
)Sls_plan
on c.User_names=c.Vertical1



--For Analysis Purpose
--where a.organ='SAAME'
----and a.User_names= 'ME-Units'
--and Dpstcode= '90231'
----'90220'--'70226'
--and a.Areacode='613'
----'675'



	----and a.Fin_month=e.Fin_Year
	----and a.Fin_year=e.Fin_Year

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_Sales_Inflow]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_Sales_Inflow]
as
select 
h.Dpst,case when h.area is null or h.area=' ' then v.CustAreaCode else h.Area end as AreaCode,H.ordertype,h.RefA as Indent,
 L.Company,L.Trantype,L.invnum,L.OrderNum,convert(date,L.OrderDate) OrderDate,L.PositionNum,L.CustCode,L.ItemCode,
L.DeliveryDate,L.WareHouse,l.Price,l.t_qoor as qty ,l.t_amld as discount,
(l.t_oamt* (case when h.t_rats_1=0 or h.t_rats_1 is null then 1 else h.t_rats_1 end)) as sales,
--h.Currency,
--h.t_oref as Segment,
c.CHNL as Segment,
h.SalesRep as SalesRepCode,b.NAMA as SalesRep,h.LineOfBusiness as LOBCode,a.T$DSCA as LineOfBusiness,
h.DeliveryTerms
From Sales_Header h
inner join Sales_Lines L
on h.Company =l.Company 
and ltrim(rtrim(h.OrderNum))=ltrim(rtrim(L.OrderNum))
left outer join vw_Business_Partner v
on ltrim(rtrim(l.CustCode))=ltrim(rtrim(v.custcode))
left outer join TTCMCS031400 a 
on h.LineOfBusiness=a.T$CBRN
left outer join (select distinct EMNO,COMPANY ,NAMA from TTCCOM001ALL) b
on h.SalesRep=b.EMNO 
and h.Company =b.COMPANY
left outer join TZZSLS326ALL c
on h.LineOfBusiness=c.CBRN

where LTRIM(RTRIM(L.ItemCode))<>'FRT' 
and t_sqnb =0
and h.t_clyn<>1

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sales_cube]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_sales_cube]
as 
select isnull(upper(organ),'')as organ,isnull(region,'')region,isnull(Dpstcode,'')Dpstcode,isnull(description,'')as Description,
isnull(dpstname,'')Dpstname,isnull(AreaCode,'')AreaCode,isnull(AreaName,'')AreaName,
case 
when organ ='India' then 1
when organ ='SAAME' then 2
when organ ='COSEA' then 3
when organ ='ID' then 4
else 5
end as ordr,
sum(isnull(budget_year,0)) as budget_year,
sum(isnull(last_month_budget,0)) as last_month_budget,
sum(isnull(ytd_budget,0)) as ytd_budget,
sum(isnull(this_month_budget,0)) as this_month_budget, 
sum(isnull(next_month_budget,0)) as next_month_budget,
sum(isnull(nextof_next_month_budget,0)) as nextof_next_month_budget,
sum(isnull(last_year_sale,0)) as last_year_sale,
sum(isnull(last_year_ytd,0)) as last_year_ytd,
sum(isnull(thr_month_sale,0)) as thr_month_sale,
sum(isnull(this_month_sale,0)) as this_month_sale,
sum(isnull(this_year_sale,0)) as this_year_sale,
sum(isnull(last_month_sale,0)) as last_month_sale,
sum(isnull(n1_month_sale,0)) as n1_month_sale,
sum(isnull(n2_month_sale,0)) as n2_month_sale,
sum(isnull(n3_month_sale,0)) as n3_month_sale

from(

SELECT
isnull(bud.global,sls.global) Global,isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ) organ,isnull(bud.region,sls.region) region,
isnull(bud.user_names,sls.user_names) user_names,isnull(bud.Division,sls.Division) Division,isnull(bud.Area,sls.areacode) AreaCode,
isnull(bud.Areaname,sls.AreaName) AreaName,isnull(bud.Dpst,sls.Dpstcode) Dpstcode,isnull(bud.dpstname,sls.dpstname) dpstname,
sls.description,bud.budget_year,bud.last_month_budget, bud.ytd_budget,bud.this_month_budget, bud.next_month_budget,bud.nextof_next_month_budget,
sls.last_year_sale,case when sls.last_year_ytd = 0 then  0.01 else sls.last_year_ytd end as last_year_ytd,
sls.this_year_sale,sls.last_month_sale, sls.this_month_sale,sls.thr_month_sale,n1_month_sale,n2_month_sale,n3_month_sale

FROM 
(select * from vw_bud_Global) bud 
full JOIN
(select * from vw_sls_Global) sls 
ON  
isnull(bud.Dpst,'0')=isnull(sls.Dpstcode,'0')
and isnull(bud.Area,'0')=isnull(sls.Areacode,'0')
where isnull(bud.organ,sls.organ)<>'India'


union

SELECT
'Domestic' as Global,'India' as organ,'India' as region,
null as  user_names,null as  Division,null as AreaCode,
null as AreaName,isnull(bud.Dpst,sls.Dpstcode) Dpstcode,isnull(bud.dpstname,sls.dpstname) dpstname,
sls.description,bud.budget_year,bud.last_month_budget, bud.ytd_budget,bud.this_month_budget, bud.next_month_budget,bud.nextof_next_month_budget,
sls.last_year_sale,case when sls.last_year_ytd = 0 then  0.01 else sls.last_year_ytd end as last_year_ytd,
sls.this_year_sale,sls.last_month_sale, sls.this_month_sale,sls.thr_month_sale,n1_month_sale,n2_month_sale,n3_month_sale


from vw_bud_Domestic_DPSTwise bud
full join vw_sls_Domestic_DPSTwise sls
on bud.dpst=sls.dpstcode

) BDM
group by Global,organ,region,user_names,Division,AreaCode,AreaName,Dpstcode,dpstname,description




GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS_DPSTwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS_DPSTwise]
as

select 
--company,date,
dpst,a.dpstname,b.division,

sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))  
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_inflow,  



sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_inflow, 


sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_day_inflow  

from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a

inner  join vw_DPST_MASTER b on  a.dpst = b.dpstcode
where a.orderdate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,getdate()) 
and concat(a.Company,a.ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))

group by 
--company,date,
dpst,a.DpstName,b.division



--union all
--select 
----0,0,
--dpstcode,dpstname,division,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0 from vw_DPST_MASTER where description  ='ATS' and  dpstcode not in (select distinct dpst from vw_Sales_Inflow)





GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_advance_bdm] as

select user_names,b.region,b.areaname,custno,custname1,month(docdt) as month_name,sum(collection) as collection 

from Acc_Advance a
left outer join (select * from vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER where Organ is not null) b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.region)) = ltrim(rtrim(b.region))
and a.dpst = b.DPSTCode
where global = 'international'
group by  user_names,b.region,b.areaname,custno,custname1,a.region,month(docdt)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_bdm] as
select user_names,b.region,b.areaname,custno,custname1,month(docdt) as month_name,sum(collection) as collection 
from Acc_Collection a

where global = 'international'
group by  user_names,b.region,b.areaname,b.areacode,custno,custname1,a.region,month(docdt)

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS_Segmentwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS_Segmentwise]
as

select Segment,LOBCode,LineOfBusiness,SalesRepCode,SalesRep,

sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))  
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_inflow,  



sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_inflow, 


sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_day_inflow  

from (select * from vw_Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a

inner  join vw_DPST_MASTER b on  a.dpst = b.dpstcode
where a.orderdate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,getdate()) 
and a.ordertype not in (select saleordertype from saletype_master_ATS where Sales_Category in (1))
and dpst not in('90046','90047')
group by Segment,LOBCode,LineOfBusiness,SalesRepCode,SalesRep--,dpst,DPSTName

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ACR_Consolidated_AME]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--Select * from vw_ACR_Consolidated_AME where ACR.area,

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_ACR_Consolidated_AME]
as
select * from
(
SELECT	ACR.cur,
ACR.company,
ACR.CurRate,
ACR.InvAmntInInvCur as invval_fc, 
ACR.CustNo, 
a.CustName1, 
b.FinCustGrp,
vw_Area_Master.AreaName,
ACR.area,
vw_Area_Master.Zone, 
vw_Area_Master.region, 
vw_Area_Master.global, 
ACR.Trantyp, 
ACR.InvNo, 
ACR.[LineNo], 
ACR.Refrence,
ACR.DocDt,
ACR.DueDt,
--CONVERT(varchar, ACR.DocDt, 101) AS DocDt, 
--CONVERT(varchar, ACR.DueDt, 101) AS DueDt, 
datediff(dd, Docdt, Duedt) AS noofdays, 
ACR.InvAmntInHomeCur, 
ACR.RecAmntHomeCur, 
ACR.BalAmntHomeCur, 
ACR.DueAmt, 
ACR.UnDueAmt, 
ACR.DueAmtHC30, 
ACR.DueAmtHC31_60, 
ACR.DueAmtHC61_90, 
ACR.DueAmtHC91_180, 
ACR.DueAmtHCGT180, 
ACR.ProductGrp, 
ACR.Division ,
vw_DPST_Master.Description as  [description],
''ardivision,
'' ardivisiondesc,
case 	when custno = 'E00625' and trantyp = 'CDJ' then 1  
	when trantyp like '%c1%' then 1 else 0 end  as filt_typ,
dpstname
,ACR.Indent

FROM 
(select distinct a.*
,case when h.t_corn=' ' then h.RefA else h.t_corn end as Indent 
from ACR a
left outer join (select distinct Company,Trantype,invnum,OrderNum,CustCode from ci_lines) b
on a.company=b.Company
and a.Trantyp=b.Trantype
and a.InvNo=b.invnum
and ltrim(rtrim(a.CustNo))=ltrim(rtrim(b.CustCode))
left outer join 
(select distinct company,OrderNum,CustCode,t_corn,RefA From Sales_Header where dpst not like '%[a-z]%') h
on b.Company =h.Company 
and b.OrderNum =h.OrderNum 
and ltrim(rtrim(b.CustCode))=ltrim(rtrim(h.CustCode))
where a.company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ELGi')
)	ACR
left outer JOIN (select distinct t_bpid as CustCode,t_nama as CustName1 from TTCCOM100400) a 
ON ACR.CustNo = a.CustCode 
left outer join (select distinct itbp as CustCode,cfcg as FinCustGrp from TTCCOM112ALL where company=400) b
ON ACR.CustNo =b.CustCode
left outer JOIN vw_Area_Master(nolock) 
ON ACR.Area = vw_Area_Master.AreaCode 
left outer JOIN vw_DPST_Master(nolock) 
ON ltrim(rtrim(vw_DPST_Master.dpstcode)) = ltrim(rtrim(ACR.productgrp))

WHERE	substring(trantyp,2,1) not in ('5','6')

	)a

where filt_typ <> 1
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_rpldetails_ats]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from vw_rpldetails_ats
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_rpldetails_ats]  as
SELECT 
LEAN_MASTER.Company, 
a_1.DIVI, a_1.DEPT, 
LTRIM(RTRIM(a_1.ITEM)) AS itemcode, 
a_1.a AS I_Tri_date,a_1.DATE AS II_Tri_Date,
CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(dd, a, DATE) END AS diff, 
a_1.SUNO, 
a_1.QTY, 
LEAN_MASTER.CEMP, 
vw_Business_Partner.custname1, 
MATERIALS_DEPT_MASTER.Dept_Name as SUPERMARKET, 
Materials_Division_MASTER.DIVISION_NAME as DEPARTMENT, 
vw_buyer.emp_name AS Buyername, 
ltrim(rtrim(LEAN_MASTER.BUYR)) BUYR, vw_buyer.emp_name AS BuyerContact, LEAN_MASTER.RPLT

FROM (select * from TZZPUR049ALL where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) as lean_master 
INNER JOIN Employee_Details vw_buyer
ON LEAN_MASTER.BUYR=vw_buyer.new_emp_code

RIGHT OUTER JOIN 
(
SELECT DIVI, DEPT, ITEM, DATE,
(SELECT MAX(DATE) AS Expr1 
FROM (select * from TZZPUR014ALL where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) AS b
WHERE DATE <> '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000'
and isdate(DATE)<> 0 
AND a.DIVI = DIVI 
AND a.DEPT = DEPT 
AND a.SUNO = SUNO 
AND a.ITEM = ITEM
AND DATE < a.DATE 
) AS a, 
SUNO ,
RQTY QTY
FROM (select * from TZZPUR014ALL where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) AS a 
WHERE (DATE <> '9999-01-01 00:00:00.000') 
and isdate(date)<> 0 
) AS a_1 

ON LTRIM(RTRIM(LEAN_MASTER.ITEM)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(a_1.ITEM)) 
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(LEAN_MASTER.DEPT)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(a_1.DEPT)) 
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(LEAN_MASTER.SUNO1)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(a_1.SUNO)) 
LEFT OUTER JOIN MATERIALS_DEPT_MASTER 
ON a_1.DEPT = MATERIALS_DEPT_MASTER.Dept_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN Materials_Division_MASTER 
ON a_1.DIVI = Materials_Division_MASTER.DIVISION_CODE
LEFT OUTER JOIN vw_Business_Partner
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(a_1.SUNO)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(vw_Business_Partner.custcode))

WHERE isdate(a_1.DATE) = 1





--select distinct BUYR from vw_rpldetails_ats --where buyr like '%100441%'
--order by BUYR
--select * from Employee_Details where new_emp_code like '%100441%'
--'100441'


GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_coll_sales_ytd] as

when b.Description = 'AED'  then 'ATS'
else [description] end  as vertical,

from LN_Sales_Details_ver2 a 
left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER b 
on a.dpst =  b.dpstcode
where  convert(datetime,Invoice_Date) between (
select convert(datetime,case when datepart(mm,dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))) < 4

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_Business_Partner_IAS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
create view [dbo].[vw_Business_Partner_IAS] as
select  bpid as custcode,a.NAMA as custname1,b.creg as CustAreaCode,cfcg as FinCustGrp,
(ltrim(rtrim(d.nama))+' '+ltrim(rtrim(d.namb))+' '+ltrim(rtrim(d.namc))+' '+ltrim(rtrim(d.namd))+' '+ltrim(rtrim(d.namf))) as CustAddress  
from TTCCOM100951 a
left outer join TTCCOM110951 b
on a.bpid=b.ofbp
left outer join TTCCOM112951 c
on a.bpid=c.itbp
left outer join TTCCOM130951 d
on a.cadr=d.cadr


GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_IAS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_sls_IAS] as   

select
a.Dpst,
a.ItemCode,a.ItemDesc,sum(a.Sales_amount) as Sales_amount,
--Product_Group,Type, --To be commented
sum(CASE WHEN day(a.invoice_date)=day(getdate()-1)and month(a.invoice_date)=month(getdate()-1)
and year(a.invoice_date)=year(getdate()-1)THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS ondate_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1)-1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
AND 
dateadd(yy, - 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_ytd, 

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
getdate() 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_year_sale,   

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 4 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
 CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
AND 
 dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_this_month_sale,


SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) 
AND 
getdate() 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS thr_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))    
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n1_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n2_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN  
dateadd(mm, - 3, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))   
AND 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm,dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) +'/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END)AS n3_month_sale


FROM 	
(
select a.Dpst,
a.ItemCode,a.ItemDesc,a.Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) as Sales_amount
--,b.Product_Group,b.Type --To be commented
from
(
select Company,CustCode,CustName,AreaCode,AreaName,
Dpst,
OrderNum,PositionNum,TranType,InvDate as Invoice_Date,InvNo,
sum(OrderQty) OrderQty,--sum(BudQty) BudQty,
sum(DeliveredQty) DeliveredQty,sum(UnitPrice) UnitPrice,sum(SalesValue) Sales_amount,
REFA,REFB,CPAY,odat,CCUR,CREP,CFCG,DDAT,ItemCode,ItemDesc
from
(
select a.Company,a.CustCode,c.CustName1 as CustName,c.custareacode as AreaCode,e.AreaName,
a.Dpst,
a.OrderNum,b.PositionNum,
b.t_invd as InvDate,b.invnum as InvNo,b.TranType,b.t_qoor as OrderQty,
--b.BQUA as BudQty,
b.t_qidl as DeliveredQty,
b.Price as UnitPrice,(b.t_qidl*b.Price) as SalesValue,a.REFA,a.REFB,
a.PaymentTerm as cpay,a.OrderDate as ODAT,a.Currency as  CCUR,a.SalesRep as CREP,
c.FinCustGrp as CFCG,b.DeliveryDate as DDAT,b.ItemCode,d.ItemDesc
from 
(select * from Sales_Header where company=951)a
left outer join (select * from Sales_Lines where company=951)b
on a.OrderNum=b.OrderNum
left outer join (select * from vw_Business_Partner_IAS)c
on a.CustCode=c.custcode
left outer join (select distinct item,ltrim(rtrim(DSCA)) as ItemDesc from TTCIBD001951)d
on ltrim(rtrim(b.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(d.ITEM))
left outer join vw_AREA_MASTER e
on c.custareacode=e.AreaCode
--where b.invnum is not null
)a
group by Company,CustCode,CustName,AreaCode,AreaName,Dpst,
OrderNum,PositionNum,InvDate,InvNo,TranType,REFA,REFB,CPAY,odat,CCUR,CREP,CFCG,DDAT,ItemCode,ItemDesc


union

select '951' as Company,a.t_itbp as CUNO,c.custname1,c.CustAreaCode,null as AreaName,
Dpst,
t_orno as ordernum,null as Positionnum,t_ttyp,
a.t_docd,a.t_ninv,
null as orderQty,--null as BudQty,
null as DeliveredQty,null as unitprice,t_amth_1,
t_refr,null as refb,t_cpay,
a.t_docd as orderdate,
t_ccur,t_crep,null as cfcg,null as ddat,
null as itemcode,null as Itemdescr
from 
(select a.t_itbp,c.Dpst,
a.t_ttyp,a.t_docd,a.t_docn,a.t_ninv,a.t_amth_1,
a.t_orno,a.t_refr,a.t_cpay,a.t_ccur,a.t_crep
from TTFACR200ALL a
left outer join Sales_Lines b
on a.Company=b.Company
and a.t_ttyp=b.Trantype
and a.t_ninv=b.invnum
left outer join Sales_Header c
on b.Company =c.Company 
and ltrim(rtrim(b.OrderNum))=ltrim(rtrim(c.OrderNum))
where a.company=951
) a
left outer join (select * from vw_Business_Partner_IAS)c
on a.t_itbp=c.custcode
where t_ttyp='csr' and a.t_docn=0
)a

--below table To be commented
--left outer join Item_Master_IAS b
--on ltrim(rtrim(a.ItemCode))=ltrim(rtrim(b.ItemCode))


--left outer join DPST_Master_IAS c


group by a.Dpst,
a.ItemCode,a.ItemDesc,a.Invoice_Date
--,b.Product_Group,b.Type --To be commented
)a
group by a.Dpst, 
ItemCode,ItemDesc
--,Product_Group,Type  --To be commented

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_coll_sales]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW  [dbo].[vw_coll_sales] as 
select vertical,monthnum,sum(collections) as collections,sum(advances) as advances,sum(sales) as sales,
sum(sales_ytd) as sales_ytd
from(

select 
isnull(isnull(collections.vertical,advances.vertical),sales.vertical) as vertical,
isnull(isnull(collections.monthnum,advances.monthnum),sales.monthnum)as monthnum,
isnull(collection,0) as collections,isnull(advance,0) as advances,isnull(sales,0) as sales,
isnull(sales_ytd,0) as sales_ytd from


--Collections
(
select sum(collection) as collection,vertical,monthnum 
from 
(
select sum(collection) as collection,vertical,monthnum from
(
SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as collection, case when [description] = 'MED' or
[description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null
then 'OTHERS' else Upper(description) end as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum FROM Acc_Collection WITH (nolock)
WHERE (custno NOT IN ('CU1ZA0001','SU1ZA0001', 'CU1A03177','SU1A03177')) 
group by month(docdt), case when [description] = 'MED' or
[description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null then 'OTHERS' else Upper(description) end 

union all

select sum(gl_receipt)/1000000 ,'OTHERS' , month(docdt) as gl_receipt from Acc_Collection_GL_receipts
group by month(docdt)
) coll
group by monthnum,vertical

union all

select sum(collection) as collection,vertical,monthnum
from
(
SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as collection, case when [description] = 'MED' or
[description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null
then 'OTHERS' else Upper(description) end as vertical
,month(docdt) as monthnum 
FROM Acc_Collection_Others WITH (nolock)
WHERE     [description] = 'ELGI SAUER' group by month(docdt), case when [description] = 'MED' or
[description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null
then 'OTHERS' else Upper(description) end 
) coll
group by monthnum,vertical

union all

SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as advance, 'OTHERS'  as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM  Acc_Advance_Others WITH (nolock) WHERE custno in ('CU1A03177','SU1A03177')
group by month(docdt), Upper(description) 

union all

select sum(collection) as collection,vertical,monthnum
from
(
SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as collection, 'OTHERS' as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM Acc_Collection_Others WITH (nolock)
WHERE [description] <> 'ELGI SAUER'
group by month(docdt)

union all

select sum(collection),vertical,monthnum
from (
SELECT sum(collection)/1000000 as collection, 'ATS'  as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM Acc_Collection_ATS
WHERE (global LIKE '%domestic%') AND (collection > 0)
and convert(datetime,docdt) >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate())) 
and docdt <= getdate() -1
group by MONTH(docdt)

union all

seLECT  SUM((c.Amnthome - c.BankCost) * - 1)/1000000 AS Collection, 
'ATS'  as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM vw_AREA_MASTER v1 
INNER JOIN vw_Business_Partner v2
ON v1.AreaCode = v2.CustAreaCode 
RIGHT OUTER JOIN (select * from Collection_Stage1 where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) c
ON LTRIM(RTRIM(v2.CustCode)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CustNo))
WHERE (c.Trantyp IN ('B29', 'B45', '633', '634', 'B28', 'B31', 'B46','B48','B49','B50','B51')) 
AND (c.DocTyp IN (2, 9)) 
AND (v1.Global <> 'Domestic') 
and convert(datetime,docdt) >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))
and docdt <= getdate() -1
GROUP BY MONTH(docdt)

)a
group by vertical,monthnum

) coll
group by monthnum,vertical

) colls
group by monthnum,vertical

) collections



full join

--Advances
(
select sum(advance) as advance ,vertical,monthnum
from (

SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as advance, case when [description] = 'MED' or
[description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null
then 'OTHERS' else Upper(description) end as vertical
,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM acc_advance WITH (nolock)
WHERE  (custno NOT IN ('CU1ZA0001','SU1ZA0001','CU1A03177','SU1A03177')) and isnull(description,'OTHERS') <> 'exports'
group by month(docdt), case when [description] = 'MED' or
[description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null
then 'OTHERS' else Upper(description) end 

union

SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as advance, Upper(description)  as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM  Acc_Advance WITH (nolock)
WHERE (custno NOT IN ('CU1ZA0001','SU1ZA0001','CU1A03177','SU1A03177')) 
and isnull(description,'OTHERS') = 'exports' and global = 'International'
group by month(docdt), Upper(description) 

union all
SELECT   -1* SUM(balamnt)/1000000 as advance,'ATS' as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum FROM Acc_Advance_ATS
group by     MONTH(docdt)

union all

SELECT  sum(collection)/1000000 as advance, Upper(description)  as vertical,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM  Acc_Advance_Others WITH (nolock)
WHERE description like '%sauer%'
group by month(docdt), Upper(description) 

)advance

group by vertical,monthnum

) advances

on advances.vertical = collections.vertical
and advances.monthnum = collections.monthnum

full join

--Sales
(
select sum(Sales_amount)/1000000 as sales,
case when [description] = 'MED' or [description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null then 'OTHERS' 
when [description] = 'AED'  then 'ATS' 
else [description] end as vertical,
--else Upper(case when dpst = '90091' or dpst  = '90002' or dpst = '90012' then 'Railways' else description end) end as vertical,
month (Invoice_Date) as monthnum 
from LN_Sales_Details_ver2  s
left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER d
on s.dpst =  d.dpstcode
where  convert(datetime,Invoice_Date) >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))
and company not in(600,612,616) 
and sales_category in (0,2) 
and dpst not in 
(select distinct dpstcode from vw_DPST_MASTER where description  ='To Elgi China'
union
select distinct dpstcode from vw_DPST_MASTER where description  ='To Elgi Gulf'
union
select distinct dpstcode from DPST_Master_ATS
union
select distinct dpstcode from vw_DPST_MASTER where description  ='Unknown'
union 
select dpstcode from vw_DPST_MASTER where division  in 
('BEYOND TO CUST','BRAZIL TO CUST','ECS TO CUST','EZL TO CUST','BELAIR TO CUST',
'AUSTRALIA TO CUST','To ELGI Australia','To ELGI Belair','To ELGI Brazil')
)
group by case when [description] = 'MED' or [description] = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' or [description] = 'Engines' or description is null
then 'OTHERS' 
when [description] = 'AED'  then 'ATS'
else [description] end,
--else Upper(case when dpst = '90091' or dpst  = '90002' or dpst = '90012' then 'Railways' else description end) end ,
month(Invoice_Date)

union all

select 
sum(Sales_amount)/1000000 as sales,
'ATS',month (Invoice_Date) as monthnum
from ATS_Sales_Details a
inner join DPST_Master_ATS  b on a.dpst =  b.dpstcode
where  convert(datetime,Invoice_Date) >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))
and dpst in ('90049','90041','90042','90044','90040','90050','90045','90051','90048','90241','90111','90240','90054',
'90242','90250','90043','90052')  
and sales_category in (0,2) 
and dpst  in (select distinct dpstcode from DPST_Master_ATS )
and SaleOrderType in (select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6))
group by month(Invoice_Date)



union all

select 
sum(Sales_amount)/1000000 as sales,
case when b.division  in ('BEYOND TO CUST','ECS TO CUST','EZL TO CUST') then 'CHINA'
when b.division in ('BELAIR TO CUST') then 'BELAIR'
when b.division in ('BRAZIL TO CUST') then 'BRAZIL'
when b.division in ('AUSTRALIA TO CUST') then 'AUSTRALIA' 
end as vertical,month (Invoice_Date) as monthnum 
from LN_Sales_Details_ver2 a 
left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER b on
a.dpst =  b.dpstcode
where  convert(datetime,Invoice_Date) >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate()))
and company not in(600,612,616)
and sales_category in (0,2) --and dpst not in (90003,90004)
and dpst  in (select dpstcode from vw_DPST_MASTER where division  in ('BEYOND TO CUST','BRAZIL TO CUST','ECS TO CUST','EZL TO CUST','BELAIR TO CUST','AUSTRALIA TO CUST')
)

group by case when b.division  in ('BEYOND TO CUST','ECS TO CUST','EZL TO CUST') then 'CHINA'
when b.division in ('BELAIR TO CUST') then 'BELAIR'
when b.division in ('BRAZIL TO CUST') then 'BRAZIL'
when b.division in ('AUSTRALIA TO CUST') then 'AUSTRALIA' 
end ,month(Invoice_Date)



) sales
on sales.vertical = collections.vertical
and sales.monthnum = collections.monthnum

full join vw_coll_sales_ytd sales_ytd 
on sales_ytd.vertical = sales.vertical
and sales_ytd.monthnum = sales.monthnum


) coll_sales
group by vertical,monthnum







--select * from ln_sales_details_ver2 where company=581

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ats_inventory_fwdcover]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ats_inventory_fwdcover] as

select 	a.*,
	b.Dept_Name as supermarket,
	c.custname1 as nama,
	d.description,
	empname,
	isnull(total,0) as total,
	isnull(wh_651,0) as wh_651,
	isnull(wh_653,0) as wh_653 ,
	isnull(wh_671,0) as wh_671,
	isnull(wh_674,0) as wh_674,
	isnull(wh_189,0) as wh_189,
	getdate()-1 as hist_date  

from (
	select 	item,
		dept,
		max(SUNO1) as supp,
		max(SQTY) as binqty,
		max(BUYR) as buyr  
	from	(select * from TZZPUR049ALL 
	where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
	and dept<>41
	) a
	where SOPS = 5
	group by dept,item
     )a

inner  join 
MATERIALS_DEPT_MASTER b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dept))  = ltrim(rtrim(b.Dept_code))

inner join 
(select t_item as itemcode,t_dsca as description from TTCIBD001600 )d
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(d.itemcode))

left outer join 
vw_Business_Partner c 
ON ltrim(rtrim(a.SUPP)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.custcode))


left outer join 
(select new_emp_code as buyr,max(emp_name) as empname from Employee_Details group by new_emp_code
union select 0, 'Others'
)e
on ltrim(rtrim(a.buyr)) = ltrim(rtrim(e.buyr))

left outer join 

(select item as itemcode,sum(QHND) as total,
sum(case when CWAR  = '651' then QHND else 0 end) as wh_651,
sum(case when CWAR  = '653' then QHND else 0 end) as wh_653,
sum(case when CWAR  = '671' then QHND else 0 end) as wh_671,
sum(case when CWAR  = '674' then QHND else 0 end) as wh_674,
sum(case when CWAR  = '189' then QHND else 0 end) as wh_189
from TWHWMD215ALL where company = 600 and CWAR in ('651','653','671','674','189') 
group by item) f
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) = ltrim(rtrim(f.itemcode))

--order by dept

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bud_sales_Itemwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




CREATE view [dbo].[vw_bud_sales_Itemwise] as


select Organ,DPSTCode,DPSTName,AreaCode,AreaName,DealerCode,DealerName,
--line,
Category,ProductLine,
company,warehouse,ItemCode,
Cal_month,Cal_year,Fin_month,Fin_year,
sum(Budget) as Budget,
sum(Sales_amount) as Sales_amount,sum(Inflow_amount) as Inflow_amount
from (

select isnull(Budget.Organ,Sales.Organ) as Organ,
isnull(Budget.DPSTCode,Sales.DPSTcode) as DPSTCode,
isnull(Budget.DPSTName,Sales.DPSTName) as DPSTName,
isnull(Budget.Area,Sales.Areacode) as AreaCode,
isnull(Budget.areaname,Sales.Areaname) as AreaName,
dlr.DealerCode,dlr.DealerName,
--Assyline.line,
isnull(prd.Category,prd2.category) as Category, 
isnull(prd.ProductLine,prd2.productline) as ProductLine,
sales.company,sales.warehouse,
isnull(Budget.item_code,sales.item) as ItemCode,
isnull(Budget.CalMonth,sales.cal_Month) as Cal_month,
isnull(Budget.CalYear,Sales.cal_year) as Cal_year,
isnull(Budget.Fin_month,sales.Fin_month) as Fin_month,
isnull(Budget.Fin_year,sales.Fin_year) as Fin_year,
Budget.Budget,
Sales.Sales_amount,
Sales.Inflow_amount

from

(select 
ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)) as Global,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)) as Organ,
ltrim(rtrim(c.region)) as region,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)) as Zone,
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)) as user_names,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)) as Division,
ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)) as Vertical1,
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)) as areaname,
c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName,
ltrim(rtrim(a.item_code)) as item_code,
month(a.date) as CalMonth,
year(a.date) as CalYear,
case when month(a.date) < 4 then month(a.date)+9 else month(a.date)-3 end Fin_month,
case when month(a.date) < 4 then year(a.date)-1 else year(a.date) end Fin_year,
sum(target) as Budget 

FROM	--Sales_Budget a
Itemwise_Budget a
	INNER JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.Area))
	INNER JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
		ON ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode))    
		and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

--where organ='COSEA'
GROUP BY ltrim(rtrim(b.Global)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Organ)),ltrim(rtrim(c.region)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Zone)),
ltrim(rtrim(c.user_names)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Division)),ltrim(rtrim(c.Vertical1)),
a.Area,ltrim(rtrim(c.areaname)),c.DPSTCode,c.DPSTName,a.item_code,month(a.date),year(a.date)
)Budget


full outer join 

(
select b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.Zone, c.user_names,c.Division,c.Vertical1,
a.custcode,b.Areacode,b.AreaName,d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.Description,
a.company,a.warehouse,ltrim(rtrim(a.Item)) as Item ,a.Item_desc,a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,
a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year,sum(Sales_amount) as Sales_amount,
sum(inf.sales) as inflow_amount

FROM 	
ELGi_Sales_Details a 
	left outer JOIN vw_AREA_MASTER b ON ltrim(rtrim(b.AreaCode)) = ltrim(rtrim(a.areacode))
	left outer JOIN vw_SALESMAPPING_MASTER c
	ON 	ltrim(rtrim(b.Areacode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.Areacode)) 
	AND ltrim(rtrim(a.Dpst)) = ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))
	left outer join vw_DPST_MASTER d
	on ltrim(rtrim(d.DpstCode))=ltrim(rtrim(c.DPSTCode))

	full outer join Sales_Inflow inf
 on  a.company=inf.Company
 and a.OrderNo=inf.OrderNum
	AND A.PositionNo=inf.PositionNum
	and a.dpst=inf.Dpst
	and a.areacode=inf.AreaCode
	and month(a.Invoice_Date)=month(inf.OrderDate)
	and year(a.Invoice_Date)=year(inf.OrderDate)
	and ltrim(rtrim(a.custcode))=ltrim(rtrim(inf.CustCode))


WHERE	(a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN '04/01/2016' AND GETDATE()) 

AND a.SaleOrderType in (
select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6)
union all
select '' as SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master
)
and a.sales_category not in (1)
AND (a.areacode IS NOT NULL) 
--and c.Organ='COSEA'
GROUP BY b.global,c.organ,c.region,c.Zone, c.user_names,c.Division,c.Vertical1,
a.custcode,b.Areacode,b.AreaName,d.Dpstcode,d.dpstname,d.Description,
a.company,a.warehouse,a.Item,a.Item_desc,
a.cal_Month,a.cal_year,a.Fin_month,a.Fin_year

)Sales

on isnull(budget.organ,'0')=isnull(Sales.organ,'0')
and isnull(Budget.DPSTCode,'0')=isnull(Sales.DPSTcode,'0')
and isnull(Budget.area,'0')=isnull(Sales.areacode,'0')
and isnull(Budget.item_code,'0')=isnull(Sales.item,'0')
and isnull(budget.fin_month,0)=isnull(Sales.Fin_month,0)
and isnull(budget.Fin_year,0)=isnull(Sales.Fin_year,0)

--left outer join vw_Sales_Inflow inf
--on  sales.company=inf.Company
--and ltrim(rtrim(isnull(Budget.item_code,Sales.Item)))=ltrim(rtrim(inf.ItemCode))
--and ltrim(rtrim(isnull(Budget.dpstcode,Sales.DPSTcode)))=ltrim(rtrim(inf.Dpst))
--and ltrim(rtrim(isnull(Budget.area,Sales.Areacode)))=ltrim(rtrim(inf.AreaCode))

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_advance_domestic]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_advance_domestic] as 
SELECT    case when areaname is null or areaname ='' then ' OTHERS' else areaname end as areaname, sum(collection)/1000000 as advance, 
sum(case when description  = 'Compressor-Channel' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as channel_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'after sales' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as after_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'DPSAC' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as dpsac_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'MED' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as med_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'Compressor-Direct' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as direct_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'Railways' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as railways_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as service_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'Engines' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as engines_adv,
--sum(case when description  = 'After Sales' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as AS_adv,
sum(case when description  = 'others' or description is null or description='' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as others_adv,
month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM         Acc_Advance WITH (nolock)
WHERE     (custno NOT IN ('ZA0001', 'A03177'))   and 
case when description is not null   then description else 'others' end <> ('exports') and 
case when global is not null   then global else 'others' end <> ('International')
group by case when areaname is null or areaname ='' then ' OTHERS' else areaname end,month(docdt)


GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_advance_exports]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_advance_exports] as 
SELECT     max(areaname) as areaname, sum(collection)/1000000 as advance, case when global = 'International' then region else zone end as zone1,
sum(case when description  = 'exports' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as exports_adv,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM         Acc_Advance WITH (nolock)
WHERE     (custno NOT IN ('ZA0001', 'A03177'))  and  global = 'international' 
--description = 'exports' 
and areaname is not null
group by case when global = 'International' then region else zone end,month(docdt)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ATS_Debtors] as
select sum(InvAmntInHomeCur) as InvAmntInHomeCur,sum(RecAmntHomeCur)as RecAmntHomeCur,
sum(BalAmntHomeCur)/1000000 as BalAmntHomeCur, sum(DueAmt)/1000000 as DueAmt,sum(UnDueAmt)/1000000 as UnDueAmt, sum(Due_30)/1000000 as DueAmtHC30,
sum(Due_31_60)/1000000  as DueAmtHC31_60, sum(Due_61_90)/1000000 as DueAmtHC61_90,sum(Due_91_120)/1000000 as DueAmtHC91_120,
sum(Due_121_150)/1000000 as DueAmtHC121_150,sum(Due_151_180)/1000000 as DueAmtHC151_180,sum(Due_181_365)/1000000 as DueAmtHC181_365,
sum(Due_366_730)/1000000 as DueAmtHC366_730,sum(Due_731_1095)/1000000 as DueAmtHC731_1095,sum(Due_gt1095)/1000000 as DueAmtgt_1095,productgrp,
case when productgrp in (90041,90051) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%'  then 'Spares'
when productgrp in (90045,90048) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%' then 'Service'
when productgrp in (90240,90241,90244,90250,90251) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%' then 'International'
when productgrp in (90040,90042,90043,90044,90050,90052) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%' then 'Domestic'
when trantyp like '6c%' then 'Demo/ Trial Units'
when trantyp like '6d%' then '6DS Invoices'
else 'Others' end as description1,

case when productgrp in (90041,90051) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%'  then 2
when productgrp in (90045,90048) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%' then 3
when productgrp in (90240,90241,90244,90250,90251) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%' then 4
when productgrp in (90040,90042,90043,90044,90050,90052) and trantyp not like '6c%'and trantyp not like '6d%' then 1
when trantyp like '6c%' then 6 
when trantyp like '6d%' then 7
else 5 end as  ordering1

from
(	
select * from 
(select * ,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 0 and 30 then dueamt else 0 end as due_30,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 31 and 60 then dueamt else 0 end as due_31_60,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 61 and 90 then dueamt else 0 end as due_61_90,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 91 and 120 then dueamt else 0 end as due_91_120,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 121 and 150 then dueamt else 0 end as due_121_150,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 151 and 180 then dueamt else 0 end as due_151_180,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 181 and 365 then dueamt else 0 end as due_181_365,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 366 and 730 then dueamt else 0 end as due_366_730,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) between 731 and 1095 then dueamt else 0 end as due_731_1095,
case when datediff(dd,duedt,(select convert(datetime,convert(varchar,max(last_run_date),101)) from last_run_Date)) > 1095 then dueamt else 0 end as due_gt1095
from  (SELECT     company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, ProductGrp, Area, DocDt, InvAmntInHomeCur, RecAmntHomeCur, BalAmntHomeCur, DueAmt, UnDueAmt, 
DueAmtHC30, DueAmtHC31_60, DueAmtHC61_90, DueAmtHC91_180, DueAmtHCGT180, DueDt, Refrence
FROM  ACR
 where company = 101 and productgrp <> '111'
 and balamnthomecur >= 1)test)vw_artest
) acc_cumm
group by productgrp,trantyp

isnull([29],0) as day29_bqty,isnull([30],0) as day30_bqty,isnull([31],0) as day31_bqty,

isnull([25],0)+ isnull([26],0)+isnull([27],0)+ isnull([28],0)+isnull([29],0)+ isnull([30],0)+isnull([31],0) as total_bqty,

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ats_prod_pqty]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from vw_ats_prod_pqty

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ats_prod_pqty] as 
select item as item_code,pgdesc,mnum,ynum,
sum(case when dnum = 1 then pqty else 0 end) as day1_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 2 then pqty else 0 end) as day2_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 3 then pqty else 0 end) as day3_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 4 then pqty else 0 end) as day4_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 5 then pqty else 0 end) as day5_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 6 then pqty else 0 end) as day6_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 7 then pqty else 0 end) as day7_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 8 then pqty else 0 end) as day8_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 9 then pqty else 0 end) as day9_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 10 then pqty else 0 end) as day10_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 11 then pqty else 0 end) as day11_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 12 then pqty else 0 end) as day12_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 13 then pqty else 0 end) as day13_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 14 then pqty else 0 end) as day14_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 15 then pqty else 0 end) as day15_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 16 then pqty else 0 end) as day16_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 17 then pqty else 0 end) as day17_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 18 then pqty else 0 end) as day18_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 19 then pqty else 0 end) as day19_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 20 then pqty else 0 end) as day20_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 21 then pqty else 0 end) as day21_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 22 then pqty else 0 end) as day22_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 23 then pqty else 0 end) as day23_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 24 then pqty else 0 end) as day24_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 25 then pqty else 0 end) as day25_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 26 then pqty else 0 end) as day26_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 27 then pqty else 0 end) as day27_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 28 then pqty else 0 end) as day28_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 29 then pqty else 0 end) as day29_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 30 then pqty else 0 end) as day30_pqty,
sum(case when dnum = 31 then pqty else 0 end) as day31_pqty,
sum(pqty) as total_pqty
from (
select 
month(pkdt) as mnum,
year(pkdt) as ynum,
ltrim(rtrim(item)) as item,
day(pkdt) as dnum,
count(*) as pqty,
pgdesc from 
(
select * from 
(select *
,convert(date,getdate()-1) as pkdt  --This need to be modified once pkdt info is available in LN
,pack=1  --This need to be modified once pkdt info is available in LN
from TWHLTC500ALL 
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS'))a
where pkdt <> '9999-01-01 00:00:00' 
and convert(datetime,pkdt) >= '04/01/2011' 
and pack = 1 
and cwar <> '664'
)a
inner join ats_production_master b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) =  ltrim(rtrim(b.tplcode)) 
group by ltrim(rtrim(item)),pgdesc,month(pkdt) ,year(pkdt) ,day(pkdt)

union all

select mnum,ynum,ltrim(rtrim(tplcode)) as item,dnum,0 as pqty,pgdesc from 
(select month(pkdt) as mnum,year(pkdt) as ynum,day(pkdt) as dnum 
from(select *
,convert(date,getdate()-1) as pkdt  --This need to be modified once pkdt info is available in LN
,pack=1  --This need to be modified once pkdt info is available in LN
from TWHLTC500ALL 
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS'))a
where pkdt <> '9999-01-01 00:00:00' 
and convert(datetime,pkdt) >= '04/01/2011'
group by month(pkdt) ,year(pkdt) ,day(pkdt)
)a,ats_production_master

)a
group by item,mnum,ynum,pgdesc



GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ats_prod_stk]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_ats_prod_stk] as 
select item itemstk,
sum(case when CWAR = '157' then QHND else 0 end) as stk_157,
sum(case when CWAR = '657' then QHND else 0 end) as stk_657,
sum(case when CWAR = '157' then QALL else 0 end) as ao_157,
sum(case when CWAR = '657' then QALL else 0 end) as ao_657
from (select * from TWHWMD215ALL 
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS') 
and ltrim(rtrim(item)) in (select  ltrim(rtrim(tplcode)) from ats_production_master ) 
and CWAR in ('657','157')
)a
group by item



GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bank_payment]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


create VIEW [dbo].[vw_bank_payment] as 
select a.fyer,case when a.fprd > 9 then a.fprd - 9 else a.fprd + 3 end as monthnum,sum(nor_pay+advice_pay)/1000000 as payment from (
select a.company,a.leac,a.fprd,a.fyer,
nor_rec - isnull(amth_adj_rec,0) as nor_rec,
nor_pay + isnull(amth_adj_pay,0) as nor_pay,
advice_rec,advice_pay,
fnd_rec + isnull(amth_adj_rec,0) as fnd_rec,
fnd_pay - isnull(amth_adj_pay,0) as fnd_pay,
anticp_rec,anticip_pay,reco_rec,reco_pay,cms_rec,cms_pay
 from (
select company,leac,fyer,fprd, 
sum(case when type = 1 then amth else 0 end) as nor_rec,
sum(case when type = 2 then amth else 0 end) as nor_pay,
sum(case when type = 3 then amth else 0 end) as advice_rec,
sum(case when type = 4 then amth else 0 end) as advice_pay,
sum(case when type = 5 then amth else 0 end) as fnd_rec,
sum(case when type = 6 then amth else 0 end) as fnd_pay,
sum(case when type = 7 then amth else 0 end) as anticp_rec,
sum(case when type = 8 then amth else 0 end) as anticip_pay,
sum(case when type = 9 then amth else 0 end) as reco_rec,
sum(case when type = 10 then amth else 0 end) as reco_pay,
sum(case when type = 13 then amth else 0 end) as cms_rec,
sum(case when type = 14 then amth else 0 end) as cms_pay

 from (
select company,dbcr,pleac as leac,sum(amth) as amth,type,isnull(fnd_leac,'') as fnd_leac,fyer,fprd 
from bank_balance a 
inner join bank_balance_gl b 
on a.leac = b.leac
group by company,dbcr,pleac,type,isnull(fnd_leac,''),fyer,fprd
)a
group by company,leac,fyer,fprd) a

left outer join

(select company,sum(case when type = 6 then amth else 0 end) as amth_adj_rec ,
sum(case when type = 5 then -amth else 0 end) as amth_adj_pay,
isnull(fnd_leac,'') as leac,fyer,fprd 
from bank_balance a 
where isnull(fnd_leac,'') <> ''  
group by company,isnull(fnd_leac,''),fyer,fprd
) b
on a.leac = b.leac 
and a.company = b.company 
and a.fyer = b.fyer 
and a.fprd  =b.fprd
)a 
group by a.fyer,case when a.fprd > 9 then a.fprd - 9 else a.fprd + 3 end



GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bud_ATS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select distinct product_group from  ATS_Budget_Master
--select * from vw_bud_ats order by ordering

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_bud_ATS]
as


select 
case when SalesType='Domestic Sales' then 1
when SalesType='International Sales' then 2
when SalesType='After Sales' then 3
when SalesType='OTHER Sales' then 4 
end as SalesTypeOrdering,*
from(

select 
SalesType,productgroup,ordering,
sum(last_year_ytd_bud) last_year_ytd_bud,
sum(this_year_ytd_bud) this_year_ytd_bud,
sum(last_month_bud) last_month_bud,
sum(this_month_bud) this_month_bud,
sum(next_month_budget) next_month_budget,
sum(nextof_next_month_budget) nextof_next_month_budget

from (
select case 
when productgroup in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN productgroup in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES', 'TOOLS SPARES','PAYU INCOME','TRAINING INCOME') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,*

from (


select productgroup,ordering,
sum(case when convert(datetime,bud_date) between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then budget else 0 end)as last_year_ytd_bud,

sum(case when convert(datetime,bud_date) between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then budget else 0 end) as this_year_ytd_bud,

sum(case when convert(datetime,bud_date) between 
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then budget else 0 end)as last_month_bud,

sum(case when convert(datetime,bud_date) between 
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then  budget else 0 end)as this_month_bud,

sum(case when month(bud_date) = datepart(mm,dateadd(mm,1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) and bud_date > dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) then budget else 0 end)as next_month_budget,
sum(case when month(bud_date) = datepart(mm,dateadd(mm,2,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) and bud_date > dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) then budget else 0 end)as nextof_next_month_budget

from 
(
select CASE 
WHEN ltrim(rtrim(upper(product_group)))='SPTC' then 'TYRE INFLATORS'
WHEN ltrim(rtrim(upper(product_group)))='CLMS PIPING SERVICE CHARGES' then 'SERVICE BILLING'
else ltrim(rtrim(upper(product_group))) end as productgroup,
case 
when ltrim(rtrim(upper(product_group)))='SPTC' then 4
WHEN ltrim(rtrim(upper(product_group)))='CLMS PIPING SERVICE CHARGES' then 12
else ordering end as ordering,bud_date,budget 
from ATS_Budget_Master
where ltrim(rtrim(upper(product_group))) not in 
('COMMERCIAL VEHICLE (TRADED)' ,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE(MFG)','Auto`ssure')

)
ATS_Budget_Master
group by productgroup,ordering


union 
select 'SCRAP',101,0,0,0,0,0,0
union 
select 'SS1/CCN',102,0,0,0,0,0,0
union 
select 'SUPPLIER SALES',103,0,0,0,0,0,0


)a
)b
group by SalesType,productgroup,ordering
)c


GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bud_ATS_DPSTwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

create view [dbo].[vw_bud_ATS_DPSTwise]
as

select dpst,dpstname,division,
SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) else year(getdate()-1)+1 end ))
THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS budget_year, 

SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate()))))+ '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))) 
THEN budget ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_ytd_budget, 

sum(case when convert(datetime,date) between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then budget else 0 end)as last_year_ytd_bud,

sum(case when convert(datetime,date) between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then budget else 0 end)as this_year_ytd_bud,

sum(case when convert(datetime,date) between 
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then budget else 0 end)as last_month_bud,

sum(case when convert(datetime,date) between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then  budget else 0 end)as this_month_bud,

sum(case when month(date) = datepart(mm,dateadd(mm,1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) and date > dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) then budget else 0 end)as next_month_budget,
sum(case when month(date) = datepart(mm,dateadd(mm,2,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) and date > dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) then budget else 0 end)as nextof_next_month_budget

from 
(
select *,target as budget 
from DPSTwise_Budget a  
inner  join  
(select * from 
(select * from DPST_Master_ATS )a
--union
--select * from dpstmaster where dpstcode=90252
) b 
on  a.dpst = b.dpstcode 

)a
group by dpst,dpstname,division


GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_bud_IAS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view  [dbo].[vw_bud_IAS]
as
select Vertical_ordr,Vertical,SubVertical,Slsofc_ordr,Slsofc,Slsofc_desc,
SUM(CASE WHEN Fin_Year=case when datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) <4 then YEAR(getdate()-1)-1 else YEAR(getdate()-1) end
THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS budget_year,  

SUM(CASE WHEN Fin_Year=case when datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) <4 then YEAR(getdate()-1)-1 else YEAR(getdate()-1) end
and Fin_Month<=(case when datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) <4 then datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))+9 
else datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))-3 end)-1
THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_budget,

SUM(CASE WHEN Fin_Year=case when datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) <4 then YEAR(getdate()-1)-1 else YEAR(getdate()-1) end
and Fin_Month<=case when datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate())) <4 then datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))+9 
else datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))-3 end
THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS ytd_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN Cal_Month =datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))
and Cal_Year=year(getdate()-1)
THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_budget, 

SUM(CASE WHEN Cal_Month= datepart(mm, dateadd(mm, 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) AND 
Cal_Year = datepart(yy, dateadd(mm, 1, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS next_month_budget,     

SUM(CASE WHEN Cal_Month = datepart(mm, dateadd(mm, 2, dateadd(dd, - 1,getdate()))) AND 
Cal_Year = datepart(yy, dateadd(mm, 2, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) 
THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS nextof_next_month_budget

FROM	IAS_Bud_DPSTwise a
group by Vertical_ordr,Vertical,SubVertical,Slsofc_ordr,Slsofc,Slsofc_desc





--select 
--SUM(CASE WHEN Cal_Month = datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))
--THEN (Budget) ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_budget
--FROM	IAS_Bud_DPSTwise a
--where Slsofc_desc= 'LG SERIES'
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_ccs_despqty_period_ln]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
