SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW[dbo].[vw_ccs_despqty_period_ln] as 

select product1 as product,a.cat,multi_month,sum(desptqty) as desptqty from (
select * from (
select product,cat,multi_month,sum(isnull(despqty,0))as desptqty from (
select a.*,cat,warrantyperiod as wi_period from ccs_rca_Desp_data_ln a, ccs_warranty_ref_Ln b
where a.product = b.product)a, (select distinct month as multi_month from ccs_rca_Desp_data_ln  )b
where  convert(datetime,month) between dateadd(mm, 1-wi_period,convert(datetime,multi_month)) and   convert(datetime,multi_month)
group by product,cat,multi_month)a
where multi_month between (select min(month) as multi_month from ccs_rca_Desp_data_ln ) and (select max(month) as multi_month from ccs_rca_Desp_data_ln))a
inner join (select * from ccs_warranty_ref_Ln)b
on a.product = b.product
group by product1, a.cat,multi_month


GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_collection_domestic]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_domestic] as 

SELECT    case when areaname is null or areaname ='' then ' OTHERS' else areaname end as areaname, sum(collection)/1000000 as collection, case when global = 'International' then region else zone end as zone1,
sum(case when description  = 'Compressor-Channel' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as channel_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'after sales' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as after_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'DPSAC' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as dpsac_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'MED' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as med_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'Compressor-Direct' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as direct_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'Railways'  then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as railways_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'Service Charges & Old DPST' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as service_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'Engines' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as engines_coll,
sum(case when description  = 'others' or description is null then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as others_coll,
--sum(case when description  = 'After Sales'  then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as AS_coll,
month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM         Acc_Collection WITH (nolock)
WHERE     (custno NOT IN ('ZA0001', 'A03177')) and description <> 'exports'
group by areaname,case when global = 'International' then region else zone end,month(docdt)









GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_collection_exports]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_exports] as 
SELECT     max(areaname) as areaname, sum(collection)/1000000 as collection, 
case when global = 'International' then region else zone end as zone1,
sum(case when description  = 'exports' then collection/1000000  else 0 end) as exports_coll,month(docdt) as monthnum
FROM         Acc_Collection WITH (nolock)
WHERE     (custno NOT IN ('ZA0001', 'A03177'))  and description = 'exports'
group by case when global = 'International' then region else zone end,month(docdt)



GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_collection_GL_receipts]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_GL_receipts] as 

select company,trantyp,invno,custno,abs(amnthome)as gl_receipt,docdt,90150 as dpst,'051' as area,
ctrantyp,cdocno,anptrantyp,anpdocno,doctyp
from Collection_Stage2 
where --year(docdt) = 2009 and 
trantyp = 'BCD'
and convert(datetime,docdt) >= '04/01/2008'  
and convert(datetime,docdt) >= dateadd(mm,-2,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,getdate())) + '/01/' + datename(yy,getdate())) 
--and ctrantyp not in ('ICC','R18','R23','R28','R40','R44','R45')
and clineno = 1
--and custdirdeb <> ''



GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_collection_GL_receipts_ATS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_collection_GL_receipts_ATS]
AS
SELECT company, Trantyp, InvNo, CustNo, ABS(AmntHome) AS gl_receipt, DocDt, 
90111 AS dpst, '051' AS area, CTranTyp, CDocNo, AnpTranTyp, AnpDocNo,DocTyp
FROM (select * from Collection_Stage2 where company in (select Company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a  

WHERE (Trantyp = 'BCD') 
AND (CONVERT(datetime, DocDt) >= '04/01/2008') 
AND (CONVERT(datetime, DocDt) >= DATEADD(mm, - 2, CONVERT(varchar,DATEPART(mm, GETDATE())) + '/01/' + DATENAME(yy, GETDATE()))) 
AND (CLineNo = 1)



GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_Customer_master_Audit]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_Customer_master_Audit]
as

select distinct a.*,e.DSCA  as Credit_Terms,Financial_customer_Group as FCG,f.t$desc FCG_DESC,c.Address,c.Country,d.GSTN 
     From (
select t_cadr,t_bpid as Custcode,t_nama as CustName,t_ccur as Currency,
case when t_bprl=1 then 'No Roles'
when t_bprl=2 then 'Customer'
when t_bprl=3 then 'Supplier'
when t_bprl=4 then 'Customer and Supplier' end as Role,
case when t_prst =1 then 'Prospect'
when t_prst =2 then 'Active'
when t_prst =3 then 'In Active' end as CustomerStatus
  From TTCCOM100400 )a
	left join (select t_itbp,t_cpay as Credit_Terms,t_cfcg  AS Financial_customer_Group From TTCCOM112400)b 
	on a.Custcode=b.t_itbp 
	left join (select CADR,concat(BLDG,BLFL,BLUN)as Address,CCTY as Country     From TTCCOM130400 )c
	on a.t_cadr=c.CADR 
	left join (select BPID,max(FOVN) as GSTN from TTCTAX400400 where CATG$L =9 and (EXDT ='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' or exdt> getdate()) group by BPID)d
	on a.Custcode =d.BPID  
		left join (select distinct dsca,cpay From TTCMCS013ALL )e
		on b.Credit_Terms =e.CPAY 
		left join (select distinct t$ficu,t$desc from TTFACR001400)f
		on b.Financial_customer_Group=f.t$ficu
			

--select distinct * From vw_Customer_master_Audit where role in ('Customer and Supplier','Customer')

GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_dates]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from vw_dates

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_dates]
as
select *,
substring(fromdate,7,4)+'-'+substring(todate,9,2) CurrentYear,
substring(lyfromdate,7,4)+'-'+substring(lytodate,9,2) LastYear

 from(
select '04/01/' + convert(varchar,(select case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end as year)) as fromdate,
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(select case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) else year(getdate()-1)+1 end as year)) as todate,
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(select case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end as year)) as lyfromdate,
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(select case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1)-1 else year(getdate()-1) end as year)) as lytodate,
convert(varchar,dateadd(mm, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))),101) as LastMonthFirstday,
convert(varchar,dateadd(dd, - 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, getdate()))),101)  as LastMonthlastday,
convert(date,getdate()-1 ) as ondate,
datename(mm,dateadd(mm,month(getdate()-1),-1)) as CurMonthName,
upper(substring(datename(mm,dateadd(mm,month(getdate()-1),-1)),1,3))+'-'+substring(convert(varchar,year(getdate()-1)),3,2)  as CurMonthName2
)a


GO

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_elgi_HR] as

SELECT 	distinct GLOBAL, 
	A.Emp_Name,
	OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE, 
	CAST(coalesce (A.Emp_Code,OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE) AS INT)  EMP_CODE,
	--a.emp_code,
	Dense_rank() OVER(PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(A.EMP_CODE)),finmonthno
order by global ) AS ERANK,
	A.Designation, 
	Org_Unit, 
	isnull(ltrim(rtrim(Division_Name)),'') Division_Name, 
	isnull(ltrim(rtrim(Function_Name)),'') Function_Name,
	isnull(ltrim(rtrim(Department)),'') Department, 
	case when ltrim(rtrim(A.Band)) is null then 'Overseas'
	when ltrim(rtrim(A.Band))='' then 'Overseas'
	else ltrim(rtrim(A.Band)) end as Band,
	Location,
	Emp_Status, 	Reason, 	Seperation_Date, 	Transfer_Date, 	New_Division, 	New_Function, 
	New_Department, 	EE_Subgroup, 	Start_Date, 	Data_Load_Date, 	num, 	FinMonthNo, 	FinMonthName, 
	FinYear, 	Fin_Year, Vertical_ordr,	vertical,	Function2,	Function2_ordr	
	--,Division_NewPage
FROM (
	

	--Domestic (Live and Resigned) Employees From SAP

	SELECT distinct 
 'DOMESTIC' AS GLOBAL,Emp_Name,' ' AS OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE, 
		Emp_Code,Band,Designation,Org_Unit,
		ltrim(rtrim(c.Division_Name)) as Division_Name,
		ltrim(rtrim(c.Function_Name)) as Function_Name,
		ltrim(rtrim(c.Department)) as Department,
		Location,Emp_Status,Reason,Seperation_Date,Transfer_Date,New_Division,New_Function, 
		New_Department,EE_Subgroup,Start_Date,Data_Load_Date,num,FinMonthNo,FinMonthName, 
		FinYear,Fin_Year,Vertical_ordr,vertical,Function2,Function2_ordr
		 
	FROM 	HR_Master a
	left outer join (select distinct Division_Code,Division_Name,Function_Code,Function_Name,Dept_Code,Department,Vertical_ordr,vertical,Function2,Function2_ordr from HR_NewDimension2) b
	on ltrim(rtrim(a.Division_Code))=ltrim(rtrim(b.Division_Code))
	and ltrim(rtrim(a.Function_Code))=ltrim(rtrim(b.Function_Code))
	and ltrim(rtrim(a.Dept_Code))=ltrim(rtrim(b.Dept_Code))

 left outer join  --Newly Added on 20 Dec 2016 to display the latest DFD names
 (select Division_Code,Division_Name,Function_Code,Function_Name,Dept_Code,Department from HR_MASTER_DFD) c
 on a.Division_Code=c.Division_Code
 and a.Function_Code=c.Function_Code
 and a.Dept_Code=c.Dept_Code
	
	where emp_code not  between 800000 and 899999
	and Org_Unit<>'ERGO DESIGN PVT LIMITED'

-----------------------Method 3: International employees from Intranet-----------------------------------------------------------

Union

--Active Foreign Employees
select * from (
select 'INTERNATIONAL' as GLOBAL,Emp_Name,emp_code as OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE,new_emp_code as Emp_Code,Band,Designation,
'' as Org_Unit,a.region_name as Division_Name,a.Function_Name,a.sub_function_name as Department,
uname as Location,
case when employee_status='Live' then 'ACTIVE'
when employee_status='Resigned' then 'WITHDRAWN' else employee_status end as Emp_Status,'' as Reason,
case when settledate is null or settledate='' then '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'
else convert(datetime,substring(settledate,7,4)+'-'+substring(settledate,4,2)+'-'+substring(settledate,1,2)) 
end as Seperation_Date,
'' as Transfer_Date,'' as New_Division,'' as New_Function,'' as New_Department,
'' as EE_Subgroup,joindate as Start_Date,
Data_Load_Date,1 as num,
case when month(Data_Load_Date) between 1 and 3 then month(Data_Load_Date) + 9 else month(Data_Load_Date) - 3 end as FinMonthNo,
datename(mm,Data_Load_Date)  as FinMonthName,
case when month(Data_Load_Date) between 1 and 3 then year(Data_Load_Date) - 1 else year(Data_Load_Date)  end as FinYear,
CASE WHEN month(Data_Load_Date) > 3 THEN (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) + 1)) 
                      ELSE (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date))) END AS Fin_Year,

b.Vertical_ordr,b.vertical,b.Function2,b.Function2_ordr 
from (select *,
dateadd(d,-1,convert(date,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))  as Data_Load_Date 
from [ELGi_LN].dbo.Employee_Details where new_emp_code between 800000 and 899999 
)a
left outer join  (select * from [ELGI-DW].dbo.HR_NewDimension2)b
on a.region_code=b.Division_Code
and a.function_code=b.Function_Code
and a.sub_function_code=b.Dept_Code
)c
where Emp_Status='ACTIVE'
and Emp_Code not in (800445,800482,800509,800510,800520)
and Start_Date<= dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))

union 

--Foreign Employees Resigned on the Current Month
select * from (
select 'INTERNATIONAL' as GLOBAL,Emp_Name,emp_code as OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE,new_emp_code as Emp_Code,Band,Designation,
'' as Org_Unit,a.region_name as Division_Name,a.Function_Name,a.sub_function_name as Department,
uname as Location,
case when employee_status='Live' then 'ACTIVE'
when employee_status='Resigned' then 'WITHDRAWN' else employee_status end as Emp_Status,'' as Reason,
case when settledate is null or settledate='' then '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'
else convert(datetime,substring(settledate,7,4)+'-'+substring(settledate,4,2)+'-'+substring(settledate,1,2)) 
end as Seperation_Date,
'' as Transfer_Date,'' as New_Division,'' as New_Function,'' as New_Department,
'' as EE_Subgroup,joindate as Start_Date,
Data_Load_Date,1 as num,
case when month(Data_Load_Date) between 1 and 3 then month(Data_Load_Date) + 9 else month(Data_Load_Date) - 3 end as FinMonthNo,
datename(mm,Data_Load_Date)  as FinMonthName,
case when month(Data_Load_Date) between 1 and 3 then year(Data_Load_Date) - 1 else year(Data_Load_Date)  end as FinYear,
CASE WHEN month(Data_Load_Date) > 3 THEN (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) + 1)) 
                      ELSE (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date))) END AS Fin_Year,

b.Vertical_ordr,b.vertical,b.Function2,b.Function2_ordr 
from (select *,
dateadd(d,-1,convert(date,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))  as Data_Load_Date 
from [ELGi_LN].dbo.Employee_Details where new_emp_code between 800000 and 899999 
)a
left outer join  (select * from [ELGI-DW].dbo.HR_NewDimension2)b
on a.region_code=b.Division_Code
and a.function_code=b.Function_Code
and a.sub_function_code=b.Dept_Code
)c
where Emp_Status='WITHDRAWN'
and Emp_Code not in (800445,800482,800509,800510,800520)
and Seperation_Date between 
(select max(Data_Load_Date)+1 from elgi_hr) and
dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))


union 


--Foreign Employees Resigned on the Next Month to be shown as ACTIVE in the Current Month
select * from (
select 'INTERNATIONAL' as GLOBAL,Emp_Name,emp_code as OLD_BAAN_EMPCODE,new_emp_code as Emp_Code,Band,Designation,
'' as Org_Unit,a.region_name as Division_Name,a.Function_Name,a.sub_function_name as Department,
uname as Location,
case when employee_status='Live' then 'ACTIVE'
when employee_status='Resigned' then 'ACTIVE' --Resigned on the Next Month to be shown as ACTIVE in the Current Month
else employee_status end as Emp_Status,'' as Reason,
case when settledate is null or settledate='' then '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'
else convert(datetime,substring(settledate,7,4)+'-'+substring(settledate,4,2)+'-'+substring(settledate,1,2)) 
end as Seperation_Date,
'' as Transfer_Date,'' as New_Division,'' as New_Function,'' as New_Department,
'' as EE_Subgroup,joindate as Start_Date,
Data_Load_Date,1 as num,
case when month(Data_Load_Date) between 1 and 3 then month(Data_Load_Date) + 9 else month(Data_Load_Date) - 3 end as FinMonthNo,
datename(mm,Data_Load_Date)  as FinMonthName,
case when month(Data_Load_Date) between 1 and 3 then year(Data_Load_Date) - 1 else year(Data_Load_Date)  end as FinYear,
CASE WHEN month(Data_Load_Date) > 3 THEN (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date)) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) + 1)) 
                      ELSE (CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date) - 1) + '-' + CONVERT(varchar, year(Data_Load_Date))) END AS Fin_Year,

b.Vertical_ordr,b.vertical,b.Function2,b.Function2_ordr 
from (select *,
dateadd(d,-1,convert(date,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))  as Data_Load_Date 
from [ELGi_LN].dbo.Employee_Details where new_emp_code between 800000 and 899999 
)a
left outer join  (select * from [ELGI-DW].dbo.HR_NewDimension2)b
on a.region_code=b.Division_Code
and a.function_code=b.Function_Code
and a.sub_function_code=b.Dept_Code
)c
where Emp_Status='ACTIVE'
and Emp_Code not in (800445,800482,800509,800510)
and Seperation_Date >
dateadd(d,-1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,year(getdate()))+'-'+RIGHT('00'+CAST(month(getdate()) AS VARCHAR(2)),2)+'-01'))


---------------------End of Method 3: International employees from Intranet---------------------------------------------------------


)A
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from vw_inflow_ATS


CREATE view [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS]
as


SELECT SalesType,productgroup,
SUM(last_year_ytd_inflow) last_year_ytd_inflow,
SUM(last_year_this_month_inflow) last_year_this_month_inflow,
SUM(this_year_ytd_inflow) this_year_ytd_inflow,
SUM(last_month_inflow) last_month_inflow,
SUM(this_month_inflow) this_month_inflow,
SUM(last_day_inflow) last_day_inflow,
SUM(last_year_day_inflow) last_year_day_inflow

FROM (
select 
SalesType,
case when SalesType='International Sales' then 'International'
WHEN productgroups='SPTC' then 'TYRE INFLATORS'
else ltrim(rtrim(upper(productgroups))) end as productgroup,  

sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))  
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_inflow,  



sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_inflow, 


sum(case when OrderDate = dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
--and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_day_inflow  

from (

select 
case 
when c.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN c.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES', 'TOOLS SPARES') then 'After Sales'
when c.ProductGroups is null then null
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,
c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Itemcode,orderdate,sum(a.sales) Sales

from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description<>'Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_prd_master c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.itemcode)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  

where 
a.Dpst not in ('90046','90047','90049','90053')  
and a.OrderDate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,getdate()) 
and concat(company,ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))
group by productgroups,dpst,a.itemcode,orderdate  



union

select 'International Sales' as SalesType,c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.ItemCode,OrderDate,sum(a.sales) Sales
from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description='Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_prd_master c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.itemcode)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  

where OrderDate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
and concat(company,ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))
group by c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate



union

select case 
when b.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN b.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES', 'TOOLS SPARES') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,
b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.ItemCode,OrderDate,sum(a.Sales) Sales
from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
inner join (
select 90047 as dpstcode,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE (TRADED)' as productgroups   
union all  
select 90046,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE(MFG)'  
union all  
select 90049,'SUPPLIER SALES'  
union all  
select 90043,'SERVICE BILLING' 
union all  
select 90053,'AUTO`SSURE'  )b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
where OrderDate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
and concat(company,ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))

group by b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.ItemCode,OrderDate

)a
group by SalesType,productgroups  
)B
GROUP BY SalesType,productgroup

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS_new]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from vw_inflow_ATS_new


CREATE view [dbo].[vw_inflow_ATS_new]
as


SELECT SalesType,productgroup,Dpst,Zone,
SUM(last_year_ytd_inflow) last_year_ytd_inflow,
SUM(last_year_this_month_inflow) last_year_this_month_inflow,
SUM(this_year_ytd_inflow) this_year_ytd_inflow,
SUM(last_month_inflow) last_month_inflow,
SUM(this_month_inflow) this_month_inflow,
SUM(last_day_inflow) last_day_inflow,
SUM(last_year_day_inflow) last_year_day_inflow

FROM (
select 
SalesType,Dpst,Zone,
case when SalesType='International Sales' then 'International'
WHEN productgroups='SPTC' then 'TYRE INFLATORS'
else ltrim(rtrim(upper(productgroups))) end as productgroup,  

sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))  
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_inflow,  



sum(case when OrderDate between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_inflow,  


sum(case when OrderDate between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_inflow, 


sum(case when OrderDate = dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
--and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_inflow,  

sum(case when OrderDate between  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.sales)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_day_inflow  

from (

select 
case 
when c.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN c.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES', 'TOOLS SPARES','PAYU INCOME','TRAINING INCOME') then 'After Sales'
when c.ProductGroups is null then null
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,
c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Itemcode,orderdate,sum(a.sales) Sales

from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description<>'Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_Prd_Master_New c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.itemcode)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item)) 
and a.Dpst=c.dpst 

where 
a.Dpst not in ('90049','90053')  
and a.OrderDate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,getdate()) 
and concat(company,ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))
group by productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.itemcode,orderdate  



union

select 'International Sales' as SalesType,c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.ItemCode,OrderDate,sum(a.sales) Sales
from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description='Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_Prd_Master_New c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.itemcode)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  
and a.Dpst=c.dpst 

where OrderDate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
and concat(company,ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))
group by c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.ItemCode,a.OrderDate

union

select case 
when b.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN b.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES', 'TOOLS SPARES') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,
b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.ItemCode,OrderDate,sum(a.Sales) Sales
from (select * from Sales_Inflow where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')) a
inner join (
--select 90047 as dpstcode,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE (TRADED)' as productgroups   
--union all  
--select 90046  as dpstcode,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE(MFG)'  as productgroups
--union all  
select 90049  as dpstcode,'SUPPLIER SALES'  as productgroups 
union all  
select 90043  as dpstcode,'SERVICE BILLING'  as productgroups
)b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
where OrderDate between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
and concat(company,ordertype) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))

group by b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.ItemCode,OrderDate



)a
group by SalesType,productgroups,Dpst,Zone
)B
GROUP BY SalesType,productgroup,Dpst,Zone

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_next_5workingdays] as
select distinct top 5 convert(date,DATE) as DATE1 ,dense_rank() over (order by DATE ) as daterank from CompanyCalendar where

and DFCA<>'4'
and DATE>=getdate()-1

create view [dbo].[vw_pbs_ats] as
select * from (
select OTBP,ITEM,BAPR,MIQT,EFDT,
exdt,row_number() over(partition by OTBP,ITEM,MIQT order by efdt desc) as ExpRank
from (select OTBP,ITEM,BAPR,EFDT,MIQT,max(EXDT) EXDT from TTDPCG031ALL
where company in (select company from ELGI_Companies_Master where CompanyGroup='ATS')
and len(OTBP)>2 
group by OTBP,ITEM,BAPR,EFDT,MIQT
having max(EXDT)>getdate()-1
)a
--For Testing Purpose
--where item='         M000003054'
)b
where ExpRank=1
--order by OTBP,ITEM,ExpRank

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

--select * from vw_sls_ATS

CREATE view [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS]
as 


SELECT SalesType,productgroup,
SUM(last_year_ytd) last_year_ytd,
SUM(last_year_this_month_sale) last_year_this_month_sale,
SUM(this_year_ytd) this_year_ytd,
SUM(last_month_sale) last_month_sale,
SUM(this_month_sale) this_month_sale,
SUM(last_day_sale) last_day_sale,
SUM(last_year_day_sale) last_year_day_sale

FROM (
select 
SalesType,
case when SalesType='International Sales' then 'International'
WHEN productgroups='SPTC' then 'TYRE INFLATORS'
else ltrim(rtrim(upper(productgroups))) end as productgroup,  
sum(case when Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))  
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_day_sale  


from 
(
select 
case 
when c.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN c.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES','Consumables', 'TOOLS SPARES') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,
c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Item,Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) Sales_amount from ATS_Sales_Details a  
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description<>'Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_prd_master c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  

where 
dpst not in (--'90043',
'90046','90047','90049','90053')  
and Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
AND a.SaleOrderType in (select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6))
group by c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Item,Invoice_Date


union

select 'International Sales' as SalesType,c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Item,Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) Sales_amount from ATS_Sales_Details a  
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description='Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_prd_master c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  

where Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
AND a.SaleOrderType in (select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6))
group by c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Item,Invoice_Date




union

select case 
when b.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN b.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES','Consumables' ,'TOOLS SPARES') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,

b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Item,Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) Sales_amount from ATS_Sales_Details a  
inner join (
select 90047 as dpstcode,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE (TRADED)' as productgroups   
union all  
select 90046,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE(MFG)'  
union all  
select 90049,'SUPPLIER SALES'  
--union all  
--select 90053,'AUTO`SSURE'  
)b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
where Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
AND a.SaleOrderType in (select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6))
group by b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Item,Invoice_Date


)a
group by SalesType,productgroups  
)B
GROUP BY SalesType,productgroup

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS_DPSTwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS_DPSTwise] as
select 
--date,
dpst,b.dpstname,b.division,
SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end ))  
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1)-1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd,- 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount)/ 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_ytd_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_sale

from ATS_Sales_Details a
inner  join 
(
select * from
(select * from DPST_Master_ATS)dpst
--union
--select * from dpstmaster where DpstCode=90252
) b on  a.dpst = b.dpstcode

where a.Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
--and concat(a.Company,a.SaleOrderType) not in (select concat(company,saleordertype) from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))
and a.SaleOrderType not in (select saleordertype from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (1))

group by 
--date,
dpst,b.DPSTName,b.division





GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS_new]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS_new]
as 


SELECT SalesType,productgroup,dpst,Zone,
SUM(last_year_ytd) last_year_ytd,
SUM(last_year_this_month_sale) last_year_this_month_sale,
SUM(this_year_ytd) this_year_ytd,
SUM(last_month_sale) last_month_sale,
SUM(this_month_sale) this_month_sale,
SUM(last_day_sale) last_day_sale,
SUM(last_year_day_sale) last_year_day_sale

FROM (
select 
SalesType,dpst,Zone,
case when SalesType='International Sales' then 'International'
WHEN productgroups='SPTC' then 'TYRE INFLATORS'
else ltrim(rtrim(upper(productgroups))) end as productgroup,  
sum(case when Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))  
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_sale,  

sum(case when Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and 
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_day_sale  


from 
(
select 
case 
when c.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN c.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES','Consumables', 'TOOLS SPARES','PAYU INCOME','TRAINING INCOME') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,
c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Item,Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) Sales_amount from ATS_Sales_Details a  
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description<>'Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_prd_master_new c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  
and ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst))=ltrim(rtrim(c.dpst))

where 
a.dpst not in ('90049','90053')--'90043'  
and Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
AND a.SaleOrderType not in (select SaleOrderType from saletype_master_ATS where Sales_Category in (1))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))<>'FRT'
group by c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Item,Invoice_Date


union

select 'International Sales' as SalesType,c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Item,Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) Sales_amount from ATS_Sales_Details a  
inner  join  (select DPSTcode from DPST_Master_ATS where description='Exports') b 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
left outer join ATS_prd_master_new c 
on ltrim(rtrim(a.item)) =ltrim(rtrim(c.item))  
and ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst))=ltrim(rtrim(c.dpst))

where Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
AND a.SaleOrderType not in (select SaleOrderType from saletype_master_ATS where Sales_Category in (1))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))<>'FRT'
group by c.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Item,Invoice_Date


union

select case 
when b.productgroups in ('SCRAP','PVD SALES','SS1/CCN','SUPPLIER SALES','SPECIAL PRODUCTS') then 'OTHER Sales'
WHEN b.productgroups in('SERVICE BILLING', 'SPARES / ACCESSORIES','Consumables' ,'TOOLS SPARES') then 'After Sales'
ELSE 'Domestic Sales'
END as SalesType,

b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Item,Invoice_Date,sum(a.Sales_amount) Sales_amount from ATS_Sales_Details a  
inner join (
--select 90047 as dpstcode,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE (TRADED)' as productgroups   
--union all  
--select 90046 as dpstcode,'COMMERCIAL VEHICLE(MFG)'   as productgroups  
--union all  
select 90049 as dpstcode,'SUPPLIER SALES'   as productgroups  
--union all  
--select 90053,'AUTO`SSURE'  
)b
on ltrim(rtrim(a.dpst)) =ltrim(rtrim(b.DPSTcode))  
where Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))
AND a.SaleOrderType not in (select SaleOrderType from saletype_master_ATS where Sales_Category in (1))
and ltrim(rtrim(a.Item))<>'FRT'
group by b.productgroups,a.dpst,a.Zone,a.Item,Invoice_Date




)a
group by SalesType,productgroups,dpst,Zone
)B
GROUP BY SalesType,productgroup,dpst,Zone









GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS_Segmentwise]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE view [dbo].[vw_sls_ATS_Segmentwise] as
select 
Segment,LOBCode,LineOfBusiness,SalesRepCode,SalesRep,--dpst,a.dpstname,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end ))  
AND 
'03/31/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1)-1 else year(getdate()-1) end ))
THEN (a.Sales_amount) / 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_year_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 2 else year(getdate()-1)-1 end )) 
and  
dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_ytd,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between 
convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,dateadd(mm,1,convert(datetime,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(yy,-1,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))))))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_year_this_month_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_year_ytd,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(mm,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_month_sale,

SUM(CASE WHEN a.Invoice_Date BETWEEN 
'04/01/' + convert(varchar,(case when month(getdate()-1) between 1 and 3 then year(getdate()-1) - 1 else year(getdate()-1) end )) 
AND 
dateadd(dd,- 1, CONVERT(varchar, datepart(mm, dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy, dateadd(dd, - 1, convert(date,getdate())))) 
THEN (a.Sales_amount)/ 1000000 ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_ytd_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between  
convert(varchar,datepart(mm,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())))) + '/1/' + datename(yy,dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate()))) 
and  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as this_month_sale,

sum(case when a.Invoice_Date between  
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
and 
dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
then (a.Sales_amount)/1000000 else 0 end)as last_day_sale

from ATS_Sales_Details a
inner  join 
(
select * from
(select * from DPST_Master_ATS)dpst
--union
--select * from dpstmaster where DpstCode=90252
) b on  a.dpst = b.dpstcode

where a.Invoice_Date between '04/01/2016' and  dateadd(dd,-1,convert(date,getdate())) 
AND a.SaleOrderType in (select SaleOrderType from SaleType_Master_ats where Sales_Category in (0,2,5,6))
and dpst not in('90046','90047')
group by Segment,LOBCode,LineOfBusiness,SalesRepCode,SalesRep--,dpst,a.dpstname



GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_subscriptionDetails]    Script Date: 1/28/2019 11:14:47 AM ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
--select * from vw_subscriptionDetails

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_subscriptionDetails] as
SELECT *,row_number()over(order by reportname) as rank from (  
Select reportname,[to],cc,[subject],laststatus,lastruntime,cast([next run date] as datetime) as [next run date],[next run time] ,mail_status  
from (  
SELECT  
c.Name AS ReportName,  
'Next Run Date' = CASE next_run_date WHEN 0 THEN null  
ELSE  substring(convert(varchar(15),next_run_date),1,4) + '/' +  
substring(convert(varchar(15),next_run_date),5,2) + '/' +  
substring(convert(varchar(15),next_run_date),7,2)  END,  
 
'Next Run Time' = isnull(CASE len(next_run_time)  
WHEN 3 THEN cast('00:0'  + Left(right(next_run_time,3),1) +':' + right(next_run_time,2) as char (8))  
WHEN 4 THEN cast('00:' + Left(right(next_run_time,4),2)  +':' + right(next_run_time,2) as char (8))  
WHEN 5 THEN cast('0' + Left(right(next_run_time,5),1) +':' + Left(right(next_run_time,4),2)  +':' + right(next_run_time,2) as char (8))  
WHEN 6 THEN cast(Left(right(next_run_time,6),2) +':' + Left(right(next_run_time,4),2) +':' + right(next_run_time,2) as char (8))  
END,'NA'),  
Convert(XML,[ExtensionSettings]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="TO"])[1]','varchar(4000)') as [To] ,
Convert(XML,[ExtensionSettings]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="CC"])[1]','varchar(4000)') as [CC] ,
Convert(XML,[ExtensionSettings]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="RenderFormat"])[1]','nvarchar(4000)') as [Render Format] ,
Convert(XML,[ExtensionSettings]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="Subject"])[1]','nvarchar(4000)') as [Subject] ,  
  
---Example report parameters: StartDateMacro, EndDateMacro &amp; Currency.  
  
Convert(XML,[Parameters]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="StartDateMacro"])[1]','nvarchar(4000)') as [Start Date] ,
Convert(XML,[Parameters]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="EndDateMacro"])[1]','nvarchar(4000)') as [End Date] ,
Convert(XML,[Parameters]).value('(//ParameterValue/Value[../Name="Currency"])[1]','nvarchar(4000)') as [Currency] ,
[LastStatus] ,[EventType] ,[LastRunTime] ,[DeliveryExtension] ,[Version] ,
case when laststatus like '%Mail sent%' or laststatus like '%The File%' then 'success'  
when  laststatus not like '%Mail sent%' and  laststatus  not like '%The File%' then 'Failed' end  as mail_status
  
FROM   
  
ReportingService_916a074721bc43a0869d72c211bd6a18.dbo.[Catalog] c  
INNER JOIN ReportingService_916a074721bc43a0869d72c211bd6a18.dbo.[Subscriptions] S 
ON c.ItemID = S.Report_OID  
INNER JOIN ReportingService_916a074721bc43a0869d72c211bd6a18.dbo.ReportSchedule R 
ON S.SubscriptionID = R.SubscriptionID  
INNER JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobs J 
ON Convert(nvarchar(128),R.ScheduleID) = J.name  
INNER JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobschedules JS 
ON J.job_id = JS.job_id
)a  
  
group by  reportname,[to],cc,[subject],laststatus,lastruntime,[next run date],[next run time],mail_status)a  
WHERE  [to] is not null


GO
USE [master]
GO
